 2388:             )
 2389:         except Exception as e:
 2390:             self._record_self_mesh_perf_observation(
 2391:                 "remote_send_dispatch",
 2392:                 (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000.0,
 2393:                 status="failed",
 2394:                 action=instr.action,
 2395:                 command_id=instr.command_id,
 2396:                 path=str(path),
 2397:                 error=str(e),
 2398:             )
 2399:             log.warning(
 2400:                 "self-mesh remote send_file failed command=%s: %s",
 2401:                 instr.command_id[:16],
 2402:                 e,
 2403:             )
 2404:             if self.state is not None:
 2405:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2406:                     self.state.record_self_mesh_audit(
 2407:                         event="remote_send_failed",
 2408:                         severity="bad",
 2409:                         root_pub=instr.root_pub,
 2410:                         device_pub=instr.target_device_pub,
 2411:                         command_id=instr.command_id,
 2412:                         action=instr.action,
 2413:                         path=str(path),
 2414:                         detail=str(e),
 2415:                     )
 2416:             self._broadcast_self_mesh_changed(
 2417:                 reason="remote_instruction_failed",
 2418:                 action=instr.action,
 2419:                 command_id=instr.command_id,
 2420:                 error=str(e),
 2421:             )
 2422: 
 2423:     async def _run_self_mesh_instruction(self, instr) -> dict[str, Any]:
 2424:         if instr.action == "pull_file_manifest":
 2425:             manifest_path = str(instr.scope.get("path") or "")
 2426:             if not manifest_path:
 2427:                 raise ValueError("scope.path required")
 2428:             return {"manifest": self._self_mesh_file_manifest(manifest_path)}
 2429:         if instr.action == "send_file_from_device":
 2430:             path = Path(str(instr.scope.get("path") or "")).expanduser().resolve()
 2431:             if not self._self_mesh_path_allowed(path):
 2432:                 raise ValueError("path is outside allowed self-mesh roots")
 2433:             if not path.is_file():
 2434:                 raise ValueError("scope.path is not a file")
 2435:             max_bytes = int(instr.scope.get("max_bytes") or 0)
 2436:             size = path.stat().st_size
 2437:             if max_bytes > 0 and size > max_bytes:
 2438:                 raise ValueError("file exceeds scoped max_bytes")
 2439:             recipient = str(instr.scope.get("recipient_fp") or "")
 2440:             if not recipient:
 2441:                 raise ValueError("scope.recipient_fp required")
 2442:             peer = await self.resolve_for_send(recipient)
 2443:             if peer is None:
 2444:                 raise ValueError("recipient is not reachable or not pinned")
 2445:             if self.state is not None:
 2446:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2447:                     self.state.record_self_mesh_audit(
 2448:                         event="remote_send_queued",
 2449:                         severity="info",
 2450:                         root_pub=instr.root_pub,
 2451:                         device_pub=instr.target_device_pub,
 2452:                         peer_fp=recipient,
 2453:                         command_id=instr.command_id,
 2454:                         action=instr.action,
 2455:                         path=str(path),
 2456:                         detail=f"queued {path.name}",
 2457:                     )
 2458:             asyncio.create_task(
 2459:                 self._execute_self_mesh_send_file_instruction(instr, peer, path)
 2460:             )
 2461:             return {
 2462:                 "queued": True,
 2463:                 "recipient": recipient,
 2464:                 "path": str(path),
 2465:                 "size": int(size),
 2466:             }
 2467:         raise ValueError(f"unsupported self-mesh action {instr.action!r}")
 2468: 
 2469:     @staticmethod
 2470:     def _self_mesh_action_capability(action: str) -> str | None:
 2471:         return {
 2472:             "pull_file_manifest": SELF_MESH_MANIFEST,
 2473:             "send_file_from_device": SELF_MESH_SEND,
 2474:         }.get(action)
 2475: 
 2476:     def _self_mesh_allowed_roots(self) -> list[Path]:
 2477:         roots: list[Path] = []
 2478:         with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2479:             roots.append(inbox_dir().resolve())
 2480:         if self.state is not None:
 2481:             with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2482:                 configured = self.state.get_setting("self_mesh_allowed_roots") or ""
 2483:                 for part in configured.split(os.pathsep):
 2484:                     if part.strip():
 2485:                         roots.append(Path(part.strip()).expanduser().resolve())
 2486:             with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2487:                 for folder in self.state.list_folders():
 2488:                     p = folder.get("local_path")
 2489:                     if p:
 2490:                         roots.append(Path(str(p)).expanduser().resolve())
 2491:         deduped: list[Path] = []
 2492:         seen: set[str] = set()
 2493:         for root in roots:
 2494:             key = os.path.normcase(str(root))
 2495:             if key not in seen:
 2496:                 seen.add(key)
 2497:                 deduped.append(root)
 2498:         return deduped
 2499: 
 2500:     def set_self_mesh_allowed_roots(self, roots: list[str]) -> list[Path]:
 2501:         """Persist operator-approved roots for remote self-mesh actions."""
 2502:         clean: list[Path] = []
 2503:         seen: set[str] = set()
 2504:         for raw in roots:
 2505:             text = str(raw or "").strip().strip('"')
 2506:             if not text:
 2507:                 continue
 2508:             path = Path(text).expanduser().resolve()
 2509:             if not path.exists():
 2510:                 raise ValueError(f"allowed root does not exist: {path}")
 2511:             if not path.is_dir():
 2512:                 raise ValueError(f"allowed root is not a directory: {path}")
 2513:             key = os.path.normcase(str(path))
 2514:             if key not in seen:
 2515:                 seen.add(key)
 2516:                 clean.append(path)
 2517:         if self.state is None:
 2518:             raise ValueError("state unavailable")
 2519:         self.state.set_setting(
 2520:             "self_mesh_allowed_roots",
 2521:             os.pathsep.join(str(p) for p in clean),
 2522:         )
 2523:         self.state.record_self_mesh_audit(
 2524:             event="allowed_roots_changed",
 2525:             severity="info",
 2526:             detail=f"{len(clean)} configured remote file root(s)",
 2527:             metadata={"configured_roots": [str(p) for p in clean]},
 2528:         )
 2529:         self._broadcast_self_mesh_changed(reason="allowed_roots_changed")
 2530:         return self._self_mesh_allowed_roots()
 2531: 
 2532:     def _record_self_mesh_perf_observation(
 2533:         self,
 2534:         metric: str,
 2535:         duration_ms: float,
 2536:         *,
 2537:         status: str = "ready",
 2538:         **metadata: Any,
 2539:     ) -> None:
 2540:         if self.state is None:
 2541:             return
 2542:         sample = {
 2543:             "route_probe_runs": 0,
 2544:             "route_probe_ready": 0,
 2545:             "route_probe_total_ms": 0.0,
 2546:             "route_probe_avg_ms": 0.0,
 2547:             "presence_rows": 0,
 2548:             "device_rows": 0,
 2549:             "recent_audit_rows": 0,
 2550:             "status": status,
 2551:             "metric": str(metric)[:80],
 2552:             "duration_ms": round(max(0.0, float(duration_ms)), 4),
 2553:             **metadata,
 2554:         }
 2555:         with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2556:             sample["presence_rows"] = len(self.state.list_self_mesh_presence())
 2557:             sample["device_rows"] = len(self.state.list_self_mesh_devices())
 2558:             sample["recent_audit_rows"] = len(self.state.list_self_mesh_audit(limit=200))
 2559:         with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2560:             self.state.record_self_mesh_perf_sample(sample)
 2561: 
 2562:     def _self_mesh_path_allowed(self, path: Path) -> bool:
 2563:         try:
 2564:             resolved = path.resolve()
 2565:         except Exception:
 2566:             return False
 2567:         for root in self._self_mesh_allowed_roots():
 2568:             try:
 2569:                 resolved.relative_to(root)
 2570:                 return True
 2571:             except ValueError:
 2572:                 continue
 2573:             except Exception:
 2574:                 continue
 2575:         return False

 2577:     async def _handle_self_mesh_remote_instruction(
 2578:         self,
 2579:         channel: ch.Channel,
 2580:         msg: dict,
 2581:         peer_fp: str,
 2582:     ) -> None:
 2583:         total_started = time.perf_counter()
 2584:         try:
 2585:             if self.state is None:
 2586:                 raise ValueError("state unavailable")
 2587:             if not self._is_pinned(peer_fp):
 2588:                 raise ValueError("peer_not_pinned")
 2589:             command_b64 = str(msg.get("command_b64") or "")
 2590:             if not command_b64:
 2591:                 raise ValueError("command_b64 required")
 2592:             command = self._self_mesh_b64u_decode(command_b64)
 2593:             body = json.loads(command.decode("utf-8"))
 2594:             root_pub = self._self_mesh_b64u_decode(str(body.get("root_pub_b64", "")))
 2595:             targets = self._self_mesh_command_contexts(root_pub)
 2596:             if not targets:
 2597:                 raise ValueError("no local self-mesh target for root")
 2598:             last_error: Exception | None = None
 2599:             instr = None
 2600:             verify_started = time.perf_counter()
 2601:             for target in targets:
 2602:                 try:
 2603:                     instr = verify_remote_instruction(
 2604:                         command,
 2605:                         expected_root_pub=root_pub,
 2606:                         expected_target_device_pub=target,
 2607:                     )
 2608:                     break
 2609:                 except Exception as e:
 2610:                     last_error = e
 2611:             if instr is None:
 2612:                 raise ValueError(
 2613:                     f"remote instruction target rejected: {last_error}"
 2614:                 )
 2615:             controller_row = self.state.get_self_mesh_device(
 2616:                 root_pub=instr.root_pub,
 2617:                 device_pub=instr.controller_device_pub,
 2618:             )
 2619:             if controller_row is None:
 2620:                 cert = verify_device_cert(
 2621:                     instr.controller_cert,
 2622:                     expected_root_pub=instr.root_pub,
 2623:                 )
 2624:                 controller_row = self.state.upsert_self_mesh_device(
 2625:                     root_pub=instr.root_pub,
 2626:                     device_pub=instr.controller_device_pub,
 2627:                     cert=instr.controller_cert,
 2628:                     device_kind=cert.device_kind,
 2629:                     label=cert.device_kind,
 2630:                     local=False,
 2631:                     trusted=True,
 2632:                     safety_state="trusted",
 2633:                     metadata={
 2634:                         "source": "remote_instruction_controller_cert",
 2635:                         "peer_fp": peer_fp,
 2636:                     },
 2637:                 )
 2638:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2639:                     self.state.record_self_mesh_audit(
 2640:                         event="controller_cert_learned",
 2641:                         severity="info",
 2642:                         root_pub=instr.root_pub,
 2643:                         device_pub=instr.controller_device_pub,
 2644:                         peer_fp=peer_fp,
 2645:                         command_id=instr.command_id,
 2646:                         action=instr.action,
 2647:                         detail="trusted root-signed controller cert learned",
 2648:                     )
 2649:             if controller_row.get("revoked") or safety_blocks_remote_instruction(
 2650:                 controller_row.get("safety_state")
 2651:             ):
 2652:                 raise ValueError(
 2653:                     f"controller device blocked by Guardian: "
 2654:                     f"{controller_row.get('safety_state') or 'revoked'}"
 2655:                 )
 2656:             target_row = self.state.get_self_mesh_device(
 2657:                 root_pub=instr.root_pub,
 2658:                 device_pub=instr.target_device_pub,
 2659:             )
 2660:             if target_row is None:
 2661:                 raise ValueError("target device is not enrolled")
 2662:             if target_row.get("revoked") or safety_blocks_remote_instruction(
 2663:                 target_row.get("safety_state")
 2664:             ):
 2665:                 raise ValueError(
 2666:                     f"target device blocked by Guardian: "
 2667:                     f"{target_row.get('safety_state') or 'revoked'}"
 2668:                 )
 2669:             self._record_self_mesh_perf_observation(
 2670:                 "command_verify",
 2671:                 (time.perf_counter() - verify_started) * 1000.0,
 2672:                 action=instr.action,
 2673:                 target_count=len(targets),
 2674:                 command_id=instr.command_id,
 2675:             )
 2676:             required_cap = self._self_mesh_action_capability(instr.action)
 2677:             if required_cap is None:
 2678:                 raise ValueError(f"unsupported self-mesh action {instr.action!r}")
 2679:             if not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, required_cap):
 2680:                 self._emit_capability_request(
 2681:                     peer_fp,
 2682:                     getattr(channel, "peer_short_id", peer_fp[:8]),
 2683:                     required_cap,
 2684:                 )
 2685:                 raise ValueError(f"capability disabled: {required_cap}")
 2686:             replay_started = time.perf_counter()
 2687:             first_seen = self.state.mark_remote_instruction_seen(
 2688:                 command_id=instr.command_id,
 2689:                 expires_ms=instr.expires_ms,
 2690:                 action=instr.action,
 2691:                 controller_device_pub=instr.controller_device_pub,
 2692:                 target_device_pub=instr.target_device_pub,
 2693:             )
 2694:             self._record_self_mesh_perf_observation(
 2695:                 "command_replay_check",
 2696:                 (time.perf_counter() - replay_started) * 1000.0,
 2697:                 status="ready" if first_seen else "replay_blocked",
 2698:                 action=instr.action,
 2699:                 command_id=instr.command_id,
 2700:             )
 2701:             if not first_seen:
 2702:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2703:                     self.state.record_self_mesh_audit(
 2704:                         event="command_replay_blocked",
 2705:                         severity="bad",
 2706:                         root_pub=instr.root_pub,
 2707:                         device_pub=instr.target_device_pub,
 2708:                         peer_fp=peer_fp,
 2709:                         command_id=instr.command_id,
 2710:                         action=instr.action,
 2711:                         detail="remote instruction replay blocked",
 2712:                     )
 2713:                 raise ValueError("remote instruction replayed")
 2714:             run_started = time.perf_counter()
 2715:             result = await self._run_self_mesh_instruction(instr)
 2716:             self._record_self_mesh_perf_observation(
 2717:                 "command_execute",
 2718:                 (time.perf_counter() - run_started) * 1000.0,
 2719:                 action=instr.action,
 2720:                 command_id=instr.command_id,
 2721:             )
 2722:             with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2723:                 self.state.record_self_mesh_audit(
 2724:                     event="command_accepted",
 2725:                     severity="good",
 2726:                     root_pub=instr.root_pub,
 2727:                     device_pub=instr.target_device_pub,
 2728:                     peer_fp=peer_fp,
 2729:                     command_id=instr.command_id,
 2730:                     action=instr.action,
 2731:                     path=str(instr.scope.get("path") or ""),
 2732:                     detail=f"accepted {instr.action}",
 2733:                     metadata={"result": result},
 2734:                 )
 2735:             self._broadcast_self_mesh_changed(
 2736:                 reason="remote_instruction_accepted",
 2737:                 action=instr.action,
 2738:                 command_id=instr.command_id,
 2739:             )
 2740:             self._record_self_mesh_perf_observation(
 2741:                 "command_total",
 2742:                 (time.perf_counter() - total_started) * 1000.0,
 2743:                 status="accepted",
 2744:                 action=instr.action,
 2745:                 command_id=instr.command_id,
 2746:             )
 2747:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 2748:                 "ACK",
 2749:                 self.me.short_id,
 2750:                 of=msg.get("id"),
 2751:                 ok=True,
 2752:                 action=instr.action,
 2753:                 command_id=instr.command_id,
 2754:                 result=result,
 2755:             )))
 2756:         except Exception as e:
 2757:             self._record_self_mesh_perf_observation(
 2758:                 "command_total",
 2759:                 (time.perf_counter() - total_started) * 1000.0,
 2760:                 status="rejected",
 2761:                 error=str(e),
 2762:             )
 2763:             log.warning(
 2764:                 "self-mesh remote instruction rejected from %s: %s",
 2765:                 peer_fp[:8],
 2766:                 e,
 2767:             )
 2768:             with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2769:                 if self.state is not None:
 2770:                     self.state.record_self_mesh_audit(
 2771:                         event="command_rejected",
 2772:                         severity="warn",
 2773:                         peer_fp=peer_fp,
 2774:                         action=str(msg.get("action") or ""),
 2775:                         detail=str(e),
 2776:                     )
 2777:             with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2778:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 2779:                     "ACK",
 2780:                     self.me.short_id,
 2781:                     of=msg.get("id"),
 2782:                     rejected=f"self_mesh_instruction_rejected: {e}",
 2783:                 )))
 2784: 
 2785:     def _apply_settings_at_boot(self) -> None:
 2786:         """v0.10.0: read settings that affect global daemon state +
 2787:         apply them once at startup. Lets the user keep their
 2788:         download_folder + log_level preferences across restarts.
 2789: 
 2790:         Each setting is wrapped in its own try so a malformed value
 2791:         from an older build doesn't take down the boot."""
 2792:         if self.state is None:
 2793:             return
 2794:         # Custom download folder. Re-validate at boot since the path
 2795:         # on disk may have moved / been deleted since the user set it.
 2796:         # On failure, fall back to default + log.
 2797:         with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2798:             from one_link.paths import set_inbox_override
 2799:             saved = self.state.get_setting("download_folder")
 2800:             if saved:
 2801:                 from pathlib import Path as _Path
 2802:                 p = _Path(saved)
 2803:                 if p.is_dir() and os.access(p, os.W_OK):
 2804:                     set_inbox_override(p.resolve())
 2805:                     log.info("download folder override active: %s", p)
 2806:                 else:
 2807:                     log.warning(
 2808:                         "download_folder setting %r is not a "
 2809:                         "writable directory; using default inbox",
 2810:                         saved,
 2811:                     )
 2812:         # Persisted log level.
 2813:         with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2814:             level = (self.state.get_setting("log_level") or "").lower()
 2815:             if level in ("error", "warn", "info", "debug"):
 2816:                 import logging as _logging
 2817:                 level_map = {
 2818:                     "error": _logging.ERROR, "warn": _logging.WARNING,
 2819:                     "info":  _logging.INFO,  "debug": _logging.DEBUG,
 2820:                 }
 2821:                 _logging.getLogger("one_link").setLevel(level_map[level])
 2822:         # v0.12.0: bandwidth + auto-accept cache.
 2823:         self.refresh_runtime_settings()
 2824: 
 2825:     def refresh_runtime_settings(self) -> None:
 2826:         """v0.12.0: re-read settings that the daemon caches in
 2827:         memory for hot-path use. Called at boot AND from
 2828:         UIServer.api_set_settings after the user saves, so changes
 2829:         apply live without a restart.
 2830: 
 2831:         Currently caches:
 2832:           - bandwidth_cap_kbps  (drives self.bandwidth_pacer)
 2833:           - auto_accept_max_size_mb
 2834:           - auto_accept_extensions
 2835:         """
 2836:         if self.state is None:
 2837:             return
 2838:         with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2839:             raw = self.state.get_setting("bandwidth_cap_kbps")
 2840:             cap = 0
 2841:             if raw:
 2842:                 try:
 2843:                     cap = int(raw)
 2844:                 except (TypeError, ValueError):
 2845:                     cap = 0
 2846:             self.bandwidth_pacer.set_cap(max(0, cap))
 2847:         with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2848:             raw = self.state.get_setting("auto_accept_max_size_mb")
 2849:             mb = 0
 2850:             if raw:
 2851:                 try:
 2852:                     mb = int(raw)
 2853:                 except (TypeError, ValueError):
 2854:                     mb = 0
 2855:             self._auto_accept_max_size_bytes = max(0, mb) * 1024 * 1024
 2856:         with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2857:             raw = self.state.get_setting("auto_accept_extensions") or ""
 2858:             self._auto_accept_extensions = {
 2859:                 e.strip().lstrip(".").lower()
 2860:                 for e in raw.split(",") if e.strip()
 2861:             }
 2862:         with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2863:             max_tb = self.state.get_setting("safety_max_file_tb")
 2864:             reserve_mb = self.state.get_setting("safety_min_free_mb")
 2865:             peer_active = self.state.get_setting("safety_peer_active_transfers")
 2866:             peer_bytes_gb = self.state.get_setting("safety_peer_active_gb")
 2867:             self._transfer_admission_policy = TransferAdmissionPolicy(
 2868:                 max_declared_bytes=(
 2869:                     max(1, int(max_tb)) * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
 2870:                     if max_tb else MAX_DECLARED_FILE_OFFER_BYTES
 2871:                 ),
 2872:                 min_free_reserve_bytes=(
 2873:                     max(256, int(reserve_mb)) * 1024 * 1024
 2874:                     if reserve_mb else TransferAdmissionPolicy().min_free_reserve_bytes
 2875:                 ),
 2876:                 max_active_inbound_transfers_per_peer=(
 2877:                     max(1, int(peer_active))
 2878:                     if peer_active
 2879:                     else TransferAdmissionPolicy().max_active_inbound_transfers_per_peer
 2880:                 ),
 2881:                 max_active_inbound_bytes_per_peer=(
 2882:                     max(1, int(peer_bytes_gb)) * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
 2883:                     if peer_bytes_gb
 2884:                     else TransferAdmissionPolicy().max_active_inbound_bytes_per_peer
 2885:                 ),
 2886:             )
 2887: 
 2888:     def _file_passes_auto_accept(self, *, name: str, size: int) -> tuple[bool, str]:
 2889:         """v0.12.0: check the inbound file against the user's
 2890:         auto-accept rules. Returns (ok, reason). ok=False blocks
 2891:         the offer with the reason surfaced to the sender."""
 2892:         if self._auto_accept_max_size_bytes > 0 and size > self._auto_accept_max_size_bytes:
 2893:             return False, "exceeds_max_size"
 2894:         if self._auto_accept_extensions:
 2895:             ext = ""
 2896:             if "." in name:
 2897:                 ext = name.rsplit(".", 1)[1].lower()
 2898:             if ext not in self._auto_accept_extensions:
 2899:                 return False, "extension_blocked"
 2900:         return True, ""
 2901: 
 2902:     def _active_inbound_load_for_peer(self, peer_fp: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
 2903:         if self.state is None:
 2904:             return 0, 0
 2905:         count = 0
 2906:         total = 0
 2907:         with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 2908:             for r in self.state.list_transfers(peer_fp=peer_fp, limit=500):
 2909:                 if r.direction != "in" or r.status not in ("offered", "active", "queued"):
 2910:                     continue
 2911:                 count += 1
 2912:                 remaining = max(0, int(r.total_bytes or r.size or 0) - int(r.progress_bytes or 0))
 2913:                 total += remaining
 2914:         return count, total

 2916:     def _transfer_admission_context(
 2917:         self,
 2918:         *,
 2919:         peer_fp: str,
 2920:         already_known_bytes: int = 0,
 2921:     ) -> TransferAdmissionContext:
 2922:         active_count, active_bytes = self._active_inbound_load_for_peer(peer_fp)
 2923:         return TransferAdmissionContext(
 2924:             incoming_dir=inbox_dir(),
 2925:             active_inbound_count_for_peer=active_count,
 2926:             active_inbound_bytes_for_peer=active_bytes,
 2927:             already_known_bytes=already_known_bytes,
 2928:         )

 2930:     async def _reject_file_offer(
 2931:         self,
 2932:         channel,
 2933:         msg: dict,
 2934:         *,
 2935:         peer_fp: str,
 2936:         name: str,
 2937:         size: int,
 2938:         blob: str | None,
 2939:         reason: str,
 2940:         user_message: str = "",
 2941:         metadata: dict | None = None,
 2942:     ) -> None:
 2943:         transfer_id = f"in:{blob}" if blob and self._valid_blob_hex(blob) else f"in:rejected:{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
 2944:         self._upsert_transfer(
 2945:             id=transfer_id,
 2946:             direction="in",
 2947:             peer_fp=peer_fp,
 2948:             kind="file",
 2949:             name=name,
 2950:             size=max(0, int(size or 0)),
 2951:             blob_hash=blob if blob and self._valid_blob_hex(blob) else None,
 2952:             status="failed",
 2953:             progress_bytes=0,
 2954:             total_bytes=max(0, int(size or 0)),
 2955:             chunks_done=0,
 2956:             chunks_total=0,
 2957:             metadata={
 2958:                 "mode": "rejected",
 2959:                 "delivery_state": "blocked",
 2960:                 "error": reason,
 2961:                 "error_class": "TransferAdmissionDenied",
 2962:                 "user_message": user_message
 2963:                 or "One Link blocked this file before any bytes were received.",
 2964:                 "admission": metadata or {},
 2965:             },
 2966:         )

 2991:     def _broadcast_key_change_if_present(self, peer_rec) -> None:
 2992:         """v0.7.8: if `state.upsert_peer` just detected a hostname-pubkey

 3039:     def _mark_transfer_waiting(
 3040:         self,
 3041:         transfer_id: str,
 3042:         *,
 3043:         path: Path,
 3044:         error: str,
 3045:         error_class: str,
 3046:         base_metadata: dict | None = None,
 3047:     ):
 3048:         now_ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
 3049:         current = self.state.get_transfer(transfer_id) if self.state else None
 3050:         metadata = {
 3051:             **(base_metadata or {}),
 3052:             **((current.metadata if current else {}) or {}),
 3053:         }
 3054:         attempts = int(metadata.get("attempts") or 0) + 1
 3055:         metadata.update({
 3056:             "path": str(path),
 3057:             "error": str(error)[:500],
 3058:             "error_class": str(error_class)[:120],
 3059:             "transient": True,
 3060:             "paused_at_ms": now_ms,
 3061:             "last_attempt_ms": now_ms,
 3062:             "attempts": attempts,
 3063:             "next_retry_ms": now_ms + _delivery_backoff_ms_for_error(
 3064:                 attempts,
 3065:                 error,
 3066:             ),
 3067:             "delivery_state": "waiting_for_device",
 3068:         })
 3069:         diagnosis = diagnose_transfer({
 3070:             "status": "paused",
 3071:             "direction": "out",
 3072:             "metadata": metadata,
 3073:         }, now_ms=now_ms).to_dict()
 3074:         metadata.update({
 3075:             "doctor": diagnosis,
 3076:             "auto_action": diagnosis["action"],
 3077:             "user_message": diagnosis["user_message"],
 3078:         })
 3079:         return self._update_transfer(
 3080:             transfer_id,
 3081:             status="paused",
 3082:             metadata=metadata,
 3083:         )

 3085:     def queue_file_transfer(
 3086:         self,
 3087:         *,
 3088:         peer_fp: str,
 3089:         path: Path,
 3090:         reason: str = "peer offline",
 3091:         schedule_resume: bool = True,
 3092:     ):
 3093:         """Create the durable transfer intent before any live route exists."""
 3094:         if self.state is None:
 3095:             raise RuntimeError("state not available")
 3096:         rec = self.state.get_peer(peer_fp)
 3097:         if rec is None or rec.trust != "pinned":
 3098:             raise RuntimeError("file queue requires a pinned peer")
 3099:         path = Path(path)
 3100:         size = path.stat().st_size
 3101:         file_index = index_path(path)
 3102:         transfer_id = f"out:{file_index.blob_hash}:{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
 3103:         source_path = self._stage_queued_file_source(
 3104:             path,
 3105:             transfer_id=transfer_id,
 3106:         )
 3107:         now_ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
 3108:         queued = self._upsert_transfer(
 3109:             id=transfer_id,
 3110:             direction="out",
 3111:             peer_fp=peer_fp,
 3112:             kind="file",
 3113:             name=path.name,
 3114:             size=size,
 3115:             blob_hash=file_index.blob_hash,
 3116:             status="paused",
 3117:             progress_bytes=0,
 3118:             total_bytes=size,
 3119:             chunks_done=0,
 3120:             chunks_total=len(file_index.chunks),
 3121:             metadata={
 3122:                 "mode": "cdc",
 3123:                 "path": str(source_path),
 3124:                 "original_path": str(path),
 3125:                 "source_staged": str(source_path) != str(path),
 3126:                 "queued_at_ms": now_ms,
 3127:                 "paused_at_ms": now_ms,
 3128:                 "attempts": 0,
 3129:                 "next_retry_ms": now_ms,
 3130:                 "transient": True,
 3131:                 "delivery_state": "waiting_for_device",
 3132:                 "error": reason,
 3133:                 "error_class": "PeerOffline",
 3134:             },
 3135:         )
 3136:         if queued is not None:
 3137:             diag = diagnose_transfer(queued, now_ms=now_ms).to_dict()
 3138:             self._update_transfer(
 3139:                 queued.id,
 3140:                 metadata={
 3141:                     **(queued.metadata or {}),
 3142:                     "doctor": diag,
 3143:                     "auto_action": diag["action"],
 3144:                     "user_message": diag["user_message"],
 3145:                 },
 3146:             )
 3147:         if schedule_resume:
 3148:             self._schedule_resume_paused(peer_fp)
 3149:         return queued
 3150: 
 3151:     def _stage_queued_file_source(self, path: Path, *, transfer_id: str) -> Path:
 3152:         """Make queued file sends independent of caller-owned temp paths.
 3153: 
 3154:         Browser uploads are already staged under One Link's upload store before
 3155:         transfer begins. Control/CLI live gates can point at temp files, though;
 3156:         a durable intent cannot depend on those surviving a daemon restart.
 3157:         """
 3158:         path = Path(path)
 3159:         try:
 3160:             uploads_root = (data_dir() / "uploads").resolve()
 3161:             if path.resolve().is_relative_to(uploads_root):
 3162:                 return path
 3163:         except Exception:
 3164:             pass
 3165:         stage_dir = data_dir() / "uploads" / "queued"
 3166:         stage_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 3167:         safe_id = "".join(
 3168:             ch if ch.isalnum() or ch in ("-", "_") else "_"
 3169:             for ch in transfer_id
 3170:         )[:96]
 3171:         safe_name = path.name.replace("/", "_").replace("\\", "_")[:160]
 3172:         staged = stage_dir / f"{safe_id}_{safe_name}"
 3173:         if staged.exists():
 3174:             return staged
 3175:         tmp = staged.with_suffix(staged.suffix + f".{os.getpid()}.tmp")
 3176:         shutil.copy2(path, tmp)
 3177:         os.replace(tmp, staged)
 3178:         return staged
