 3180:     def _mark_due_transfers_waiting_for_peer(
 3181:         self,
 3182:         peer_fp: str,
 3183:         *,
 3184:         reason: str,
 3185:         error_class: str,
 3186:     ) -> int:
 3187:         """Back off due outbound intents for a peer that is not sendable.
 3188: 
 3189:         This keeps the background queue quiet: an offline peer should not
 3190:         trigger scary errors or tight retry loops; the durable rows remain
 3191:         Waiting and the next backoff window/session-up will try again.
 3192:         """
 3193:         if self.state is None:
 3194:             return 0
 3195:         now_ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
 3196:         try:
 3197:             rows = self.state.list_transfers(peer_fp=peer_fp, limit=200)
 3198:         except Exception:
 3199:             return 0
 3200:         marked = 0
 3201:         for r in rows:
 3202:             if r.direction != "out" or r.status not in ("paused", "queued"):
 3203:                 continue
 3204:             meta = r.metadata or {}
 3205:             if int(meta.get("next_retry_ms") or 0) > now_ms:
 3206:                 continue
 3207:             self._mark_transfer_waiting(
 3208:                 r.id,
 3209:                 path=Path(meta.get("path") or r.name),
 3210:                 error=reason,
 3211:                 error_class=error_class,
 3212:                 base_metadata=meta,
 3213:             )
 3214:             marked += 1
 3215:         return marked
 3216: 
 3217:     # v0.6.3: transfer-ledger watchdog.
 3218:     STUCK_TRANSFER_DEADLINE_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000  # 5 min without progress
 3219:     STUCK_TRANSFER_PLANNING_DEADLINE_MS = 2 * 60 * 1000
 3220: 
 3221:     def _reap_stuck_transfers(self) -> int:
 3222:         """Mark any stale active transfer as paused/retryable if it
 3223:         hasn't been updated in STUCK_TRANSFER_DEADLINE_MS. Defends
 3224:         the UI against silent stalls (peer crashed, NAT dropped the
 3225:         connection, network change). Returns the count reaped."""
 3226:         if self.state is None:
 3227:             return 0
 3228:         now_ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
 3229:         cutoff = now_ms - self.STUCK_TRANSFER_DEADLINE_MS
 3230:         try:
 3231:             transfers = self.state.list_transfers(limit=500)
 3232:         except Exception:
 3233:             return 0
 3234:         reaped = 0
 3235:         for t in transfers:
 3236:             meta = t.metadata or {}
 3237:             if t.status == "queued" and meta.get("mode") == "planning":
 3238:                 planning_cutoff = now_ms - self.STUCK_TRANSFER_PLANNING_DEADLINE_MS
 3239:                 if t.updated_ms > planning_cutoff:
 3240:                     continue
 3241:                 src_path = Path(meta.get("path") or t.name)
 3242:                 if not src_path.is_file():
 3243:                     self._update_transfer(
 3244:                         t.id,
 3245:                         status="failed",
 3246:                         metadata={
 3247:                             **meta,
 3248:                             "error": f"source file no longer exists: {src_path}",
 3249:                             "error_class": "FileNotFoundError",
 3250:                             "transient": False,
 3251:                             "delivery_state": "needs_attention",
 3252:                             "reaped": True,
 3253:                             "reaped_reason": "planning_source_missing",
 3254:                             "reaped_at_ms": now_ms,
 3255:                         },
 3256:                     )
 3257:                     reaped += 1
 3258:                     continue
 3259:                 self._mark_transfer_waiting(
 3260:                     t.id,
 3261:                     path=src_path,
 3262:                     error="send was interrupted before transfer started; resuming automatically",
 3263:                     error_class="PlanningInterrupted",
 3264:                     base_metadata={
 3265:                         **meta,
 3266:                         "reaped": True,
 3267:                         "reaped_reason": "stale_planning_row",
 3268:                         "reaped_at_ms": now_ms,
 3269:                     },
 3270:                 )
 3271:                 reaped += 1
 3272:                 continue
 3273:             if t.status not in ("offered", "active"):
 3274:                 continue
 3275:             if t.updated_ms > cutoff:
 3276:                 continue
 3277:             try:
 3278:                 self._mark_transfer_waiting(
 3279:                     t.id,
 3280:                     path=Path(meta.get("path") or t.name),
 3281:                     error="transfer stalled; waiting to resume automatically",
 3282:                     error_class="StalledTransfer",
 3283:                     base_metadata={
 3284:                         **meta,
 3285:                         "reaped": True,
 3286:                         "reaped_reason": "no_progress_within_deadline",
 3287:                         "reaped_at_ms": now_ms,
 3288:                     },
 3289:                 )
 3290:                 reaped += 1
 3291:                 log.info(
 3292:                     "reaped stuck transfer %s (%s, last update %d ms ago)",
 3293:                     t.id, t.status, now_ms - t.updated_ms,
 3294:                 )
 3295:             except Exception as e:
 3296:                 log.warning("could not reap transfer %s: %s", t.id, e)
 3297:         return reaped
 3298: 
 3299:     # ─── peer (encrypted) side ──────────────────────────────────────────
 3300:     def _handshake_admit(self, ip: str) -> bool:
 3301:         """H3: per-IP rate + concurrency gate. Returns True if accepted.
 3302: 
 3303:         Loopback bypasses the gate — the local UI / CLI / test runner all
 3304:         talk to the daemon on 127.0.0.1 and an attacker who already has
 3305:         loopback access has bigger primitives than handshake spam.
 3306:         """
 3307:         if ip in HANDSHAKE_LOOPBACK_IPS:
 3308:             return True
 3309:         now = time.monotonic()
 3310:         cutoff = now - HANDSHAKE_PER_IP_RATE_WINDOW_S
 3311:         history = self._handshake_history.setdefault(ip, [])
 3312:         # Drop expired timestamps.
 3313:         i = 0
 3314:         for ts in history:
 3315:             if ts >= cutoff:
 3316:                 break
 3317:             i += 1
 3318:         if i:
 3319:             del history[:i]
 3320:         if len(history) >= HANDSHAKE_PER_IP_RATE_MAX:
 3321:             return False
 3322:         if self._handshake_inflight.get(ip, 0) >= HANDSHAKE_PER_IP_INFLIGHT_MAX:
 3323:             return False
 3324:         history.append(now)
 3325:         self._handshake_inflight[ip] = self._handshake_inflight.get(ip, 0) + 1
 3326:         return True
 3327: 
 3328:     def _handshake_release(self, ip: str) -> None:
 3329:         if ip in HANDSHAKE_LOOPBACK_IPS:
 3330:             return
 3331:         n = self._handshake_inflight.get(ip, 0) - 1
 3332:         if n <= 0:
 3333:             self._handshake_inflight.pop(ip, None)
 3334:         else:
 3335:             self._handshake_inflight[ip] = n
 3336:         # If the rate-limit window is empty too, drop the bucket so the
 3337:         # dicts can't grow without bound under churn.
 3338:         if (
 3339:             ip not in self._handshake_inflight
 3340:             and not self._handshake_history.get(ip)
 3341:         ):
 3342:             self._handshake_history.pop(ip, None)
 3343: 
 3344:     async def _handle_peer(
 3345:         self,
 3346:         reader: asyncio.StreamReader,
 3347:         writer: asyncio.StreamWriter,
 3348:         *,
 3349:         regime: str | None = None,
 3350:     ) -> None:
 3351:         """Inbound peer handler. `regime` is set by the caller:
 3352:           - None (TCP path): classified post-handshake from the
 3353:             socket's peer address.
 3354:           - "relay" (relay tunnel path): set by
 3355:             _handle_relay_inbound_session — the writer is a synthetic
 3356:             relay stream and `peername` would be misleading.
 3357:         """
 3358:         addr = writer.get_extra_info("peername")
 3359:         peer_ip = addr[0] if addr else ""
 3360:         # v0.20.7 (security audit M8): refuse fast at the global
 3361:         # concurrent-peer ceiling. Counter-based; asyncio is single-
 3362:         # threaded so check-then-increment is atomic. The counter
 3363:         # increments only after the cap check passes, so the limit
 3364:         # is observed even under burst arrival.
 3365:         if self._inbound_peer_count >= MAX_TOTAL_PEER_CONNECTIONS:
 3366:             log.warning(
 3367:                 "peer connection refused: global cap %d reached",
 3368:                 MAX_TOTAL_PEER_CONNECTIONS,
 3369:             )
 3370:             with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 3371:                 writer.close()
 3372:                 await writer.wait_closed()
 3373:             return
 3374:         if not self._handshake_admit(peer_ip):
 3375:             log.warning("handshake throttled from %s", peer_ip)
 3376:             with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 3377:                 writer.close()
 3378:                 await writer.wait_closed()
 3379:             return
 3380:         try:
 3381:             try:
 3382:                 channel = await asyncio.wait_for(
 3383:                     ch.respond(reader, writer, self.me),
 3384:                     timeout=HANDSHAKE_DEADLINE_S,
 3385:                 )
 3386:             except asyncio.TimeoutError:
 3387:                 log.warning("handshake deadline exceeded from %s", addr)
 3388:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 3389:                     writer.close()
 3390:                     await writer.wait_closed()
 3391:                 return
 3392:             except asyncio.IncompleteReadError as e:
 3393:                 if not e.partial:
 3394:                     log.debug("empty pre-handshake disconnect from %s", addr)
 3395:                 else:
 3396:                     log.warning("handshake failed from %s: %s", addr, e)
 3397:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 3398:                     writer.close()
 3399:                     await writer.wait_closed()
 3400:                 return
 3401:             except Exception as e:
 3402:                 log.warning("handshake failed from %s: %s", addr, e)
 3403:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 3404:                     writer.close()
 3405:                     await writer.wait_closed()
 3406:                 return
 3407:         finally:
 3408:             self._handshake_release(peer_ip)
 3409:         log.info("peer connected: %s @ %s", channel.peer_short_id, addr)
 3410:         peer_fp = fingerprint_of(channel.peer_ed_pub)
 3411:         # v0.5.6: stamp regime so /api/peers can surface "via relay" /
 3412:         # "internet" / "lan" badges for the inbound side. Outbound
 3413:         # sessions are stamped separately on OutboundSession.
 3414:         inbound_regime = regime if regime is not None else _classify_address_regime(peer_ip)
 3415:         self._inbound_regime[peer_fp] = inbound_regime
 3416:         if self._inbound_is_rejected(peer_fp):
 3417:             log.warning("rejected peer attempted inbound connection: %s", peer_fp[:8])
 3418:             await channel.close()
 3419:             return
 3420:         # v0.20.7 (security audit M8): per-fp cap. Defends against a
 3421:         # single peer key opening many parallel inbound channels to
 3422:         # crowd the global cap. Strict cap; refuse fast.
 3423:         existing_for_fp = self._inbound_per_fp.get(peer_fp, 0)
 3424:         if existing_for_fp >= MAX_PEER_CONNECTIONS_PER_FP:
 3425:             log.warning(
 3426:                 "peer %s already has %d inbound channels (cap %d); refusing",
 3427:                 peer_fp[:8], existing_for_fp, MAX_PEER_CONNECTIONS_PER_FP,
 3428:             )
 3429:             await channel.close()
 3430:             return
 3431:         # v0.20.7 (security audit M8): increment counters AFTER all
 3432:         # the early-return paths. The recv-loop's finally decrements
 3433:         # both. Handshake-failure paths above don't touch counters,
 3434:         # which means a flood of handshake-failures still doesn't
 3435:         # leak counter slots.
 3436:         self._inbound_peer_count += 1
 3437:         self._inbound_per_fp[peer_fp] = existing_for_fp + 1
 3438:         self._inbound_live_channels.setdefault(peer_fp, []).append(channel)
 3439:         if self.state is not None:
 3440:             try:
 3441:                 hostname: str | None = None
 3442:                 if self.discovery:
 3443:                     pinfo = self.discovery.registry.find(channel.peer_short_id)
 3444:                     if pinfo:
 3445:                         hostname = pinfo.hostname
 3446:                 rec = self.state.upsert_peer(
 3447:                     fingerprint=peer_fp,
 3448:                     short_id=channel.peer_short_id,
 3449:                     pubkey=channel.peer_ed_pub,
 3450:                     hostname=hostname,
 3451:                     address=addr[0] if addr else None,
 3452:                     port=addr[1] if addr else None,
 3453:                 )
 3454:                 # v0.7.8: if upsert_peer just detected a hostname-pubkey
 3455:                 # rotation, the returned record carries the new event id
 3456:                 # as a runtime attribute. Broadcast it live so every
 3457:                 # open tab raises the red banner without waiting for
 3458:                 # the next /api/peers poll.
 3459:                 self._broadcast_key_change_if_present(rec)
 3460:             except Exception as e:
 3461:                 log.warning("upsert_peer failed: %s", e)
 3462: 
 3463:         # Send our capabilities eagerly (no ACK expected).
 3464:         try:
 3465:             await channel.send(encode_msg(self._build_my_caps_for_channel(channel)))
 3466:             # v0.8.2: ratchet-activation half-step. Once we've also
 3467:             # received the peer's CAPS we'll flip both directions.
 3468:             channel.note_caps_sent()
 3469:             channel.maybe_activate_ratchet()
 3470:         except Exception as e:
 3471:             log.warning("CAPS send failed: %s", e)
 3472: 
 3473:         try:
 3474:             while True:
 3475:                 try:
 3476:                     # v0.20.7 (security audit H4): bounded read deadline.
 3477:                     # A peer that holds the channel open with no further
 3478:                     # bytes after handshake exits the loop here instead
 3479:                     # of pinning fds forever.
 3480:                     plaintext = await asyncio.wait_for(
 3481:                         channel.recv(), timeout=PEER_IDLE_S
 3482:                     )
 3483:                 except asyncio.IncompleteReadError:
 3484:                     break
 3485:                 except asyncio.TimeoutError:
 3486:                     log.info(
 3487:                         "peer %s idle for %.0fs, closing channel",
 3488:                         channel.peer_short_id, PEER_IDLE_S,
 3489:                     )
 3490:                     break
 3491:                 if plaintext.startswith(BINARY_FRAME_MAGIC):
 3492:                     msg = _decode_binary_frame(plaintext)
 3493:                 else:
 3494:                     msg = decode_msg(plaintext)
 3495:                 await self._on_peer_message(channel, msg)
 3496:         except Exception as e:
 3497:             log.warning("peer loop error (%s): %s", channel.peer_short_id, e)
 3498:         finally:
 3499:             await channel.close()
 3500:             log.info("peer disconnected: %s", channel.peer_short_id)
 3501:             # v0.20.7 (security audit M8): decrement counters that
 3502:             # were incremented after the rejected-check above. Both
 3503:             # decrements are guarded against the (impossible-in-
 3504:             # practice) negative-counter case to keep the daemon
 3505:             # resilient against any future ordering bug.
 3506:             if self._inbound_peer_count > 0:
 3507:                 self._inbound_peer_count -= 1
 3508:             current_fp_count = self._inbound_per_fp.get(peer_fp, 0)
 3509:             if current_fp_count <= 1:
 3510:                 self._inbound_per_fp.pop(peer_fp, None)
 3511:             else:
 3512:                 self._inbound_per_fp[peer_fp] = current_fp_count - 1
 3513:             live = self._inbound_live_channels.get(peer_fp)
 3514:             if live is not None:
 3515:                 with contextlib.suppress(ValueError):
 3516:                     live.remove(channel)
 3517:                 if not live:
 3518:                     self._inbound_live_channels.pop(peer_fp, None)
 3519: 
 3520:     async def _on_peer_message(self, channel: ch.Channel, msg: dict) -> None:
 3521:         peer_fp = fingerprint_of(channel.peer_ed_pub)
 3522:         peer_sid = channel.peer_short_id
 3523:         # v0.7.0: any frame received from a paired peer = they're alive.
 3524:         self._stamp_pair_health(peer_fp)
 3525:         t = msg.get("t")
 3526:         # H2: rejected peers cannot drive any state mutation, including the
 3527:         # sqlite write that CAPS would have caused. They get an ACK with the
 3528:         # rejection reason so they can fail loudly instead of silently
 3529:         # retrying a write-amplification primitive against our DB.
 3530:         if self._inbound_is_rejected(peer_fp):
 3531:             with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 3532:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 3533:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id,
 3534:                     of=msg.get("id"), rejected="peer_rejected",
 3535:                 )))
 3536:             raise RuntimeError(f"rejected peer attempted message: {peer_fp[:8]}")
 3537:         if t == "PRESENCE":
 3538:             self.record_peer_presence(peer_fp, msg.get("presence"))
 3539:             return
 3540:         if t == "CAPS":
 3541:             # v0.20.7 (security audit M18): intersect peer-claimed
 3542:             # features with our LOCAL_CAPABILITIES so an attacker
 3543:             # can't poison state with arbitrary feature strings
 3544:             # (e.g. claim "admin" / "grant_files" / "root_share")
 3545:             # that future code might key off. We only persist
 3546:             # features WE recognize. Backward-compat: peers
 3547:             # advertising a future capability we haven't shipped
 3548:             # yet are silently ignored — they'll keep working
 3549:             # against the subset of caps that are common.
 3550:             raw_features = list(normalize_caps(msg.get("features", [])))
 3551:             features = [
 3552:                 f for f in raw_features
 3553:                 if f in LOCAL_CAPABILITIES or f in CAPS_FEATURES
 3554:             ]
 3555:             bind = msg.get("channel_bind")
 3556:             # v0.20.7 (security audit H1): channel_bind is REQUIRED.
 3557:             # The v0.7.0 audit fix #10 added a transcript-bound CAPS
 3558:             # claim to defeat channel-splicing / cross-session glue
 3559:             # attacks. The receiver previously verified the claim only
 3560:             # if present (`if isinstance(bind, dict)`), so a malicious
 3561:             # peer could omit it and silently land on the pre-fix-#10
 3562:             # acceptance path. Pre-v0.7.0 peers (which last shipped
 3563:             # ~6+ months ago) must upgrade to communicate with a v0.20.7
 3564:             # daemon. This is a deliberate compat break for security.
 3565:             if not isinstance(bind, dict):
 3566:                 raise RuntimeError(
 3567:                     f"CAPS missing channel_bind from {peer_fp[:8]} "
 3568:                     f"(peer must upgrade to v0.7.0+)"
 3569:                 )
 3570:             expected_peer_fp = self.me.fingerprint
 3571:             expected_self_fp = peer_fp
 3572:             transcript = getattr(channel, "transcript_hex", "")
 3573:             if (
 3574:                 bind.get("peer_fp") != expected_peer_fp
 3575:                 or bind.get("self_fp") != expected_self_fp
 3576:                 or bind.get("transcript") != transcript
 3577:             ):
 3578:                 raise RuntimeError(
 3579:                     f"CAPS channel binding mismatch from {peer_fp[:8]}"
 3580:                 )
 3581:             channel.peer_caps = {
 3582:                 "protocol": msg.get("protocol", "?"),
 3583:                 "features": features,
 3584:                 "from": msg.get("from"),
 3585:                 # v0.20.7: bind is now guaranteed-dict (checked above).
 3586:                 "channel_bind": bind,
 3587:                 "app_version": msg.get("app_version"),
 3588:                 "presence": msg.get("presence"),
 3589:             }
 3590:             self.record_peer_presence(peer_fp, msg.get("presence"))
 3591:             # v0.8.2: ratchet-activation half-step. Once we've also
 3592:             # SENT our CAPS we'll flip both directions to ratchet.
 3593:             with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 3594:                 channel.note_caps_received(features)
 3595:                 if channel.maybe_activate_ratchet():
 3596:                     log.info(
 3597:                         "ratchet activated on inbound channel from %s",
 3598:                         peer_fp[:8],
 3599:                     )
 3600:             # v0.10.4: peer's reported presence drives the UI dot.
 3601:             if msg.get("presence"):
 3602:                 self.record_peer_presence(peer_fp, msg.get("presence"))
 3603:             if self.state is not None:
 3604:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 3605:                     self.state.set_peer_capabilities(peer_fp, features)
 3606:             # v0.5.4: pair-time URL inheritance.
 3607:             # Adopt rendezvous URLs from the peer — but only if:
 3608:             #   1. Peer is pinned (we explicitly trusted them via SAS)
 3609:             #   2. We haven't already inherited from this peer this session
 3610:             #   3. We have an `inherit_rendezvous` setting on (default True)
 3611:             #   4. The URLs validate (state.set_rendezvous_urls rejects junk)
 3612:             shared = msg.get("share_rdz")
 3613:             if (
 3614:                 isinstance(shared, list)
 3615:                 and shared
 3616:                 and self._is_pinned(peer_fp)
 3617:                 and peer_fp not in self._inherited_rdz_from
 3618:             ):
 3619:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 3620:                     self._inherit_rendezvous_urls_from(peer_fp, shared)
 3621:             log.info(
 3622:                 "peer caps from %s: %s features=%s",
 3623:                 peer_sid, channel.peer_caps["protocol"],
 3624:                 channel.peer_caps["features"],
 3625:             )
 3626:             return  # no ACK needed
 3627:         if t == "PRESENCE":
 3628:             # v0.10.4: peer reported a status change. No ACK needed.
 3629:             self.record_peer_presence(peer_fp, str(msg.get("presence") or ""))
 3630:             return
 3631:         if t == "CAPABILITY_GRANT":
 3632:             # Bundle 58: peer ships a signed capability grant over the
 3633:             # established channel. Receiver verifies + accepts into
 3634:             # _cap_store; subsequent _capability_allowed checks
 3635:             # consult the store. The grant authorizes the SENDER (us)
 3636:             # to perform actions against the SENDING peer's resources.
 3637:             #
 3638:             # Wire shape: { "t": "CAPABILITY_GRANT", "id": <id>,
 3639:             #               "grant_b64": "<base64 caps_grants record>" }
 3640:             # NB: do NOT use a local ``import base64`` here — base64 is
 3641:             # already imported at module level and shadowing it would
 3642:             # cause UnboundLocalError on FILE_CHUNK handling later in
 3643:             # the same function (Python's local-name analysis).
 3644:             try:
 3645:                 grant_b64 = msg.get("grant_b64", "")
 3646:                 if not isinstance(grant_b64, str) or not grant_b64:
 3647:                     raise ValueError("grant_b64 missing or wrong type")
 3648:                 # Audit H15 May 2026: bound the base64 string length
 3649:                 # BEFORE decode so an attacker can't flood us with
 3650:                 # large blobs to verify. 8 KiB encoded → ~6 KiB
 3651:                 # decoded; caps_grants.parse_grant has its own
 3652:                 # MAX_CAPS_LEN=4096 inside, plus the underlying
 3653:                 # Capability::decode caps caveats + wire bytes.
 3654:                 if len(grant_b64) > 12_000:
 3655:                     raise ValueError(
 3656:                         f"grant_b64 too long: {len(grant_b64)} > 12000"
 3657:                     )
 3658:                 # Local-name distinct from the FILE_OFFER ``blob``
 3659:                 # below so mypy's type inference for the outer scope
 3660:                 # doesn't collide.
 3661:                 grant_blob = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(
 3662:                     grant_b64 + "=" * (-len(grant_b64) % 4)
 3663:                 )
 3664:                 self._cap_store.accept(
 3665:                     grant_blob,
 3666:                     expected_subject_pub=self.me.public_bytes,
 3667:                     expected_granter_pub=channel.peer_ed_pub,
 3668:                 )
 3669:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 3670:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), ok=True,
 3671:                 )))
 3672:                 log.info(
 3673:                     "accepted capability grant from %s (active grants: %d)",
 3674:                     peer_fp[:8], len(self._cap_store),
 3675:                 )
 3676:             except Exception as e:
 3677:                 log.warning(
 3678:                     "rejected capability grant from %s: %s",
 3679:                     peer_fp[:8], e,
 3680:                 )
 3681:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 3682:                     await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 3683:                         "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 3684:                         rejected=f"grant_rejected: {e}",
 3685:                     )))
 3686:             return
 3687:         if t == "SELF_MESH_PRESENCE":
 3688:             await self._handle_self_mesh_presence(channel, msg, peer_fp)
 3689:             return
 3690:         if t == "SELF_MESH_REMOTE_INSTRUCTION":
 3691:             await self._handle_self_mesh_remote_instruction(channel, msg, peer_fp)
 3692:             return
 3693:         if t == "TEXT":
 3694:             if not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, CHAT):
 3695:                 self._emit_capability_request(peer_fp, peer_sid, CHAT)
 3696:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 3697:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg["id"], rejected="capability_disabled",
 3698:                 )))
 3699:                 return
 3700:             ev = self._persist(msg=msg, direction="in", peer_fp=peer_fp, peer_short_id=peer_sid)
 3701:             self._broadcast_tail(ev)
 3702:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg("ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg["id"])))
 3703:         elif t == "FILE_OFFER":
 3704:             if not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, FILES):
 3705:                 self._emit_capability_request(peer_fp, peer_sid, FILES)
 3706:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 3707:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg["id"], rejected="capability_disabled",
 3708:                 )))
 3709:                 return
 3710:             blob = str(msg.get("blob") or "")
 3711:             if not self._valid_blob_hex(blob):
 3712:                 await self._reject_file_offer(
 3713:                     channel,
 3714:                     msg,
 3715:                     peer_fp=peer_fp,
 3716:                     name=self._safe_transfer_name(msg.get("name")),
 3717:                     size=0,
 3718:                     blob=None,
 3719:                     reason="invalid_blob",
 3720:                     user_message="One Link blocked a file offer with an invalid file fingerprint.",
 3721:                 )
 3722:                 return
 3723:             size = self._safe_transfer_size(msg.get("size"))
 3724:             name = self._safe_transfer_name(msg.get("name"))
 3725:             if size is None:
 3726:                 await self._reject_file_offer(
 3727:                     channel,
 3728:                     msg,
 3729:                     peer_fp=peer_fp,
 3730:                     name=name,
 3731:                     size=0,
 3732:                     blob=blob,
 3733:                     reason="invalid_size",
 3734:                     user_message="One Link blocked a file offer with an invalid size.",
 3735:                 )
 3736:                 return
 3737:             # v0.12.0: auto-accept rules. If the user has configured
 3738:             # a max size or extension allowlist and this file fails
 3739:             # them, ACK with the rejection reason and don't open a
 3740:             # write handle. The sender sees the rejection and the
 3741:             # user can loosen their filter to retry.
 3742:             passed, reason = self._file_passes_auto_accept(name=name, size=size)
 3743:             if not passed:
 3744:                 log.info(
 3745:                     "auto-accept reject: %s (%d bytes) reason=%s",
 3746:                     name, size, reason,
 3747:                 )
 3748:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 3749:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg["id"],
 3750:                     rejected=f"auto_accept_{reason}",
 3751:                 )))
 3752:                 return
 3753:             raw_chunks = msg.get("chunks")
 3754:             chunks_were_advertised = raw_chunks is not None
 3755:             cdc_chunks = self._normalize_cdc_chunks(raw_chunks, declared_size=size)
 3756:             if chunks_were_advertised and cdc_chunks is None:
 3757:                 await self._reject_file_offer(
 3758:                     channel,
 3759:                     msg,
 3760:                     peer_fp=peer_fp,
 3761:                     name=name,
 3762:                     size=size,
 3763:                     blob=blob,
 3764:                     reason="invalid_chunk_map",
 3765:                     user_message="One Link blocked a file offer with an invalid resumable chunk map.",
 3766:                 )
 3767:                 return
 3768:             missing = None
 3769:             swarm_assist: dict = {"pulled": 0, "sources": {}}
 3770:             known_hashes: set[str] = set()
 3771:             already_known_bytes = 0
 3772:             if cdc_chunks:
 3773:                 known_hashes = set(self._available_chunk_hashes(
 3774:                     [str(c["hash"]) for c in cdc_chunks],
 3775:                     hydrate=False,
 3776:                     limit=len(cdc_chunks),
 3777:                 ))
 3778:                 already_known_bytes = known_bytes_from_chunks(cdc_chunks, known_hashes)
 3779:                 missing = {
 3780:                     int(c["index"]) for c in cdc_chunks
 3781:                     if str(c["hash"]) not in known_hashes
 3782:                 }
 3783:             admission = evaluate_transfer_admission(
 3784:                 name=name,
 3785:                 size=size,
 3786:                 peer_fp=peer_fp,
 3787:                 policy=self._transfer_admission_policy,
 3788:                 context=self._transfer_admission_context(
 3789:                     peer_fp=peer_fp,
 3790:                     already_known_bytes=already_known_bytes,
 3791:                 ),
 3792:             )
 3793:             if not admission.ok:
 3794:                 await self._reject_file_offer(
 3795:                     channel,
 3796:                     msg,
 3797:                     peer_fp=peer_fp,
 3798:                     name=name,
 3799:                     size=size,
 3800:                     blob=blob,
 3801:                     reason=admission.wire_reason(),
 3802:                     user_message=admission.user_message,
 3803:                     metadata=admission.to_metadata(),
 3804:                 )
 3805:                 return
 3806:             if size > MAX_INCOMING_FILE_BYTES and not cdc_chunks:
 3807:                 await self._reject_file_offer(
 3808:                     channel,
 3809:                     msg,
 3810:                     peer_fp=peer_fp,
 3811:                     name=name,
 3812:                     size=size,
 3813:                     blob=blob,
 3814:                     reason="stream_offer_too_large",
 3815:                     user_message=(
 3816:                         "One Link needs a resumable chunk map before accepting a file this large."
 3817:                     ),
 3818:                 )
 3819:                 return
 3820:             # v0.20.7 (security audit H16): open with exclusive-create
 3821:             # against a uniquified path so a name + blob-prefix
 3822:             # collision can't truncate an existing inbox file.
 3823:             out_path = self._unique_inbox_path(blob, name)
 3824:             handle = open(out_path, "xb")
 3825:             if cdc_chunks:
 3826:                 if missing:
 3827:                     missing, swarm_assist = await self._swarm_assist_file_offer(
 3828:                         sender_fp=peer_fp,
 3829:                         name=name,
 3830:                         size=size,
 3831:                         blob=blob,
 3832:                         cdc_chunks=cdc_chunks,
 3833:                         missing=missing,
 3834:                     )
 3835:             transfer_id = f"in:{blob}"
 3836:             self._incoming_files[blob] = IncomingFile(
 3837:                 name=name,
 3838:                 size=size,
 3839:                 blob_hex=blob,
 3840:                 out_path=out_path,
 3841:                 handle=handle,
 3842:                 # blake3 lacks PEP-561 stubs; the runtime hasher
 3843:                 # exposes update/hexdigest exactly per _HasherProtocol.
 3844:                 # ``cast`` documents the contract for the type
 3845:                 # checker without bypassing it.
 3846:                 hasher=cast(_HasherProtocol, blake3.blake3()),
 3847:                 cdc_chunks=cdc_chunks,
 3848:                 cdc_missing=missing,
 3849:                 cdc_parts={},
 3850:                 transfer_id=transfer_id,
 3851:             )
 3852:             self._upsert_transfer(
 3853:                 id=transfer_id,
 3854:                 direction="in",
 3855:                 peer_fp=peer_fp,
 3856:                 kind="file",
 3857:                 name=name,
 3858:                 size=size,
 3859:                 blob_hash=blob,
 3860:                 status="offered",
 3861:                 progress_bytes=0 if missing else size if cdc_chunks else 0,
 3862:                 total_bytes=size,
 3863:                 chunks_done=(len(cdc_chunks) - len(missing or [])) if cdc_chunks else 0,
 3864:                 chunks_total=len(cdc_chunks) if cdc_chunks else 0,
 3865:                 metadata={
 3866:                     "mode": "cdc" if cdc_chunks else "stream",
 3867:                     "path": str(out_path),
 3868:                     "missing_chunks": len(missing or []),
 3869:                     "swarm_assist": swarm_assist,
 3870:                     "admission": admission.to_metadata(),
 3871:                     "file_risk": classify_file_risk(name),
 3872:                 },
 3873:             )
 3874:             log.info(
 3875:                 "file offer: %s (%d bytes) blob=%s from %s",
 3876:                 name, msg["size"], blob[:8], peer_sid,
 3877:             )
 3878:             ev = self._persist(msg=msg, direction="in", peer_fp=peer_fp, peer_short_id=peer_sid)
 3879:             self._broadcast_tail(ev)
 3880:             if cdc_chunks is not None:
 3881:                 # Phase B Bloom-init honor mode: when ONE_LINK_BLOOM_HONOR=1
 3882:                 # AND peer advertises BLOOM_INIT_V1 AND native crate is
 3883:                 # available, drop the FILE_WANTS list and rely on the
 3884:                 # accompanying BLOOM_INIT_FILTER for chunk dispatch. The
 3885:                 # sender + receiver still run an integrity-check-and-
 3886:                 # recover round at transfer end to catch the rare
 3887:                 # false-positive-induced miss. When the env flag is off
 3888:                 # (the default), both messages fly and FILE_WANTS stays
 3889:                 # canonical.
 3890:                 use_bloom_only = self._bloom_only_for_peer(peer_fp)
 3891:                 if not use_bloom_only:
 3892:                     await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 3893:                         "FILE_WANTS", self.me.short_id,
 3894:                         of=msg["id"], blob=blob, wants=sorted(missing or []),
 3895:                     )))
 3896:                 await self._maybe_send_bloom_init_advisory(
 3897:                     channel, msg_id=msg["id"], blob=blob, peer_fp=peer_fp
 3898:                 )
 3899:                 if not missing:
 3900:                     self._schedule_finish_cdc_file(blob, peer_fp, peer_sid, msg)
 3901:             else:
 3902:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg("ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg["id"])))
 3903:         elif t == "FILE_CHUNK":
 3904:             blob = str(msg["blob"])
 3905:             f = self._incoming_files.get(blob)
 3906:             if not f:
 3907:                 log.warning("FILE_CHUNK with no offer: %s", blob[:8])
 3908:                 return
 3909:             # v0.20.7 (security audit H15 / H17): re-check pinned +
 3910:             # files capability on every chunk, not just at FILE_OFFER.
 3911:             # Without this, a user revoking files mid-transfer leaves
 3912:             # the IncomingFile entry intact and chunks keep landing
 3913:             # on disk; the rejection becomes effective only on the
 3914:             # next FILE_OFFER.
 3915:             if not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, FILES):
 3916:                 self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 3917:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 3918:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 3919:                     rejected="capability_revoked_mid_stream",
 3920:                 )))
 3921:                 return
 3922:             try:
 3923:                 seq = int(msg.get("seq", -1))
 3924:             except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
 3925:                 self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 3926:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 3927:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), rejected="bad_file_chunk_sequence",
 3928:                 )))
 3929:                 return
 3930:             if seq != f.next_seq:
 3931:                 self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 3932:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 3933:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), rejected="file_chunk_sequence_mismatch",
 3934:                 )))
 3935:                 return
 3936:             try:
 3937:                 data = base64.b64decode(msg["data"], validate=True)
 3938:             except (binascii.Error, ValueError) as e:
 3939:                 self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 3940:                 log.warning("invalid FILE_CHUNK base64 from %s: %s", peer_sid, e)
 3941:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 3942:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), rejected="bad_file_chunk_data",
 3943:                 )))
 3944:                 return
 3945:             if f.received + len(data) > f.size:
 3946:                 self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 3947:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 3948:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), rejected="file_chunk_size_overrun",
 3949:                 )))
 3950:                 return
 3951:             f.handle.write(data)
 3952:             f.hasher.update(data)
 3953:             f.received += len(data)
 3954:             f.next_seq += 1
 3955:             self._update_transfer(
 3956:                 f.transfer_id,
 3957:                 status="active",
 3958:                 progress_bytes=f.received,
 3959:                 total_bytes=f.size,
 3960:                 chunks_done=f.next_seq,
 3961:                 chunks_total=max(f.next_seq, (f.size + CHUNK_SIZE - 1) // CHUNK_SIZE),
 3962:             )
 3963:             if msg.get("eof"):
 3964:                 f.handle.close()
 3965:                 got = f.hasher.hexdigest()
 3966:                 ok = got == f.blob_hex and f.received == f.size
 3967:                 done = {
 3968:                     "t": "FILE_DONE",
 3969:                     "id": msg["id"],
 3970:                     "ts": msg["ts"],
 3971:                     "from": msg["from"],
 3972:                     "name": f.name,
 3973:                     "size": f.size,
 3974:                     "path": str(f.out_path),
 3975:                     "blob": f.blob_hex,
 3976:                     "ok": ok,
 3977:                     "file_risk": classify_file_risk(f.name),
 3978:                 }
 3979:                 ev = self._persist(msg=done, direction="in", peer_fp=peer_fp, peer_short_id=peer_sid)
 3980:                 self._broadcast_tail(ev)
 3981:                 self._incoming_files.pop(blob, None)
 3982:                 if not ok:
 3983:                     with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
 3984:                         f.out_path.unlink()
 3985:                     self._update_transfer(f.transfer_id, status="failed")
 3986:                 else:
 3987:                     self._update_transfer(
 3988:                         f.transfer_id,
 3989:                         status="complete",
 3990:                         progress_bytes=f.size,
 3991:                         total_bytes=f.size,
 3992:                     )
 3993:                 log.info("file done: %s ok=%s -> %s", f.name, ok, f.out_path)
 3994:                 await self._ack_file_chunk(channel, msg, f, force_individual=True)
 3995:                 if ok:
 3996:                     self._cache_file_chunks(f.out_path)
 3997:                     # Phase D #3: observe successful receive in prefetch
 3998:                     # predictor so the warm-cache model sees both ends
 3999:                     # of every transfer.
 4000:                     self._observe_prefetch(peer_fp, f.blob_hex)
 4001:                 return
 4002:             await self._ack_file_chunk(channel, msg, f)
 4003:         elif t == "FILE_BIN_CHUNK":
 4004:             await self._handle_file_binary_chunk(channel, msg, peer_fp, peer_sid)
 4005:         elif t == "FILE_NATIVE_CHUNK":
 4006:             # Phase C-3 (ADR-0026): native chunk-store transport.
 4007:             await self._handle_file_native_chunk(channel, msg, peer_fp, peer_sid)
 4008:         elif t == "FILE_CDC_CHUNK":
 4009:             await self._handle_file_cdc_chunk(channel, msg, peer_fp, peer_sid)
 4010:         elif t == "CHUNK_QUERY":
 4011:             await self._handle_chunk_query(channel, msg, peer_fp)
 4012:         elif t == "CHUNK_PULL":
 4013:             await self._handle_chunk_pull(channel, msg, peer_fp)
 4014:         elif t == "GROUP_EVENT":
 4015:             # v0.8.0: peer is sending us a CRDT GroupEvent (create,
 4016:             # add_member, remove_member, change_role, rename, leave).
 4017:             # We persist via state.upsert_group_event after signature
 4018:             # verification; reduce_events runs lazily on next state
 4019:             # materialization. UI broadcasts a `group_event` so it
 4020:             # can refresh the groups list / conversation membership.
 4021:             if not self._is_pinned(peer_fp):
 4022:                 return
 4023:             event_wire = msg.get("event")
 4024:             if not isinstance(event_wire, dict):
 4025:                 return
 4026:             try:
 4027:                 from one_link import groups as gmod
 4028:                 group_ev = gmod.GroupEvent.from_wire(event_wire)
 4029:             except Exception as e:
 4030:                 log.warning("malformed GROUP_EVENT from %s: %s", peer_fp[:8], e)
 4031:                 return
 4032:             # Verify signature. group_ev.verify() raises ValueError on
 4033:             # bad signature; treat any exception as untrusted.
 4034:             try:
 4035:                 group_ev.verify()
 4036:             except Exception as e:
 4037:                 log.warning(
 4038:                     "GROUP_EVENT signature failed: from=%s peer=%s: %s",
 4039:                     group_ev.author_pubkey.hex()[:8], peer_fp[:8], e,
 4040:                 )
 4041:                 return
 4042:             if self.state is not None:
 4043:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 4044:                     self.state.upsert_group_event(
 4045:                         group_id=group_ev.group_id,
 4046:                         event_id=group_ev.event_id,
 4047:                         timestamp_ms=group_ev.timestamp_ms,
 4048:                         wire_dict=group_ev.to_wire(),
 4049:                     )
 4050:                 # Bump the cached group_meta name so the sidebar
 4051:                 # reflects the latest reduce result without forcing
 4052:                 # the UI to recompute.
 4053:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 4054:                     gstate = self._group_state_for(group_ev.group_id)
 4055:                     if gstate is not None:
 4056:                         self.state.upsert_group_meta(
 4057:                             group_id=group_ev.group_id,
 4058:                             name=gstate.name or "",
 4059:                             created_ms=int(time.time() * 1000),
 4060:                             state_hash="",
 4061:                         )
 4062:             if self.ui_server is not None:
 4063:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 4064:                     self.ui_server.broadcast({
 4065:                         "type": "group_event",
 4066:                         "group_id": group_ev.group_id.hex(),
 4067:                         "event_kind": group_ev.kind,
 4068:                     })
 4069:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4070:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 4071:             )))
 4072:         elif t == "GROUP_KEY_OFFER":
 4073:             await self._handle_group_key_offer(channel, msg, peer_fp)
 4074:         elif t == "GROUP_MSG":
 4075:             await self._handle_group_msg(channel, msg, peer_fp, peer_sid)
 4076:         elif t == "ENDPOINT_UPDATE":
 4077:             await self._handle_endpoint_update(channel, msg, peer_fp, peer_sid)
 4078:         elif t == "BLOOM_INIT_FILTER":
 4079:             # Phase B advisory: receiver advertised its locally-held
 4080:             # chunk set as a Bloom. Sender logs the savings potential
 4081:             # for telemetry. The canonical chunk dispatch still flows
 4082:             # through FILE_WANTS (which arrived alongside this frame).
 4083:             # Future cutover: flip to honor the Bloom and drop the
 4084:             # FILE_WANTS list from BLOOM_INIT_V1 peers.
 4085:             await self._handle_bloom_init_advisory(channel, msg, peer_fp)
 4086:         elif t == "REACTION":
 4087:             # v0.7.5: emoji reaction frame. {target, emoji, op}.
 4088:             # Only pinned peers can react against our messages, since
 4089:             # accepting reactions from strangers would surface their
 4090:             # short_id in our UI without prior trust.
 4091:             if not self._is_pinned(peer_fp):
 4092:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4093:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 4094:                     rejected="not_pinned",
 4095:                 )))
 4096:                 return
 4097:             target = str(msg.get("target") or "")
 4098:             emoji = str(msg.get("emoji") or "")
 4099:             op = str(msg.get("op") or "add")
 4100:             if not target or not emoji or op not in ("add", "remove"):
 4101:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4102:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 4103:                     rejected="bad_reaction",
 4104:                 )))
 4105:                 return
 4106:             if self.state is not None:
 4107:                 try:
 4108:                     if op == "add":
 4109:                         self.state.record_reaction(
 4110:                             target_msg_id=target, peer_fp=peer_fp, emoji=emoji,
 4111:                         )
 4112:                     else:
 4113:                         self.state.remove_reaction(
 4114:                             target_msg_id=target, peer_fp=peer_fp, emoji=emoji,
 4115:                         )
 4116:                 except Exception as e:
 4117:                     log.warning("record_reaction failed: %s", e)
 4118:             if self.ui_server is not None:
 4119:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 4120:                     self.ui_server.broadcast({
 4121:                         "type": "reaction",
 4122:                         "target": target, "peer_fp": peer_fp,
 4123:                         "emoji": emoji, "op": op,
 4124:                     })
 4125:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4126:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 4127:             )))
 4128:         elif t == "EDIT_MSG":
 4129:             # v0.7.6: peer is editing one of THEIR previously-sent messages.
 4130:             # We only honour edits from pinned peers. Server-side EDIT_COOLDOWN_S
 4131:             # bound is enforced; older edits are dropped.
 4132:             if not self._is_pinned(peer_fp):
 4133:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4134:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 4135:                     rejected="not_pinned",
 4136:                 )))
 4137:                 return
 4138:             target = str(msg.get("target") or "")
 4139:             new_body = msg.get("body")
 4140:             edited_at = int(msg.get("edited_at_ms") or 0) or int(time.time() * 1000)
 4141:             if not target or not isinstance(new_body, str):
 4142:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4143:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 4144:                     rejected="bad_edit",
 4145:                 )))
 4146:                 return
 4147:             # Cooldown: only allow edit within 5 minutes of original ts.
 4148:             if self.state is not None:
 4149:                 tgt = self.state.get_message(target)
 4150:                 if tgt is None:
 4151:                     await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4152:                         "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 4153:                         rejected="unknown_target",
 4154:                     )))
 4155:                     return
 4156:                 if tgt.peer_fp != peer_fp:
 4157:                     # Peers can only edit their own messages.
 4158:                     await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4159:                         "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 4160:                         rejected="not_author",
 4161:                     )))
 4162:                     return
 4163:                 if edited_at - tgt.ts_ms > EDIT_COOLDOWN_MS:
 4164:                     await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4165:                         "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 4166:                         rejected="cooldown",
 4167:                     )))
 4168:                     return
 4169:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 4170:                     self.state.edit_message(
 4171:                         id=target, new_body=new_body, edited_at_ms=edited_at,
 4172:                     )
 4173:             if self.ui_server is not None:
 4174:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 4175:                     self.ui_server.broadcast({
 4176:                         "type": "msg_edit",
 4177:                         "target": target,
 4178:                         "body": new_body,
 4179:                         "edited_at_ms": edited_at,
 4180:                     })
 4181:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4182:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 4183:             )))
 4184:         elif t == "DELETE_MSG":
 4185:             if not self._is_pinned(peer_fp):
 4186:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4187:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 4188:                     rejected="not_pinned",
 4189:                 )))
 4190:                 return
 4191:             target = str(msg.get("target") or "")
 4192:             deleted_at = int(msg.get("deleted_at_ms") or 0) or int(time.time() * 1000)
 4193:             if not target:
 4194:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4195:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 4196:                     rejected="bad_delete",
 4197:                 )))
 4198:                 return
 4199:             if self.state is not None:
 4200:                 tgt = self.state.get_message(target)
 4201:                 if tgt is None or tgt.peer_fp != peer_fp:
 4202:                     await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4203:                         "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 4204:                         rejected="not_author",
 4205:                     )))
 4206:                     return
 4207:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 4208:                     self.state.delete_message(
 4209:                         id=target, deleted_at_ms=deleted_at,
 4210:                     )
 4211:             if self.ui_server is not None:
 4212:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 4213:                     self.ui_server.broadcast({
 4214:                         "type": "msg_delete",
 4215:                         "target": target,
 4216:                         "deleted_at_ms": deleted_at,
 4217:                     })
 4218:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4219:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 4220:             )))
 4221:         elif t == "TYPING":
 4222:             # v0.12.3: ephemeral "peer is typing" indicator.
 4223:             # Pinned-only — strangers can't poke our UI.
 4224:             # Capped expiry at 10s (the wire claims 5s; we cap to
 4225:             # avoid a malicious peer setting expires_in_ms = MAX
 4226:             # to lock the indicator on forever).
 4227:             if not self._is_pinned(peer_fp):
 4228:                 return
 4229:             # Honor the local display privacy toggle: if off, we
 4230:             # silently drop the WS broadcast so the UI never shows
 4231:             # the indicator. We still cache the deadline so other
 4232:             # internal consumers (notification suppression, etc.)
 4233:             # can read it later.
 4234:             display_on = True
 4235:             if self.state is not None:
 4236:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 4237:                     v = self.state.get_setting("display_typing_indicators")
 4238:                     if v is not None and v != "true":
 4239:                         display_on = False
 4240:             try:
 4241:                 expires_in_ms = int(msg.get("expires_in_ms") or 5000)
 4242:             except (TypeError, ValueError):
 4243:                 expires_in_ms = 5000
 4244:             expires_in_ms = max(0, min(10_000, expires_in_ms))
 4245:             now_ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
 4246:             self._peer_typing[peer_fp] = now_ms + expires_in_ms
 4247:             if display_on and self.ui_server is not None:
 4248:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 4249:                     self.ui_server.broadcast({
 4250:                         "type": "peer_typing",
 4251:                         "peer_fp": peer_fp,
 4252:                         "expires_at_ms": now_ms + expires_in_ms,
 4253:                     })
 4254:         elif t == "READ_MARKER":
 4255:             # v0.7.6: peer reports they've read up to ts X.
 4256:             # Pinned-only — receipts from strangers leak nothing
 4257:             # useful to us and could be a flood vector otherwise.
 4258:             if not self._is_pinned(peer_fp):
 4259:                 return
 4260:             up_to = int(msg.get("up_to_ts_ms") or 0)
 4261:             if up_to <= 0:
 4262:                 return
 4263:             # We track THEIR read marker so the UI can render
 4264:             # ✓✓ next to OUR messages with ts ≤ up_to.
 4265:             # Stored in the same peer_read_markers table keyed
 4266:             # by peer_fp; flips role here intentionally.
 4267:             if self.state is not None:
 4268:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 4269:                     self.state.record_read_marker(peer_fp, up_to)
 4270:             if self.ui_server is not None:
 4271:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 4272:                     self.ui_server.broadcast({
 4273:                         "type": "read_marker",
 4274:                         "peer_fp": peer_fp,
 4275:                         "up_to_ts_ms": up_to,
 4276:                     })
 4277:         elif t == "PING":
 4278:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg("PONG", self.me.short_id)))
 4279:         elif t == "PAIR_REQUEST":
 4280:             # Peer wants to pair with us. Compute the SAS bound to the
 4281:             # channel's transcript_hash (audit fix H11) and store as
 4282:             # incoming, surface to UI for the user to verify.
 4283:             transcript = getattr(channel, "transcript_hash", None)
 4284:             sas = compute_sas(
 4285:                 self.me.public_bytes,
 4286:                 channel.peer_ed_pub,
 4287:                 transcript_hash=transcript,
 4288:             )
 4289:             # v0.20.7 (security audit M20): if we previously rejected
 4290:             # this peer, set the previously_rejected flag so the UI
 4291:             # surfaces a "previously blocked" warning before the user
 4292:             # clicks Match.
 4293:             previously_rejected = False
 4294:             if self.state is not None:
 4295:                 try:
 4296:                     rec = self.state.get_peer(peer_fp)
 4297:                     previously_rejected = bool(rec and rec.trust == "rejected")
 4298:                 except Exception:
 4299:                     previously_rejected = False
 4300:             ctx = self.pairing.get(peer_fp)
 4301:             # v0.20.7 (security audit H12): treat an expired ctx as
 4302:             # absent so a stale "Match" prompt that the user ignored
 4303:             # earlier doesn't carry over and bypass the fresh ceremony.
 4304:             if (
 4305:                 ctx is None
 4306:                 or ctx.state in (PairState.NONE, PairState.PAIRED, PairState.REJECTED)
 4307:                 or ctx.is_expired()
 4308:             ):
 4309:                 ctx = self.pairing.begin(
 4310:                     peer_fp=peer_fp, sas=sas, incoming=True,
 4311:                     previously_rejected=previously_rejected,
 4312:                 )
 4313:             if self.ui_server is not None:
 4314:                 self.ui_server.broadcast({
 4315:                     "type": "pair_request",
 4316:                     "peer_fp": peer_fp,
 4317:                     "peer_short_id": peer_sid,
 4318:                     "sas": sas,
 4319:                     "previously_rejected": previously_rejected,
 4320:                 })
 4321:             log.info("PAIR_REQUEST from %s sas=%s ctx.state=%s",
 4322:                      peer_sid, sas, ctx.state.value)
 4323:             # ACK so the sender can close the connection cleanly.
 4324:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg("ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg["id"])))
 4325:         elif t == "PAIR_CONFIRM":
 4326:             # Peer says SAS matched on their side.
 4327:             ctx = self.pairing.they_confirm(peer_fp)
 4328:             if ctx is None or (ctx is not None and ctx.is_expired()):
 4329:                 # v0.20.7 (security audit H11 + H12): no live ctx (or
 4330:                 # the ctx is past its TTL). The legacy fallback used
 4331:                 # to silently fabricate a v1 SAS and begin a new ctx
 4332:                 # with they_confirmed=True; with v2 SAS bound to the
 4333:                 # transcript_hash, that fallback would display a
 4334:                 # different code than what the peer's side computed
 4335:                 # and the user would (correctly) see a mismatch.
 4336:                 # Refuse instead so the user retries pair from
 4337:                 # scratch with a fresh ceremony.
 4338:                 log.warning(
 4339:                     "PAIR_CONFIRM refused: no live pair context for %s",
 4340:                     peer_sid,
 4341:                 )
 4342:                 await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4343:                     "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg["id"],
 4344:                     rejected="no_live_pair_context",
 4345:                 )))
 4346:                 return
 4347:             # Re-fetch the latest ctx (in case other handlers mutated it
 4348:             # while we were processing).
 4349:             ctx = self.pairing.get(peer_fp) or ctx
 4350:             if ctx and ctx.both_confirmed and self.state is not None:
 4351:                 # Defensive upsert in case the peer record was missed.
 4352:                 try:
 4353:                     self.state.upsert_peer(
 4354:                         fingerprint=peer_fp,
 4355:                         short_id=peer_sid,
 4356:                         pubkey=channel.peer_ed_pub,
 4357:                     )
 4358:                 except Exception:
 4359:                     pass
 4360:                 self.state.set_peer_trust(peer_fp, "pinned", actor="pairing")
 4361:                 # v0.7.1 deny-by-default: SAS pair grants CHAT only.
 4362:                 # The user can grant files/folders/groups via the UI
 4363:                 # prompt that fires on the first request.
 4364:                 self._apply_default_capability_policy(peer_fp)
 4365:                 if self.ui_server is not None:
 4366:                     self.ui_server.broadcast({
 4367:                         "type": "peer_trust",
 4368:                         "fingerprint": peer_fp,
 4369:                         "trust": "pinned",
 4370:                     })
 4371:                 log.info("paired with %s (sas=%s)", peer_sid, ctx.sas)
 4372:             elif self.ui_server is not None:
 4373:                 self.ui_server.broadcast({
 4374:                     "type": "pair_progress",
 4375:                     "peer_fp": peer_fp,
 4376:                     "they_confirmed": True,
 4377:                 })
 4378:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg("ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg["id"])))
 4379:         elif t == "PAIR_REJECT":
 4380:             self.pairing.reject(peer_fp)
 4381:             if self.state is not None:
 4382:                 try:
 4383:                     self.state.upsert_peer(
 4384:                         fingerprint=peer_fp, short_id=peer_sid,
 4385:                         pubkey=channel.peer_ed_pub,
 4386:                     )
 4387:                 except Exception:
 4388:                     pass
 4389:                 self.state.set_peer_trust(peer_fp, "rejected", actor="pairing")
 4390:             if self.ui_server is not None:
 4391:                 self.ui_server.broadcast({
 4392:                     "type": "pair_rejected",
 4393:                     "peer_fp": peer_fp,
 4394:                     "peer_short_id": peer_sid,
 4395:                 })
 4396:             log.info("pair rejected by %s", peer_sid)
 4397:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg("ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg["id"])))
 4398: 
 4399:         # ─── folder sync wire protocol ──────────────────────────────────
 4400:         elif t == "MANIFEST_PUSH":
 4401:             # Peer is offering us their view of a shared folder.
 4402:             if not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, FOLDER_SYNC):
 4403:                 self._emit_capability_request(peer_fp, peer_sid, FOLDER_SYNC)
 4404:                 return
 4405:             await self._handle_manifest_push(channel, msg, peer_fp)
 4406:         elif t == "MANIFEST_WANTS":
 4407:             # Audit H13 May 2026: gate ON the FOLDER_SYNC cap too.
 4408:             # Without this, a peer with the FOLDER_SYNC cap revoked
 4409:             # could still pull blobs out of the folder by asking for
 4410:             # them directly via MANIFEST_WANTS, bypassing the
 4411:             # MANIFEST_PUSH cap-check above. Cap-policy + share-list
 4412:             # are AND-composed, not OR.
 4413:             if not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, FOLDER_SYNC):
 4414:                 self._emit_capability_request(peer_fp, peer_sid, FOLDER_SYNC)
 4415:                 return
 4416:             await self._handle_manifest_wants(channel, msg, peer_fp)
 4417:         elif t == "BLOB_OFFER":
 4418:             # Audit H13 May 2026: same gate. BLOB_OFFER is the inbound
 4419:             # half of MANIFEST_WANTS; either end of the pull path must
 4420:             # honour cap revocation.
 4421:             if not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, FOLDER_SYNC):
 4422:                 self._emit_capability_request(peer_fp, peer_sid, FOLDER_SYNC)
 4423:                 return
 4424:             await self._handle_blob_offer(channel, msg, peer_fp)
 4425:         elif t == "BLOB_CHUNK":
 4426:             # Audit H13 May 2026: BLOB_CHUNK is the streaming body of
 4427:             # a folder-sync transfer. Cap revocation must take
 4428:             # mid-stream, not just at handshake.
 4429:             if not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, FOLDER_SYNC):
 4430:                 self._emit_capability_request(peer_fp, peer_sid, FOLDER_SYNC)
 4431:                 return
 4432:             await self._handle_blob_chunk(channel, msg, peer_fp)
 4433: 
 4434:         # ─── FILE_PROVENANCE — inbound Reality-dot evidence ─────────────
 4435:         elif t == "FILE_PROVENANCE":
 4436:             self._handle_file_provenance(msg=msg, channel=channel, peer_fp=peer_fp)
 4437: 
 4438:         # ─── Living Presence wire dispatch ──────────────────────────────
 4439:         elif t in _LIVING_PRESENCE_WIRE_TYPES:
 4440:             await self._dispatch_living_presence_message(
 4441:                 channel=channel, msg=msg, peer_fp=peer_fp, peer_sid=peer_sid,
 4442:             )
 4443:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 4444:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), ok=True,
 4445:             )))
 4446:         elif t == _TRUST_SYNC_WIRE_TYPE:
 4447:             await self._handle_peer_verify_notice(channel, msg, peer_fp, peer_sid)
