 5868:     async def _handle_chunk_query(self, channel, msg, peer_fp) -> None:
 5869:         if not self._is_pinned(peer_fp) or not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, FILES):
 5870:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 5871:                 "CHUNK_HAVE", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), hashes=[],
 5872:                 rejected="not_authorized",
 5873:             )))
 5874:             return
 5875:         raw = msg.get("hashes") or []
 5876:         if not isinstance(raw, list):
 5877:             raw = []
 5878:         have = self._available_chunk_hashes(raw)
 5879:         await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 5880:             "CHUNK_HAVE", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), hashes=have,
 5881:         )))
 5882: 
 5883:     async def _handle_chunk_pull(self, channel, msg, peer_fp) -> None:
 5884:         if not self._is_pinned(peer_fp) or not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, FILES):
 5885:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 5886:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), rejected="not_authorized",
 5887:             )))
 5888:             return
 5889:         h = str(msg.get("hash", ""))
 5890:         if not self._valid_blob_hex(h):
 5891:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 5892:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), rejected="bad_hash",
 5893:             )))
 5894:             return
 5895:         data = self._read_chunk_cache(h)
 5896:         if data is None:
 5897:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 5898:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), rejected="missing_chunk",
 5899:             )))
 5900:             return
 5901:         enc, payload = self._encode_payload(data)
 5902:         await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 5903:             "CHUNK_DATA",
 5904:             self.me.short_id,
 5905:             of=msg.get("id"),
 5906:             hash=h,
 5907:             enc=enc,
 5908:             wire_size=len(payload),
 5909:             size=len(data),
 5910:             data=base64.b64encode(payload).decode("ascii"),
 5911:         )))
 5912: 
 5913:     async def query_peer_chunks(self, peer: Peer, hashes: list[str]) -> dict:
 5914:         block = self._check_outbound_trust(peer)
 5915:         if block:
 5916:             raise RuntimeError(block)
 5917:         peer_fp = self._peer_fp_from_peer(peer) or ""
 5918:         if peer_fp and not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, FILES):
 5919:             raise RuntimeError(f"files capability disabled for peer {peer.short_id}")
 5920:         clean = [h for h in hashes[:2048] if self._valid_blob_hex(str(h))]
 5921:         last_error: BaseException | None = None
 5922:         for attempt in range(2):
 5923:             sess = await self._get_outbound_session(peer)
 5924:             try:
 5925:                 async with sess.lock:
 5926:                     q = make_msg("CHUNK_QUERY", self.me.short_id, hashes=clean)
 5927:                     # Phase A2: routed through PeerTransport facade (CHUNK_QUERY
 5928:                     # is the third message-type migration after PING + send_to).
 5929:                     await self._send_via_transport(
 5930:                         sess.peer_fp, sess.channel, encode_msg(q)
 5931:                     )
 5932:                     while True:
 5933:                         reply = await self._recv_chunk_protocol_reply(
 5934:                             sess=sess,
 5935:                             request_id=str(q.get("id")),
 5936:                             expected_types={"CHUNK_HAVE"},
 5937:                             timeout_s=FILE_ACK_DEADLINE_S,
 5938:                         )
 5939:                         have = [
 5940:                             str(h) for h in (reply.get("hashes") or [])
 5941:                             if self._valid_blob_hex(str(h))
 5942:                         ]
 5943:                         self._record_route_observation(
 5944:                             sess.peer_fp,
 5945:                             route=sess.regime,
 5946:                             ok=not bool(reply.get("rejected")),
 5947:                         )
 5948:                         return {
 5949:                             "ok": not reply.get("rejected"),
 5950:                             "hashes": have,
 5951:                             "rejected": reply.get("rejected"),
 5952:                         }
 5953:             except Exception as exc:
 5954:                 last_error = exc
 5955:                 if not _is_transient_send_error(exc) or attempt >= 1:
 5956:                     raise
 5957:                 self._record_route_observation(
 5958:                     sess.peer_fp,
 5959:                     route=sess.regime,
 5960:                     ok=False,
 5961:                     error_code=type(exc).__name__,
 5962:                 )
 5963:                 await self._drop_outbound_session(sess.peer_fp)
 5964:                 continue
 5965:         if last_error is not None:
 5966:             raise last_error
 5967:         raise RuntimeError("chunk query failed without an error")
 5968: 
 5969:     async def pull_peer_chunk(self, peer: Peer, chunk_hash: str) -> dict:
 5970:         block = self._check_outbound_trust(peer)
 5971:         if block:
 5972:             raise RuntimeError(block)
 5973:         peer_fp = self._peer_fp_from_peer(peer) or ""
 5974:         if peer_fp and not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, FILES):
 5975:             raise RuntimeError(f"files capability disabled for peer {peer.short_id}")
 5976:         if not self._valid_blob_hex(str(chunk_hash)):
 5977:             raise RuntimeError("bad chunk hash")
 5978:         last_error: BaseException | None = None
 5979:         for attempt in range(2):
 5980:             sess = await self._get_outbound_session(peer)
 5981:             try:
 5982:                 async with sess.lock:
 5983:                     q = make_msg("CHUNK_PULL", self.me.short_id, hash=str(chunk_hash))
 5984:                     # Phase A2: routed through PeerTransport facade.
 5985:                     await self._send_via_transport(
 5986:                         sess.peer_fp, sess.channel, encode_msg(q)
 5987:                     )
 5988:                     while True:
 5989:                         reply = await self._recv_chunk_protocol_reply(
 5990:                             sess=sess,
 5991:                             request_id=str(q.get("id")),
 5992:                             expected_types={"CHUNK_DATA"},
 5993:                             timeout_s=FILE_ACK_DEADLINE_S,
 5994:                             accept_rejected_ack=True,
 5995:                         )
 5996:                         if reply.get("t") == "ACK" and reply.get("rejected"):
 5997:                             self._record_route_observation(
 5998:                                 sess.peer_fp,
 5999:                                 route=sess.regime,
 6000:                                 ok=False,
 6001:                                 error_code=str(reply.get("rejected")),
 6002:                             )
 6003:                             return {"ok": False, "rejected": reply.get("rejected")}
 6004:                         data = base64.b64decode(reply.get("data", ""), validate=True)
 6005:                         data = self._decode_payload(
 6006:                             str(reply.get("enc", "raw")),
 6007:                             data,
 6008:                             max_bytes=CDC_MAX_CHUNK_BYTES + 64,
 6009:                         )
 6010:                         if blake3.blake3(data).hexdigest() != chunk_hash:
 6011:                             self._record_route_observation(
 6012:                                 sess.peer_fp,
 6013:                                 route=sess.regime,
 6014:                                 ok=False,
 6015:                                 error_code="chunk_integrity_failure",
 6016:                             )
 6017:                             raise RuntimeError("CHUNK_DATA integrity failure")
 6018:                         self._store_chunk_cache(chunk_hash, data)
 6019:                         self._record_route_observation(
 6020:                             sess.peer_fp,
 6021:                             route=sess.regime,
 6022:                             ok=True,
 6023:                             bandwidth_bps=max(1.0, float(len(data) * 8)),
 6024:                         )
 6025:                         return {
 6026:                             "ok": True,
 6027:                             "hash": chunk_hash,
 6028:                             "size": len(data),
 6029:                             "wire_size": int(reply.get("wire_size") or len(data)),
 6030:                         }
 6031:             except Exception as exc:
 6032:                 last_error = exc
 6033:                 if not _is_transient_send_error(exc) or attempt >= 1:
 6034:                     raise
 6035:                 self._record_route_observation(
 6036:                     sess.peer_fp,
 6037:                     route=sess.regime,
 6038:                     ok=False,
 6039:                     error_code=type(exc).__name__,
 6040:                 )
 6041:                 await self._drop_outbound_session(sess.peer_fp)
 6042:                 continue
 6043:         if last_error is not None:
 6044:             raise last_error
 6045:         raise RuntimeError("chunk pull failed without an error")
 6046: 
 6047:     async def _recv_chunk_protocol_reply(
 6048:         self,
 6049:         *,
 6050:         sess: OutboundSession,
 6051:         request_id: str,
 6052:         expected_types: set[str],
 6053:         timeout_s: float,
 6054:         accept_rejected_ack: bool = False,
 6055:     ) -> dict:
 6056:         """Receive the matching chunk-protocol reply on a shared peer channel.
 6057: 
 6058:         Swarm chunk query/pull rides the same encrypted channel as chat,
 6059:         presence, grants, and file-control traffic. Production peers can send
 6060:         those frames while a chunk request is in flight, so treating the next
 6061:         frame as "the reply" makes large transfers flaky. This helper waits
 6062:         for the response with a matching ``of`` id, tolerates legacy responses
 6063:         that omit ``of``, and lets ordinary out-of-band frames continue through
 6064:         the normal peer-message handler.
 6065:         """
 6066:         deadline = time.monotonic() + max(0.001, float(timeout_s))
 6067:         while True:
 6068:             remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
 6069:             if remaining <= 0:
 6070:                 raise asyncio.TimeoutError(
 6071:                     f"timed out waiting for {sorted(expected_types)} reply"
 6072:                 )
 6073:             reply = decode_msg(await asyncio.wait_for(
 6074:                 sess.channel.recv(), timeout=remaining,
 6075:             ))
 6076:             t = str(reply.get("t") or "")
 6077:             if t == "CAPS":
 6078:                 continue
 6079:             of = reply.get("of")
 6080:             if of not in (None, request_id):
 6081:                 log.debug(
 6082:                     "ignored stale chunk-protocol frame %s of=%s while waiting for %s",
 6083:                     t, of, request_id,
 6084:                 )
 6085:                 continue
 6086:             if t in expected_types:
 6087:                 return reply
 6088:             if accept_rejected_ack and t == "ACK" and reply.get("rejected"):
 6089:                 return reply
 6090:             if t.startswith("CHUNK_") or t == "ACK":
 6091:                 log.debug(
 6092:                     "ignored unrelated chunk-protocol frame %s while waiting for %s",
 6093:                     t, sorted(expected_types),
 6094:                 )
 6095:                 continue
 6096:             try:
 6097:                 await self._on_peer_message(sess.channel, reply)
 6098:             except Exception as e:
 6099:                 log.debug(
 6100:                     "out-of-band peer frame %s failed during chunk wait: %s",
 6101:                     t, e,
 6102:                 )
 6103: 
 6104:     def _swarm_trust_score(self, peer_fp: str) -> float:
 6105:         if self.state is None:
 6106:             return 0.0
 6107:         rec = self.state.get_peer(peer_fp)
 6108:         if rec is None:
 6109:             return 0.0
 6110:         score = 1.0 if rec.trust == "pinned" else 0.0
 6111:         if rec.is_verified:
 6112:             score += 1.0
 6113:         return score
 6114: 
 6115:     async def query_swarm_chunk_sources(
 6116:         self,
 6117:         peers: list[Peer],
 6118:         hashes: list[str],
 6119:         *,
 6120:         concurrency: int = 4,
 6121:     ) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
 6122:         clean = []
 6123:         seen = set()
 6124:         for h in hashes[:SWARM_QUERY_MAX_HASHES]:
 6125:             h = str(h)
 6126:             if h not in seen and self._valid_blob_hex(h):
 6127:                 seen.add(h)
 6128:                 clean.append(h)
 6129:         sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max(1, int(concurrency)))
 6130:         claims: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
 6131:         batches = [
 6132:             clean[i:i + SWARM_QUERY_BATCH_HASHES]
 6133:             for i in range(0, len(clean), SWARM_QUERY_BATCH_HASHES)
 6134:         ]
 6135: 
 6136:         async def _query(peer: Peer) -> None:
 6137:             peer_fp = self._peer_fp_from_peer(peer)
 6138:             if not peer_fp:
 6139:                 return
 6140:             async with sem:
 6141:                 have: set[str] = set()
 6142:                 for batch in batches:
 6143:                     try:
 6144:                         res = await self.query_peer_chunks(peer, batch)
 6145:                     except Exception as e:
 6146:                         log.debug("swarm chunk query skipped %s: %s", peer.short_id, e)
 6147:                         return
 6148:                     if not res.get("ok"):
 6149:                         return
 6150:                     have.update(
 6151:                         str(h) for h in (res.get("hashes") or [])
 6152:                         if self._valid_blob_hex(str(h))
 6153:                     )
 6154:             if have:
 6155:                 claims[peer_fp] = have
 6156: 
 6157:         await asyncio.gather(*(_query(p) for p in peers))
 6158:         # Phase E #1: enrich the chunk-cohold registry from swarm
 6159:         # query results. Each claim ("peer X has these chunk hashes")
 6160:         # is exactly the gossip-equivalent the homology feeder's
 6161:         # cohold graph needs. Without this hook the feeder only sees
 6162:         # locally-observed FILE_DONE events; with it, every swarm
 6163:         # query brightens the picture.
 6164:         try:
 6165:             for peer_fp, chunk_hashes in claims.items():
 6166:                 short_id = peer_fp[:8]
 6167:                 for blob_hex in chunk_hashes:
 6168:                     if self._valid_blob_hex(blob_hex):
 6169:                         holders = self._chunk_holders.setdefault(
 6170:                             blob_hex, set(),
 6171:                         )
 6172:                         holders.add(short_id)
 6173:             while len(self._chunk_holders) > self._chunk_holders_cap:
 6174:                 eldest = next(iter(self._chunk_holders))
 6175:                 del self._chunk_holders[eldest]
 6176:         except Exception:  # pragma: no cover — defensive
 6177:             pass
 6178:         return claims
 6179: 
 6180:     async def pull_swarm_missing_chunks(
 6181:         self,
 6182:         *,
 6183:         peers: list[Peer],
 6184:         manifest: FileManifest,
 6185:         needed_indexes: list[int] | None = None,
 6186:         concurrency: int = 3,
 6187:     ) -> dict:
 6188:         needed = set(needed_indexes) if needed_indexes is not None else {
 6189:             c.index for c in manifest.chunks
 6190:         }
 6191:         needed_hashes = [
 6192:             c.hash for c in manifest.chunks
 6193:             if c.index in needed and not self._chunk_cache_path(c.hash).is_file()
 6194:         ]
 6195:         if not needed_hashes:
 6196:             return {
 6197:                 "ok": True,
 6198:                 "pulled": 0,
 6199:                 "missing_indexes": [],
 6200:                 "sources": {},
 6201:                 "concurrency": 0,
 6202:             }
 6203:         claims = await self.query_swarm_chunk_sources(
 6204:             peers,
 6205:             needed_hashes,
 6206:             concurrency=concurrency,
 6207:         )
 6208:         health_latency = {}
 6209:         health_bandwidth = {}
 6210:         health_reliability = {}
 6211:         peer_by_fp = {}
 6212:         for p in peers:
 6213:             fp = self._peer_fp_from_peer(p)
 6214:             if not fp:
 6215:                 continue
 6216:             peer_by_fp[fp] = p
 6217:             health = self.get_pair_health(fp) or {}
 6218:             latency = health.get("latency_ewma_ms")
 6219:             if isinstance(latency, (int, float)) and not (latency != latency):
 6220:                 health_latency[fp] = float(latency)
 6221:             bandwidth = health.get("bandwidth_bps") or health.get("throughput_bps")
 6222:             if isinstance(bandwidth, (int, float)) and bandwidth > 0:
 6223:                 health_bandwidth[fp] = float(bandwidth)
 6224:             reliability = health.get("reliability")
 6225:             if isinstance(reliability, (int, float)):
 6226:                 health_reliability[fp] = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(reliability)))
 6227:         # Phase E #2: feed the field score for each source peer into
 6228:         # the swarm planner so high-coherence holders are ranked
 6229:         # ahead of equally-trusted low-coherence ones. The planner's
 6230:         # ChunkSource already has a coherence_score slot;
 6231:         # source_from_hashes accepts it; route_score already promotes
 6232:         # it above bandwidth/latency. The only thing that was
 6233:         # missing was this single call-site fill-in. Honors the
 6234:         # ONE_LINK_FIELD_PREFETCH_DISABLE kill-switch.
 6235:         field_disabled = os.environ.get(
 6236:             "ONE_LINK_FIELD_PREFETCH_DISABLE", "",
 6237:         ).strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on")
 6238: 
 6239:         def _coherence_for(fp: str) -> float | None:
 6240:             if field_disabled:
 6241:                 return None
 6242:             try:
 6243:                 return self.field_score_for_peer(fp[:8])
 6244:             except Exception:  # pragma: no cover
 6245:                 return None
 6246: 
 6247:         source_objects = [
 6248:             source_from_hashes(
 6249:                 fp,
 6250:                 hashes,
 6251:                 trust_score=self._swarm_trust_score(fp),
 6252:                 latency_ms=health_latency.get(fp),
 6253:                 bandwidth_bps=health_bandwidth.get(fp),
 6254:                 reliability=health_reliability.get(fp, 1.0),
 6255:                 coherence_score=_coherence_for(fp),
 6256:             )
 6257:             for fp, hashes in claims.items()
 6258:         ]
 6259:         sources_by_hash: dict[str, list[ChunkSource]] = {h: [] for h in needed_hashes}
 6260:         for source in source_objects:
 6261:             if source.peer_fp not in peer_by_fp:
 6262:                 continue
 6263:             for chunk_hash in source.chunk_hashes:
 6264:                 bucket = sources_by_hash.get(chunk_hash)
 6265:                 if bucket is not None:
 6266:                     bucket.append(source)
 6267:         candidate_fps_by_hash: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
 6268:         for chunk_hash in needed_hashes:
 6269:             candidates = list(sources_by_hash.get(chunk_hash, ()))
 6270:             candidates.sort(
 6271:                 key=lambda s: (*s.route_score_without_tiebreaker(), s.peer_fp),
 6272:                 reverse=True,
 6273:             )
 6274:             candidate_fps_by_hash[chunk_hash] = [s.peer_fp for s in candidates]
 6275:         chunk_by_index = {c.index: c for c in manifest.chunks}
 6276:         chunk_size_by_hash = {c.hash: c.size for c in manifest.chunks}
 6277:         plan = plan_swarm_sources(
 6278:             manifest=manifest,
 6279:             needed_indexes=needed,
 6280:             sources=source_objects,
 6281:         )
 6282:         base_concurrency = max(1, int(concurrency))
 6283:         live_sources = {
 6284:             s.peer_fp
 6285:             for s in source_objects
 6286:             if s.peer_fp in peer_by_fp
 6287:             and any(h in sources_by_hash for h in s.chunk_hashes)
 6288:         }
 6289:         effective_concurrency = min(
 6290:             SWARM_PULL_MAX_CONCURRENCY,
 6291:             max(
 6292:                 base_concurrency,
 6293:                 min(len(needed_hashes), max(1, len(live_sources) * 2)),
 6294:             ),
 6295:         )
 6296:         sem = asyncio.Semaphore(effective_concurrency)
 6297:         pulled = 0
 6298:         retried = 0
 6299:         healed = 0
 6300:         failed: set[int] = set()
 6301:         succeeded: set[int] = set()
 6302: 
 6303:         def _pull_deadline_s(fp: str, chunk_hash: str) -> float:
 6304:             size = chunk_size_by_hash.get(chunk_hash, 0)
 6305:             latency_s = max(0.0, health_latency.get(fp, 100.0)) / 1000.0
 6306:             bandwidth_bps = max(1.0, health_bandwidth.get(fp, 8_000_000.0))
 6307:             reliability = max(0.05, health_reliability.get(fp, 1.0))
 6308:             transfer_s = (max(1, size) * 8.0) / max(1.0, bandwidth_bps * reliability)
 6309:             budget = 0.75 + (latency_s * 4.0) + (transfer_s * 8.0)
 6310:             return min(
 6311:                 SWARM_PULL_MAX_DEADLINE_S,
 6312:                 max(SWARM_PULL_MIN_DEADLINE_S, budget),
 6313:             )
 6314: 
 6315:         async def _pull_from(index: int, fp: str, chunk_hash: str) -> bool:
 6316:             nonlocal pulled
 6317:             if self._chunk_cache_path(chunk_hash).is_file():
 6318:                 succeeded.add(index)
 6319:                 return True
 6320:             peer = peer_by_fp.get(fp)
 6321:             if peer is None:
 6322:                 return False
 6323:             async with sem:
 6324:                 try:
 6325:                     res = await asyncio.wait_for(
 6326:                         self.pull_peer_chunk(peer, chunk_hash),
 6327:                         timeout=_pull_deadline_s(fp, chunk_hash),
 6328:                     )
 6329:                 except Exception as e:
 6330:                     log.debug("swarm chunk pull failed %s from %s: %s", chunk_hash[:8], fp[:8], e)
 6331:                     return False
 6332:             if res.get("ok"):
 6333:                 pulled += 1
 6334:                 succeeded.add(index)
 6335:                 return True
 6336:             return False
 6337: 
 6338:         async def _pull(index: int, fp: str, chunk_hash: str) -> None:
 6339:             if not await _pull_from(index, fp, chunk_hash):
 6340:                 failed.add(index)
 6341: 
 6342:         pulls = [
 6343:             _pull(a.index, str(a.source_peer_fp), a.chunk_hash)
 6344:             for a in plan.assignments
 6345:             if a.status == "assigned" and a.source_peer_fp
 6346:         ]
 6347:         if pulls:
 6348:             await asyncio.gather(*pulls)
 6349: 
 6350:         if failed:
 6351:             retry_indexes = sorted(failed)
 6352:             failed.clear()
 6353: 
 6354:             async def _retry(index: int) -> None:
 6355:                 nonlocal retried, healed
 6356:                 chunk = chunk_by_index.get(index)
 6357:                 if chunk is None:
 6358:                     failed.add(index)
 6359:                     return
 6360:                 primary = next(
 6361:                     (
 6362:                         a.source_peer_fp for a in plan.assignments
 6363:                         if a.index == index
 6364:                     ),
 6365:                     None,
 6366:                 )
 6367:                 for fp in candidate_fps_by_hash.get(chunk.hash, []):
 6368:                     if fp == primary:
 6369:                         continue
 6370:                     retried += 1
 6371:                     if await _pull_from(index, fp, chunk.hash):
 6372:                         healed += 1
 6373:                         return
 6374:                 if index not in succeeded:
 6375:                     failed.add(index)
 6376: 
 6377:             await asyncio.gather(*(_retry(i) for i in retry_indexes))
 6378:         missing = sorted(set(plan.missing_indexes) | failed)
 6379:         return {
 6380:             "ok": not missing,
 6381:             "pulled": pulled,
 6382:             "retried": retried,
 6383:             "healed": healed,
 6384:             "missing_indexes": missing,
 6385:             "sources": plan.per_source_counts(),
 6386:             "source_bytes": plan.per_source_bytes(),
 6387:             "assigned_bytes": plan.assigned_bytes,
 6388:             "missing_bytes": plan.missing_bytes,
 6389:             "concurrency": effective_concurrency,
 6390:             "schedule": list(plan.rarest_first_indexes),
 6391:             "candidate_sources": {
 6392:                 h: fps for h, fps in candidate_fps_by_hash.items() if len(fps) > 1
 6393:             },
 6394:         }
 6395: 
 6396:     def _trusted_chunk_source_peers(self, *, exclude_fp: str) -> list[Peer]:
 6397:         """Build direct peer candidates for swarm chunk assistance."""
 6398:         if self.state is None:
 6399:             return []
 6400:         try:
 6401:             records = self.state.list_peers()
 6402:         except Exception:
 6403:             return []
 6404:         out: list[Peer] = []
 6405:         for rec in records:
 6406:             if rec.fingerprint in (exclude_fp, self.me.fingerprint):
 6407:                 continue
 6408:             if rec.trust != "pinned":
 6409:                 continue
 6410:             if not rec.pubkey:
 6411:                 continue
 6412:             candidates: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
 6413:             seen: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()
 6414: 
 6415:             def add_candidate(host: str | None, port: int | None) -> None:
 6416:                 if not host or not port:
 6417:                     return
 6418:                 try:
 6419:                     key = (str(host), int(port))
 6420:                 except Exception:
 6421:                     return
 6422:                 if key[1] <= 0 or key[1] > 65535 or key in seen:
 6423:                     return
 6424:                 seen.add(key)
 6425:                 candidates.append(key)
 6426: 
 6427:             add_candidate(rec.last_address, rec.last_port)
 6428:             with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 6429:                 stored = self.state.list_route_candidates(
 6430:                     rec.fingerprint,
 6431:                     verified_only=True,
 6432:                     limit=4,
 6433:                 )
 6434:                 for candidate in self._rank_route_candidates(rec.fingerprint, stored):
 6435:                     add_candidate(candidate.get("host"), candidate.get("port"))
 6436: 
 6437:             for host, port in candidates[:2]:
 6438:                 out.append(Peer(
 6439:                     short_id=rec.short_id,
 6440:                     hostname=rec.hostname or rec.short_id,
 6441:                     address=host,
 6442:                     port=port,
 6443:                     ed_pub_hex=rec.pubkey.hex(),
 6444:                 ))
 6445:         return out[:8]

 6447:     async def _swarm_assist_file_offer(
 6448:         self,
 6449:         *,
 6450:         sender_fp: str,
 6451:         name: str,
 6452:         size: int,
 6453:         blob: str,
 6454:         cdc_chunks: list[dict],
 6455:         missing: set[int],
 6456:     ) -> tuple[set[int], dict]:
 6457:         """Try to satisfy inbound missing chunks from other trusted devices."""
 6458:         missing_before = sorted(int(i) for i in missing)
 6459:         if not missing:
 6460:             return missing, {
 6461:                 "pulled": 0,
 6462:                 "sources": {},
 6463:                 "source_count": 0,
 6464:                 "missing_before": [],
 6465:                 "missing_after": [],
 6466:                 "strategy": "already_local",
 6467:             }
 6468:         peers = self._trusted_chunk_source_peers(exclude_fp=sender_fp)
 6469:         if not peers:
 6470:             return missing, {
 6471:                 "pulled": 0,
 6472:                 "sources": {},
 6473:                 "source_count": 0,
 6474:                 "missing_before": missing_before,
 6475:                 "missing_after": missing_before,
 6476:                 "strategy": "sender_only",
 6477:             }
 6478:         manifest = FileManifest(
 6479:             name=name,
 6480:             size=size,
 6481:             blob_hash=blob,
 6482:             chunks=tuple(
 6483:                 FileChunkManifest(
 6484:                     index=int(c["index"]),
 6485:                     start=int(c["start"]),
 6486:                     end=int(c["end"]),
 6487:                     size=int(c["size"]),
 6488:                     hash=str(c["hash"]),
 6489:                 )
 6490:                 for c in cdc_chunks
 6491:             ),
 6492:         )
 6493:         try:
 6494:             result = await asyncio.wait_for(
 6495:                 self.pull_swarm_missing_chunks(
 6496:                     peers=peers,
 6497:                     manifest=manifest,
 6498:                     needed_indexes=sorted(missing),
 6499:                 ),
 6500:                 timeout=SWARM_ASSIST_DEADLINE_S,
 6501:             )
 6502:         except Exception as e:
 6503:             log.debug("swarm assist skipped for %s: %s", blob[:8], e)
 6504:             return missing, {
 6505:                 "pulled": 0,
 6506:                 "sources": {},
 6507:                 "source_count": 0,
 6508:                 "missing_before": missing_before,
 6509:                 "missing_after": missing_before,
 6510:                 "strategy": "swarm_probe_failed",
 6511:                 "error": str(e)[:200],
 6512:             }
 6513:         remaining = {
 6514:             int(c["index"])
 6515:             for c in cdc_chunks
 6516:             if int(c["index"]) in missing
 6517:             and not self._chunk_cache_path(str(c["hash"])).is_file()
 6518:         }
 6519:         sources = dict(result.get("sources") or {})
 6520:         source_bytes = dict(result.get("source_bytes") or {})
 6521:         pulled = int(result.get("pulled") or 0)
 6522:         missing_after = sorted(remaining)
 6523:         source_count = len([fp for fp, count in sources.items() if int(count or 0) > 0])
 6524:         saved_bytes = sum(
 6525:             int(c["size"])
 6526:             for c in cdc_chunks
 6527:             if int(c["index"]) in set(missing_before) - set(missing_after)
 6528:         )
 6529:         return remaining, {
 6530:             "pulled": pulled,
 6531:             "retried": int(result.get("retried") or 0),
 6532:             "healed": int(result.get("healed") or 0),
 6533:             "sources": sources,
 6534:             "source_count": source_count,
 6535:             "source_bytes": source_bytes,
 6536:             "assisted_bytes": saved_bytes,
 6537:             "assigned_bytes": int(result.get("assigned_bytes") or 0),
 6538:             "missing_bytes": int(result.get("missing_bytes") or 0),
 6539:             "candidate_sources": dict(result.get("candidate_sources") or {}),
 6540:             "missing_before": missing_before,
 6541:             "missing_after": missing_after,
 6542:             "strategy": "multi_source_chunk_pull" if pulled else "sender_only",
 6543:             "user_message": (
 6544:                 f"Pulled {pulled} missing chunk{'s' if pulled != 1 else ''} "
 6545:                 f"from {source_count} trusted device"
 6546:                 f"{'s' if source_count != 1 else ''}."
 6547:                 if pulled
 6548:                 else "No trusted device had the missing chunks yet."
 6549:             ),
 6550:         }
 6551: 
 6552:     def _encode_payload(self, data: bytes, *, allow_compress: bool = True) -> tuple[str, bytes]:
 6553:         if not allow_compress or len(data) < COMPRESSION_MIN_BYTES:
 6554:             return "raw", data
 6555:         compressed = zlib.compress(data, level=1)
 6556:         if len(compressed) <= len(data) * (1.0 - COMPRESSION_MIN_SAVINGS):
 6557:             return "zlib", compressed
 6558:         return "raw", data
 6559: 
 6560:     def _decode_payload(self, encoding: str, data: bytes, *, max_bytes: int | None = None) -> bytes:
 6561:         """Decompress an inbound payload with a strict output bound.
 6562: 
 6563:         M4: previously the cap was MAX_INCOMING_FILE_BYTES (1 GiB) for every
 6564:         decompression call, so a zlib bomb of ~1 KB compressed → 1 GiB
 6565:         decompressed could happen before we raised. Callers now pass the
 6566:         *expected* upper bound for the specific message they are decoding —
 6567:         for CDC chunks, that's CDC_MAX_CHUNK_BYTES; for whole files, the
 6568:         declared size; etc.
 6569:         """
 6570:         if encoding == "raw" or not encoding:
 6571:             return data
 6572:         cap = max_bytes if max_bytes is not None else MAX_INCOMING_FILE_BYTES
 6573:         if cap <= 0:
 6574:             raise RuntimeError("max_bytes must be positive")
 6575:         # +1 lets us detect overflow without silently truncating valid data.
 6576:         if encoding == "zlib":
 6577:             dec = zlib.decompressobj()
 6578:             out = dec.decompress(data, cap + 1)
 6579:             if dec.unconsumed_tail or len(out) > cap:
 6580:                 raise RuntimeError(
 6581:                     f"compressed payload exceeds maximum size ({cap} bytes)"
 6582:                 )
 6583:             out += dec.flush()
 6584:             # v0.20.7 (security audit M6): re-check the per-call cap
 6585:             # after dec.flush(), not just MAX_INCOMING_FILE_BYTES.
 6586:             # flush() can emit additional bytes from the decoder's
 6587:             # internal buffer that the bounded decompress() call did
 6588:             # not return. Without this re-check, the per-chunk cap
 6589:             # was leaky and a stream of small over-cap chunks could
 6590:             # compound into noticeable extra allocation.
 6591:             if len(out) > cap:
 6592:                 raise RuntimeError(
 6593:                     f"compressed payload exceeds maximum size after flush "
 6594:                     f"({len(out)} > {cap})"
 6595:                 )
 6596:             if len(out) > MAX_INCOMING_FILE_BYTES:
 6597:                 raise RuntimeError("compressed payload exceeds maximum size")
 6598:             return out
 6599:         raise RuntimeError(f"unknown payload encoding: {encoding}")
 6600: 
 6601:     async def _handle_file_native_chunk(self, channel, msg, peer_fp, peer_sid) -> None:
 6602:         """Phase C-3 (ADR-0026) — receive a FILE_NATIVE_CHUNK message.
 6603: 
 6604:         Wire shape::
 6605: 
 6606:             {
 6607:               "t": "FILE_NATIVE_CHUNK",
 6608:               "id": ..., "ts": ..., "from": ...,
 6609:               "blob": <hex>,
 6610:               "seq": <int>,
 6611:               "chunk_id": <hex 32B BLAKE3>,
 6612:               "plaintext_len": <int>,
 6613:               "data": <base64 of native ciphertext>,
 6614:               "eof": <bool>,
 6615:             }
 6616: 
 6617:         Decryption flows through ``channel.get_or_create_native_transfer_session()``;
 6618:         the AEAD tag binds chunk_id as AAD so any swap/tamper raises
 6619:         before plaintext is exposed. The receiver's native session
 6620:         is matched to the sender's by the shared derive_native_transfer
 6621:         secret, so chunks decrypt in lockstep without any per-chunk
 6622:         key exchange.
 6623:         """
 6624:         from one_link import native_transfer as _nt
 6625: 
 6626:         blob = str(msg.get("blob", ""))
 6627:         f = self._incoming_files.get(blob)
 6628:         if not f:
 6629:             log.warning("FILE_NATIVE_CHUNK with no offer: %s", blob[:8])
 6630:             return
 6631:         # Mid-stream capability re-check (matches FILE_BIN_CHUNK pattern).
 6632:         if not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, FILES):
 6633:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6634:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 6635:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 6636:                 rejected="capability_revoked_mid_stream",
 6637:             )))
 6638:             return
 6639:         seq = int(msg.get("seq", -1))
 6640:         if seq != f.next_seq:
 6641:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6642:             raise RuntimeError(
 6643:                 f"FILE_NATIVE_CHUNK sequence mismatch for {blob[:8]}: "
 6644:                 f"expected {f.next_seq}, got {seq}"
 6645:             )
 6646:         try:
 6647:             chunk_id_hex = str(msg["chunk_id"])
 6648:             chunk_id = bytes.fromhex(chunk_id_hex)
 6649:             if len(chunk_id) != 32:
 6650:                 raise ValueError(f"chunk_id must be 32 bytes, got {len(chunk_id)}")
 6651:             plaintext_len = int(msg["plaintext_len"])
 6652:             ciphertext = base64.b64decode(msg["data"], validate=True)
 6653:         except (KeyError, ValueError, binascii.Error) as exc:
 6654:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6655:             log.warning("FILE_NATIVE_CHUNK decode error from %s: %s", peer_sid, exc)
 6656:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 6657:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 6658:                 rejected="bad_native_chunk_envelope",
 6659:             )))
 6660:             return
 6661:         # Build the session lazily on first chunk. After this it's
 6662:         # reused for the rest of the channel's lifetime — both peers
 6663:         # cache matched instances independently.
 6664:         try:
 6665:             session = channel.get_or_create_native_transfer_session()
 6666:         except Exception as exc:
 6667:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6668:             log.warning("native transfer session unavailable: %s", exc)
 6669:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 6670:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 6671:                 rejected="native_transfer_unavailable",
 6672:             )))
 6673:             return
 6674:         record = _nt.NativeChunkRecord(
 6675:             chunk_id=chunk_id,
 6676:             chunk_index=seq,
 6677:             plaintext_len=plaintext_len,
 6678:             ciphertext=ciphertext,
 6679:         )
 6680:         try:
 6681:             data = session.decrypt_chunk(record)
 6682:         except Exception as exc:
 6683:             # AEAD tag failure means the chunk was tampered, the
 6684:             # session secret diverged, or the chunk_id was swapped.
 6685:             # Any of those is fatal for the transfer.
 6686:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6687:             log.warning(
 6688:                 "FILE_NATIVE_CHUNK decrypt failure for %s (seq=%d): %s",
 6689:                 blob[:8], seq, exc,
 6690:             )
 6691:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 6692:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 6693:                 rejected="native_chunk_decrypt_failed",
 6694:             )))
 6695:             return
 6696:         if f.received + len(data) > f.size:
 6697:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6698:             raise RuntimeError(
 6699:                 f"FILE_NATIVE_CHUNK exceeds declared size for {blob[:8]}: "
 6700:                 f"{f.received + len(data)} > {f.size}"
 6701:             )
 6702:         f.handle.write(data)
 6703:         f.hasher.update(data)
 6704:         f.received += len(data)
 6705:         f.next_seq += 1
 6706:         self._update_transfer(
 6707:             f.transfer_id,
 6708:             status="active",
 6709:             progress_bytes=f.received,
 6710:             total_bytes=f.size,
 6711:             chunks_done=f.next_seq,
 6712:             chunks_total=max(f.next_seq, (f.size + CHUNK_SIZE - 1) // CHUNK_SIZE),
 6713:         )
 6714:         if msg.get("eof"):
 6715:             f.handle.close()
 6716:             got = f.hasher.hexdigest()
 6717:             ok = got == f.blob_hex and f.received == f.size
 6718:             done = {
 6719:                 "t": "FILE_DONE",
 6720:                 "id": msg["id"],
 6721:                 "ts": msg["ts"],
 6722:                 "from": msg["from"],
 6723:                 "name": f.name,
 6724:                 "size": f.size,
 6725:                 "path": str(f.out_path),
 6726:                 "blob": f.blob_hex,
 6727:                 "ok": ok,
 6728:                 "file_risk": classify_file_risk(f.name),
 6729:             }
 6730:             ev = self._persist(msg=done, direction="in", peer_fp=peer_fp, peer_short_id=peer_sid)
 6731:             self._broadcast_tail(ev)
 6732:             self._incoming_files.pop(blob, None)
 6733:             if not ok:
 6734:                 with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
 6735:                     f.out_path.unlink()
 6736:                 self._update_transfer(f.transfer_id, status="failed")
 6737:             else:
 6738:                 self._update_transfer(
 6739:                     f.transfer_id,
 6740:                     status="complete",
 6741:                     progress_bytes=f.size,
 6742:                     total_bytes=f.size,
 6743:                 )
 6744:             log.info("native file done: %s ok=%s -> %s", f.name, ok, f.out_path)
 6745:             await self._ack_file_chunk(channel, msg, f, force_individual=True)
 6746:             if ok:
 6747:                 self._cache_file_chunks(f.out_path)
 6748:             return
 6749:         await self._ack_file_chunk(channel, msg, f)
 6750: 
 6751:     async def _handle_file_binary_chunk(self, channel, msg, peer_fp, peer_sid) -> None:
 6752:         """Receive one raw binary file chunk carried inside the encrypted channel."""
 6753: 
 6754:         blob = str(msg.get("blob", ""))
 6755:         f = self._incoming_files.get(blob)
 6756:         if not f:
 6757:             log.warning("FILE_BIN_CHUNK with no offer: %s", blob[:8])
 6758:             return
 6759:         # v0.20.7 (security audit H15 / H17): re-check pinned + files
 6760:         # capability on every chunk so a mid-transfer revoke takes
 6761:         # effect immediately. See the FILE_CHUNK comment for the full
 6762:         # rationale.
 6763:         if not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, FILES):
 6764:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6765:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 6766:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 6767:                 rejected="capability_revoked_mid_stream",
 6768:             )))
 6769:             return
 6770:         seq = int(msg.get("seq", -1))
 6771:         if seq != f.next_seq:
 6772:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6773:             raise RuntimeError(
 6774:                 f"FILE_BIN_CHUNK sequence mismatch for {blob[:8]}: "
 6775:                 f"expected {f.next_seq}, got {seq}"
 6776:             )
 6777:         data = msg.get("_binary_data")
 6778:         if not isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray)):
 6779:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6780:             raise RuntimeError("FILE_BIN_CHUNK missing binary payload")
 6781:         data = bytes(data)
 6782:         if f.received + len(data) > f.size:
 6783:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6784:             raise RuntimeError(
 6785:                 f"FILE_BIN_CHUNK exceeds declared size for {blob[:8]}: "
 6786:                 f"{f.received + len(data)} > {f.size}"
 6787:             )
 6788:         f.handle.write(data)
 6789:         f.hasher.update(data)
 6790:         f.received += len(data)
 6791:         f.next_seq += 1
 6792:         self._update_transfer(
 6793:             f.transfer_id,
 6794:             status="active",
 6795:             progress_bytes=f.received,
 6796:             total_bytes=f.size,
 6797:             chunks_done=f.next_seq,
 6798:             chunks_total=max(f.next_seq, (f.size + CHUNK_SIZE - 1) // CHUNK_SIZE),
 6799:         )
 6800:         if msg.get("eof"):
 6801:             f.handle.close()
 6802:             got = f.hasher.hexdigest()
 6803:             ok = got == f.blob_hex and f.received == f.size
 6804:             done = {
 6805:                 "t": "FILE_DONE",
 6806:                 "id": msg["id"],
 6807:                 "ts": msg["ts"],
 6808:                 "from": msg["from"],
 6809:                 "name": f.name,
 6810:                 "size": f.size,
 6811:                 "path": str(f.out_path),
 6812:                 "blob": f.blob_hex,
 6813:                 "ok": ok,
 6814:             }
 6815:             self._incoming_files.pop(blob, None)
 6816:             if not ok:
 6817:                 # v0.20.7 (security audit M23): same quarantine
 6818:                 # discipline as _finish_cdc_file. See note there.
 6819:                 quarantine_target: Optional[Path] = None
 6820:                 try:
 6821:                     quarantine_target = f.out_path.with_name(
 6822:                         f.out_path.name + ".failed." + secrets.token_hex(4)
 6823:                     )
 6824:                     f.out_path.rename(quarantine_target)
 6825:                 except OSError:
 6826:                     quarantine_target = None
 6827:                 if quarantine_target is not None:
 6828:                     with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
 6829:                         quarantine_target.unlink()
 6830:                 else:
 6831:                     with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
 6832:                         f.out_path.unlink()
 6833:                 done["path"] = ""
 6834:                 ev = self._persist(
 6835:                     msg=done, direction="in",
 6836:                     peer_fp=peer_fp, peer_short_id=peer_sid,
 6837:                 )
 6838:                 self._broadcast_tail(ev)
 6839:                 self._update_transfer(f.transfer_id, status="failed")
 6840:             else:
 6841:                 ev = self._persist(
 6842:                     msg=done, direction="in",
 6843:                     peer_fp=peer_fp, peer_short_id=peer_sid,
 6844:                 )
 6845:                 self._broadcast_tail(ev)
 6846:                 self._update_transfer(
 6847:                     f.transfer_id,
 6848:                     status="complete",
 6849:                     progress_bytes=f.size,
 6850:                     total_bytes=f.size,
 6851:                 )
 6852:             log.info("binary file done: %s ok=%s -> %s", f.name, ok, f.out_path)
 6853:             await self._ack_file_chunk(channel, msg, f, force_individual=True)
 6854:             if ok:
 6855:                 self._cache_file_chunks(f.out_path)
 6856:             return
 6857:         await self._ack_file_chunk(channel, msg, f)
 6858: 
 6859:     async def _handle_file_cdc_chunk(self, channel, msg, peer_fp, peer_sid) -> None:
 6860:         blob = str(msg.get("blob", ""))
 6861:         f = self._incoming_files.get(blob)
 6862:         if not f or f.cdc_chunks is None or f.cdc_missing is None:
 6863:             return
 6864:         # v0.20.7 (security audit H15 / H17): re-check pinned + files
 6865:         # capability on every chunk so a mid-transfer revoke takes
 6866:         # effect immediately. The CDC path additionally writes to the
 6867:         # global chunk cache (which other peers can pull from), so
 6868:         # leaking chunks past a revoke is doubly-bad without this gate.
 6869:         if not self._capability_allowed(peer_fp, FILES):
 6870:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6871:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 6872:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"),
 6873:                 rejected="capability_revoked_mid_stream",
 6874:             )))
 6875:             return
 6876:         try:
 6877:             idx = int(msg.get("index", -1))
 6878:         except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
 6879:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6880:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 6881:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), rejected="bad_cdc_chunk_index",
 6882:             )))
 6883:             return
 6884:         if idx < 0 or idx >= len(f.cdc_chunks) or idx not in f.cdc_missing:
 6885:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6886:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 6887:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), rejected="unexpected_cdc_chunk",
 6888:             )))
 6889:             return
 6890:         expected = f.cdc_chunks[idx]
 6891:         # M4: bound decompression by the *expected* chunk size, not by the
 6892:         # whole-file cap. A zlib bomb is rejected at 1.5x the expected
 6893:         # chunk size (small slack for compressor framing variance).
 6894:         max_chunk_out = max(expected["size"] + 64, CDC_MAX_CHUNK_BYTES + 64)
 6895:         try:
 6896:             payload = msg.get("_binary_data")
 6897:             if isinstance(payload, (bytes, bytearray)):
 6898:                 data = bytes(payload)
 6899:             else:
 6900:                 data = base64.b64decode(msg.get("data", ""), validate=True)
 6901:             data = self._decode_payload(
 6902:                 str(msg.get("enc", "raw")), data, max_bytes=max_chunk_out,
 6903:             )
 6904:         except (binascii.Error, ValueError) as e:
 6905:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6906:             log.warning("invalid FILE_CDC_CHUNK payload from %s: %s", peer_sid, e)
 6907:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 6908:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), rejected="bad_cdc_chunk_data",
 6909:             )))
 6910:             return
 6911:         if len(data) != expected["size"] or blake3.blake3(data).hexdigest() != expected["hash"]:
 6912:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 6913:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 6914:                 "ACK", self.me.short_id, of=msg.get("id"), rejected="cdc_chunk_integrity_failure",
 6915:             )))
 6916:             return
 6917:         self._store_chunk_cache(
 6918:             expected["hash"],
 6919:             data,
 6920:             blob_hash=f.blob_hex,
 6921:             chunk_index=idx,
 6922:         )
 6923:         assert f.cdc_parts is not None
 6924:         assert f.cdc_missing is not None
 6925:         assert f.cdc_chunks is not None
 6926:         f.cdc_parts[idx] = data
 6927:         f.cdc_missing.remove(idx)
 6928:         cached = len(f.cdc_chunks) - len(f.cdc_missing)
 6929:         done_bytes = sum(int(c["size"]) for c in f.cdc_chunks if int(c["index"]) not in f.cdc_missing)
 6930:         self._update_transfer(
 6931:             f.transfer_id,
 6932:             status="active",
 6933:             progress_bytes=done_bytes,
 6934:             total_bytes=f.size,
 6935:             chunks_done=cached,
 6936:             chunks_total=len(f.cdc_chunks),
 6937:             metadata={
 6938:                 "mode": "cdc",
 6939:                 "path": str(f.out_path),
 6940:                 "missing_chunks": len(f.cdc_missing),
 6941:                 "file_risk": classify_file_risk(f.name),
 6942:             },
 6943:         )
 6944:         if not f.cdc_missing:
 6945:             await self._ack_file_chunk(channel, msg, f, force_individual=True)
 6946:             self._schedule_finish_cdc_file(blob, peer_fp, peer_sid, msg)
 6947:         else:
 6948:             await self._ack_file_chunk(channel, msg, f)
 6949: 
 6950:     async def _finish_cdc_file(self, blob: str, peer_fp: str, peer_sid: str, src_msg: dict) -> None:
 6951:         f = self._incoming_files.get(blob)
 6952:         if not f or f.cdc_chunks is None:
 6953:             return
 6954:         try:
 6955:             f.handle.seek(0)
 6956:             f.handle.truncate()
 6957:             h = blake3.blake3()
 6958:             written = 0
 6959:             for c in f.cdc_chunks:
 6960:                 data = f.cdc_parts.get(c["index"]) if f.cdc_parts else None
 6961:                 if data is None:
 6962:                     data = self._read_chunk_cache(c["hash"])
 6963:                 if data is None:
 6964:                     return
 6965:                 f.handle.write(data)
 6966:                 h.update(data)
 6967:                 written += len(data)
 6968:             f.handle.close()
 6969:             ok = h.hexdigest() == blob and written == f.size
 6970:             done = {
 6971:                 "t": "FILE_DONE", "id": src_msg["id"], "ts": src_msg["ts"],
 6972:                 "from": src_msg["from"], "name": f.name, "size": f.size,
 6973:                 "path": str(f.out_path), "blob": blob, "ok": ok,
 6974:                 "cdc": True,
 6975:                 "file_risk": classify_file_risk(f.name),
 6976:             }
 6977:             self._incoming_files.pop(blob, None)
 6978:             if not ok:
 6979:                 # v0.20.7 (security audit M23): the prior implementation
 6980:                 # ran ``contextlib.suppress(OSError): unlink`` and
 6981:                 # broadcast the ``path`` field regardless. On Windows
 6982:                 # an antivirus / search-indexer transient handle on
 6983:                 # the just-closed file frequently makes the unlink
 6984:                 # fail; the corrupt file then sits in the user's
 6985:                 # inbox indistinguishable (by name) from a legitimate
 6986:                 # one, and the FILE_DONE WS event surfaces a path
 6987:                 # pointing at it. Move-aside-then-retry-unlink ensures
 6988:                 # the visible inbox state never has a path the user
 6989:                 # would mistake for a clean download.
 6990:                 quarantine_target: Optional[Path] = None
 6991:                 try:
 6992:                     quarantine_target = f.out_path.with_name(
 6993:                         f.out_path.name + ".failed." + secrets.token_hex(4)
 6994:                     )
 6995:                     f.out_path.rename(quarantine_target)
 6996:                 except OSError:
 6997:                     quarantine_target = None
 6998:                 if quarantine_target is not None:
 6999:                     with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
 7000:                         quarantine_target.unlink()
 7001:                 else:
 7002:                     with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
 7003:                         f.out_path.unlink()
 7004:                 # Strip the path field from the broadcast so any UI
 7005:                 # subscriber doesn't surface the corrupt path.
 7006:                 done["path"] = ""
 7007:                 ev = self._persist(
 7008:                     msg=done, direction="in",
 7009:                     peer_fp=peer_fp, peer_short_id=peer_sid,
 7010:                 )
 7011:                 self._broadcast_tail(ev)
 7012:                 self._update_transfer(f.transfer_id, status="failed")
 7013:                 return
 7014:             ev = self._persist(msg=done, direction="in", peer_fp=peer_fp, peer_short_id=peer_sid)
 7015:             self._broadcast_tail(ev)
 7016:             self._record_finished_cdc_sources(f.out_path, f)
 7017:             self._update_transfer(
 7018:                 f.transfer_id,
 7019:                 status="complete",
 7020:                 progress_bytes=f.size,
 7021:                 total_bytes=f.size,
 7022:                 chunks_done=len(f.cdc_chunks),
 7023:                 chunks_total=len(f.cdc_chunks),
 7024:             )
 7025:         except Exception:
 7026:             self._update_transfer(f.transfer_id, status="failed")
 7027:             self._abort_incoming_file(blob, f)
 7028:             raise
 7029: 
 7030:     def _record_finished_cdc_sources(self, path: Path, f: IncomingFile) -> None:
 7031:         """Record chunk source rows for a just-assembled CDC receive.
 7032: 
 7033:         The finish path already has the verified manifest. Re-indexing the
 7034:         whole output file here makes repeated large-file sends feel stuck even
 7035:         though no network bytes are needed. Keep the fast content-addressed
 7036:         evidence without paying a second full-file scan.
 7037:         """
 7038:         if self.state is None or not f.cdc_chunks:
 7039:             return
 7040:         try:
 7041:             st = path.stat()
 7042:             self.state.record_chunk_sources_for_file(
 7043:                 path=str(path),
 7044:                 file_size=int(st.st_size),
 7045:                 mtime_ms=int(st.st_mtime * 1000),
 7046:                 chunks=[
 7047:                     {
 7048:                         "index": int(c["index"]),
 7049:                         "start": int(c["start"]),
 7050:                         "end": int(c["end"]),
 7051:                         "size": int(c["size"]),
 7052:                         "hash": str(c["hash"]),
 7053:                     }
 7054:                     for c in f.cdc_chunks
 7055:                 ],
 7056:                 source="received_cdc",
 7057:             )
 7058:         except Exception as e:
 7059:             log.debug("finished CDC source recording skipped for %s: %s", path, e)
 7060: 
 7061:     def _schedule_finish_cdc_file(
 7062:         self, blob: str, peer_fp: str, peer_sid: str, src_msg: dict,
 7063:     ) -> None:
 7064:         """Finish a fully deduped receive after the FILE_WANTS response flushes.
 7065: 
 7066:         If the sender needs zero chunks, the important wire response is
 7067:         FILE_WANTS(wants=[]). Rebuilding the duplicate inbox file can touch tens
 7068:         or hundreds of MiB of local disk, so it must not sit in front of the
 7069:         sender's no-byte completion path.
 7070:         """
 7071: 
 7072:         async def _runner() -> None:
 7073:             try:
 7074:                 await self._finish_cdc_file(blob, peer_fp, peer_sid, src_msg)
 7075:             except Exception as e:
 7076:                 log.warning("background CDC finish failed for %s: %s", blob[:8], e)
 7077: 
 7078:         asyncio.create_task(_runner())
 7079: 
 7080:     # ─── folder sync handlers ──────────────────────────────────────────
 7081:     def _is_pinned(self, peer_fp: str) -> bool:
 7082:         if self.state is None:
 7083:             return False
 7084:         rec = self.state.get_peer(peer_fp)
 7085:         return bool(rec and rec.trust == "pinned")
 7086: 
 7087:     def _sandbox_filter_manifest_entries(
 7088:         self, *, folder: dict, peer_fp: str, entries: list,
 7089:     ) -> list:
 7090:         """v0.7.2 sandbox: per-entry policy gate for incoming manifest
 7091:         rows. Each entry is either accepted (returned + audited as
 7092:         'write' or 'delete') or rejected (dropped + audited).
 7093: 
 7094:         Rejection reasons:
 7095:           - reject_pattern   — file_path matches an ignored glob
 7096:           - reject_size      — declared size > max_file_bytes
 7097:           - reject_traversal — file_path contains '..' or absolute root
 7098:         """
 7099:         if self.state is None:
 7100:             return entries
 7101:         folder_name = folder["name"]
 7102:         max_size = folder.get("max_file_bytes")
 7103:         patterns = folder.get("ignored_patterns") or []
 7104:         kept: list = []
 7105:         for e in entries:
 7106:             if not isinstance(e, dict):
 7107:                 continue
 7108:             file_path = str(e.get("file_path", "") or "")
 7109:             blob_hash = e.get("blob_hash")
 7110:             size = e.get("size")
 7111:             # Path-traversal guard: reject any entry whose path
 7112:             # would escape the sandbox root or look like an absolute
 7113:             # path. Existing code in foldersync also normalizes; this
 7114:             # is a belt-and-suspenders check at the policy layer with
 7115:             # an audited reject so the user can see attempts.
 7116:             #
 7117:             # v0.20.7 (security audit M21): broader rejection set.
 7118:             # The original guard caught `..` / leading `/` /
 7119:             # `X:` Windows drive-letter starts, but missed:
 7120:             #   - NUL + control characters (POSIX silently truncates
 7121:             #     paths at NUL; Windows rejects but logs; either way
 7122:             #     a control char in a filename is suspicious).
 7123:             #   - UNC paths (``\\server\share\...``) — even after the
 7124:             #     `\` → `/` flip these aren't local paths.
 7125:             #   - Windows reserved device basenames (CON, NUL, COM1
 7126:             #     etc., even with extensions) — opening one yields
 7127:             #     the device, not a real file.
 7128:             #   - Trailing dot / space — Windows silently strips
 7129:             #     them, collapsing distinct names onto one on-disk
 7130:             #     entry which an attacker can use for collision.
 7131:             norm = file_path.replace("\\", "/").lstrip("/")
 7132:             has_control = any(
 7133:                 ord(c) < 0x20 or ord(c) == 0x7f for c in file_path
 7134:             )
 7135:             looks_unc = (
 7136:                 file_path.startswith("\\\\")
 7137:                 or file_path.startswith("//")
 7138:                 or "\\\\?\\" in file_path
 7139:             )
 7140:             from pathlib import PurePosixPath
 7141:             try:
 7142:                 parts = PurePosixPath(norm).parts if norm else ()
 7143:             except Exception:
 7144:                 parts = ()
 7145:             reserved_windows = frozenset({
 7146:                 "CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL",
 7147:                 "COM1", "COM2", "COM3", "COM4", "COM5",
 7148:                 "COM6", "COM7", "COM8", "COM9",
 7149:                 "LPT1", "LPT2", "LPT3", "LPT4", "LPT5",
 7150:                 "LPT6", "LPT7", "LPT8", "LPT9",
 7151:             })
 7152:             has_reserved = any(
 7153:                 part.split(".")[0].upper() in reserved_windows
 7154:                 for part in parts
 7155:             )
 7156:             has_trailing_dot_or_space = any(
 7157:                 part != part.rstrip(". ") for part in parts
 7158:             )
 7159:             if (
 7160:                 not norm
 7161:                 or ".." in norm.split("/")
 7162:                 or file_path.startswith("/")
 7163:                 or (len(file_path) > 1 and file_path[1] == ":")
 7164:                 or has_control
 7165:                 or looks_unc
 7166:                 or has_reserved
 7167:                 or has_trailing_dot_or_space
 7168:             ):
 7169:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 7170:                     self.state.record_folder_audit_event(
 7171:                         folder_name=folder_name, peer_fp=peer_fp,
 7172:                         action="reject_traversal", file_path=file_path,
 7173:                         blob_hash=blob_hash if isinstance(blob_hash, str) else None,
 7174:                         size=int(size) if isinstance(size, int) else None,
 7175:                         note="path traversal or absolute path",
 7176:                     )
 7177:                 continue
 7178:             # Pattern deny-list.
 7179:             if patterns and self.state.folder_path_matches_ignored(
 7180:                 norm, patterns,
 7181:             ):
 7182:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 7183:                     self.state.record_folder_audit_event(
 7184:                         folder_name=folder_name, peer_fp=peer_fp,
 7185:                         action="reject_pattern", file_path=norm,
 7186:                         blob_hash=blob_hash if isinstance(blob_hash, str) else None,
 7187:                         size=int(size) if isinstance(size, int) else None,
 7188:                     )
 7189:                 continue
 7190:             # Size cap.
 7191:             if (
 7192:                 max_size is not None
 7193:                 and isinstance(size, int)
 7194:                 and size > int(max_size)
 7195:             ):
 7196:                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 7197:                     self.state.record_folder_audit_event(
 7198:                         folder_name=folder_name, peer_fp=peer_fp,
 7199:                         action="reject_size", file_path=norm,
 7200:                         blob_hash=blob_hash if isinstance(blob_hash, str) else None,
 7201:                         size=int(size),
 7202:                         note=f"exceeds max_file_bytes={max_size}",
 7203:                     )
 7204:                 continue
 7205:             # Accept. Audit as write/delete depending on whether
 7206:             # this is a tombstone.
 7207:             kept.append(e)
 7208:             with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 7209:                 self.state.record_folder_audit_event(
 7210:                     folder_name=folder_name, peer_fp=peer_fp,
 7211:                     action="delete" if blob_hash is None else "write",
 7212:                     file_path=norm,
 7213:                     blob_hash=blob_hash if isinstance(blob_hash, str) else None,
 7214:                     size=int(size) if isinstance(size, int) else None,
 7215:                 )
 7216:         return kept
 7217: 
 7218:     async def _handle_manifest_push(self, channel, msg, peer_fp):
 7219:         if self.folder_engine is None or self.state is None:
 7220:             return
 7221:         # Only sync folders the peer is explicitly shared with AND is pinned.
 7222:         if not self._is_pinned(peer_fp):
 7223:             log.info("ignoring MANIFEST_PUSH from non-pinned peer %s", peer_fp[:8])
 7224:             return
 7225:         folder_name = msg.get("folder")
 7226:         if not folder_name:
 7227:             return
 7228:         f = self.state.get_folder(folder_name)
 7229:         if not f or peer_fp not in f["shared_with"]:
 7230:             log.info("MANIFEST_PUSH for folder we don't share with this peer")
 7231:             return
 7232:         if not self.state.folder_peer_allows(folder_name, peer_fp, "pull"):
 7233:             log.info("MANIFEST_PUSH denied by folder capability for %s", peer_fp[:8])
 7234:             return
 7235:         remote_root = msg.get("merkle_root")
 7236:         remote_count = msg.get("entry_count")
 7237:         local_root = self.folder_engine.manifest_root(folder_name)
 7238:         local_count = len(self.folder_engine.manifest_for(folder_name))
 7239:         # M7: a peer can claim "merkle_root matches yours" to make us skip
 7240:         # the merge and miss real updates. Only honour the early-exit when
 7241:         # *both* roots match AND the entry counts match. The root alone is
 7242:         # peer-supplied (can be lied about); the count check makes the
 7243:         # asymmetric attack (pretending to be in sync) require an actual
 7244:         # collision rather than just a guess.
 7245:         entries = msg.get("entries", []) or []
 7246:         if (
 7247:             remote_root and remote_root == local_root
 7248:             and isinstance(remote_count, int) and remote_count == local_count
 7249:             and not entries
 7250:         ):
 7251:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 7252:                 "MANIFEST_WANTS", self.me.short_id,
 7253:                 folder=folder_name, wants=[], merkle_root=local_root,
 7254:                 already_in_sync=True,
 7255:             )))
 7256:             log.info(
 7257:                 "MANIFEST_PUSH from %s: Merkle roots + counts match; in sync",
 7258:                 peer_fp[:8],
 7259:             )
 7260:             return
 7261:         # v0.7.2 sandbox: filter remote entries against the folder's
 7262:         # capability policy (max_file_bytes, ignored_patterns, path
 7263:         # traversal). Each accept/reject decision is audited so the
 7264:         # user can review what the peer tried to do. The filtered
 7265:         # list is what the manifest engine actually merges.
 7266:         entries = self._sandbox_filter_manifest_entries(
 7267:             folder=f, peer_fp=peer_fp, entries=entries,
 7268:         )
 7269:         try:
 7270:             wants_data = self.folder_engine.receive_remote_manifest(
 7271:                 folder_name=folder_name, entries=entries,
 7272:                 peer_fp=peer_fp,  # v0.8.9: attribute conflicts to source
 7273:             )
 7274:         except Exception as e:
 7275:             log.warning("manifest merge failed: %s", e)
 7276:             return
 7277:         wants = [
 7278:             d["blob_hash"] for d in wants_data
 7279:             if d.get("blob_hash") and self._valid_blob_hex(d["blob_hash"])
 7280:         ]
 7281:         # M1: register the wanted set so subsequent BLOB_OFFER / BLOB_CHUNK
 7282:         # frames from this peer are gated to the blobs we asked for.
 7283:         if wants:
 7284:             self._expected_blob_pulls.setdefault(peer_fp, set()).update(wants)
 7285:         await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 7286:             "MANIFEST_WANTS", self.me.short_id,
 7287:             folder=folder_name, wants=wants,
 7288:             merkle_root=self.folder_engine.manifest_root(folder_name),
 7289:         )))
 7290:         log.info("MANIFEST_PUSH from %s: %d entries, %d wants",
 7291:                  peer_fp[:8], len(entries), len(wants))
 7292: 
 7293:     async def _handle_manifest_wants(self, channel, msg, peer_fp):
 7294:         if self.folder_engine is None or self.state is None:
 7295:             return
 7296:         if not self._is_pinned(peer_fp):
 7297:             return
 7298:         folder_name = msg.get("folder")
 7299:         wants = msg.get("wants", []) or []
 7300:         if not folder_name:
 7301:             return
 7302:         f = self.state.get_folder(folder_name)
 7303:         if not f or peer_fp not in f["shared_with"]:
 7304:             return
 7305:         if not self.state.folder_peer_allows(folder_name, peer_fp, "push"):
 7306:             return
 7307:         for blob_hex in wants:
 7308:             if not self._valid_blob_hex(blob_hex):
 7309:                 continue
 7310:             if not self.blob_store or not self.blob_store.has(blob_hex):
 7311:                 continue
 7312:             size = self.blob_store.size(blob_hex)
 7313:             await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 7314:                 "BLOB_OFFER", self.me.short_id,
 7315:                 blob=blob_hex, size=size,
 7316:             )))
 7317:             seq = 0
 7318:             try:
 7319:                 with self.blob_store.open_read(blob_hex) as fh:
 7320:                     prev = fh.read(CHUNK_SIZE)
 7321:                     while prev:
 7322:                         cur = fh.read(CHUNK_SIZE)
 7323:                         eof = not cur
 7324:                         await channel.send(encode_msg(make_msg(
 7325:                             "BLOB_CHUNK", self.me.short_id,
 7326:                             blob=blob_hex, seq=seq,
 7327:                             data=base64.b64encode(prev).decode("ascii"),
 7328:                             eof=eof,
 7329:                         )))
 7330:                         seq += 1
 7331:                         prev = cur
 7332:             except OSError as e:
 7333:                 log.warning("blob stream %s failed: %s", blob_hex[:8], e)
 7334: 
 7335:     async def _handle_blob_offer(self, channel, msg, peer_fp):
 7336:         if not self._is_pinned(peer_fp) or self.blob_store is None:
 7337:             return
 7338:         blob = msg.get("blob")
 7339:         size = msg.get("size", 0)
 7340:         if not self._valid_blob_hex(blob or ""):
 7341:             return
 7342:         if size < 0 or size > MAX_INCOMING_FILE_BYTES:
 7343:             return
 7344:         # M1: only accept blobs we explicitly requested from this peer via
 7345:         # MANIFEST_WANTS in the current sync cycle. A paired peer cannot use
 7346:         # the folder-sync wire as a write primitive into our blob store with
 7347:         # content we never asked for.
 7348:         expected = self._expected_blob_pulls.get(peer_fp)
 7349:         if expected is None or blob not in expected:
 7350:             log.info(
 7351:                 "ignoring unsolicited BLOB_OFFER from %s for %s",
 7352:                 peer_fp[:8], blob[:12] if blob else "?",
 7353:             )
 7354:             return
 7355:         # If we already have this blob, ignore the offer (peer wasted work).
 7356:         if self.blob_store.has(blob):
 7357:             return
 7358:         # Open a streaming writer.
 7359:         cm = self.blob_store.writer()
 7360:         writer, tmp_path = cm.__enter__()
 7361:         self._incoming_blobs[blob] = {
 7362:             "size": int(size),
 7363:             "received": 0,
 7364:             "next_seq": 0,
 7365:             "writer": writer,
 7366:             "cm": cm,
 7367:             "tmp_path": tmp_path,
 7368:         }
 7369: 
 7370:     async def _handle_blob_chunk(self, channel, msg, peer_fp):
 7371:         if not self._is_pinned(peer_fp) or self.blob_store is None:
 7372:             return
 7373:         blob = msg.get("blob")
 7374:         ctx = self._incoming_blobs.get(blob)
 7375:         if ctx is None:
 7376:             return
 7377:         # M1 (defense in depth): the offer was already gated, but if the
 7378:         # connection got reused after a different sync cycle this gate
 7379:         # ensures chunks for an unsolicited offer can't slip through.
 7380:         expected = self._expected_blob_pulls.get(peer_fp)
 7381:         if expected is None or blob not in expected:
 7382:             self._abort_blob(blob)
 7383:             return
 7384:         seq = msg.get("seq", -1)
 7385:         if seq != ctx["next_seq"]:
 7386:             log.warning("BLOB_CHUNK seq mismatch for %s (got %s, want %d)",
 7387:                         blob[:8], seq, ctx["next_seq"])
 7388:             self._abort_blob(blob)
 7389:             return
 7390:         try:
 7391:             data = base64.b64decode(msg.get("data", ""))
 7392:         except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
 7393:             self._abort_blob(blob)
 7394:             return
 7395:         ctx["received"] += len(data)
 7396:         ctx["next_seq"] += 1
 7397:         if ctx["received"] > ctx["size"] + (8 * 1024):
 7398:             self._abort_blob(blob)
 7399:             return
 7400:         try:
 7401:             ctx["writer"].write(data)
 7402:         except Exception:
 7403:             self._abort_blob(blob)
 7404:             return
 7405:         if msg.get("eof"):
 7406:             try:
 7407:                 got_hash = ctx["writer"].commit()
 7408:             except Exception as e:
 7409:                 log.warning("blob commit failed: %s", e)
 7410:                 self._abort_blob(blob)
 7411:                 return
 7412:             ctx["cm"].__exit__(None, None, None)
 7413:             self._incoming_blobs.pop(blob, None)
 7414:             if got_hash != blob:
 7415:                 log.warning("blob hash mismatch: got %s, want %s",
 7416:                             got_hash[:12], blob[:12])
 7417:                 # Hash didn't match; remove what we stored
 7418:                 self.blob_store.remove(got_hash)
 7419:                 return
 7420:             # Drop the satisfied entry from the expected-pull set.
 7421:             self._expected_blob_pulls.get(peer_fp, set()).discard(blob)
 7422:             self.blob_store.path(got_hash)  # confirms it lives
 7423:             # State + folder_engine are both initialised inside
 7424:             # ``start()`` before any chunk can land here; the wider
 7425:             # nullable typing is for the boot window.
 7426:             assert self.state is not None
 7427:             assert self.folder_engine is not None
 7428:             try:
 7429:                 self.state.record_blob(got_hash, ctx["received"])
 7430:             except Exception:
 7431:                 pass
 7432:             n_files = self.folder_engine.materialize_after_blob_arrived(
 7433:                 blob_hash=got_hash,
 7434:             )
 7435:             if self.ui_server is not None:
 7436:                 self.ui_server.broadcast({
 7437:                     "type": "folder_synced",
 7438:                     "blob": got_hash,
 7439:                     "files": n_files,
 7440:                 })
 7441:             log.info("blob received %s (%d files materialized)",
 7442:                      got_hash[:12], n_files)
 7443: 
 7444:     def _abort_blob(self, blob: str) -> None:
 7445:         ctx = self._incoming_blobs.pop(blob, None)
 7446:         if not ctx:
 7447:             return
 7448:         try:
 7449:             ctx["cm"].__exit__(None, None, None)
 7450:         except Exception:
 7451:             pass
 7452: 
 7453:     # ─── outbound to a peer ─────────────────────────────────────────────
 7454:     def _peer_fp_from_peer(self, peer: Peer) -> str | None:
 7455:         if not peer.ed_pub_hex:
 7456:             return None
 7457:         try:
 7458:             return fingerprint_of(bytes.fromhex(peer.ed_pub_hex))
 7459:         except ValueError:
 7460:             return None
 7461: 
 7462:     # ─── v0.5.1: rendezvous lifecycle + peer-endpoint resolution ───────
 7463:     async def _start_rendezvous(self, *, peer_port: int) -> None:
 7464:         """Start a RendezvousClient if URLs are configured. No-op
 7465:         otherwise. Failures are logged, not raised — the daemon must
 7466:         keep working LAN-only when rendezvous is unreachable.
 7467: 
 7468:         v0.5.4: First-run defaults — if no URLs are configured in
 7469:         state yet, harvest them from (in priority order):
 7470:           1. ONE_LINK_RDZ_DEFAULTS env var (comma-separated URLs)
 7471:           2. ~/.config/one-link/seeds.toml (or platform equivalent)
 7472:           3. The DEFAULT_RENDEZVOUS_URLS constant baked into the
 7473:              binary (empty by default; populated by distributors who
 7474:              want a zero-step out-of-box experience)
 7475:         These defaults are written to state.set_rendezvous_urls
 7476:         once on first run; user edits in Settings override.
 7477:         """
 7478:         if self.state is None:
 7479:             return
