 3530:     def _append_call_media_event_audit(self, body: dict) -> None:
 3531:         """Append a sanitized call-media event row.
 3532: 
 3533:         Events are fixed slugs from the browser media driver. They do not
 3534:         include SDP, ICE candidates, IP addresses, device names, file names,
 3535:         peer labels, or message contents.
 3536:         """
 3537:         try:
 3538:             call_id = str(body.get("call_id") or "")
 3539:             event = str(body.get("event") or "").strip().lower()
 3540:             allowed_events = {
 3541:                 "local_media_ready",
 3542:                 "negotiation_starting",
 3543:                 "offer_preparing",
 3544:                 "offer_sent",
 3545:                 "offer_send_failed",
 3546:                 "answer_preparing",
 3547:                 "answer_sent",
 3548:                 "answer_send_failed",
 3549:                 "remote_offer_received",
 3550:                 "remote_answer_received",
 3551:                 "remote_track_connected",
 3552:                 "ice_state_changed",
 3553:             }
 3554:             if not call_id or event not in allowed_events:
 3555:                 return
 3556: 
 3557:             def _clean_token(name: str, allowed: set[str]) -> str | None:
 3558:                 raw = body.get(name)
 3559:                 if not isinstance(raw, str):
 3560:                     return None
 3561:                 clean = raw.strip().lower()
 3562:                 return clean if clean in allowed else None
 3563: 
 3564:             row = {
 3565:                 "ts_ms": int(time.time() * 1000),
 3566:                 "row_type": "event",
 3567:                 "call_id": call_id,
 3568:                 "event": event,
 3569:                 "reason": _clean_token(
 3570:                     "reason", {"start", "accept", "active", "watchdog", "metrics"},
 3571:                 ),
 3572:                 "media_kind": _clean_token("media_kind", {"audio", "video"}),
 3573:                 "state": _clean_token(
 3574:                     "state",
 3575:                     {
 3576:                         "new", "checking", "connected", "completed",
 3577:                         "failed", "disconnected", "closed", "connecting",
 3578:                     },
 3579:                 ),
 3580:                 "ok": bool(body.get("ok")) if "ok" in body else None,
 3581:             }
 3582:             log_dir = data_dir() / "logs"
 3583:             log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 3584:             with (log_dir / "call_media_audit.jsonl").open(
 3585:                 "a", encoding="utf-8",
 3586:             ) as f:
 3587:                 f.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
 3588:         except Exception as exc:
 3589:             log.debug("call media event audit append failed: %s", exc)
 3590: 
 3591:     def _append_call_media_audit(self, body: dict) -> None:
 3592:         """Append a privacy-safe WebRTC media diagnostic row.
 3593: 
 3594:         The row intentionally excludes SDP bodies, ICE candidate strings,
 3595:         IP addresses, device names, and message contents. It captures only
 3596:         state-machine and aggregate media counters so a failed call can be
 3597:         diagnosed after the fact.
 3598:         """
 3599:         try:
 3600:             call_id = str(body.get("call_id") or "")
 3601:             if not call_id:
 3602:                 return
 3603:             allowed_states = {
 3604:                 "new", "checking", "connected", "completed", "failed",
 3605:                 "disconnected", "closed", "connecting", "stable",
 3606:                 "have-local-offer", "have-remote-offer",
 3607:                 "have-local-pranswer", "have-remote-pranswer",
 3608:                 "gathering", "complete",
 3609:             }
 3610: 
 3611:             def _state(name: str) -> str | None:
 3612:                 raw = body.get(name)
 3613:                 if not isinstance(raw, str):
 3614:                     return None
 3615:                 clean = raw.strip().lower()
 3616:                 return clean if clean in allowed_states else None
 3617: 
 3618:             def _int(name: str) -> int | None:
 3619:                 raw = body.get(name)
 3620:                 if raw is None:
 3621:                     return None
 3622:                 try:
 3623:                     value = int(raw)
 3624:                 except (TypeError, ValueError):
 3625:                     return None
 3626:                 return max(0, min(value, 32))
 3627: 
 3628:             def _float(name: str) -> float | None:
 3629:                 raw = body.get(name)
 3630:                 if raw is None:
 3631:                     return None
 3632:                 try:
 3633:                     value = float(raw)
 3634:                 except (TypeError, ValueError):
 3635:                     return None
 3636:                 if value != value:
 3637:                     return None
 3638:                 return value
 3639: 
 3640:             row = {
 3641:                 "ts_ms": int(time.time() * 1000),
 3642:                 "row_type": "metrics",
 3643:                 "call_id": call_id,
 3644:                 "ice_connection_state": _state("ice_connection_state"),
 3645:                 "connection_state": _state("connection_state"),
 3646:                 "ice_gathering_state": _state("ice_gathering_state"),
 3647:                 "signaling_state": _state("signaling_state"),
 3648:                 "has_local_description": bool(body.get("has_local_description")),
 3649:                 "has_remote_description": bool(body.get("has_remote_description")),
 3650:                 "local_audio_tracks": _int("local_audio_tracks"),
 3651:                 "local_video_tracks": _int("local_video_tracks"),
 3652:                 "local_live_audio_tracks": _int("local_live_audio_tracks"),
 3653:                 "local_live_video_tracks": _int("local_live_video_tracks"),
 3654:                 "remote_audio_tracks": _int("remote_audio_tracks"),
 3655:                 "remote_video_tracks": _int("remote_video_tracks"),
 3656:                 "remote_live_audio_tracks": _int("remote_live_audio_tracks"),
 3657:                 "remote_live_video_tracks": _int("remote_live_video_tracks"),
 3658:                 "rtt_ms": _float("rtt_ms"),
 3659:                 "jitter_ms": _float("jitter_ms"),
 3660:                 "loss_rate": _float("loss_rate"),
 3661:                 "bandwidth_estimate_kbps": _float("bandwidth_estimate_kbps"),
 3662:             }
 3663:             log_dir = data_dir() / "logs"
 3664:             log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 3665:             with (log_dir / "call_media_audit.jsonl").open(
 3666:                 "a", encoding="utf-8",
 3667:             ) as f:
 3668:                 f.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
 3669:         except Exception as exc:
 3670:             log.debug("call media audit append failed: %s", exc)
 3671: 
 3672:     def _handle_observe_frame_action(self, body: dict) -> web.Response:
 3673:         """Tier η — browser reports an arriving real audio/video frame.
 3674: 
 3675:         Body: {"action": "observe_frame", "call_id": ...,
 3676:                "media_kind": "audio"|"video", "seq": <int>,
 3677:                "timestamp_us": <int>}
 3678:         Content is NOT shipped to the daemon — only metadata. The
 3679:         runtime tracks confirm-ratios; content stays in the browser.
 3680:         """
 3681:         from one_link.predictive_continuity import MediaKind
 3682:         call_id = body.get("call_id")
 3683:         if not isinstance(call_id, str) or not call_id:
 3684:             return web.json_response(
 3685:                 {"ok": False, "user_message": "Call is no longer active."},
 3686:             )
 3687:         kind_str = (body.get("media_kind") or "audio").lower()
 3688:         kind = MediaKind.AUDIO if kind_str == "audio" else MediaKind.VIDEO
 3689:         try:
 3690:             seq = int(body.get("seq", 0))
 3691:             ts_us = int(body.get("timestamp_us", 0))
 3692:         except (TypeError, ValueError):
 3693:             return web.json_response(
 3694:                 {"ok": False, "user_message": "Couldn't read that frame."},
 3695:             )
 3696:         # The runtime hashes content for novelty matching but doesn't
 3697:         # need it on the daemon — pass a stable placeholder.
 3698:         placeholder = seq.to_bytes(8, "big", signed=False)
 3699:         self.daemon._predictive.observe_real_frame(
 3700:             call_id=call_id, media_kind=kind,
 3701:             seq=seq, timestamp_us=ts_us, content=placeholder,
 3702:         )
 3703:         return web.json_response({"ok": True, "call_id": call_id})
 3704: 
 3705:     def _handle_predict_frame_action(self, body: dict) -> web.Response:
 3706:         """Tier η — browser missed a frame slot; runtime returns
 3707:         a prediction descriptor (the actual sample synthesis happens
 3708:         in the browser via the Extrapolator)."""
 3709:         from one_link.predictive_continuity import MediaKind
 3710:         call_id = body.get("call_id")
 3711:         if not isinstance(call_id, str) or not call_id:
 3712:             return web.json_response(
 3713:                 {"ok": False, "user_message": "Call is no longer active."},
 3714:             )
 3715:         kind_str = (body.get("media_kind") or "audio").lower()
 3716:         kind = MediaKind.AUDIO if kind_str == "audio" else MediaKind.VIDEO
 3717:         try:
 3718:             due_seq = int(body.get("due_seq", 0))
 3719:             now_us = int(body.get("now_us", 0))
 3720:         except (TypeError, ValueError):
 3721:             return web.json_response(
 3722:                 {"ok": False, "user_message": "Couldn't compute prediction."},
 3723:             )
 3724:         result = self.daemon._predictive.request_prediction(
 3725:             call_id=call_id, media_kind=kind,
 3726:             due_seq=due_seq, now_us=now_us,
 3727:         )
 3728:         if result is None or result.frame is None:
 3729:             return web.json_response({
 3730:                 "ok": True, "call_id": call_id,
 3731:                 "predicted": False,
 3732:                 "reason": result.reason_code if result else "unknown",
 3733:             })
 3734:         return web.json_response({
 3735:             "ok": True, "call_id": call_id,
 3736:             "predicted": True,
 3737:             "frame_kind": result.frame.frame_kind.name,
 3738:             "reason": result.reason_code,
 3739:         })

 3754:     async def _handle_attest_frame_action(self, body: dict) -> web.Response:
 3755:         """Tier β — accept a browser-computed SHA-256 window hash,
 3756:         wrap it in a signed FrameProvenance, and ship to the peer
 3757:         as CALL_FRAME_ATTEST.
 3758: 
 3759:         Body shape:
 3760:           {"action": "attest_frame", "call_id": ...,
 3761:            "segment_hash_hex": "<64-hex>",  # SHA-256 of audio chunk
 3762:            "timestamp_us": <int>,
 3763:            "path_class": "lan"|"direct"|"relay"|"onion"|"local",
 3764:            "recording_state": "none"|"local"|"remote"|"mutual"}
 3765:         """
 3766:         from one_link.frame_provenance import PathClass, RecordingState
 3767:         from one_link.live_frame_provenance import (
 3768:             LIVE_SCHEMA_V2,
 3769:             sign_browser_window,
 3770:         )
 3771:         from one_link.wire import make_msg
 3772: 
 3773:         call_id = body.get("call_id")
 3774:         if not isinstance(call_id, str) or not call_id:
 3775:             return web.json_response(
 3776:                 {"ok": False, "user_message": "Call is no longer active."},
 3777:             )
 3778:         mgr = self.daemon._call_registry.get(call_id)
 3779:         if mgr is None:
 3780:             return web.json_response(
 3781:                 {"ok": False, "user_message": "This call is no longer active."},
 3782:             )
 3783: 
 3784:         seg_hex = body.get("segment_hash_hex")
 3785:         if not isinstance(seg_hex, str) or len(seg_hex) != 64:
 3786:             return web.json_response(
 3787:                 {"ok": False, "user_message": "Couldn't attest that audio."},
 3788:             )
 3789:         try:
 3790:             seg_bytes = bytes.fromhex(seg_hex)
 3791:         except ValueError:
 3792:             return web.json_response(
 3793:                 {"ok": False, "user_message": "Couldn't attest that audio."},
 3794:             )
 3795:         try:
 3796:             ts_us = int(body.get("timestamp_us", 0))
 3797:         except (TypeError, ValueError):
 3798:             return web.json_response(
 3799:                 {"ok": False, "user_message": "Couldn't attest that audio."},
 3800:             )
 3801: 
 3802:         path_class_map = {
 3803:             "local": PathClass.LOCAL, "lan": PathClass.LAN,
 3804:             "direct": PathClass.DIRECT, "relay": PathClass.RELAY,
 3805:             "onion": PathClass.ONION, "mesh": PathClass.MESH,
 3806:         }
 3807:         rec_map = {
 3808:             "none": RecordingState.NOT_RECORDING,
 3809:             "local": RecordingState.RECORDING_LOCAL,
 3810:             "remote": RecordingState.RECORDING_REMOTE,
 3811:             "mutual": RecordingState.RECORDING_MUTUAL,
 3812:         }
 3813:         path_class = path_class_map.get(
 3814:             (body.get("path_class") or "lan").lower(), PathClass.LAN,
 3815:         )
 3816:         recording_state = rec_map.get(
 3817:             (body.get("recording_state") or "none").lower(),
 3818:             RecordingState.NOT_RECORDING,
 3819:         )
 3820:         device_id = self.daemon.me.fingerprint[:8]
 3821:         try:
 3822:             signed = sign_browser_window(
 3823:                 signing_key=self.daemon.me.private,
 3824:                 device_id=device_id,
 3825:                 path_class=path_class,
 3826:                 recording_state=recording_state,
 3827:                 segment_hash=seg_bytes,
 3828:                 timestamp_us=ts_us,
 3829:             )
 3830:         except Exception as exc:
 3831:             log.warning("attest_frame sign failed: %s", exc)
 3832:             return web.json_response(
 3833:                 {"ok": False, "user_message": "Couldn't attest that audio."},
 3834:             )
 3835: 
 3836:         peer_master_vk_hex = mgr.state.peer_master_vk_hex
 3837:         peer = self.daemon._resolve_peer_for_outbound(peer_master_vk_hex)
 3838:         if peer is None:
 3839:             return web.json_response(
 3840:                 {"ok": False, "user_message": "Couldn't reach that contact."},
 3841:             )
 3842:         # Wire-encode the signed attestation.
 3843:         from one_link.frame_provenance import to_wire_dict
 3844:         wire_msg = make_msg(
 3845:             "CALL_FRAME_ATTEST",
 3846:             self.daemon.me.short_id,
 3847:             call_id=call_id,
 3848:             attestation=to_wire_dict(signed),
 3849:         )
 3850:         try:
 3851:             await asyncio.wait_for(
 3852:                 self.daemon.send_to(peer, [wire_msg]),
 3853:                 timeout=getattr(self.daemon, "CALL_SIGNAL_SEND_TIMEOUT_S", 6.0),
 3854:             )
 3855:         except Exception as exc:
 3856:             log.warning("attest_frame send failed: %s", exc)
 3857:             return web.json_response(
 3858:                 {"ok": False, "user_message": "Couldn't reach that contact."},
 3859:             )
 3860:         return web.json_response({"ok": True, "call_id": call_id})

 3979:     async def api_me(self, request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
 3980:         me = self.daemon.me
 3981:         display_name = None
 3982:         onboarding_completed = False
 3983:         # Response keys include "onboarding_completed": for the legacy

 4556:             timeline.append({
 4557:                 "id": row.get("id"),
 4558:                 "ts_ms": row.get("ts_ms"),
 4559:                 "event": row.get("event"),
 4560:                 "severity": row.get("severity"),
 4561:                 "detail": row.get("detail") or "",
 4562:                 "kind": "trust",
 4563:             })
 4564: 
 4565:         people_rows = []
 4566:         def pub_id(raw: bytes | None) -> str:
 4567:             if not raw:
 4568:                 return ""
 4569:             return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")
 4570:         for rec in pinned[:12]:
 4571:             people_rows.append({
 4572:                 "id": getattr(rec, "fingerprint", "")[:12],
 4573:                 "label": (
 4574:                     getattr(rec, "local_alias", None)
 4575:                     or getattr(rec, "display_name", None)
 4576:                     or getattr(rec, "hostname", None)
 4577:                     or getattr(rec, "short_id", None)
 4578:                     or "Trusted person"
 4579:                 ),
 4580:                 "kind": "person",
 4581:                 "trusted": True,
 4582:                 "verified": bool(getattr(rec, "is_verified", False)),
 4583:             })
 4584:         for dev in remote_devices[:12]:
 4585:             dev_pub_b64 = pub_id(dev.get("device_pub"))
 4586:             people_rows.append({
 4587:                 "id": dev_pub_b64[:12],
 4588:                 "label": dev.get("label") or dev.get("device_kind") or "My device",
 4589:                 "kind": "device",
 4590:                 "trusted": bool(dev.get("trusted")),
 4591:                 "safety_state": dev.get("safety_state") or "trusted",
 4592:             })
 4593: 
 4594:         state_label = "excellent" if overall >= 85 else "good" if overall >= 70 else "needs_attention"
 4595:         headline = {
 4596:             "excellent": "One Link is strongly protected",
 4597:             "good": "One Link is ready, with a few upgrades available",
 4598:             "needs_attention": "One Link needs a little setup",
 4599:         }[state_label]
 4600:         return web.json_response({
 4601:             "ok": True,
 4602:             "generated_at_ms": now,
 4603:             "score": overall,
 4604:             "state": state_label,
 4605:             "headline": headline,
 4606:             "detail": (
 4607:                 f"{len(trusted_devices)} trusted device(s), {len(pinned)} trusted people, "
 4608:                 f"{len(folders)} shared folder(s), {active_calls} active call(s)."
 4609:             ),
 4610:             "scores": score_rows,
 4611:             "actions": actions[:6],
 4612:             "people": people_rows[:16],
 4613:             "lost_device": {
 4614:                 "ready": bool(roots and trusted_devices),
 4615:                 "unsafe_devices": len(unsafe_devices),
 4616:                 "freeze_available": bool(trusted_devices),
 4617:                 "recover_available": bool(unsafe_devices),
 4618:                 "human": (
 4619:                     "Freeze a device first, then recover or revoke after you verify what happened."
 4620:                 ),
 4621:             },
 4622:             "calls": {
 4623:                 "ready": bool(pinned or remote_devices),
 4624:                 "active": active_calls,
 4625:                 "human": "Calls use trusted peers and the same private fabric readiness checks.",
 4626:             },
 4627:             "timeline": timeline,
 4628:             "setup": {
 4629:                 "completed": bool(setup.get("completed")),
 4630:                 "current_step": setup.get("current_step"),
 4631:                 "next_action": setup.get("next_action") or {},
 4632:             },

 4635:     async def api_update_setup(self, request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
 4636:         state = self.daemon.state
 4637:         if state is None:
 4638:             return web.json_response({"error": "state not available"}, status=503)
 4639:         try:
 4640:             data = await request.json()
 4641:         except Exception as e:
 4642:             return web.json_response({"error": f"bad json: {e}"}, status=400)
 4643:         now = int(time.time() * 1000)
 4644:         action = str(data.get("action") or "").strip()
 4645:         if action == "skip":
 4646:             state.set_setting("one_setup_skipped_at_ms", str(now))
 4647:             state.set_setting("one_setup_last_prompted_at_ms", str(now))
 4648:         elif action == "complete":
 4649:             state.set_setting("one_setup_completed", "true")
 4650:             state.set_setting("onboarding_completed", "true")
 4651:             state.set_setting("one_setup_completed_at_ms", str(now))
 4652:         elif action == "privacy_proof_viewed":
 4653:             state.set_setting("one_setup_privacy_proof_viewed_at_ms", str(now))
 4654:         elif action == "safety_reviewed":
 4655:             state.set_setting("one_setup_safety_reviewed_at_ms", str(now))
 4656:         elif action == "first_message_sent":
 4657:             state.set_setting("one_setup_first_message_at_ms", str(now))
 4658:         elif action == "first_file_sent":
 4659:             state.set_setting("one_setup_first_file_at_ms", str(now))
 4660:         elif action == "recovery_configured":
 4661:             state.set_setting("one_setup_recovery_configured_at_ms", str(now))
 4662:         elif action == "reset":
 4663:             for key in (
 4664:                 "one_setup_completed",
 4665:                 "one_setup_completed_at_ms",
 4666:                 "one_setup_skipped_at_ms",
 4667:                 "one_setup_last_prompted_at_ms",
 4668:                 "one_setup_current_step",
 4669:                 "one_setup_first_message_at_ms",
 4670:                 "one_setup_first_file_at_ms",
 4671:                 "one_setup_privacy_proof_viewed_at_ms",
 4672:                 "one_setup_safety_reviewed_at_ms",
 4673:                 "one_setup_recovery_configured_at_ms",
 4674:                 "onboarding_completed",
 4675:             ):
 4676:                 state.delete_setting(key)
 4677:         else:
 4678:             return web.json_response(
 4679:                 {
 4680:                     "error": "unsupported setup action",
 4681:                     "allowed": [
 4682:                         "skip", "complete", "privacy_proof_viewed",
 4683:                         "safety_reviewed", "first_message_sent",
 4684:                         "first_file_sent", "recovery_configured", "reset",
 4685:                     ],
 4686:                 },
 4687:                 status=400,
 4688:             )
 4689:         return web.json_response(self._one_setup_snapshot())

 4691:     def _sweep_setup_device_invites(self) -> None:
 4692:         now = int(time.time() * 1000)
 4693:         for token, rec in list(self._setup_device_invites.items()):
 4694:             if int(rec.get("expires_ms") or 0) <= now or rec.get("claimed"):
 4695:                 self._setup_device_invites.pop(token, None)

 4698:         return f"one-link://setup/add-device?token={token}"

 4700:     def _lan_peer_base_url(self, request: web.Request) -> str:
 4701:         """Return the URL base another device on Wi-Fi should open.
 4702: 
 4703:         The desktop UI usually calls invite endpoints through
 4704:         127.0.0.1, but a phone scanning that URL would hit itself.
 4705:         When the daemon is LAN-bound, encode the machine's LAN IP in
 4706:         QR links so the invited phone reaches the actual desktop
 4707:         daemon. If the daemon is intentionally loopback-only, keep the
 4708:         request host so tests and local-only flows remain deterministic.
 4709:         """
 4710:         if self.bind_host not in ("127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"):
 4711:             lan_ip = _detect_lan_ip()
 4712:             if lan_ip != "127.0.0.1":
 4713:                 if self.https_port:
 4714:                     return f"https://{lan_ip}:{self.https_port}"
 4715:                 return f"http://{lan_ip}:{self.port}"
 4716:         return f"{request.scheme}://{request.host}"
 4717: 
 4718:     def _setup_invite_peer_url(self, request: web.Request, token: str) -> str:
 4719:         return f"{self._lan_peer_base_url(request)}/peer?setup_device_invite={token}"

 4721:     async def api_setup_device_invite(self, request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
 4722:         """Create a short-lived One Setup invite for a new device.
 4723: 
 4724:         Unlike the older self-mesh enrollment invite, this is not bound
 4725:         to the current device's public key. The claiming device submits
 4726:         its own public key, then this daemon mints the device cert from
 4727:         the local root seed. That is the right first-run shape for
 4728:         "add my phone/laptop" without fake success.
 4729:         """
 4730:         from one_link.self_mesh_enrollment import MeshRoot, b64u, b64u_decode
 4731: 
 4732:         state = self.daemon.state
 4733:         if state is None:
 4734:             return web.json_response({"error": "state_unavailable"}, status=503)
 4735:         try:
 4736:             body = await request.json()
 4737:         except Exception:
 4738:             body = {}
 4739:         try:
 4740:             roots = state.list_self_mesh_roots(include_seed=True)
 4741:             root = next((r for r in roots if r.get("root_seed")), None)
 4742:             if root is None:
 4743:                 created = MeshRoot.create()
 4744:                 root = state.upsert_self_mesh_root(
 4745:                     root_pub=created.root_pub,
 4746:                     root_seed=created.root_seed,
 4747:                     label=str(body.get("root_label") or "My devices")[:120],
 4748:                     metadata={"source": "one_setup_device_invite"},
 4749:                 )
 4750:                 root = state.get_self_mesh_root(created.root_pub, include_seed=True)
 4751:             if root is None or not root.get("root_seed"):
 4752:                 raise ValueError("root seed unavailable for setup invite")
 4753:             token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
 4754:             now = int(time.time() * 1000)
 4755:             expires_ms = now + 5 * 60 * 1000
 4756:             label = str(body.get("label") or "Add device")[:120]
 4757:             self._sweep_setup_device_invites()
 4758:             self._setup_device_invites[token] = {
 4759:                 "root_pub": bytes(root["root_pub"]),
 4760:                 "root_seed": bytes(root["root_seed"]),
 4761:                 "label": label,
 4762:                 "created_ms": now,
 4763:                 "expires_ms": expires_ms,
 4764:                 "claimed": False,
 4765:             }
 4766:             state.record_self_mesh_audit(
 4767:                 event="setup_device_invite_created",
 4768:                 severity="info",
 4769:                 root_pub=bytes(root["root_pub"]),
 4770:                 detail=label,
 4771:                 metadata={"expires_ms": expires_ms},
 4772:             )
 4773:             return web.json_response({
 4774:                 "ok": True,
 4775:                 "token": token,
 4776:                 "deep_link": self._setup_invite_deep_link(token),
 4777:                 "peer_url": self._setup_invite_peer_url(request, token),
 4778:                 "qr_url": f"/api/setup/device-invite/qr.svg?token={token}",
 4779:                 "root_pub_b64": b64u(bytes(root["root_pub"])),
 4780:                 "label": label,
 4781:                 "created_ms": now,
 4782:                 "expires_ms": expires_ms,
 4783:                 "expires_in_seconds": 300,
 4784:             })
 4785:         except Exception as exc:
 4786:             return web.json_response({
 4787:                 "error": "setup_device_invite_rejected",
 4788:                 "hint": str(exc),
 4789:             }, status=400)

 4791:     async def api_setup_device_invite_claim(self, request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
 4792:         from one_link.pairing import compute_sas, format_sas
 4793:         from one_link.self_mesh_enrollment import b64u, b64u_decode
 4794: 
 4795:         state = self.daemon.state
 4796:         if state is None:
 4797:             return web.json_response({"error": "state_unavailable"}, status=503)
 4798:         body = await request.json()
 4799:         try:
 4800:             token = str(body.get("token") or "")
 4801:             self._sweep_setup_device_invites()
 4802:             invite = self._setup_device_invites.get(token)
 4803:             if invite is None:
 4804:                 raise ValueError("invite expired or not found")
 4805:             device_pub = b64u_decode(str(body.get("device_pub_b64") or ""))
 4806:             if len(device_pub) != 32:
 4807:                 raise ValueError("device public key must be 32 bytes")
 4808:             kind = str(body.get("device_kind") or "remote-device")[:80]
 4809:             label = str(body.get("label") or kind or "One Link device")[:120]
 4810:             sas = compute_sas(self.daemon.me.public_bytes, device_pub)
 4811:             invite["pending_claim"] = {
 4812:                 "device_pub": device_pub,
 4813:                 "device_pub_b64": b64u(device_pub),
 4814:                 "device_kind": kind,
 4815:                 "label": label,
 4816:                 "trust_code": format_sas(sas),
 4817:                 "claimed_ms": int(time.time() * 1000),
 4818:             }
 4819:             state.record_self_mesh_audit(
 4820:                 event="setup_device_invite_pending",
 4821:                 severity="info",
 4822:                 root_pub=bytes(invite["root_pub"]),
 4823:                 device_pub=device_pub,
 4824:                 detail=label,
 4825:                 metadata={"device_kind": kind},
 4826:             )
 4827:             with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 4828:                 self.daemon._broadcast_self_mesh_changed(
 4829:                     event="setup_device_invite_pending",
 4830:                     root_pub=bytes(invite["root_pub"]),
 4831:                     device_pub=device_pub,
 4832:                     label=label,
 4833:                 )
 4834:             return web.json_response({
 4835:                 "ok": True,
 4836:                 "pending": True,
 4837:                 "root_pub_b64": b64u(bytes(invite["root_pub"])),
 4838:                 "device_pub_b64": b64u(device_pub),
 4839:                 "device_kind": kind,
 4840:                 "label": label,
 4841:                 "trust_code": format_sas(sas),
 4842:                 "trusted": False,
 4843:             })
 4844:         except Exception as exc:
 4845:             return web.json_response({
 4846:                 "error": "setup_device_invite_claim_rejected",
 4847:                 "hint": str(exc),
 4848:             }, status=400)

 4850:     async def api_setup_device_invite_confirm(self, request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
 4851:         from one_link.self_mesh_enrollment import b64u, mint_device_cert
 4852: 
 4853:         state = self.daemon.state
 4854:         if state is None:
 4855:             return web.json_response({"error": "state_unavailable"}, status=503)
 4856:         body = await request.json()
 4857:         try:
 4858:             token = str(body.get("token") or "")
 4859:             self._sweep_setup_device_invites()
 4860:             invite = self._setup_device_invites.get(token)
 4861:             pending = invite.get("pending_claim") if isinstance(invite, dict) else None
 4862:             if not isinstance(pending, dict):
 4863:                 raise ValueError("no pending device claim for this invite")
 4864:             device_pub = bytes(pending["device_pub"])

 4866:             label = str(pending.get("label") or kind)

 4871:                 device_kind=kind,
 4872:             )
 4873:             row = state.upsert_self_mesh_device(
 4874:                 root_pub=bytes(invite["root_pub"]),
 4875:                 device_pub=device_pub,
 4876:                 cert=cert,
 4877:                 device_kind=kind,
 4878:                 label=label,
 4879:                 local=False,
 4880:                 trusted=True,
 4881:                 metadata={"source": "one_setup_invite_confirmed"},
 4882:             )
 4883:             invite["claimed"] = True
 4884:             self._setup_device_invites.pop(token, None)
 4885:             state.record_self_mesh_audit(
 4886:                 event="setup_device_invite_confirmed",
 4887:                 severity="good",
 4888:                 root_pub=bytes(invite["root_pub"]),
 4889:                 device_pub=device_pub,
 4890:                 detail=label,
 4891:                 metadata={"device_kind": kind, "trust_code": pending.get("trust_code")},
 4892:             )
 4893:             with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
 4894:                 self.daemon._broadcast_self_mesh_changed(
 4895:                     event="setup_device_invite_confirmed",
 4896:                     root_pub=bytes(invite["root_pub"]),
 4897:                     device_pub=device_pub,
 4898:                     label=label,
 4899:                 )
 4900:             return web.json_response({
 4901:                 "ok": True,
 4902:                 "root_pub_b64": b64u(bytes(invite["root_pub"])),
 4903:                 "device_pub_b64": b64u(device_pub),
 4904:                 "cert_b64": b64u(cert),
 4905:                 "device_kind": row["device_kind"],
 4906:                 "label": row["label"],
 4907:                 "trusted": row["trusted"],
 4908:                 "revoked": row["revoked"],
 4909:             })
 4910:         except Exception as exc:
 4911:             return web.json_response({
 4912:                 "error": "setup_device_invite_confirm_rejected",
 4913:                 "hint": str(exc),
 4914:             }, status=400)

 4916:     async def api_setup_device_invite_reject(self, request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
 4917:         state = self.daemon.state
 4918:         if state is None:
 4919:             return web.json_response({"error": "state_unavailable"}, status=503)

 4943:     async def api_setup_device_invite_qr(self, request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
 4944:         token = str(request.query.get("token") or "")
 4945:         try:
 4946:             self._sweep_setup_device_invites()
 4947:             if token not in self._setup_device_invites:
 4948:                 raise ValueError("invite expired or not found")
 4949:             import io
 4950:             import qrcode
 4951:             import qrcode.image.svg
 4952: 
 4953:             qr = qrcode.QRCode(border=2, box_size=8)
 4954:             qr.add_data(self._setup_invite_peer_url(request, token))
 4955:             qr.make(fit=True)
 4956:             img = qr.make_image(image_factory=qrcode.image.svg.SvgPathImage)
 4957:             buf = io.BytesIO()
 4958:             img.save(buf)
 4959:             resp = web.Response(
 4960:                 text=buf.getvalue().decode("utf-8"),
 4961:                 content_type="image/svg+xml",
 4962:             )
 4963:             resp.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
 4964:             return resp
 4965:         except ImportError:
 4966:             return web.json_response({
 4967:                 "error": "qrcode_lib_missing",
 4968:                 "hint": "pip install qrcode>=7",
 4969:             }, status=500)
 4970:         except Exception as exc:
 4971:             return web.json_response({
 4972:                 "error": "setup_device_invite_qr_rejected",
 4973:                 "hint": str(exc),
 4974:             }, status=400)

 4976:     async def api_metrics(self, request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
 4977:         """Production telemetry surface. Returns JSON with:
 4978: 
 4979:         - Native diagnostics (per `Daemon.native_diagnostics()`):
 4980:           which Phase A1/D/E crates are loaded + advertised.
 4981:         - Field-snapshot metrics from `FieldSnapshotManager`: solve
 4982:           count, failure count, snapshot age, topology size.
 4983:         - Per-peer field-driven advisories (cadence + score) for the
 4984:           currently-known peer set.
 4985:         - Relay-metrics summary (count + recent solve latency).
 4986: 
 4987:         Pattern: read-only, never mutates daemon state. Safe to scrape
 4988:         every few seconds from an operator dashboard. The JSON shape
 4989:         is stable; adding fields is additive but renames need a
 4990:         version bump.
 4991:         """
 4992:         d = self.daemon
 4993:         native = d.native_diagnostics()
 4994:         field_metrics = d.field_snapshot_metrics()
 4995:         # Per-peer advisories (only includes peers in the latest
 4996:         # snapshot; for peers without an entry the caller treats it as
 4997:         # "no recommendation, use baseline").
 4998:         per_peer: dict[str, dict] = {}
 4999:         registry = d.discovery.registry if d.discovery else None
 5000:         if registry is not None:
 5001:             for peer in registry.list():
 5002:                 short_id = peer.short_id
 5003:                 cadence = d.cadence_for_peer(short_id)
 5004:                 score = d.field_score_for_peer(short_id)
 5005:                 entry: dict = {}
 5006:                 if cadence is not None:
 5007:                     entry["cadence_bytes"] = cadence
 5008:                 if score is not None:
 5009:                     entry["field_score"] = score
 5010:                 # Per-peer transport choice: which transport the
 5011:                 # daemon would route this peer through right now.
 5012:                 # Either "webrtc" (default) or "quic" (when both
 5013:                 # peers advertise QUIC_TRANSPORT_V1 + endpoint up).
 5014:                 try:
 5015:                     entry["transport_kind"] = d.transport_choice_for_peer(peer)
 5016:                 except Exception:
 5017:                     pass
 5018:                 if entry:
 5019:                     per_peer[short_id] = entry
 5020:         relay_count = len(getattr(d, "_relay_metrics", {}) or {})
 5021:         return web.json_response({
 5022:             "version": __import__("one_link").__version__,
 5023:             "native": native,
 5024:             "field": field_metrics,
 5025:             "per_peer_field_advisories": per_peer,
 5026:             "relay_metrics_count": relay_count,
 5027:             "fabric": self._safe_fabric_snapshot(summary=True),
 5028:         })
 5029: 
 5030:     def _safe_fabric_snapshot(self, *, summary: bool = False) -> dict:
 5031:         route_candidates = self._route_candidate_summary(summary=summary)
 5032:         getter = getattr(self.daemon, "_fabric_snapshot", None)
 5033:         if not callable(getter):
 5034:             return {
 5035:                 "ok": False,
 5036:                 "route_candidates": route_candidates,
 5037:                 "route_truth": {
 5038:                     "state": "Waiting for device",
 5039:                     "reason": "daemon does not expose fabric snapshot",
 5040:                 },
 5041:                 "scores": [],
 5042:                 "activation": [],
 5043:                 "probes": [],
 5044:             }
 5045:         try:
 5046:             snap = getter()
 5047:         except Exception as exc:
 5048:             return {
 5049:                 "ok": False,
 5050:                 "error": str(exc),
 5051:                 "route_candidates": route_candidates,
 5052:                 "route_truth": {
 5053:                     "state": "Waiting for device",
 5054:                     "reason": "fabric snapshot failed",
 5055:                 },
 5056:                 "scores": [],
 5057:                 "activation": [],
 5058:                 "probes": [],
 5059:             }
 5060:         if not summary:
 5061:             snap = dict(snap)
 5062:             snap["route_candidates"] = route_candidates
 5063:             snap["no_router"] = self._no_router_summary(snap, route_candidates=route_candidates)
 5064:             return snap
 5065:         summary_snap = {
 5066:             "ok": bool(snap.get("ok")),
 5067:             "cache_age_s": snap.get("cache_age_s"),
 5068:             "route_truth": snap.get("route_truth", {}),
 5069:             "route_candidates": route_candidates,
 5070:             "performance": snap.get("performance", {}),
 5071:             "score_count": len(snap.get("scores") or []),
 5072:             "activation_count": len(snap.get("activation") or []),
 5073:             "ready_paths": sum(
 5074:                 1 for a in (snap.get("activation") or [])
 5075:                 if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("state") in {"active", "ready"}
 5076:             ),
 5077:             "available_paths": sum(
 5078:                 1 for p in (snap.get("probes") or [])
 5079:                 if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("available")
 5080:             ),
 5081:         }
 5082:         summary_snap["no_router"] = self._no_router_summary(
 5083:             snap,
 5084:             route_candidates=route_candidates,
 5085:         )
 5086:         return summary_snap
 5087: 
 5088:     def _no_router_summary(self, snap: dict, *, route_candidates: dict | None = None) -> dict:
 5089:         """Machine-readable local path guidance for the no-router case.
 5090: 
 5091:         This keeps the "We are One" promise concrete: when infrastructure is
 5092:         missing, the app can still say whether a cable/local path is ready,
 5093:         whether a route token can be exchanged, and what safe action comes
 5094:         next. It never opens a path and never exposes secrets.
 5095:         """
 5096: 
 5097:         route_candidates = route_candidates or self._route_candidate_summary(summary=True)
 5098:         probes = [p for p in (snap.get("probes") or []) if isinstance(p, dict)]
 5099:         scores = [s for s in (snap.get("scores") or []) if isinstance(s, dict)]
 5100:         activation = [a for a in (snap.get("activation") or []) if isinstance(a, dict)]
 5101:         ethernet_ready = any(
 5102:             p.get("kind") == "ethernet" and p.get("available")
 5103:             for p in probes
 5104:         )
 5105:         local_bulk_ready = any(
 5106:             p.get("available") and p.get("bulk_capable") and p.get("kind") in {
 5107:                 "ethernet",
 5108:                 "lan",
 5109:                 "loopback",
 5110:                 "private_hotspot",
 5111:                 "wifi_direct",
 5112:             }
 5113:             for p in probes
 5114:         )
 5115:         verified_local = [
 5116:             r for r in (route_candidates.get("top") or [])
 5117:             if isinstance(r, dict)
 5118:             and r.get("verified")
 5119:             and str(r.get("route") or "") in {
 5120:                 "ethernet",
 5121:                 "lan",
 5122:                 "peer_server",
 5123:                 "wifi_direct",
 5124:                 "private_hotspot",
 5125:             }
 5126:         ]
 5127:         pending_local_paths = int(route_candidates.get("pending_local") or 0)
 5128:         failed_local_paths = int(route_candidates.get("failed_local") or 0)
 5129:         token_ready = int(getattr(self.daemon, "_rendezvous_peer_port", 0) or 0) > 0
 5130:         qr_ready = any(
 5131:             p.get("kind") == "qr_control" and p.get("available")
 5132:             for p in probes
 5133:         )
 5134:         if verified_local:
 5135:             state = "trusted_path_ready"
 5136:             next_action = "send"
 5137:             message = "A trusted local path is ready."
 5138:         elif pending_local_paths > 0:
 5139:             state = "checking_path"
 5140:             next_action = "verify_local_endpoint"
 5141:             message = "Checking the local route with a key-confirmed probe."
 5142:         elif failed_local_paths > 0 and token_ready:
 5143:             state = "route_check_failed"
 5144:             next_action = "show_or_import_route_token"
 5145:             message = "That route did not answer. Try the token again after the devices are on the same local path."
 5146:         elif ethernet_ready:
 5147:             state = "cable_ready"
 5148:             next_action = "exchange_route_token"
 5149:             message = "A direct local link is visible."
 5150:         elif local_bulk_ready and token_ready:
 5151:             state = "local_network_ready"
 5152:             next_action = "exchange_route_token"
 5153:             message = "A local path is available."
 5154:         elif token_ready and qr_ready:
 5155:             state = "token_ready"
 5156:             next_action = "show_or_import_route_token"
 5157:             message = "Exchange a route token to create a local path."
 5158:         elif token_ready:
 5159:             state = "waiting_for_local_path"
 5160:             next_action = "connect_cable_or_same_network"
 5161:             message = "Connect the devices locally, then exchange a route token."
 5162:         else:
 5163:             state = "peer_listener_unavailable"
 5164:             next_action = "start_daemon_peer_listener"
 5165:             message = "The local peer listener is not ready yet."
 5166:         steps = self._no_router_steps(
 5167:             token_ready=token_ready,
 5168:             qr_ready=qr_ready,
 5169:             ethernet_ready=ethernet_ready,
 5170:             local_bulk_ready=local_bulk_ready,
 5171:             trusted_local_paths=len(verified_local),
 5172:             pending_local_paths=pending_local_paths,
 5173:             failed_local_paths=failed_local_paths,
 5174:             next_action=next_action,
 5175:         )
 5176:         path_options = self._no_router_path_options(
 5177:             probes=probes,
 5178:             trusted_local_paths=len(verified_local),
 5179:             pending_local_paths=pending_local_paths,
 5180:             failed_local_paths=failed_local_paths,
 5181:             token_ready=token_ready,
 5182:             qr_ready=qr_ready,
 5183:             ethernet_ready=ethernet_ready,
 5184:             local_bulk_ready=local_bulk_ready,
 5185:             next_action=next_action,
 5186:         )
 5187:         operator_guide = self._no_router_operator_guide(
 5188:             state=state,
 5189:             next_action=next_action,
 5190:             steps=steps,
 5191:             path_options=path_options,
 5192:         )
 5193:         creation = self._path_creation_summary_for_probes(probes)
 5194:         return {
 5195:             "state": state,
 5196:             "next_action": next_action,
 5197:             "message": message,
 5198:             "token_ready": token_ready,
 5199:             "qr_ready": qr_ready,
 5200:             "ethernet_ready": ethernet_ready,
 5201:             "local_bulk_ready": local_bulk_ready,
 5202:             "trusted_local_paths": len(verified_local),
 5203:             "pending_local_paths": pending_local_paths,
 5204:             "failed_local_paths": failed_local_paths,
 5205:             "steps": steps,
 5206:             "path_options": path_options,
 5207:             "operator_guide": operator_guide,
 5208:             "creation": creation,
 5209:             "route_token_url": "/api/route-bootstrap" if token_ready else None,
 5210:             "qr_url": "/api/route-bootstrap/qr.svg" if token_ready and qr_ready else None,
 5211:             "import_url": "/api/route-bootstrap/import",
 5212:             "safeguards": [
 5213:                 "route tokens carry endpoint hints only",
 5214:                 "paired identity must match before endpoint probes run",
 5215:                 "promoted endpoints still require a key-confirmed session",
 5216:             ],
 5217:             "top_scores": [
 5218:                 {
 5219:                     "route": s.get("route_name"),
 5220:                     "adapter_id": s.get("adapter_id"),
 5221:                     "usable_for_bulk": bool(s.get("usable_for_bulk")),
 5222:                     "reason": s.get("reason"),
 5223:                 }
 5224:                 for s in scores[:4]
 5225:             ],
 5226:             "activation": [
 5227:                 {
 5228:                     "route": a.get("route_name"),
 5229:                     "state": a.get("state"),
 5230:                     "next_action": a.get("next_action"),
 5231:                     "automatic": bool(a.get("automatic")),
 5232:                 }
 5233:                 for a in activation[:4]
 5234:             ],
 5235:         }
 5236: 
 5237:     def _no_router_path_options(
 5238:         self,
 5239:         *,
 5240:         probes: list[dict],
 5241:         trusted_local_paths: int,
 5242:         pending_local_paths: int,
 5243:         failed_local_paths: int,
 5244:         token_ready: bool,
 5245:         qr_ready: bool,
 5246:         ethernet_ready: bool,
 5247:         local_bulk_ready: bool,
 5248:         next_action: str,
 5249:     ) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
 5250:         def probe_for(kind: str) -> dict:
 5251:             return next(
 5252:                 (
 5253:                     p for p in probes
 5254:                     if p.get("kind") == kind and bool(p.get("available"))
 5255:                 ),
 5256:                 {},
 5257:             )
 5258: 
 5259:         def option(
 5260:             option_id: str,
 5261:             label: str,
 5262:             *,
 5263:             status: str,
 5264:             next_step: str,
 5265:             reason: str,
 5266:             probe: dict | None = None,
 5267:             priority: int,
 5268:         ) -> dict[str, object]:
 5269:             probe = probe or {}
 5270:             return {
 5271:                 "id": option_id,
 5272:                 "label": label,
 5273:                 "status": status,
 5274:                 "next_step": next_step,
 5275:                 "reason": reason,
 5276:                 "priority": priority,
 5277:                 "bulk_capable": bool(probe.get("bulk_capable")),
 5278:                 "control_capable": bool(probe.get("control_capable", True)),
 5279:                 "requires_user_action": bool(probe.get("requires_user_action")),
 5280:                 "requires_admin": bool(probe.get("requires_admin")),
 5281:                 "estimated_bps": float(probe.get("estimated_bps") or 0.0),
 5282:             }
 5283: 
 5284:         trusted_status = "ready" if trusted_local_paths > 0 else "pending"
 5285:         if pending_local_paths > 0:
 5286:             trusted_status = "current"
 5287:         elif failed_local_paths > 0:
 5288:             trusted_status = "blocked"
 5289: 
 5290:         ethernet_probe = probe_for("ethernet")
 5291:         lan_probe = probe_for("lan")
 5292:         hotspot_probe = probe_for("private_hotspot")
 5293:         wifi_direct_probe = probe_for("wifi_direct")
 5294:         qr_probe = probe_for("qr_control")
 5295: 
 5296:         options = [
 5297:             option(
 5298:                 "trusted_verified_path",
 5299:                 "trusted path",
 5300:                 status=trusted_status,
 5301:                 next_step="send" if trusted_local_paths > 0 else "wait_for_key_confirmed_probe",
 5302:                 reason=(
 5303:                     "a verified local endpoint can carry transfers"
 5304:                     if trusted_local_paths > 0 else
 5305:                     "route-token endpoints must pass a key-confirmed probe"
 5306:                 ),
 5307:                 probe=ethernet_probe or lan_probe,
 5308:                 priority=0 if trusted_local_paths > 0 else 30,
 5309:             ),
 5310:             option(
 5311:                 "direct_ethernet",
 5312:                 "direct cable",
 5313:                 status=(
 5314:                     "ready" if ethernet_ready else
 5315:                     "current" if next_action == "connect_cable_or_same_network" else
 5316:                     "pending"
 5317:                 ),
 5318:                 next_step="exchange_route_token" if token_ready else "start_peer_listener",
 5319:                 reason=(
 5320:                     "link-local Ethernet is visible"
 5321:                     if ethernet_ready else
 5322:                     "connect both devices with Ethernet or the same unmanaged switch"
 5323:                 ),
 5324:                 probe=ethernet_probe,
 5325:                 priority=10 if ethernet_ready else 40,
 5326:             ),
 5327:             option(
 5328:                 "same_local_network",
 5329:                 "same network",
 5330:                 status=(
 5331:                     "ready" if local_bulk_ready else
 5332:                     "current" if next_action == "connect_cable_or_same_network" else
 5333:                     "pending"
 5334:                 ),
 5335:                 next_step="exchange_route_token" if token_ready else "start_peer_listener",
 5336:                 reason=(
 5337:                     "a bulk-capable local network path is visible"
 5338:                     if local_bulk_ready else
 5339:                     "put both devices on the same trusted LAN or hotspot"
 5340:                 ),
 5341:                 probe=lan_probe,
 5342:                 priority=20 if local_bulk_ready else 45,
 5343:             ),
 5344:             option(
 5345:                 "route_token_exchange",
 5346:                 "route token",
 5347:                 status=(
 5348:                     "ready" if token_ready and qr_ready else
 5349:                     "current" if token_ready else
 5350:                     "blocked"
 5351:                 ),
 5352:                 next_step="show_or_import_route_token" if token_ready else "start_peer_listener",
 5353:                 reason=(
 5354:                     "QR/token exchange is ready"
 5355:                     if token_ready and qr_ready else
 5356:                     "local peer listener must be ready before tokens can be minted"
 5357:                 ),
 5358:                 probe=qr_probe,
 5359:                 priority=15 if token_ready else 80,
 5360:             ),
 5361:         ]
 5362:         if hotspot_probe:
 5363:             options.append(option(
 5364:                 "private_hotspot",
 5365:                 "private hotspot",
 5366:                 status="current" if not local_bulk_ready else "ready",
 5367:                 next_step="open_os_hotspot_then_exchange_token",
 5368:                 reason="use the OS hotspot ceremony, then exchange a route token",
 5369:                 probe=hotspot_probe,
 5370:                 priority=25,
 5371:             ))
 5372:         if wifi_direct_probe:
 5373:             options.append(option(
 5374:                 "wifi_direct",
 5375:                 "Wi-Fi Direct",
 5376:                 status="current" if not local_bulk_ready else "ready",
 5377:                 next_step="open_os_wifi_direct_then_exchange_token",
 5378:                 reason="use the platform Wi-Fi Direct ceremony, then exchange a route token",
 5379:                 probe=wifi_direct_probe,
 5380:                 priority=26,
 5381:             ))
 5382:         return sorted(
 5383:             options,
 5384:             key=lambda o: (
 5385:                 {"ready": 0, "current": 1, "pending": 2, "blocked": 3}.get(str(o["status"]), 4),
 5386:                 int(o["priority"]),
 5387:                 str(o["id"]),
 5388:             ),
 5389:         )
 5390: 
 5391:     @staticmethod
 5392:     def _no_router_operator_guide(
 5393:         *,
 5394:         state: str,
 5395:         next_action: str,
 5396:         steps: list[dict[str, object]],
 5397:         path_options: list[dict[str, object]],
 5398:     ) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, object]]]:
 5399:         step_status = {str(s.get("id")): str(s.get("status") or "pending") for s in steps}
 5400:         best_path = next(
 5401:             (
 5402:                 p for p in path_options
 5403:                 if str(p.get("id")) not in {"trusted_verified_path", "route_token_exchange"}
 5404:                 and str(p.get("status")) in {"ready", "current"}
 5405:             ),
 5406:             path_options[0] if path_options else {},
 5407:         )
 5408: 
 5409:         def guide_step(
 5410:             step_id: str,
 5411:             label: str,
 5412:             detail: str,
 5413:             *,
 5414:             status: str | None = None,
 5415:         ) -> dict[str, object]:
 5416:             return {
 5417:                 "id": step_id,
 5418:                 "label": label,
 5419:                 "detail": detail,
 5420:                 "status": status or step_status.get(step_id, "pending"),
 5421:             }
 5422: 
 5423:         local_detail = str(best_path.get("reason") or "create or join a local path")
 5424:         token_detail = (
 5425:             "show this device's route token or scan/import the other device's token"
 5426:             if next_action != "start_daemon_peer_listener" else
 5427:             "wait for the local peer listener before minting a route token"
 5428:         )
 5429:         verify_detail = (
 5430:             "probe is checking the endpoint now"
 5431:             if state == "checking_path" else
 5432:             "endpoint must prove the pinned peer key before use"
 5433:         )
 5434:         send_status = "ready" if state == "trusted_path_ready" else "pending"
 5435:         return {
 5436:             "send": [
 5437:                 guide_step("connect_cable_or_same_network", "choose path", local_detail),
 5438:                 guide_step("show_or_import_route_token", "share token", token_detail),
 5439:                 guide_step("verify_local_endpoint", "verify", verify_detail),
 5440:                 guide_step("send", "send", "One Link will use the trusted local path automatically", status=send_status),
 5441:             ],
 5442:             "receive": [
 5443:                 guide_step("connect_cable_or_same_network", "join path", local_detail),
 5444:                 guide_step("show_or_import_route_token", "import token", token_detail),
 5445:                 guide_step("verify_local_endpoint", "verify", verify_detail),
 5446:                 guide_step("send", "receive", "incoming transfers can arrive over the verified path", status=send_status),
 5447:             ],
 5448:         }
 5449: 
 5450:     @staticmethod
 5451:     def _path_creation_summary_for_probes(probes: list[dict]) -> dict[str, object]:
 5452:         try:
 5453:             from one_link.transport_path_creation import (
 5454:                 creation_summary,
 5455:                 plans_from_probe_dicts,
 5456:             )
 5457: 
 5458:             plans = plans_from_probe_dicts(probes)
 5459:             return creation_summary(plans)
 5460:         except Exception as exc:
 5461:             return {
 5462:                 "ready": 0,
 5463:                 "needs_user": 0,
 5464:                 "blocked": 0,
 5465:                 "unsupported": 0,
 5466:                 "next_action": "path_creation_unavailable",
 5467:                 "plans": [],
 5468:                 "error": str(exc),
 5469:             }
 5470: 
 5471:     def _no_router_steps(
 5472:         self,
 5473:         *,
 5474:         token_ready: bool,
 5475:         qr_ready: bool,
 5476:         ethernet_ready: bool,
 5477:         local_bulk_ready: bool,
 5478:         trusted_local_paths: int,
 5479:         pending_local_paths: int = 0,
 5480:         failed_local_paths: int = 0,
 5481:         next_action: str,
 5482:     ) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
 5483:         def status(step_id: str, ready: bool, *, failed: bool = False) -> str:
 5484:             if ready:
 5485:                 return "ready"
 5486:             if failed:
 5487:                 return "blocked"
 5488:             if next_action == step_id:
 5489:                 return "current"
 5490:             return "pending"
 5491: 
 5492:         local_ready = bool(ethernet_ready or local_bulk_ready)
 5493:         token_step_ready = bool(token_ready and qr_ready)
 5494:         verified_ready = int(trusted_local_paths) > 0
 5495:         probe_pending = int(pending_local_paths) > 0
 5496:         probe_failed = int(failed_local_paths) > 0 and not verified_ready
 5497:         return [
 5498:             {
 5499:                 "id": "connect_cable_or_same_network",
 5500:                 "label": "local link",
 5501:                 "status": status("connect_cable_or_same_network", local_ready),
 5502:             },
 5503:             {
 5504:                 "id": "show_or_import_route_token",
 5505:                 "label": "route token",
 5506:                 "status": status("show_or_import_route_token", token_step_ready),
 5507:             },
 5508:             {
 5509:                 "id": "verify_local_endpoint",
 5510:                 "label": "verified path",
 5511:                 "status": (
 5512:                     "current" if probe_pending else
 5513:                     status("verify_local_endpoint", verified_ready, failed=probe_failed)
 5514:                 ),
 5515:             },
 5516:             {
 5517:                 "id": "send",
 5518:                 "label": "send",
 5519:                 "status": status("send", verified_ready),
 5520:             },
 5521:         ]
 5522: 
 5523:     def _route_candidate_summary(self, *, summary: bool) -> dict:
 5524:         state = getattr(self.daemon, "state", None)
 5525:         if state is None or not hasattr(state, "list_route_candidates"):
 5526:             return {
 5527:                 "known": 0,
 5528:                 "verified": 0,
 5529:                 "peers": 0,
 5530:                 "routes": [],
 5531:                 "top": [],
 5532:             }
 5533:         try:
 5534:             rows = state.list_route_candidates(limit=128)
 5535:         except Exception:
 5536:             return {
 5537:                 "known": 0,
 5538:                 "verified": 0,
 5539:                 "peers": 0,
 5540:                 "routes": [],
 5541:                 "top": [],
 5542:             }
 5543:         verified = [r for r in rows if r.get("verified")]
 5544:         local_route_names = {
 5545:             "ethernet",
 5546:             "lan",
 5547:             "peer_server",
 5548:             "wifi_direct",
 5549:             "private_hotspot",
 5550:         }
 5551:         local_rows = [
 5552:             r for r in rows
 5553:             if str(r.get("route") or "") in local_route_names
 5554:         ]
 5555:         local_verified = [r for r in local_rows if r.get("verified")]
 5556:         pending_local = [
 5557:             r for r in local_rows
 5558:             if not r.get("verified") and int(r.get("failures") or 0) == 0
 5559:         ]
 5560:         failed_local = [
 5561:             r for r in local_rows
 5562:             if not r.get("verified") and int(r.get("failures") or 0) > 0
 5563:         ]
 5564:         peers = {str(r.get("peer_fp") or "") for r in rows if r.get("peer_fp")}
 5565:         routes = sorted({
 5566:             str(r.get("route") or "")
 5567:             for r in rows
 5568:             if str(r.get("route") or "")
 5569:         })
 5570:         top_rows = verified or rows
 5571:         top = []
 5572:         for r in top_rows[: 4 if summary else 12]:
 5573:             item = {
 5574:                 "peer": str(r.get("peer_fp") or "")[:8],
 5575:                 "route": r.get("route"),
 5576:                 "transport": r.get("transport"),
 5577:                 "source": r.get("source"),
 5578:                 "verified": bool(r.get("verified")),
 5579:                 "successes": int(r.get("successes") or 0),
 5580:                 "failures": int(r.get("failures") or 0),
 5581:                 "latency_ms": r.get("latency_ms"),
 5582:                 "bandwidth_bps": r.get("bandwidth_bps"),
 5583:             }
 5584:             if not summary:
 5585:                 item["host"] = r.get("host")
 5586:                 item["port"] = r.get("port")
 5587:                 item["updated_ms"] = r.get("updated_ms")
 5588:                 item["expires_ms"] = r.get("expires_ms")
 5589:             top.append(item)
 5590:         return {
 5591:             "known": len(rows),
 5592:             "verified": len(verified),
 5593:             "local_verified": len(local_verified),
 5594:             "pending_local": len(pending_local),
 5595:             "failed_local": len(failed_local),
 5596:             "peers": len(peers),
 5597:             "routes": routes,
 5598:             "top": top,
 5599:         }
 5600: 
 5601:     async def api_fabric(self, request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
 5602:         """Read-only Universal Comms Fabric snapshot.
 5603: 
 5604:         Exposes the local hardware/path inventory, adapter scores, and the
 5605:         route-truth bridge into the transfer brain. This endpoint never starts
 5606:         a transport or mutates daemon state beyond the daemon's bounded probe
 5607:         cache.
 5608:         """
 5609: 
 5610:         return web.json_response(self._safe_fabric_snapshot())
 5611: 
 5612:     async def api_fabric_no_router(self, request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
 5613:         """No-router local path readiness.
 5614: 
 5615:         This is the small "just works" surface for generated local paths:
 5616:         cable/link-local readiness, QR route-token readiness, trusted local
 5617:         route count, and the next safe action. It is read-only and token-gated.
 5618:         """
 5619: 
 5620:         fabric = self._safe_fabric_snapshot()
 5621:         no_router = fabric.get("no_router") if isinstance(fabric, dict) else None
 5622:         if not isinstance(no_router, dict):
 5623:             no_router = self._no_router_summary(fabric if isinstance(fabric, dict) else {})
 5624:         return web.json_response({
 5625:             "ok": bool(fabric.get("ok")) if isinstance(fabric, dict) else False,
 5626:             **no_router,
 5627:         })
 5628: 
 5629:     async def api_fabric_path_create(self, request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
 5630:         """Safety-gated local path creation plans.
 5631:

 5650:     async def api_fabric_path_create_launch(self, request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
 5651:         """Launch a user-visible OS ceremony from a path creation plan.
 5652: 
 5653:         The launcher is intentionally narrow: no silent network mutation, no
 5654:         credential generation, and no automatic radio toggles. Test and CI
 5655:         runs may set ONE_LINK_DISABLE_PATH_CREATE_LAUNCH=1 to prove the API
 5656:         contract without opening a settings window.
 5657:         """
 5658: 
 5659:         try:
 5660:             body = await request.json()
 5661:         except Exception:
 5662:             body = {}
 5663:         path_id = str(body.get("path_id") or "").strip()
 5664:         if not path_id:
 5665:             return web.json_response({
 5666:                 "error": "missing path_id",
 5667:                 "hint": "choose one creation plan path_id",
 5668:             }, status=400)
 5669:         fabric = self._safe_fabric_snapshot()
 5670:         probes = [
 5671:             p for p in ((fabric or {}).get("probes") or [])
 5672:             if isinstance(p, dict)
 5673:         ]
 5674:         try:
 5675:             from one_link.transport_path_creation import (
 5676:                 launch_creation_plan,
 5677:                 plans_from_probe_dicts,
 5678:             )
 5679: 
 5680:             plans = plans_from_probe_dicts(probes)
 5681:             dry_run = bool(body.get("dry_run"))
 5682:             disabled = os.environ.get("ONE_LINK_DISABLE_PATH_CREATE_LAUNCH") == "1"
 5683:             result = launch_creation_plan(
 5684:                 path_id,
 5685:                 plans,
 5686:                 dry_run=dry_run or disabled,
 5687:             )
 5688:             if disabled:
 5689:                 result["disabled"] = True
 5690:                 result["launched"] = False
 5691:             return web.json_response(result)
 5692:         except ValueError as exc:
 5693:             return web.json_response({
 5694:                 "error": "path_creation_launch_rejected",
 5695:                 "hint": str(exc),
 5696:             }, status=409)
 5697:         except Exception as exc:
 5698:             return web.json_response({
 5699:                 "error": "path_creation_launch_failed",
 5700:                 "hint": str(exc),
 5701:             }, status=500)

 5703:     async def api_fabric_path_create_native(self, request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
 5704:         """Execute a supported native path creation helper.
 5705: 
 5706:         This is deliberately stricter than the settings launcher. It requires
 5707:         either dry_run=true or ONE_LINK_ALLOW_NATIVE_PATH_CREATE=1, redacts
 5708:         credentials from every response, and returns structured unsupported
 5709:         evidence for OS surfaces without safe public command APIs.
 5710:         """
 5711: 
 5712:         try:
 5713:             body = await request.json()
 5714:         except Exception:
 5715:             body = {}
 5716:         path_id = str(body.get("path_id") or "").strip()
 5717:         if not path_id:
 5718:             return web.json_response({
 5719:                 "error": "missing path_id",
 5720:                 "hint": "choose one creation plan path_id",
 5721:             }, status=400)
 5722:         fabric = self._safe_fabric_snapshot()
 5723:         probes = [
 5724:             p for p in ((fabric or {}).get("probes") or [])
 5725:             if isinstance(p, dict)
 5726:         ]
 5727:         try:
 5728:             from one_link.transport_path_creation import (
 5729:                 execute_native_creation_plan,
 5730:                 native_helpers_from_env,
 5731:                 plans_from_probe_dicts,
 5732:             )
 5733: 
 5734:             plans = plans_from_probe_dicts(probes)
 5735:             helper_specs = native_helpers_from_env()
 5736:             dry_run = bool(body.get("dry_run"))
 5737:             disabled = os.environ.get("ONE_LINK_DISABLE_NATIVE_PATH_CREATE") == "1"
 5738:             allow_native = (
 5739:                 os.environ.get("ONE_LINK_ALLOW_NATIVE_PATH_CREATE") == "1"
 5740:                 and not disabled
 5741:             )
 5742:             result = execute_native_creation_plan(
 5743:                 path_id,
 5744:                 plans,
 5745:                 dry_run=dry_run or disabled,
 5746:                 allow_native=allow_native,
 5747:                 ssid=str(body.get("ssid") or ""),
 5748:                 passphrase=str(body.get("passphrase") or ""),
 5749:                 helper_specs=helper_specs,
 5750:             )
 5751:             if disabled:
 5752:                 result["disabled"] = True
 5753:                 result["state"] = "dry_run"
 5754:             status = 200 if bool(result.get("ok")) else 409
 5755:             return web.json_response(result, status=status)
 5756:         except ValueError as exc:
 5757:             return web.json_response({
 5758:                 "error": "native_path_creation_rejected",
 5759:                 "hint": str(exc),
 5760:             }, status=409)
 5761:         except Exception as exc:
 5762:             return web.json_response({
 5763:                 "error": "native_path_creation_failed",
 5764:                 "hint": str(exc),
 5765:             }, status=500)
