 9455:   function applyTheme(theme) {
 9456:     const t = (theme || "dark").toLowerCase();
 9457:     const html = document.documentElement;
 9458:     if (t === "light") html.setAttribute("data-theme", "light");
 9459:     else if (t === "auto") html.setAttribute("data-theme", "auto");
 9460:     else html.removeAttribute("data-theme");  // dark = default
 9461:   }
 9462: 
 9463:   // v0.10.0: do-not-disturb check. Compares current local time
 9464:   // against the user's window. Wraps around midnight when start
 9465:   // > end (e.g. 22:00 → 07:00 means "any time between 22:00 and
 9466:   // 07:00 the next morning").
 9467:   function isQuietHoursActive() {
 9468:     const rs = state.runtimeSettings;
 9469:     if (!rs?.dnd_enabled) return false;
 9470:     const parse = (s) => {
 9471:       const m = (s || "").match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/);
 9472:       if (!m) return null;
 9473:       return parseInt(m[1], 10) * 60 + parseInt(m[2], 10);
 9474:     };
 9475:     const start = parse(rs.dnd_start);
 9476:     const end = parse(rs.dnd_end);
 9477:     if (start == null || end == null) return false;
 9478:     const now = new Date();
 9479:     const minutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
 9480:     if (start === end) return false;  // zero-width window
 9481:     if (start < end) return minutes >= start && minutes < end;
 9482:     // Wrap-around (e.g. 22:00 → 07:00).
 9483:     return minutes >= start || minutes < end;
 9484:   }
 9485: 
 9486:   // v0.10.0: notification chime via Web Audio API. Two-tone synth,
 9487:   // ~250ms total, gentle decay. No vendored audio file. Respects
 9488:   // the master setting + DND + per-peer mute.
 9489:   let _audioCtx = null;
 9490:   function _getAudioCtx() {
 9491:     if (!_audioCtx) {
 9492:       try {
 9493:         _audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
 9494:       } catch { return null; }
 9495:     }
 9496:     if (_audioCtx.state === "suspended") _audioCtx.resume().catch(() => {});
 9497:     return _audioCtx;
 9498:   }
 9499:   function playNotificationChime() {
 9500:     if (!state.runtimeSettings?.notification_sound) return;
 9501:     const ctx = _getAudioCtx();
 9502:     if (!ctx) return;
 9503:     const now = ctx.currentTime;
 9504:     // Two notes: G5 (784 Hz) → C6 (1047 Hz). Quick, pleasant.
 9505:     [
 9506:       { freq: 784, start: 0,    dur: 0.12 },
 9507:       { freq: 1047, start: 0.10, dur: 0.16 },
 9508:     ].forEach(({ freq, start, dur }) => {
 9509:       const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
 9510:       const gain = ctx.createGain();
 9511:       osc.type = "sine";
 9512:       osc.frequency.value = freq;
 9513:       gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now + start);
 9514:       gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.18, now + start + 0.01);
 9515:       gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + start + dur);
 9516:       osc.connect(gain).connect(ctx.destination);
 9517:       osc.start(now + start);
 9518:       osc.stop(now + start + dur + 0.05);
 9519:     });
 9520:   }
 9521:   // v0.21.x: synthesized ring audio for calls. Two flavors:
 9522:   //   - Ringback (outgoing): quiet sine pulse, 0.5s on / 0.5s off,
 9523:   //     reassures the caller that something is happening. Stopped
 9524:   //     on accept / decline / end.
 9525:   //   - Ringtone (incoming): louder dual-frequency phone-style ring,
 9526:   //     1s on / 0.4s gap, repeating. Stopped on accept / decline /
 9527:   //     end. Honors notification-sound + quiet-hours + peer-mute
 9528:   //     just like other in-app audio.
 9529:   // Synthesizing in-browser avoids shipping audio assets and lets
 9530:   // the user mute by toggling notification sound.
 9531:   const _callRingState = {
 9532:     timer: null,
 9533:     nodes: [],
 9534:   };
 9535:   function _stopCallRing() {
 9536:     if (_callRingState.timer) {
 9537:       clearInterval(_callRingState.timer);
 9538:       _callRingState.timer = null;
 9539:     }
 9540:     for (const n of _callRingState.nodes) {
 9541:       try { n.stop(); } catch (_) {}
 9542:       try { n.disconnect(); } catch (_) {}
 9543:     }
 9544:     _callRingState.nodes = [];
 9545:   }
 9546:   function _scheduleRingPulse({ freqs, dur, gainPeak, when }) {
 9547:     const ctx = _getAudioCtx();
 9548:     if (!ctx) return;
 9549:     const start = when ?? ctx.currentTime;
 9550:     for (const f of freqs) {
 9551:       const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
 9552:       const gain = ctx.createGain();
 9553:       osc.type = "sine";
 9554:       osc.frequency.value = f;
 9555:       gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, start);
 9556:       gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gainPeak, start + 0.02);
 9557:       gain.gain.setValueAtTime(gainPeak, start + dur - 0.04);
 9558:       gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, start + dur);
 9559:       osc.connect(gain).connect(ctx.destination);
 9560:       osc.start(start);
 9561:       osc.stop(start + dur + 0.05);
 9562:       _callRingState.nodes.push(osc, gain);
 9563:     }
 9564:   }
 9565:   function _shouldPlayCallRing(opts = {}) {
 9566:     if (state.runtimeSettings?.notification_sound === false) return false;
 9567:     if (isQuietHoursActive()) return false;
 9568:     if (opts.peer_fp) {
 9569:       const peer = [...state.peers.values()]
 9570:         .find((p) => p.fingerprint === opts.peer_fp);
 9571:       if (peer?.muted) return false;
 9572:     }
 9573:     return true;
 9574:   }
 9575:   function startCallRingback(opts = {}) {
 9576:     _stopCallRing();
 9577:     if (!_shouldPlayCallRing(opts)) return;
 9578:     // Quiet single-tone pulse, classic "I'm calling, they're ringing" feel.
 9579:     // 0.5s on, 0.5s silence, repeating.
 9580:     const pulse = () => {
 9581:       _scheduleRingPulse({ freqs: [440], dur: 0.45, gainPeak: 0.04 });
 9582:     };
 9583:     pulse();
 9584:     _callRingState.timer = setInterval(pulse, 1000);
 9585:   }
 9586:   function startCallRingtone(opts = {}) {
 9587:     _stopCallRing();
 9588:     if (!_shouldPlayCallRing(opts)) return;
 9589:     // Dual-frequency phone-style ring, louder than ringback. Two
 9590:     // short pulses (1s + 1s) followed by a 1.2s gap = recognizable
 9591:     // ring cadence.
 9592:     const ctx = _getAudioCtx();
 9593:     if (!ctx) return;
 9594:     const ring = () => {
 9595:       const t0 = ctx.currentTime;
 9596:       _scheduleRingPulse({ freqs: [440, 480], dur: 0.4, gainPeak: 0.10, when: t0 });
 9597:       _scheduleRingPulse({ freqs: [440, 480], dur: 0.4, gainPeak: 0.10, when: t0 + 0.6 });
 9598:     };
 9599:     ring();
 9600:     // Total cadence 2.4s (0.4 + 0.2 + 0.4 + 1.4 gap)
 9601:     _callRingState.timer = setInterval(ring, 2400);
 9602:   }
 9603:   function stopCallRing() {
 9604:     _stopCallRing();
 9605:   }
 9606:   if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
 9607:     window.startCallRingback = startCallRingback;
 9608:     window.startCallRingtone = startCallRingtone;
 9609:     window.stopCallRing = stopCallRing;
 9610:   }
 9611: 
 9612:   function soundOnIncoming(opts = {}) {
 9613:     if (isQuietHoursActive()) return;
 9614:     if (opts.peer_fp) {
 9615:       const peer = [...state.peers.values()]
 9616:         .find(p => p.fingerprint === opts.peer_fp);
 9617:       if (peer?.muted) return;
 9618:     }
 9619:     playNotificationChime();
 9620:   }

 9622:   // v0.21.x: increment / decrement / refresh unread surfaces.
 9623:   //
 9624:   // Single source of truth: state.unreadByPeer + state.totalUnread.
 9625:   // Document title prefix and navigator.setAppBadge() (the OS-level
 9626:   // dock / taskbar count) are derived. Browser tab title format:
 9627:   // "(N) One Link" mirrors iMessage/Slack/Discord.
 9628:   const _BASE_TAB_TITLE = "One Link";
 9629:   function _refreshUnreadSurfaces() {
 9630:     const total = state.totalUnread || 0;
 9631:     try {
 9632:       document.title = total > 0
 9633:         ? `(${total > 99 ? "99+" : total}) ${_BASE_TAB_TITLE}`
 9634:         : _BASE_TAB_TITLE;
 9635:     } catch {}
 9636:     try {
 9637:       if (total > 0 && navigator.setAppBadge) {
 9638:         navigator.setAppBadge(total).catch(() => {});
 9639:       } else if (navigator.clearAppBadge) {
 9640:         navigator.clearAppBadge().catch(() => {});
 9641:       }
 9642:     } catch {}
 9643:   }
 9644:   function bumpUnread(peerShortId) {
 9645:     if (!peerShortId) return;
 9646:     state.unreadByPeer[peerShortId] = (state.unreadByPeer[peerShortId] || 0) + 1;
 9647:     state.totalUnread = (state.totalUnread || 0) + 1;
 9648:     _refreshUnreadSurfaces();
 9649:     try { renderPeers(); } catch {}
 9650:   }
 9651:   function clearUnread(peerShortId) {
 9652:     if (!peerShortId) return;
 9653:     const prev = state.unreadByPeer[peerShortId] || 0;
 9654:     if (prev === 0) return;
 9655:     delete state.unreadByPeer[peerShortId];
 9656:     state.totalUnread = Math.max(0, (state.totalUnread || 0) - prev);
 9657:     _refreshUnreadSurfaces();
 9658:     try { renderPeers(); } catch {}
 9659:   }
 9660:   function clearAllUnread() {
 9661:     if (!state.totalUnread) return;
 9662:     state.unreadByPeer = {};
 9663:     state.totalUnread = 0;
 9664:     _refreshUnreadSurfaces();
 9665:   }
 9666:   // On window focus, clear unread for the currently-selected peer
 9667:   // (the user IS reading those messages right now). Other peers
 9668:   // keep their badges until they're opened.
 9669:   window.addEventListener("focus", () => {
 9670:     if (state.selectedPeer) clearUnread(state.selectedPeer);
 9671:   });
 9672:   document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
 9673:     if (!document.hidden && state.selectedPeer) clearUnread(state.selectedPeer);
 9674:   });

 9676:   function notifyIncoming(title, body, opts = {}) {
 9677:     // v0.10.0: pair the desktop notification with the chime.
 9678:     soundOnIncoming(opts);
 9679:     if (!notifySupported()) return;
 9680:     if (Notification.permission !== "granted") return;
 9681:     if (document.hasFocus()) return;
 9682:     // v0.10.0: do-not-disturb suppresses BOTH the chime AND the
 9683:     // desktop notification. Messages still arrive - they just
 9684:     // don't ping.
 9685:     if (isQuietHoursActive()) return;
 9686:     // v0.7.3: respect per-device mute. Caller passes peer_fp; if
 9687:     // that peer's record is `muted`, swallow the notification.
 9688:     if (opts.peer_fp) {
 9689:       const peer = [...state.peers.values()]
 9690:         .find(p => p.fingerprint === opts.peer_fp);
 9691:       if (peer?.muted) return;
 9692:     }
 9693:     try {
 9694:       const n = new Notification(title, {
 9695:         body: body || "",
 9696:         icon: "/static/one-glyph.png",
 9697:         silent: false,
 9698:       });
 9699:       n.onclick = () => { window.focus(); n.close(); };
 9700:       setTimeout(() => { try { n.close(); } catch {} }, 8000);
 9701:     } catch {}
 9702:   }

 9757:   // ── v0.10.3 first-pair nudge ──────────────────────────────────────
 9758:   // Show a "say hi" callout above the chat ONCE after a peer first
 9759:   // becomes pinned. Tracks shown-fingerprints in localStorage so the
 9760:   // nudge doesn't re-pop on subsequent visits or new pairings.
 9761:   const FIRST_PAIR_KEY = "one_link.first_pair_shown";
 9762: 
 9763:   function _firstPairShownSet() {
 9764:     try {
 9765:       const raw = localStorage.getItem(FIRST_PAIR_KEY) || "";
 9766:       return new Set(raw.split(",").filter(Boolean));
 9767:     } catch { return new Set(); }
 9768:   }
 9769:   function _markFirstPairShown(fp) {
 9770:     try {
 9771:       const cur = _firstPairShownSet();

 9857:   // ── Render: peer list ──────────────────────────────────────────────
 9858:   // v0.4: sidebar is paired-only. The server filters; the UI renders
 9859:   // whatever it gets. Unpaired peers live in the discovery modal, not here.
 9860:   function _peerListHash(peers, selected) {
 9861:     // v0.7.x: stable signature of everything renderPeers reads off
 9862:     // each peer record. If this is unchanged across two refreshPeers
 9863:     // ticks, skip the DOM rebuild - the previous version was tearing
 9864:     // down + re-attaching every peer row every 5s, which the user
 9865:     // sees as a visible flicker. We coalesce latency into 80/250 ms
 9866:     // buckets so a few ms of jitter don't trigger redraws.
 9867:     const parts = [];
 9868:     parts.push(`sel=${selected || ""}`);
 9869:     // v0.21.x: my own version goes into the hash so a daemon update
 9870:     // re-renders every peer row's version-compare badge.
 9871:     parts.push(`my=${state.me?.app_version || ""}`);
 9872:     // v0.21.x: per-peer unread counts in the hash so the sidebar
 9873:     // badge appears/disappears as unread state changes.
 9874:     const uk = Object.keys(state.unreadByPeer).sort().map((k) =>
 9875:       `${k}:${state.unreadByPeer[k]}`).join(",");
 9876:     parts.push(`u=${uk}`);
 9877:     for (const p of peers) {
 9878:       const lat = p?.health?.latency_ewma_ms;
 9879:       const latBucket = lat == null ? -1 : (lat < 80 ? 0 : lat < 250 ? 1 : 2);
 9880:       // v0.21.x channel staleness bucket — coalesces last_alive_ms
 9881:       // into "fresh / stale / unknown" so a few seconds of jitter
 9882:       // doesn't trigger redraws but a transition (fresh→stale) does.
 9883:       const la = p?.health?.last_alive_ms;
 9884:       const staleBucket = la == null || la <= 0
 9885:         ? -1
 9886:         : ((Date.now() - la) < 60_000 ? 0 : 1);
 9887:       parts.push([
 9888:         p.short_id, p.hostname || "", p.address || "", p.port || 0,
 9889:         p.online ? 1 : 0, p.trust || "", latBucket, staleBucket,
 9890:         (p.allowed_capabilities || ["*"]).join(","),
 9891:         // v0.7.7: avatar overlay flips when verification toggles.
 9892:         p.is_verified ? 1 : 0,
 9893:         // v0.7.8: red ⚠ overlay flips when unacked-event count
 9894:         // changes. Bucketed at 0 / 1 / many to coalesce repeats.
 9895:         (p.key_change_unacked || 0) === 0 ? 0 : ((p.key_change_unacked || 0) === 1 ? 1 : 2),
 9896:         // v0.10.4: presence drives the avatar dot color.
 9897:         p.presence || "",
 9898:         // v0.21.x: peer's advertised app_version drives a "matches /
 9899:         // older / newer" pill in the row sub-line. Compatibility
 9900:         // verdict drives a yellow ⚠ badge when the negotiated path
 9901:         // is degraded vs our local preferred. Both surface so the
 9902:         // "queued while online" confusion has a visible cause.
 9903:         p.app_version || "",
 9904:         (p.compatibility?.compatible === false) ? "incompat" : "",
 9905:         (p.compatibility?.mode || ""),
 9906:       ].join("|"));
 9907:     }
 9908:     return parts.join("§");
 9909:   }
 9910: 
 9911:   // v0.21.x: numeric-aware semver-ish compare. Accepts strings like
 9912:   // "0.21.0-alpha", "0.20.6", "1.0.0". Returns negative if a<b, 0 if
 9913:   // equal, positive if a>b. Falls back to lexical compare on parse
 9914:   // failure (still useful, and the worst case is the badge says
 9915:   // "different version" without older/newer arrow).
 9916:   function _compareAppVersion(a, b) {
 9917:     if (!a || !b) return 0;
 9918:     if (a === b) return 0;
 9919:     const partsA = String(a).split(/[-+]/, 1)[0].split(".").map(n => parseInt(n, 10));
 9920:     const partsB = String(b).split(/[-+]/, 1)[0].split(".").map(n => parseInt(n, 10));
 9921:     const len = Math.max(partsA.length, partsB.length);
 9922:     for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
 9923:       const x = partsA[i] || 0;
 9924:       const y = partsB[i] || 0;
 9925:       if (isNaN(x) || isNaN(y)) return a < b ? -1 : 1;
 9926:       if (x !== y) return x - y;
 9927:     }
 9928:     // numeric parts equal; compare pre-release suffix (none > any suffix)
 9929:     const sufA = String(a).split(/[-+]/).slice(1).join("-");
 9930:     const sufB = String(b).split(/[-+]/).slice(1).join("-");
 9931:     if (sufA === sufB) return 0;
 9932:     if (!sufA) return 1;
 9933:     if (!sufB) return -1;
 9934:     return sufA < sufB ? -1 : 1;
 9935:   }
 9936:   // v0.21.x: returns a small DOM badge or null when nothing useful to
 9937:   // say. Three cases worth surfacing:
 9938:   //   - peer is on an older build than us  → "On older build" + ⬇
 9939:   //   - peer is on a newer build than us  → "On newer build" + ⬆
 9940:   //   - peer never did a CAPS exchange    → null (we don't speak FUD)
 9941:   //   - peer is same version               → null (least clutter)
 9942:   // When the daemon's compatibility negotiation marks the path as
 9943:   // incompatible OR forced to a fallback transfer_mode, we also
 9944:   // surface that as a yellow ⚠ chip — this is the case that drives
 9945:   // "queued while online" symptoms.
 9946:   function renderPeerVersionBadge(peer) {
 9947:     const myVer = state.me?.app_version || null;
 9948:     const theirVer = peer?.app_version || null;
 9949:     const compat = peer?.compatibility || null;
 9950:     let chip = null;
 9951:     let kind = null;
 9952:     // Compatibility-degraded path takes priority because that's the
 9953:     // case that actually breaks sends; version-only diff is just
 9954:     // informational.
 9955:     if (compat && compat.compatible === false) {
 9956:       chip = el("span", "peer-ver-badge peer-ver-incompat", "⚠ Incompatible");
 9957:       const reasons = (compat.reasons || []).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 3).join(", ");
 9958:       chip.title = reasons
 9959:         ? `Wire-path renegotiation needed: ${reasons}. Click for details.`
 9960:         : "Wire-path renegotiation needed. Sends may queue until both sides catch up. Click for details.";
 9961:       kind = "incompat";
 9962:     } else if (compat && compat.mode === "fallback") {
 9963:       chip = el("span", "peer-ver-badge peer-ver-fallback", "⚠ Fallback path");
 9964:       chip.title = `Negotiated transfer_mode: ${compat.transfer_mode || "fallback"}. Some features may be limited. Click for details.`;
 9965:       kind = "fallback";
 9966:     } else if (myVer && theirVer) {
 9967:       const cmp = _compareAppVersion(theirVer, myVer);
 9968:       if (cmp < 0) {
 9969:         chip = el("span", "peer-ver-badge peer-ver-older", "⬇ Older build");
 9970:         chip.title = `Other device is on v${theirVer}. You're on v${myVer}. Click for how to update.`;
 9971:         kind = "older";
 9972:       } else if (cmp > 0) {
 9973:         chip = el("span", "peer-ver-badge peer-ver-newer", "⬆ Newer build");
 9974:         chip.title = `Other device is on v${theirVer}. You're on v${myVer}. Click for what to do.`;
 9975:         kind = "newer";
 9976:       }
 9977:     }
 9978:     if (!chip) return null;
 9979:     // v0.21.x: every surface a "why is this badge here" affordance.
 9980:     // Click opens a calm explainer modal with concrete next steps.
 9981:     // Buttons inside the modal route to: copy install path, open
 9982:     // dist folder, dismiss. Sender-side: no auto-push of binaries
 9983:     // (that's the next layer); this is the human-readable path.
 9984:     chip.style.cursor = "pointer";
 9985:     chip.tabIndex = 0;
 9986:     chip.setAttribute("role", "button");
 9987:     const openExplainer = (ev) => {
 9988:       ev.stopPropagation();
 9989:       ev.preventDefault();
 9990:       openVersionMismatchModal(peer, kind, { myVer, theirVer, compat });
 9991:     };
 9992:     chip.addEventListener("click", openExplainer);
 9993:     chip.addEventListener("keydown", (ev) => {
 9994:       if (ev.key === "Enter" || ev.key === " ") openExplainer(ev);
 9995:     });
 9996:     return chip;
 9997:   }
 9998:   // v0.21.x: explainer modal for the peer-version badge. Lives as a
 9999:   // singleton on document.body so renderPeers can fire-and-forget.
10000:   // Three flavors (older / newer / incompat / fallback) share one
10001:   // shell; copy differs.
10002:   function openVersionMismatchModal(peer, kind, ctx) {
10003:     const peerLabel = peer?.display_name || peer?.hostname || peer?.short_id || "the other device";
10004:     let title, lead, steps, primaryLabel, primaryAction;
10005:     const myVer = ctx.myVer || "unknown";
10006:     const theirVer = ctx.theirVer || "unknown";

10010:       steps = [
10011:         "Open One Link on the other device and let it run for a few seconds — the daemons re-handshake automatically.",

10021:       title = "Using a fallback wire path";
10022:       lead = `${peerLabel} can talk to you, but on a slower or older transfer mode (${ctx.compat?.transfer_mode || "legacy"}). Sends still work, but features added in your build may not be available until the other side catches up.`;
10023:       steps = [
10024:         `Your build is v${myVer}. The other device reports v${theirVer || "unknown"}.`,
10025:         "Update whichever side is older to get the full feature set on both ends.",
10026:       ];
10027:       primaryLabel = "OK";
10028:       primaryAction = null;
10029:     } else if (kind === "older") {
10030:       title = "Other device is on an older build";
10031:       lead = `${peerLabel} is running v${theirVer}. You're running v${myVer}. Some sends may queue or fall back to a slower path until both sides match.`;
10032:       steps = [
10033:         "Open One Link on this machine's repo or installer folder.",
10034:         "Copy the *whole* dist/one-link/ folder (or the latest installer) to the other device.",

10036:         "Both sides will re-handshake automatically. The badge clears within a few seconds.",
10037:       ];
10038:       primaryLabel = "Copy my version label";
10039:       primaryAction = () => {
10040:         const label = `One Link v${myVer}`;
10041:         try {
10042:           if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
10043:             navigator.clipboard.writeText(label);
10044:             toast("Version copied. Tell the other device which build to match.", "good", 4500);
10045:           } else {
10046:             toast(label, "info", 6000);
10047:           }
10048:         } catch {
10049:           toast(label, "info", 6000);
10050:         }
10051:       };
10052:     } else { // newer
10053:       title = "Other device is on a newer build";
10054:       lead = `${peerLabel} is running v${theirVer}. You're running v${myVer}. Newer features they add may not be available on your side until you catch up.`;
10055:       steps = [
10056:         "Pull the latest from your One Link source (git pull) and rebuild the daemon, OR",
10057:         "Ask the person running the other device to share their dist/one-link/ folder back.",
10058:         "Restart One Link on this machine after replacing the folder.",
10059:       ];
10060:       primaryLabel = "OK";
10061:       primaryAction = null;
10062:     }
10063:     _ensureVersionMismatchModal();
10064:     const modal = document.getElementById("version-mismatch-modal");
10065:     modal.querySelector(".vmm-title").textContent = title;
10066:     modal.querySelector(".vmm-lead").textContent = lead;
10067:     const stepsHost = modal.querySelector(".vmm-steps");
10068:     stepsHost.innerHTML = "";
10069:     steps.forEach((s) => {
10070:       const li = document.createElement("li");
10071:       li.textContent = s;
10072:       stepsHost.appendChild(li);
10073:     });
10074:     const primaryBtn = modal.querySelector(".vmm-primary");
10075:     primaryBtn.textContent = primaryLabel;
10076:     primaryBtn.onclick = (ev) => {
10077:       ev.stopPropagation();
10078:       if (primaryAction) primaryAction();
10079:       else closeVersionMismatchModal();
10080:     };
10081:     modal.classList.add("show");
10082:     document.body.classList.add("vmm-open");
10083:   }

10129:   // v0.21.x: call permission preflight. The first time a user
10130:   // clicks 📞 / 📹 we explain WHY the browser is about to ask for
10131:   // mic / camera. Without this, the cold prompt feels random and
10132:   // some users deny it by reflex, which then leaves the call
10133:   // half-set-up with no useful UI feedback. Returns true to
10134:   // proceed with the call, false to abort silently.
10135:   //
10136:   // Skip conditions:
10137:   //   - The user already saw the preflight (localStorage flag).
10138:   //   - The browser reports the permission as "granted" already.
10139:   // Both conditions can apply per-permission (mic-only voice calls
10140:   // don't preflight camera).
10141:   const CALL_PREFLIGHT_KEY = "one_link.call_preflight.v1";
10142:   async function _callPermissionPreflight({ video, peerLabel }) {
10143:     const needs = ["microphone"];
10144:     if (video) needs.push("camera");
10145:     // Fast path: every permission already granted -> proceed.
10146:     let allGranted = true;
10147:     if (navigator.permissions && navigator.permissions.query) {
10148:       for (const name of needs) {
10149:         try {
10150:           const st = await navigator.permissions.query({ name });
10151:           if (st.state !== "granted") { allGranted = false; break; }
10152:         } catch {
10153:           allGranted = false;
10154:           break;
10155:         }
10156:       }
10157:     } else {
10158:       allGranted = false;
10159:     }
10160:     if (allGranted) return true;
10161:     // Already acked the explainer in a previous call? Skip directly to the cold prompt.
10162:     try {
10163:       const ack = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CALL_PREFLIGHT_KEY) || "{}");
10164:       const needed = needs.every((n) => ack[n] === true);
10165:       if (needed) return true;
10166:     } catch {}
10167:     // Otherwise show the preflight modal and wait for user choice.
10168:     return await _showCallPreflightModal({ needs, peerLabel });
10169:   }
10170:   if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
10171:     window._callPermissionPreflight = _callPermissionPreflight;
10172:   }
10173:   function _showCallPreflightModal({ needs, peerLabel }) {
10174:     return new Promise((resolve) => {
10175:       _ensureCallPreflightModal();
10176:       const modal = document.getElementById("call-preflight-modal");
10177:       const wantsCamera = needs.includes("camera");
10178:       modal.querySelector(".cpm-title").textContent = wantsCamera
10179:         ? "One Link needs your mic and camera"
10180:         : "One Link needs your microphone";
10181:       const leadLines = [];
10182:       if (peerLabel) {
10183:         leadLines.push(`To call ${peerLabel}, your browser is about to ask permission.`);
10184:       } else {
10185:         leadLines.push("Your browser is about to ask permission.");
10186:       }
10187:       leadLines.push(
10188:         wantsCamera
10189:           ? "Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere except to this call. You can revoke mic or camera access any time from your browser settings."
10190:           : "Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere except to this call. You can revoke mic access any time from your browser settings.",
10191:       );
10192:       modal.querySelector(".cpm-lead").innerHTML = leadLines
10193:         .map((s) => `<p>${_escapeHtml(s)}</p>`)
10194:         .join("");
10195:       const proceedBtn = modal.querySelector(".cpm-primary");
10196:       const cancelBtn = modal.querySelector(".cpm-secondary");
10197:       const onProceed = () => {
10198:         try {
10199:           const ack = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CALL_PREFLIGHT_KEY) || "{}");
10200:           for (const n of needs) ack[n] = true;
10201:           localStorage.setItem(CALL_PREFLIGHT_KEY, JSON.stringify(ack));
10202:         } catch {}
10203:         cleanup();
10204:         resolve(true);
10205:       };
10206:       const onCancel = () => {
10207:         cleanup();
10208:         resolve(false);
10209:       };
10210:       const onBackdrop = (ev) => {
10211:         const t = ev.target;
10212:         if (t && t instanceof Element && t.hasAttribute("data-cpm-close")) {
10213:           onCancel();
10214:         }
10215:       };
10216:       const onKey = (ev) => {
10217:         if (ev.key === "Escape") onCancel();
10218:         if (ev.key === "Enter") onProceed();
10219:       };
10220:       function cleanup() {
10221:         proceedBtn.removeEventListener("click", onProceed);
10222:         cancelBtn.removeEventListener("click", onCancel);
10223:         modal.removeEventListener("click", onBackdrop);
10224:         document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
10225:         modal.classList.remove("show");
10226:         document.body.classList.remove("cpm-open");
10227:       }
10228:       proceedBtn.addEventListener("click", onProceed);
10229:       cancelBtn.addEventListener("click", onCancel);
10230:       modal.addEventListener("click", onBackdrop);
10231:       document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
10232:       modal.classList.add("show");
10233:       document.body.classList.add("cpm-open");
10234:       setTimeout(() => proceedBtn.focus(), 50);
10235:     });
10236:   }
10237:   function _ensureCallPreflightModal() {
10238:     if (document.getElementById("call-preflight-modal")) return;
10239:     const m = document.createElement("div");
10240:     m.id = "call-preflight-modal";

10486:   async function loadDiscoverable({ prune = false } = {}) {
10487:     if (state.discoverLoading) return;
10488:     state.discoverLoading = true;
10489:     const refreshBtn = $("#discover-refresh");
10490:     if (refreshBtn) refreshBtn.classList.add("spinning");
10491:     try {
10492:       if (prune) {
10493:         try { await api.post("/api/peers/prune", {}); } catch {}
10494:       }
10495:       // May 16 2026 - call the new smart-discovery endpoint that
10496:       // runs mDNS + ARP + SSDP + NetBIOS in parallel and returns
10497:       // three sections. Falls back to the legacy peer-only path
10498:       // if the endpoint isn't available yet (e.g., daemon is
10499:       // pre-update).
10500:       let smart = null;
10501:       try {
10502:         smart = await api.get("/api/discover/all?timeout=5");
10503:       } catch (_) {}
10504:       const { peers } = await api.get("/api/peers?include_unpaired=1");
10505:       const unpairedReady = peers.filter(
10506:         (p) => p.trust !== "pinned" && p.online && p.fingerprint
10507:       );
10508:       if (smart) {
10509:         // Merge the legacy unpaired-but-running-One-Link list into
10510:         // smart.ready_to_pair. They're the same set logically but
10511:         // the smart endpoint may not yet see the most-recently-
10512:         // arrived peer.
10513:         const seen_ips = new Set((smart.ready_to_pair || []).map(d => d.ip));
10514:         for (const p of unpairedReady) {
10515:           if (!seen_ips.has(p.address)) {
10516:             smart.ready_to_pair = smart.ready_to_pair || [];
10517:             smart.ready_to_pair.push({
10518:               ip: p.address || "",
10519:               hostname: p.hostname || p.short_id || "",
10520:               vendor: "",
10521:               kind: deviceKindLabel(p)?.label?.toLowerCase().includes("laptop") ? "laptop" : "unknown",
10522:               one_link_peer: p,
10523:             });
10524:           }
10525:         }
10526:         state.discoverSmart = smart;
10527:       } else {
10528:         state.discoverSmart = {
10529:           ready_to_pair: unpairedReady.map(p => ({
10530:             ip: p.address || "",
10531:             hostname: p.hostname || p.short_id || "",
10532:             kind: "laptop",
10533:             one_link_peer: p,
10534:           })),
10535:           pairable: [],
10536:           other_gear: [],
10537:           network_health: {},
10538:         };
10539:       }
10540:       renderDiscoverable();
10541:     } catch (e) {
10542:       console.warn(e);
10543:       const body = $("#discover-body");
10544:       if (body) body.innerHTML = `<div class="empty">Couldn't reach the service. ${e.message || e}</div>`;
10545:     } finally {
10546:       state.discoverLoading = false;
10547:       if (refreshBtn) refreshBtn.classList.remove("spinning");
10548:     }
10549:   }

10556:       router: "📡", iot: "🔌", console: "🎮", unknown: "❓",
10557:     }[kind] || "❓";

10583:   function _renderDeviceRow(d, action) {
10584:     /* action = "pair" | "invite" */
10585:     const row = el("div", "discover-row");
10586:     const av = el("div", "avatar", _kindIcon(d.kind));
10587:     const meta = el("div", "meta");
10588:     const nameRow = el("div", "name");
10589:     nameRow.textContent = d.hostname
10590:       || (d.vendor ? `${d.vendor} ${_kindLabel(d.kind).toLowerCase()}` : _kindLabel(d.kind));
10591:     meta.appendChild(nameRow);
10592:     const subParts = [];
10593:     if (d.vendor) subParts.push(d.vendor);
10594:     subParts.push(_kindLabel(d.kind));
10595:     if (d.ip) subParts.push(d.ip);
10596:     meta.appendChild(el("div", "sub", subParts.join(" · ")));
10597:     const btn = el(
10598:       "button",
10599:       action === "pair" ? "pair-btn" : "pair-btn",
10600:       action === "pair" ? "Pair" : (_isPersonalDeviceKind(d.kind) ? "Pair" : "Invite"),
10601:     );
10602:     row.appendChild(av);
10603:     row.appendChild(meta);
10604:     row.appendChild(btn);
10605:     row.onclick = async () => {
10606:       if (action === "pair" && d.one_link_peer) {
10607:         if (!d.one_link_peer.fingerprint) {
10608:           toast("That device isn't ready yet. Try again in a moment.", "warn");
10609:           return;
10610:         }
10611:         closeDiscoverModal();
10612:         openPairModal(d.one_link_peer);
10613:       } else if (_isPersonalDeviceKind(d.kind)) {
10614:         await startOneSetupDevicePairing();
10615:       } else {
10616:         await openInviteModal(d);
10617:       }
10618:     };
10619:     return row;
10620:   }

10622:   function _hasDiscoveredPhone(devices) {

10628:       return /\b(phone|iphone|android|pixel|galaxy|oneplus|xiaomi|redmi)\b/.test(text);
10629:     });

10651:   function renderDiscoverable() {
10652:     const body = $("#discover-body");
10653:     if (!body) return;
10654:     body.innerHTML = "";
10655:     const smart = state.discoverSmart || {};
10656:     const ready = smart.ready_to_pair || [];
10657:     const pairable = smart.pairable || [];
10658:     const other = smart.other_gear || [];
10659:     const allDiscovered = [...ready, ...pairable, ...other];
10660:     const health = smart.network_health || {};
10661: 
10662:     // Status line under the title.
10663:     const status = $("#discover-status");
10664:     if (status) {
10665:       const total = ready.length + pairable.length + other.length;
10666:       if (total === 0) {
10667:         status.textContent = "";
10668:       } else {
10669:         status.textContent =
10670:           `${total} device${total === 1 ? "" : "s"} on your network · ` +
10671:           `${ready.length} ready to pair, ${pairable.length} inviteable`;
10672:       }
10673:     }
10674: 
10675:     // Network-health banner - surface AP isolation / captive
10676:     // portal issues so the user knows WHY the scan looks empty.
10677:     if (health.ap_isolation_suspected || health.captive_portal_suspected) {
10678:       const banner = el("div", "discover-health-warn");
10679:       banner.style.cssText = `
10680:         padding: 12px 14px; margin-bottom: 14px;
10681:         background: rgba(255,180,90,0.08);
10682:         border: 1px solid rgba(255,180,90,0.32);
10683:         border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13px;
10684:       `;
10685:       banner.textContent = (health.messages || []).join(" ");
10686:       body.appendChild(banner);
10687:     }
10688: 
10689:     if (ready.length === 0 && pairable.length === 0 && other.length === 0) {
10690:       const empty = el("div", "empty");
10691:       empty.style.padding = "32px 16px";
10692:       empty.innerHTML = `
10693:         <p style="margin: 0 0 6px;">No other devices found on your Wi-Fi yet.</p>
10694:         <p style="margin: 0; color: rgba(180,200,255,0.7); font-size: 13px;">
10695:           Either no devices are around, or your Wi-Fi blocks
10696:           device-to-device discovery. You can still pair anyone by
10697:           sending them an invite link.
10698:         </p>`;
10699:       body.appendChild(empty);
10700:     }
10701: 
10702:     if (!_hasDiscoveredPhone(allDiscovered)) {
10703:       body.appendChild(_renderPhoneHelp());
10704:     }
10705: 
10706:     // Section 1: Ready to pair (already running One Link).
10707:     if (ready.length > 0) {
10708:       body.appendChild(el(
10709:         "div", "discover-section-h",
10710:         `Ready to pair · already running One Link (${ready.length})`,
10711:       ));
10712:       for (const d of ready) body.appendChild(_renderDeviceRow(d, "pair"));
10713:     }
10714:     // Section 2: Other devices on your Wi-Fi.
10715:     if (pairable.length > 0) {
10716:       body.appendChild(el(
10717:         "div", "discover-section-h",
10718:         `Other devices on your Wi-Fi (${pairable.length})`,
10719:       ));
10720:       for (const d of pairable) body.appendChild(_renderDeviceRow(d, "invite"));
10721:     }
10722:     // Section 3: Other gear (TVs / speakers / printers) - collapsed.
10723:     if (other.length > 0) {
10724:       const details = el("details");
10725:       details.style.marginTop = "12px";
10726:       const summary = el("summary", "discover-section-h");
10727:       summary.style.cursor = "pointer";
10728:       summary.textContent = `Other gear on your network (${other.length})`;
10729:       details.appendChild(summary);
10730:       for (const d of other) details.appendChild(_renderDeviceRow(d, "invite"));
10731:       body.appendChild(details);
10732:     }
10733:   }

10744:   // Best-effort platform detection. UA-string + touch-primary
10745:   // pointer check; tablets with a stylus still count as touch.
10746:   function _isMobileLikely() {
10747:     try {
10748:       const ua = navigator.userAgent || "";
10749:       if (/Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod|Mobile/i.test(ua)) return true;
10750:       // Some Windows tablets report Mobile UA; double-check via
10751:       // pointer media query.
10752:       if (window.matchMedia &&
10753:           window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches &&
10754:           navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1) {
10755:         return true;
10756:       }
10757:     } catch (_) {}
10758:     return false;
10759:   }

10761:   async function openInviteModal(targetDevice) {
10762:     if (!targetDevice || _isPersonalDeviceKind(targetDevice.kind) || targetDevice.kind === "unknown") {
10763:       await startOneSetupDevicePairing();
10764:       return;
10765:     }
10766:     const overlay = $("#invite-backdrop");

10768:     const urlEl = $("#invite-url");
10769:     const expiryEl = $("#invite-expiry");

10771:     const tgtLine = $("#invite-target-line");
10772:     if (!overlay || !codeEl || !urlEl || !qrHost) return;
10773:     overlay.classList.add("show");
10774: 
10775:     // Target line copy.
10776:     if (tgtLine) {
10777:       if (targetDevice) {
10778:         const who = targetDevice.hostname || targetDevice.vendor || "this device";
10779:         const ip = targetDevice.ip ? ` (${targetDevice.ip})` : "";
10780:         tgtLine.textContent = `Inviting ${who}${ip}. Have them scan the code or open the link.`;
10781:       } else {
10782:         tgtLine.textContent = "Hand them the QR code or send them the link.";
10783:       }
10784:     }
10785: 
10786:     // Loading state.
10787:     codeEl.textContent = "------";
10788:     urlEl.textContent = "";
10789:     if (expiryEl) expiryEl.textContent = "...";
10790:     qrHost.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#888; font-size:12px;">Generating QR...</div>';
10791:     _stopInviteCountdown();
10792: 
10793:     try {
10794:       const body = await api.post("/api/discover/invite", {
10795:         target_label: targetDevice
10796:           ? (targetDevice.hostname || targetDevice.vendor || "")
10797:           : "",
10798:       });
10799:       const code = body.code || "";
10800:       const landing = body.landing_url || "";
10801:       _inviteCurrentCode = code;
10802:       _inviteExpiresAtMs = body.expires_ms || (Date.now() + 300000);
10803:       codeEl.textContent = code;
10804:       urlEl.textContent = landing;
10805:       // Real SVG QR from the daemon, sized to the card. <img src>
10806:       // automatically sends the session cookie for same-origin
10807:       // requests, so the auth gate accepts it transparently.
10808:       const qrUrl = `/api/discover/invite/qr.svg?code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}`;
10809:       qrHost.innerHTML = `<img src="${qrUrl}" alt="Pair QR code" `
10810:         + `style="width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain;" `
10811:         + `onerror="this.parentNode.innerHTML='<div style=color:#c33;font-size:12px;>QR generation failed</div>'" />`;
10812:       // Live MM:SS countdown.
10813:       _startInviteCountdown();
10814:       // Tailor the action row to the platform.
10815:       //
10816:       // On Windows desktop, navigator.share() routes through the
10817:       // Windows share sheet which defaults to Microsoft Phone Link
10818:       // (a corp account-tied service that violates the sovereignty
10819:       // floor and confuses users). So Web Share is ONLY used when
10820:       // we're on a real mobile / touch-primary device - there the
10821:       // OS share sheet is a first-class send mechanism (Messages /
10822:       // Mail / AirDrop / etc.).
10823:       //
10824:       // On desktop we show our own sovereign options: Email link
10825:       // via mailto:, Show fullscreen QR (great for showing across
10826:       // a room), and Save QR (downloads the SVG to disk).
10827:       const isMobile = _isMobileLikely();
10828:       $("#invite-share").style.display = (isMobile && navigator.share) ? "" : "none";
10829:       $("#invite-email").style.display = isMobile ? "none" : "";
10830:       $("#invite-fullscreen").style.display = isMobile ? "none" : "";
10831:       $("#invite-save-qr").style.display = isMobile ? "none" : "";
10832:       // Wire the save-QR anchor to the qr.svg URL.
10833:       const dl = $("#invite-qr-download");
10834:       if (dl) {
10835:         dl.href = qrUrl;
10836:         dl.download = `one-link-invite-${code}.svg`;
10837:         dl.dataset.ready = "1";
10838:       }
10839:     } catch (e) {
10840:       codeEl.textContent = "ERROR";
10841:       urlEl.textContent = "";
10842:       qrHost.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#c33; font-size:12px;">`
10843:         + `Couldn't generate invite.<br>${escapeText(e.message || String(e))}</div>`;
10844:     }
10845:   }

10847:   function _startInviteCountdown() {
10848:     _stopInviteCountdown();
10849:     const expiryEl = $("#invite-expiry");
10850:     if (!expiryEl) return;
10851:     const tick = () => {
10852:       const ms = _inviteExpiresAtMs - Date.now();
10853:       if (ms <= 0) {
10854:         expiryEl.textContent = "Expired";
10855:         expiryEl.style.color = "#e36a6a";
10856:         _stopInviteCountdown();
10857:         return;
10858:       }
10859:       const total = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
10860:       const mm = Math.floor(total / 60);
10861:       const ss = total % 60;
10862:       expiryEl.textContent = `${mm}:${ss.toString().padStart(2, "0")}`;
10863:       expiryEl.style.color = ms < 60000 ? "#e3a86a" : "";
10864:     };
10865:     tick();
10866:     _inviteCountdownTimer = setInterval(tick, 1000);
10867:   }

10894:   // ── Inline text rendering: links, code, bold, italic ──────────────
10895:   // Tokenize and build DOM nodes - never inject raw HTML.
10896:   // Tokens (in order of priority): triple-backtick blocks, inline `code`,
10897:   // URLs, **bold**, _italic_.
10898:   function renderInlineText(body) {
10899:     const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
10900:     const blocks = (body || "").split(/```([\s\S]*?)```/g);
10901:     for (let i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
10902:       if (i % 2 === 1) {
10903:         const pre = document.createElement("pre");
10904:         const code = document.createElement("code");
10905:         code.textContent = blocks[i];
10906:         pre.appendChild(code);
10907:         frag.appendChild(pre);
10908:       } else {
10909:         renderInlineNonCode(blocks[i], frag);
10910:       }
10911:     }
10912:     return frag;
10913:   }

10915:   // v0.21.x file-bubble open: click a complete FILE bubble (sender
10916:   // OR receiver) to see the file. For images we open an inline
10917:   // lightbox; for everything else the file is opened in a new tab
10918:   // (the browser then renders it inline or downloads it depending
10919:   // on type). The sender side resolves the file from
10920:   // state.outboundFileCache (browser holds the original File until
10921:   // tab close); the receiver side hits /api/files/<name> which the
10922:   // daemon serves from inbox_dir. When neither path is available
10923:   // the bubble surfaces a calm hint instead of dead-clicking.
10924:   function _outboundFileKey(name, size) {
10925:     return `${(name || "").toLowerCase()}|${size || 0}`;
10926:   }
10927:   function rememberOutboundFile(file) {
10928:     if (!file || !file.name) return;
10929:     const key = _outboundFileKey(file.name, file.size);
10930:     const prev = state.outboundFileCache.get(key);
10931:     if (prev?.objectUrl) {
10932:       try { URL.revokeObjectURL(prev.objectUrl); } catch (_) {}
10933:     }
10934:     state.outboundFileCache.set(key, {
10935:       file,
10936:       addedAt: Date.now(),
10937:       objectUrl: null,
10938:     });
10939:   }
10940:   function objectUrlForOutboundFile(name, size) {
10941:     const key = _outboundFileKey(name, size);
10942:     const ent = state.outboundFileCache.get(key);
10943:     if (!ent) return null;
10944:     if (!ent.objectUrl) ent.objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(ent.file);
10945:     return ent.objectUrl;
10946:   }

11009:   // v0.21.x: lightbox is gallery-aware. When opened on an image
11010:   // bubble in a conversation, it computes the set of other images
11011:   // in that conversation and lets ← / → / swipe move between them
11012:   // without closing. Falls back to single-image mode if no
11013:   // conversation context is supplied.
11014:   const _lightboxState = { gallery: [], index: 0 };
11015:   function openLightbox({ url, name, sizeBytes, downloadName, gallery, index }) {
11016:     const lb = _ensureLightbox();
11017:     _ensureLightboxNavButtons();
11018:     if (Array.isArray(gallery) && gallery.length > 0) {
11019:       _lightboxState.gallery = gallery;
11020:       _lightboxState.index = Math.max(0, Math.min(gallery.length - 1, index || 0));
11021:     } else {
11022:       _lightboxState.gallery = [{ url, name, sizeBytes, downloadName }];
11023:       _lightboxState.index = 0;
11024:     }
11025:     _paintLightbox();
11026:     _attachLightboxNav();
11027:     lb.classList.add("show");
11028:     document.body.classList.add("lb-open");
11029:   }
11030:   function _paintLightbox() {
11031:     const lb = document.getElementById("file-lightbox");
11032:     if (!lb) return;
11033:     const ent = _lightboxState.gallery[_lightboxState.index];
11034:     if (!ent) return;
11035:     const count = _lightboxState.gallery.length;
11036:     const indexLabel = count > 1
11037:       ? ` · ${_lightboxState.index + 1} of ${count}`
11038:       : "";
11039:     lb.querySelector(".file-lightbox-name").textContent = (ent.name || "image")
11040:       + (ent.sizeBytes ? ` · ${fmtBytes(ent.sizeBytes)}` : "")
11041:       + indexLabel;
11042:     const body = lb.querySelector(".file-lightbox-body");
11043:     body.replaceChildren();
11044:     const img = document.createElement("img");
11045:     img.src = ent.url;
11046:     img.alt = ent.name || "image";
11047:     img.className = "file-lightbox-img";
11048:     body.appendChild(img);
11049:     const openA = lb.querySelector(".file-lightbox-open");
11050:     openA.href = ent.url;
11051:     const dlA = lb.querySelector(".file-lightbox-download");
11052:     dlA.href = ent.url;
11053:     dlA.setAttribute("download", ent.downloadName || ent.name || "file");
11054:     // Nav button visibility — hidden when there's only one image.
11055:     const prev = lb.querySelector(".file-lightbox-prev");
11056:     const next = lb.querySelector(".file-lightbox-next");
11057:     if (prev) prev.style.display = count > 1 ? "" : "none";
11058:     if (next) next.style.display = count > 1 ? "" : "none";
11059:   }
11060:   function _stepLightbox(delta) {
11061:     const count = _lightboxState.gallery.length;
11062:     if (count <= 1) return;
11063:     _lightboxState.index = (_lightboxState.index + delta + count) % count;
11064:     _paintLightbox();
11065:   }
11066:   function _ensureLightboxNavButtons() {
11067:     const lb = document.getElementById("file-lightbox");
11068:     if (!lb || lb.querySelector(".file-lightbox-prev")) return;
11069:     const prev = document.createElement("button");
11070:     prev.type = "button";
11071:     prev.className = "file-lightbox-prev";
11072:     prev.setAttribute("aria-label", "Previous image");
11073:     prev.textContent = "‹";
11074:     prev.onclick = (ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); _stepLightbox(-1); };
11075:     const next = document.createElement("button");
11076:     next.type = "button";
11077:     next.className = "file-lightbox-next";
11078:     next.setAttribute("aria-label", "Next image");
11079:     next.textContent = "›";
11080:     next.onclick = (ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); _stepLightbox(1); };
11081:     lb.appendChild(prev);
11082:     lb.appendChild(next);
11083:   }
11084:   function _attachLightboxNav() {
11085:     const lb = document.getElementById("file-lightbox");
11086:     if (!lb || lb._navAttached) return;
11087:     lb._navAttached = true;
11088:     document.addEventListener("keydown", (ev) => {
11089:       if (!lb.classList.contains("show")) return;
11090:       if (ev.key === "ArrowLeft") { ev.preventDefault(); _stepLightbox(-1); }
11091:       else if (ev.key === "ArrowRight") { ev.preventDefault(); _stepLightbox(1); }
11092:     });
11093:     // Touch swipe
11094:     let startX = 0, startY = 0, tracking = false;
11095:     const body = lb.querySelector(".file-lightbox-body");
11096:     body.addEventListener("touchstart", (ev) => {
11097:       const t = ev.touches[0]; startX = t.clientX; startY = t.clientY; tracking = true;
11098:     }, { passive: true });
11099:     body.addEventListener("touchend", (ev) => {
11100:       if (!tracking) return; tracking = false;
11101:       const t = ev.changedTouches[0];
11102:       const dx = t.clientX - startX;
11103:       const dy = t.clientY - startY;
11104:       if (Math.abs(dx) > 40 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
11105:         _stepLightbox(dx > 0 ? -1 : 1);
11106:       }
11107:     }, { passive: true });
11108:   }
11109:   // v0.21.x: build a gallery for the current conversation by
11110:   // walking state.messages for image-typed bubbles. Each entry maps
11111:   // to the inbound /api/files URL or the outbound cached blob URL.
11112:   function _buildLightboxGalleryForCurrent(currentMsg) {
11113:     const peerShortId = currentMsg.peer;
11114:     if (!peerShortId) return null;
11115:     const entries = [];
11116:     let activeIdx = 0;
11117:     const all = state.messages.filter((m) =>
11118:       m.peer === peerShortId
11119:       && (m.t === "FILE_OFFER" || m.t === "FILE_DONE")
11120:       && isImageName(m.name));
11121:     for (const m of all) {
11122:       let url = null;
11123:       let downloadName = m.name || "";
11124:       if (m.dir === "in") {
11125:         const fname = (m.path || m.name || "").toString().split(/[\\\/]/).pop();
11126:         if (fname) {
11127:           url = `/api/files/${encodeURIComponent(fname)}`;
11128:           downloadName = fname;
11129:         }
11130:       } else {
11131:         url = objectUrlForOutboundFile(m.name, m.size || 0);
11132:       }
11133:       if (!url) continue;
11134:       if (m.id === currentMsg.id) activeIdx = entries.length;
11135:       entries.push({
11136:         url,
11137:         name: m.name || "image",
11138:         sizeBytes: m.size || 0,
11139:         downloadName,
11140:       });
11141:     }
11142:     if (entries.length === 0) return null;
11143:     return { gallery: entries, index: activeIdx };
11144:   }
11145:   function closeLightbox() {
11146:     const lb = document.getElementById("file-lightbox");
11147:     if (!lb) return;
11148:     lb.classList.remove("show");
11149:     document.body.classList.remove("lb-open");
11150:     const body = lb.querySelector(".file-lightbox-body");
11151:     if (body) body.replaceChildren();
11152:   }
11153:   // Open the file referenced by `msg` (a TEXT-shaped FILE_OFFER or
11154:   // FILE_DONE event). Picks the right source: receiver → daemon's
11155:   // /api/files; sender → cached File object. Picks the right
11156:   // viewer: image → lightbox; everything else → new tab.
11157:   function openMessageFile(msg) {
11158:     const name = msg.name || "file";
11159:     const size = msg.size || 0;
11160:     const isImage = isImageName(name);
11161:     let url = null;
11162:     let downloadName = name;
11163:     if (msg.dir === "in") {
11164:       const fname = (msg.path || name || "").toString().split(/[\\\/]/).pop();
11165:       if (!fname) {
11166:         toast("Couldn't find the file on disk.", "info", 4000);
11167:         return;
11168:       }
11169:       url = `/api/files/${encodeURIComponent(fname)}`;
11170:       downloadName = fname;
11171:     } else if (msg.dir === "out") {
11172:       url = objectUrlForOutboundFile(name, size);
11173:       if (!url) {
11174:         toast(
11175:           "The original file isn't kept in the browser after a tab refresh. "
11176:           + "Drag and drop it again to re-share.",
11177:           "info", 6000,
11178:         );
11179:         return;
11180:       }
11181:     }
11182:     if (!url) return;
11183:     if (isImage) {
11184:       // v0.21.x: prefer gallery mode so ← / → swipe through every
11185:       // image in this conversation. Falls back to single-image when
11186:       // we can't compute the gallery (e.g. orphan bubble).
11187:       const gal = _buildLightboxGalleryForCurrent(msg);
11188:       if (gal) {
11189:         openLightbox({ gallery: gal.gallery, index: gal.index });
11190:       } else {
11191:         openLightbox({ url, name, sizeBytes: size, downloadName });
11192:       }
11193:     } else {
11194:       window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
11195:     }
11196:   }
11197: 
11198:   // Long message bodies clutter the chat the way a pasted log or
11199:   // wall-of-text does in Claude. Collapse anything past the
11200:   // thresholds below into a preview with a Show more / Show less
11201:   // toggle so the bubble stays a glance-able height by default.
11202:   // The text is fully rendered (and selectable) in both states —
11203:   // collapsed just hides the overflow under a CSS mask. Per-message
11204:   // ephemeral state; nothing persisted.
11205:   const COLLAPSE_CHARS = 600;
11206:   const COLLAPSE_LINES = 8;
11207:   function appendCollapsibleText(parent, body) {
11208:     const text = body || "";
11209:     const lines = text.split("\n").length;
11210:     const long = text.length > COLLAPSE_CHARS || lines > COLLAPSE_LINES;
11211:     if (!long) {
11212:       parent.appendChild(renderInlineText(text));
11213:       return;
11214:     }
11215:     const wrap = document.createElement("div");
11216:     wrap.className = "msg-body collapsible collapsed";
11217:     wrap.appendChild(renderInlineText(text));
11218:     parent.appendChild(wrap);
11219:     const toggle = document.createElement("button");
11220:     toggle.type = "button";
11221:     toggle.className = "body-toggle";
11222:     toggle.textContent = "Show more";
11223:     toggle.title = `Message is ${text.length.toLocaleString()} characters`;
11224:     toggle.onclick = (ev) => {
11225:       ev.stopPropagation();
11226:       if (wrap.classList.contains("collapsed")) {
11227:         wrap.classList.remove("collapsed");
11228:         toggle.textContent = "Show less";
11229:       } else {
11230:         wrap.classList.add("collapsed");
11231:         toggle.textContent = "Show more";
11232:       }
11233:     };
11234:     parent.appendChild(toggle);
11235:   }
11236:   function renderInlineNonCode(text, frag) {
11237:     const parts = text.split(/`([^`\n]+)`/g);
11238:     for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
11239:       if (i % 2 === 1) {
11240:         const c = document.createElement("code");
11241:         c.textContent = parts[i];
11242:         frag.appendChild(c);
11243:       } else {
11244:         renderInlineMarks(parts[i], frag);
11245:       }
11246:     }
11247:   }
11248:   function renderInlineMarks(text, frag) {
11249:     // Collect non-overlapping ranges for url / bold / italic.
11250:     const URL_RE  = /\bhttps?:\/\/[^\s<>"']+|\bwww\.[^\s<>"']+/gi;
11251:     const BOLD_RE = /\*\*([^*\n]+)\*\*/g;
11252:     const ITAL_RE = /(?:^|[\s(\[{])_([^_\n]+)_(?=$|[\s).,!?:;\]}])/g;
11253:     const ranges = [];
11254:     let m;
11255:     while ((m = URL_RE.exec(text))  !== null) ranges.push({s: m.index, e: m.index + m[0].length, t: "url",  raw: m[0]});
11256:     while ((m = BOLD_RE.exec(text)) !== null) ranges.push({s: m.index, e: m.index + m[0].length, t: "bold", raw: m[1]});
11257:     while ((m = ITAL_RE.exec(text)) !== null) {
11258:       // Italic match includes a leading whitespace/open-bracket; offset start.
11259:       const lead = m[0].length - (m[1].length + 2);
11260:       ranges.push({s: m.index + lead, e: m.index + m[0].length, t: "ital", raw: m[1]});
11261:     }
11262:     ranges.sort((a, b) => a.s - b.s);
11263:     const kept = [];
11264:     let cursor = 0;
11265:     for (const r of ranges) {
11266:       if (r.s < cursor) continue;
11267:       kept.push(r);
11268:       cursor = r.e;
11269:     }
11270:     let pos = 0;
11271:     for (const r of kept) {
11272:       if (r.s > pos) frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.slice(pos, r.s)));
11273:       if (r.t === "url") {
11274:         const a = document.createElement("a");
11275:         const href = r.raw.startsWith("www.") ? "https://" + r.raw : r.raw;
11276:         a.href = href;
11277:         a.textContent = r.raw;
11278:         a.target = "_blank";
11279:         a.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
11280:         frag.appendChild(a);
11281:       } else if (r.t === "bold") {
11282:         const b = document.createElement("strong");
11283:         b.textContent = r.raw;
11284:         frag.appendChild(b);
11285:       } else if (r.t === "ital") {
11286:         const i = document.createElement("em");
11287:         i.textContent = r.raw;
11288:         frag.appendChild(i);
11289:       }
11290:       pos = r.e;
11291:     }
11292:     if (pos < text.length) frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.slice(pos)));
11293:   }

11323:   // v0.9.0: minimal markdown renderer scoped to previews.
11324:   // Supports: ATX headings (# ##), paragraphs, fenced code blocks,
11325:   // blockquotes, ordered + unordered lists (single-level), horizontal
11326:   // rules. Inline syntax delegates to renderInlineNonCode (bold,
11327:   // italic, inline code, autolinks). Deliberately small + safe - no
11328:   // raw HTML escape hatch, so no XSS surface.
11329:   function renderMarkdownDoc(source) {
11330:     const root = el("div", "md-preview");
11331:     const lines = (source || "").split(/\r?\n/);
11332:     let i = 0;
11333:     const n = lines.length;
11334:     while (i < n) {
11335:       const ln = lines[i];
11336:       if (/^```/.test(ln.trimStart())) {
11337:         // Fenced code block
11338:         const lang = ln.trimStart().slice(3).trim();
11339:         const buf = [];
11340:         i += 1;
11341:         while (i < n && !/^```/.test(lines[i].trimStart())) {
11342:           buf.push(lines[i]);
11343:           i += 1;
11344:         }
11345:         const pre = document.createElement("pre");
11346:         const code = document.createElement("code");
11347:         if (lang) code.dataset.lang = lang;
11348:         code.textContent = buf.join("\n");
11349:         pre.appendChild(code);
11350:         root.appendChild(pre);
11351:         if (i < n) i += 1;  // skip closing fence
11352:         continue;
11353:       }
11354:       const headM = ln.match(/^(#{1,6})\s+(.*)$/);
11355:       if (headM) {
11356:         const lvl = headM[1].length;
11357:         const h = document.createElement("h" + lvl);
11358:         renderInlineNonCode(headM[2].trim(), h);
11359:         root.appendChild(h);
11360:         i += 1;
11361:         continue;
11362:       }
11363:       if (/^(-{3,}|\*{3,}|_{3,})\s*$/.test(ln)) {
11364:         root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
11365:         i += 1;
11366:         continue;
11367:       }
11368:       if (/^>\s?/.test(ln)) {
11369:         // Blockquote - collect contiguous > lines.
11370:         const buf = [];
11371:         while (i < n && /^>\s?/.test(lines[i])) {
11372:           buf.push(lines[i].replace(/^>\s?/, ""));
11373:           i += 1;
11374:         }
11375:         const bq = document.createElement("blockquote");
11376:         renderInlineNonCode(buf.join("\n"), bq);
11377:         root.appendChild(bq);
11378:         continue;
11379:       }
11380:       const ulM = ln.match(/^([-*+])\s+(.*)$/);
11381:       const olM = ln.match(/^(\d+)\.\s+(.*)$/);
11382:       if (ulM || olM) {
11383:         const ordered = !!olM;
11384:         const list = document.createElement(ordered ? "ol" : "ul");
11385:         while (i < n) {
11386:           const L = lines[i];
11387:           const m = ordered ? L.match(/^(\d+)\.\s+(.*)$/) : L.match(/^([-*+])\s+(.*)$/);
11388:           if (!m) break;
11389:           const li = document.createElement("li");
11390:           renderInlineNonCode(m[2], li);
11391:           list.appendChild(li);
11392:           i += 1;
11393:         }
11394:         root.appendChild(list);
11395:         continue;
11396:       }
11397:       if (ln.trim() === "") { i += 1; continue; }
11398:       // Paragraph - collect lines until blank or block boundary.
11399:       const buf = [ln];
11400:       i += 1;
11401:       while (i < n) {
11402:         const L = lines[i];
11403:         if (L.trim() === "") break;
11404:         if (/^(#{1,6}\s|>\s|```|[-*+]\s|\d+\.\s|(-{3,}|\*{3,}|_{3,})\s*$)/.test(L.trimStart())) break;
11405:         buf.push(L);
11406:         i += 1;
11407:       }
11408:       const p = document.createElement("p");
11409:       renderInlineNonCode(buf.join(" "), p);
11410:       root.appendChild(p);
11411:     }
11412:     return root;
11413:   }

11482:   // Look up the transfer record matching a FILE_OFFER message.
11483:   // FILE_OFFER carries `blob` (hex); transfer carries `blob_hash`.
11484:   // Direction must match too (out vs in are distinct ledger rows).
11485:   function transferForMessage(msg) {
11486:     const blob = (msg.blob || "").toLowerCase();
11487:     if (!blob) return null;
11488:     for (const t of state.transfersById.values()) {
11489:       if (t.direction === msg.dir && (t.blob_hash || "").toLowerCase() === blob) {
11490:         return t;
11491:       }
11492:     }
11493:     return null;
11494:   }

11496:   function statusLabel(t, fallback) {
11497:     if (!t) return fallback;
11498:     if (t.display_state) return t.display_state;
11499:     const meta = t.metadata || {};
11500:     if (meta.doctor?.label) return meta.doctor.label;
11501:     const stateName = meta.delivery_state || "";
11502:     if (t.status === "queued")   return stateName === "resuming" ? "Resuming" : "Waiting for device";
11503:     if (t.status === "offered")  return "Sending…";
11504:     if (t.status === "active")   return `Sending… ${Math.round(t.progress_pct || 0)}%`;
11505:     if (t.status === "complete") return t.direction === "in" ? "Received" : "Done";
11506:     if (t.status === "paused")   return stateName === "resuming" ? "Resuming" : "Waiting for device";
11507:     if (t.status === "failed")   return meta.transient ? "Waiting for device" : "Needs attention";
11508:     return t.status || fallback;
11509:   }

11511:   // v0.8.8: per-transfer EWMA rate tracker. Each `transfer` WS event
11512:   // is a snapshot - by diffing progress_bytes across events we get
11513:   // bytes/sec without any extra wire data. EWMA (alpha=0.4) smooths
11514:   // out the chunk-by-chunk burstiness without going stale on slow
11515:   // links. Reset on terminal status so the next transfer for the
11516:   // same id (e.g. retry after pause) starts clean.
11517:   const _RATE_ALPHA = 0.4;
11518:   function updateTransferRate(t) {
11519:     if (!t || !t.id) return;
11520:     const terminal = t.status === "complete" || t.status === "failed";
11521:     if (terminal) {
11522:       state.transferRates.delete(t.id);
11523:       return;
11524:     }
11525:     if (t.status !== "active" && t.status !== "offered") {
11526:       // queued / paused - keep last bps but stamp timestamp so a
11527:       // resume's first delta is reasonable.
11528:       const cur = state.transferRates.get(t.id) || {};
11529:       cur.lastBytes = t.progress_bytes || 0;
11530:       cur.lastTs = Date.now();
11531:       state.transferRates.set(t.id, cur);
11532:       return;
11533:     }
11534:     const now = Date.now();
11535:     const prev = state.transferRates.get(t.id);
11536:     if (!prev) {
11537:       state.transferRates.set(t.id, {
11538:         lastBytes: t.progress_bytes || 0,
11539:         lastTs: now,
11540:         bps: 0,
11541:       });
11542:       return;
11543:     }
11544:     const dt = (now - prev.lastTs) / 1000;
11545:     if (dt < 0.1) return;  // ignore <100ms gaps - too noisy.
11546:     const db = (t.progress_bytes || 0) - prev.lastBytes;
11547:     if (db < 0) {
11548:       // progress went backwards (resume / retry) - restart.
11549:       state.transferRates.set(t.id, {
11550:         lastBytes: t.progress_bytes || 0,
11551:         lastTs: now,
11552:         bps: 0,
11553:       });
11554:       return;
11555:     }
11556:     const inst = db / dt;
11557:     const ewma = (1 - _RATE_ALPHA) * (prev.bps || 0) + _RATE_ALPHA * inst;
11558:     state.transferRates.set(t.id, {
11559:       lastBytes: t.progress_bytes || 0,
11560:       lastTs: now,
11561:       bps: ewma,
11562:     });
11563:   }
11564:   function rateForTransfer(t) {
11565:     if (!t) return 0;
11566:     const r = state.transferRates.get(t.id);
11567:     if (!r) return 0;
11568:     // Decay if no event for >3s - peer probably stalled. Avoids
11569:     // showing a stale "14 MB/s" forever on a frozen transfer.
11570:     const age = (Date.now() - (r.lastTs || 0)) / 1000;
11571:     if (age > 3) return 0;
11572:     return r.bps || 0;
11573:   }
11574:   function transferRouteLabel(route) {
11575:     const r = String(route || "").toLowerCase();
11576:     if (r === "lan" || r === "wifi" || r === "wifi_direct") return "Wi-Fi direct";
11577:     if (r === "ethernet") return "Ethernet direct";
11578:     if (r === "relay" || r === "rendezvous") return "Relay";
11579:     if (r === "local_cache" || r === "known") return "Known chunks";
11580:     if (r) return r.replace(/_/g, " ");
11581:     return "Best available";
11582:   }
11583:   function transferAutopilotFacts(t, kind) {
11584:     if (!t) return [];
11585:     const truth = t.autopilot_truth || {};
11586:     if (Array.isArray(truth.facts) && truth.facts.length) {
11587:       return [...new Set(truth.facts.filter(Boolean))].slice(0, 7);
11588:     }
11589:     const meta = t.metadata || {};
11590:     const plan = meta.autopilot_plan || {};
11591:     const fabricTruth = meta.fabric_plan?.route_truth || {};
11592:     const perf = meta.performance_summary || {};
11593:     const assist = meta.swarm_assist || {};
11594:     const facts = [];
11595:     const liveBps = rateForTransfer(t);
11596:     const doneBps = Number(perf.effective_mbps || 0) > 0
11597:       ? (Number(perf.effective_mbps) * 1_000_000) / 8
11598:       : 0;
11599:     const displayBps = liveBps > 0 ? liveBps : doneBps;
11600:     if (displayBps > 0) {
11601:       facts.push(`${kind === "sent" ? "Finished at" : "Sending at"} ${fmtMbps(displayBps)}`);
11602:     }
11603: 
11604:     const progressBytes = Number(t.progress_bytes || 0);
11605:     const totalBytes = Number(t.total_bytes || 0);
11606:     const skippedBytes = Number(perf.skipped_bytes || meta.skipped_bytes || 0);
11607:     const savedBytes = Number(perf.saved_bytes || meta.saved_bytes || assist.assisted_bytes || 0);
11608:     let savings = Number(perf.bandwidth_savings_ratio || plan.estimated_savings_ratio || meta.bandwidth_savings_ratio || 0);
11609:     if (!savings && totalBytes > 0 && (skippedBytes > 0 || savedBytes > 0)) {
11610:       savings = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (skippedBytes + savedBytes) / totalBytes));
11611:     }
11612:     if (savings > 0.01) {
11613:       facts.push(`${Math.round(savings * 100)}% already known`);
11614:       facts.push("Only sent missing pieces");
11615:     }
11616: 
11617:     const frame = String(perf.frame_kind || plan.frame_kind || meta.frame_kind || "").toLowerCase();
11618:     if (frame.includes("binary") || meta.binary_frame === true) {
11619:       facts.push("Using fast binary path");
11620:     }
11621:     if (kind === "paused" || t.status === "queued" || meta.delivery_state === "resuming" || meta.transient) {
11622:       facts.push("Resuming automatically");
11623:     }
11624:     if (assist && Number(assist.pulled || 0) > 0) {
11625:       const pulled = Number(assist.pulled || 0);
11626:       const sourceCount = Number(assist.source_count || Object.keys(assist.sources || {}).length || 1);
11627:       facts.push(`Pulled ${pulled} chunk${pulled === 1 ? "" : "s"} from ${sourceCount} trusted device${sourceCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}`);
11628:     }
11629:     const route = fabricTruth.kind || perf.route || plan.route || meta.route || (assist.strategy === "multi_source_chunk_pull" ? "local_cache" : "");
11630:     if (route) {
11631:       const renderedRoute = fabricTruth.kind ? route : transferRouteLabel(route);
11632:       facts.push(`Route: ${renderedRoute}`);
11633:     }
11634:     if (progressBytes > 0 && totalBytes > 0 && progressBytes < totalBytes && kind !== "sent") {
11635:       facts.push("Resuming automatically");
11636:     }
11637:     return [...new Set(facts)].slice(0, 6);
11638:   }
11639:   function renderTransferFacts(t, kind) {

11641:     if (!facts.length) return null;
11642:     const wrap = el("div", "transfer-facts");
11643:     for (const fact of facts) {
11644:       wrap.appendChild(el("span", "transfer-fact", fact));
11645:     }
11646:     return wrap;

11648:   function transferCommandMetrics(t) {
11649:     if (!t) return [];
11650:     const truth = t.autopilot_truth || {};
11651:     const meta = t.metadata || {};

11653:     const report = meta.transfer_report || {};
11654:     const fabricTruth = meta.fabric_plan?.route_truth || {};
11655:     const liveBps = rateForTransfer(t);
11656:     const speedMbps = liveBps > 0
11657:       ? (liveBps * 8) / 1_000_000
11658:       : Number(truth.speed_mbps || perf.effective_mbps || 0);
11659:     const wireMbps = Number(truth.wire_mbps || perf.wire_mbps || 0);
11660:     const knownPct = Number(truth.known_pct || 0);
11661:     const savedBytes = Number(
11662:       truth.saved_bytes || perf.saved_bytes || report.saved_bytes ||
11663:       meta.saved_bytes || meta.swarm_assist?.assisted_bytes || 0
11664:     );
11665:     const assist = meta.swarm_assist || {};
11666:     const swarmSources = Number(assist.source_count || Object.keys(assist.sources || {}).length || 0);
11667:     const swarmHealed = Number(assist.healed || 0);
11668:     const wireBytes = Number(
11669:       truth.wire_bytes || report.wire_bytes_sent || t.wire_bytes || 0
11670:     );
11671:     const route = truth.route_label || fabricTruth.kind || transferRouteLabel(
11672:       truth.route || perf.route || meta.autopilot_plan?.route || meta.route

11674:     const rows = [];
11675:     if (speedMbps > 0) rows.push({ label: "effective", value: `${speedMbps >= 100 ? speedMbps.toFixed(0) : speedMbps.toFixed(1)} Mbps` });
11676:     if (wireMbps > 0) rows.push({ label: "wire", value: `${wireMbps >= 100 ? wireMbps.toFixed(0) : wireMbps.toFixed(1)} Mbps` });
11677:     if (knownPct > 0) rows.push({ label: "already known", value: `${knownPct >= 10 ? knownPct.toFixed(0) : knownPct.toFixed(1)}%` });
11678:     if (savedBytes > 0) rows.push({ label: "avoided", value: fmtBytes(savedBytes) });
11679:     if (swarmSources > 0) rows.push({ label: "sources", value: String(swarmSources) });
11680:     if (swarmHealed > 0) rows.push({ label: "healed", value: String(swarmHealed) });
11681:     if (wireBytes > 0) rows.push({ label: "sent over wire", value: fmtBytes(wireBytes) });
11682:     if (route && route !== "Best available") rows.push({ label: "route", value: route });
11683:     if (truth.fast_path_label) rows.push({ label: "path", value: truth.fast_path_label });
11684:     if (truth.automatic && truth.self_healing_action && !["none", "continue", "observe"].includes(truth.self_healing_action)) {
11685:       rows.push({ label: "self-healing", value: truth.self_healing_action.replace(/_/g, " ") });
11686:     }
11687:     return rows.slice(0, 8);
11688:   }

11702:   function renderPrimaryTransferSummary(t) {
11703:     const metrics = transferCommandMetrics(t);
11704:     const facts = transferAutopilotFacts(t, statusKind(t));
11705:     const speed = metrics.find(m => m.label === "effective")?.value || "";
11706:     const known = metrics.find(m => m.label === "already known")?.value || "";

12331:   function chooseBestSelfMeshDevice() {
12332:     const mesh = state.selfMesh || {};
12333:     const select = $("#self-mesh-device-select");
12334:     const devices = Array.isArray(mesh.devices) ? mesh.devices : [];
12335:     if (!select || devices.length === 0) return toast("No trusted device yet.", "info");
12336:     const scored = devices
12337:       .filter(d => d.device_pub_b64 && !d.revoked)
12338:       .map(d => {
12339:         const p = _selfMeshPresenceFor(d);
12340:         const latency = Number(p?.latency_ms ?? 999999);
12341:         const awake = p?.state === "awake" ? 1000 : 0;
12342:         const local = d.local ? 100 : 0;
12343:         const trusted = d.trusted ? 50 : 0;
12344:         const recent = Number(p?.updated_ms || d.updated_ms || 0) / 100000000000;
12345:         return { d, score: awake + local + trusted + recent - Math.min(latency, 999999) / 1000 };
12346:       })
12347:       .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
12348:     const best = scored[0]?.d || null;
12349:     if (!best) return toast("No usable device to choose yet.", "info");
12350:     select.value = best.device_pub_b64;
12351:     toast(`Using ${best.label || best.device_kind || "best device"}`, "good", 2500);
12352:     renderSelfMesh();
12353:   }

12703:   function _downloadCourierBundle(bundleB64, manifest) {
12704:     const body = JSON.stringify({
12705:       type: "one-link-courier-bundle",
12706:       version: 1,
12707:       bundle_b64: bundleB64,
12708:       manifest,
12709:     }, null, 2);

12711:     const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
12712:     const a = document.createElement("a");
12713:     const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
12714:     a.href = url;
12715:     a.download = `one-link-courier-${stamp}.olcb.json`;
12716:     document.body.appendChild(a);
12717:     a.click();
12718:     a.remove();

12720:   }

12816:   async function importCourierBundleFile(file) {
12817:     if (!file) return;
12818:     const keyToken = ($("#courier-key-token")?.value || "").trim();
12819:     if (!keyToken) {
12820:       toast("Paste the unlock code first.", "info", 3500);

12823:     }

12828:         const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
12829:         bundleB64 = parsed.bundle_b64 || parsed.bundle || "";
12830:       } catch {
12831:         bundleB64 = text.trim();
12832:       }
12833:       if (!bundleB64) throw new Error("Offline bundle file did not contain bundle data");
12834:       const r = await api.courierImport({ bundle_b64: bundleB64, key_token: keyToken });
12835:       if (r.manifest?.blob_hash) {

12838:           name: r.manifest.name || "offline-file.bin",
12839:         });
12840:         toast(`Offline file ready: ${assembled.name || "ready"}`, "good", 6000);
12841:       } else {
12842:         toast(`Imported ${r.stored_chunks || 0} file chunk${r.stored_chunks === 1 ? "" : "s"}`, "good", 4500);
12843:       }
12844:       await refreshCourierStatus();
12845:       await refreshStatus();
12846:       await refreshTransfers();
12847:       renderCourierKit();
12848:     } catch (e) {
12849:       toast(`Import failed: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad", 8000);
12850:     }
12851:   }

12905:   function aggregateActiveTransferStats() {
12906:     let count = 0, bps = 0, sent = 0, total = 0;
12907:     for (const t of state.transfers) {
12908:       if (t.status === "active" || t.status === "offered") {
12909:         count += 1;
12910:         bps += rateForTransfer(t);
12911:         sent += t.progress_bytes || 0;
12912:         total += t.total_bytes || 0;
12913:       }
12914:     }
12915:     return { count, bps, sent, total };
12916:   }

12938:     pill.appendChild(document.createTextNode(label + rate + pct));
12939:     pill.title = `${fmtBytes(sent)} of ${fmtBytes(total)} sent${bps > 0 ? ` at ${fmtMbps(bps)}` : ""}. Click to open Files.`;

12968:   function statusKind(t) {
12969:     if (!t) return "queued";
12970:     if (t.status === "complete") return "sent";
12971:     if (t.status === "failed")   return (t.metadata || {}).transient ? "paused" : "failed";
12972:     if (t.status === "paused")   return "paused";
12973:     if (t.status === "active" || t.status === "offered") return "sending";
12974:     return "queued";
12975:   }
12976:   function statusGlyph(kind) {
12977:     if (kind === "sent") return "✓";
12978:     if (kind === "failed") return "✗";
12979:     if (kind === "paused") return "⏸";
12980:     if (kind === "sending") return "⏳";
12981:     return "•";
12982:   }
