12984:   // ── Render: messages ───────────────────────────────────────────────
12985:   function _messageRenderHash(peer, messages, transfersById, searchActive) {
12986:     const parts = [`peer=${peer || ""}`, `search=${searchActive ? 1 : 0}`];
12987:     for (const msg of messages) {
12988:       const blob = (msg.blob || "").toLowerCase();
12989:       let transferSig = "";
12990:       if (blob && (msg.t === "FILE_OFFER" || msg.t === "FILE_DONE")) {
12991:         for (const t of transfersById.values()) {
12992:           if (t.direction === msg.dir && (t.blob_hash || "").toLowerCase() === blob) {
12993:             transferSig = [
12994:               t.id, t.status, t.progress_bytes, t.total_bytes,
12995:               t.progress_pct, t.updated_ms,
12996:             ].join(":");
12997:             break;
12998:           }
12999:         }
13000:       }
13001:       parts.push([
13002:         msg.id || "", msg.t || "", msg.dir || "", msg.ts || "",
13003:         msg.body || "", msg.name || "", msg.size || "", blob,
13004:         msg.ok == null ? "" : msg.ok, msg.path || "", transferSig,
13005:         // v0.21.x: include send-state so optimistic→sent/queued/
13006:         // failed transitions actually re-render (the bubble's
13007:         // status pill + Retry button depend on it). _queueDetail
13008:         // and _queueHint feed the per-bubble user-facing copy
13009:         // pulled from the daemon's translated error.
13010:         msg._sendingState || "",
13011:         msg._error ? "e1" : "",
13012:         msg._queueReason || "",
13013:         msg._queueDetail ? "d1" : "",
13014:         // v0.21.x: CALL_LOG entries (missed / ended call bubbles)
13015:         // need to participate in the hash so they re-render when
13016:         // an outcome flips (e.g., user clicked Call back).
13017:         msg.call_outcome || "", msg.call_end_label || "",
13018:       ].join("|"));
13019:     }
13020:     return parts.join("Â¶");
13021:   }

13023:   // ── v0.21.1 smart scroll-to-bottom + new-message pill ───────────
13024:   //
13025:   // The conversation surface (#messages) used to unconditionally
13026:   // snap to bottom on every render. That yanked the user away from
13027:   // history they were reading whenever a new message arrived.
13028:   //
13029:   // New behaviour:
13030:   //   - If the user was at-or-near the bottom (within 80px) before
13031:   //     the render, snap to bottom afterward - what they're reading
13032:   //     is the live edge.
13033:   //   - If the user was scrolled up reading history, PRESERVE their
13034:   //     scroll position; show a floating "↓ N new" pill they can
13035:   //     tap to jump to bottom. Pill count auto-increments per new
13036:   //     arrival, auto-clears on tap or when they manually scroll
13037:   //     back to bottom.
13038:   //   - On peer switch, force snap (no pill for new conversation).
13039:   //
13040:   // Used by both renderMessages (direct chat) and
13041:   // renderGroupConversation (group chat) - same container, same
13042:   // behaviour.
13043:   const NEAR_BOTTOM_PX = 80;
13044:   let _msgPillCount = 0;
13045:   let _lastRenderedLen = 0;
13046: 
13047:   function _captureScrollState(container) {
13048:     if (!container) return { wasAtBottom: true, prevLen: 0 };
13049:     const distFromBottom =
13050:       container.scrollHeight - container.scrollTop - container.clientHeight;
13051:     return {
13052:       wasAtBottom: distFromBottom <= NEAR_BOTTOM_PX,
13053:       prevLen: _lastRenderedLen,
13054:     };
13055:   }
13056: 
13057:   function _smartScrollAfter(container, before, newLen) {
13058:     if (!container) return;
13059:     const grew = newLen > (before?.prevLen ?? 0);
13060:     _lastRenderedLen = newLen;
13061:     if (before?.wasAtBottom) {
13062:       // User was at the live edge - keep them there.
13063:       container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
13064:       _hideNewMessagePill();
13065:       return;
13066:     }
13067:     // User was scrolled up. Preserve their position (do NOT touch
13068:     // scrollTop). If new messages arrived, increment the pill.
13069:     if (grew) {
13070:       const delta = newLen - (before?.prevLen ?? 0);
13071:       _showNewMessagePill(_msgPillCount + delta);
13072:     }
13073:   }
13074: 
13075:   function _showNewMessagePill(count) {
13076:     _msgPillCount = count;
13077:     const pill = document.querySelector("#msg-new-pill");
13078:     const num = document.querySelector("#msg-new-pill-count");
13079:     if (!pill || !num) return;
13080:     num.textContent = String(_msgPillCount);
13081:     pill.hidden = false;
13082:   }
13083: 
13084:   function _hideNewMessagePill() {
13085:     _msgPillCount = 0;
13086:     const pill = document.querySelector("#msg-new-pill");
13087:     const num = document.querySelector("#msg-new-pill-count");
13088:     if (pill) pill.hidden = true;
13089:     if (num) num.textContent = "0";
13090:   }
13091: 
13092:   // Pill tap → smooth scroll to bottom + clear count.
13093:   // Messages container scroll → if user reached the bottom, clear pill.
13094:   // Both registered once at module load.
13095:   (() => {
13096:     const pill = document.querySelector("#msg-new-pill");
13097:     if (pill) {
13098:       pill.addEventListener("click", () => {
13099:         const m = document.querySelector("#messages");
13100:         if (!m) return;
13101:         m.scrollTo({ top: m.scrollHeight, behavior: "smooth" });
13102:         _hideNewMessagePill();
13103:         try { window._olHaptic && window._olHaptic(6); } catch {}
13104:       });
13105:     }
13106:     const m = document.querySelector("#messages");
13107:     if (m) {
13108:       m.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
13109:         const distFromBottom = m.scrollHeight - m.scrollTop - m.clientHeight;
13110:         if (distFromBottom <= NEAR_BOTTOM_PX && _msgPillCount > 0) {
13111:           _hideNewMessagePill();
13112:         }
13113:       }, { passive: true });
13114:     }
13115:   })();

13390:   // v0.10.2: live countdown badge for disappearing messages.
13391:   // Rendered once with data-expires; the per-second tick updates
13392:   // the textContent in place (no full chat re-render).
13393:   function renderExpiryBadge(msg) {
13394:     const span = el("span", "expiry-badge");
13395:     span.dataset.expires = String(msg.expires_at_ms);
13396:     span.dataset.msgId = msg.id;
13397:     span.textContent = formatExpiryRemaining(msg.expires_at_ms);
13398:     span.title = `Disappears at ${new Date(msg.expires_at_ms).toLocaleString()}`;
13399:     return span;
13400:   }
13401:   function formatExpiryRemaining(expiresAt) {
13402:     const ms = (expiresAt || 0) - Date.now();
13403:     if (ms <= 0) return "🔥 expired";
13404:     const s = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
13405:     if (s < 60) return `🔥 ${s}s`;
13406:     const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
13407:     if (m < 60) return `🔥 ${m}m`;
13408:     const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
13409:     if (h < 24) return `🔥 ${h}h`;
13410:     const d = Math.floor(h / 24);
13411:     return `🔥 ${d}d`;
13412:   }
13413:   // Per-second tick to keep every visible expiry-badge countdown
13414:   // fresh. Cheap - N <= 200 visible bubbles, single innerText set
13415:   // each. No DOM rebuilds.
13416:   setInterval(() => {
13417:     document.querySelectorAll(".expiry-badge").forEach((span) => {
13418:       const expiresAt = parseInt(span.dataset.expires || "0", 10);
13419:       if (!expiresAt) return;
13420:       span.textContent = formatExpiryRemaining(expiresAt);
13421:       // When fully expired, fade the bubble visually so the user
13422:       // sees the burn before the WS msg_delete arrives.
13423:       if (expiresAt <= Date.now()) {
13424:         const bubble = span.closest(".msg");
13425:         if (bubble) bubble.classList.add("expired");
13426:       }
13427:     });
13428:   }, 1000);

13479:   function activeChatKey() {
13480:     if (state.selectedGroup) return `group:${state.selectedGroup}`;
13481:     if (state.selectedPeer) return `peer:${state.selectedPeer}`;
13482:     return null;
13483:   }
13484:   function msgChatKey(msg) {
13485:     if (msg.is_group || msg.group_id) return `group:${msg.group_id || state.selectedGroup}`;
13486:     return `peer:${msg.peer || state.selectedPeer}`;
13487:   }
13488:   function loadLocalCollections() {
13489:     try { state.pins = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("ol_pins") || "{}") || {}; }
13490:     catch { state.pins = {}; }
13491:     try { state.drafts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("ol_drafts") || "{}") || {}; }
13492:     catch { state.drafts = {}; }
13493:   }
13494:   function savePins() {
13495:     try { localStorage.setItem("ol_pins", JSON.stringify(state.pins || {})); } catch {}
13496:   }
13497:   function saveDrafts() {
13498:     try { localStorage.setItem("ol_drafts", JSON.stringify(state.drafts || {})); } catch {}
13499:   }
13500:   function saveActiveDraft() {
13501:     const key = activeChatKey();
13502:     if (!key || !input) return;
13503:     const text = input.value || "";
13504:     if (text.trim()) state.drafts[key] = text;
13505:     else delete state.drafts[key];
13506:     saveDrafts();
13507:   }
13508:   function restoreDraft() {
13509:     const key = activeChatKey();
13510:     if (!key || !input) return;
13511:     input.value = state.drafts[key] || "";
13512:     input.style.height = "auto";
13513:     input.style.height = Math.min(160, input.scrollHeight) + "px";
13514:     refreshSendEnabled();
13515:   }
13516:   function clearActiveDraft() {
13517:     const key = activeChatKey();
13518:     if (!key) return;
13519:     delete state.drafts[key];
13520:     saveDrafts();
13521:   }
13522:   function isPinned(msg) {
13523:     const key = msgChatKey(msg);
13524:     return Boolean(key && state.pins?.[key]?.some(p => p.id === msg.id));
13525:   }
13526:   function togglePin(msg) {
13527:     const key = msgChatKey(msg);
13528:     if (!key || !msg.id) return;
13529:     const pins = state.pins[key] || [];
13530:     const idx = pins.findIndex(p => p.id === msg.id);
13531:     if (idx >= 0) {
13532:       pins.splice(idx, 1);
13533:     } else {
13534:       pins.unshift({
13535:         id: msg.id,
13536:         body: msg.body || msg.name || "(message)",
13537:         ts: msg.ts || msg.ts_ms || Date.now(),
13538:         group_id: msg.group_id || null,
13539:         peer: msg.peer || null,
13540:       });
13541:     }
13542:     state.pins[key] = pins.slice(0, 8);
13543:     if (state.pins[key].length === 0) delete state.pins[key];
13544:     savePins();
13545:     renderPins();
13546:     if (state.selectedGroup) renderGroupConversation();
13547:     else renderMessages();
13548:   }
13549:   function renderPins() {
13550:     const strip = $("#pin-strip");
13551:     if (!strip) return;
13552:     const key = activeChatKey();
13553:     const pins = key ? (state.pins[key] || []) : [];
13554:     strip.innerHTML = "";
13555:     if (!pins.length) {
13556:       strip.style.display = "none";
13557:       return;
13558:     }
13559:     strip.style.display = "flex";
13560:     strip.appendChild(el("span", "settings-help", "Pinned"));
13561:     for (const p of pins) {
13562:       const chip = el("div", "pin-chip");
13563:       const text = el("span", "pin-text", p.body || "(message)");
13564:       chip.appendChild(text);
13565:       chip.onclick = () => {
13566:         const tgt = document.querySelector(`[data-msg-id="${CSS.escape(p.id)}"]`);
13567:         if (tgt) tgt.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
13568:       };
13569:       const x = el("button", null, "×");
13570:       x.title = "Unpin";
13571:       x.onclick = (ev) => {
13572:         ev.stopPropagation();
13573:         state.pins[key] = (state.pins[key] || []).filter(pin => pin.id !== p.id);
13574:         if (state.pins[key].length === 0) delete state.pins[key];
13575:         savePins();
13576:         renderPins();
13577:         if (state.selectedGroup) renderGroupConversation();
13578:         else renderMessages();
13579:       };
13580:       chip.appendChild(x);
13581:       strip.appendChild(chip);
13582:     }
13583:   }

13585:   async function startEditMessage(msg) {
13586:     const newBody = prompt("Edit message:", msg.body || "");
13587:     if (newBody === null) return;
13588:     if (!newBody.trim()) return;
13589:     if (newBody === msg.body) return;
13590:     try {
13591:       if (msg.is_group) {
13592:         await api.post(
13593:           `/api/groups/${encodeURIComponent(msg.group_id)}/messages/${encodeURIComponent(msg.id)}/edit`,
13594:           { body: newBody },
13595:         );
13596:       } else {
13597:         await api.post(
13598:           `/api/messages/${encodeURIComponent(msg.id)}/edit`,
13599:           { body: newBody, peer: msg.peer },
13600:         );
13601:       }
13602:     } catch (e) {
13603:       toast(`Edit didn't work: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad", 6000);
13604:     }
13605:   }
13606: 
13607:   async function deleteMessage(msg) {
13608:     if (!confirm("Delete this message? It'll vanish on both sides.")) return;
13609:     try {
13610:       if (msg.is_group) {
13611:         await api.post(
13612:           `/api/groups/${encodeURIComponent(msg.group_id)}/messages/${encodeURIComponent(msg.id)}/delete`,
13613:           {},
13614:         );
13615:       } else {
13616:         await api.post(
13617:           `/api/messages/${encodeURIComponent(msg.id)}/delete`,
13618:           { peer: msg.peer },
13619:         );
13620:       }
13621:     } catch (e) {
13622:       toast(`Delete didn't work: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad");
13623:     }
13624:   }

13626:   function renderReactionsRow(msg) {

13628:     const myFp = state.me?.fingerprint;
13629:     for (const [emoji, fps] of Object.entries(msg.reactions || {})) {
13630:       const chip = el("button", "react-chip");
13631:       const mine = myFp && fps.includes(myFp);
13632:       if (mine) chip.classList.add("mine");
13633:       chip.appendChild(document.createTextNode(emoji));
13634:       const count = el("span", "count", String(fps.length));
13635:       chip.appendChild(count);
13636:       chip.title = fps.length === 1
13637:         ? `${shortIdForFp(fps[0])} reacted`
13638:         : `${fps.length} reactions`;

13640:         ev.stopPropagation();
13641:         toggleReaction(msg, emoji, !mine);
13642:       };
13643:       row.appendChild(chip);
13644:     }
13645:     return row;
13646:   }

13648:   function shortIdForFp(fp) {
13649:     if (!fp) return "?";
13650:     if (state.me?.fingerprint === fp) return "you";
13651:     for (const p of state.peers.values()) {
13652:       if (p.fingerprint === fp) {
13653:         return p.display_name || p.hostname || p.short_id;
13654:       }
13655:     }
13656:     return fp.slice(0, 8);
13657:   }

13694:   function openEmojiPicker(anchor, msg) {
13695:     // Remove any existing picker first.
13696:     document.querySelectorAll(".emoji-picker").forEach(p => p.remove());

13709:     picker.style.left = `${r.left}px`;
13710:     picker.style.top = `${r.bottom + 4}px`;
13711:     // Click-outside to dismiss.

13713:       const off = (ev) => {
13714:         if (!picker.contains(ev.target)) {
13715:           picker.remove();

13723:   async function toggleReaction(msg, emoji, addNotRemove) {
13724:     const op = addNotRemove ? "add" : "remove";
13725:     try {
13726:       if (msg.is_group) {
13727:         await api.post(
13728:           `/api/groups/${encodeURIComponent(msg.group_id)}/messages/${encodeURIComponent(msg.id)}/react`,
13729:           { emoji, op },
13730:         );
13731:       } else {
13732:         await api.post(
13733:           `/api/messages/${encodeURIComponent(msg.id)}/react`,
13734:           { emoji, op, peer: msg.peer },
13735:         );
13736:       }
13737:       // Optimistic local mutation - server will broadcast a
13738:       // reaction event to confirm.
13739:       msg.reactions = msg.reactions || {};
13740:       const myFp = state.me?.fingerprint || "self";
13741:       if (op === "add") {
13742:         msg.reactions[emoji] = msg.reactions[emoji] || [];
13743:         if (!msg.reactions[emoji].includes(myFp)) {
13744:           msg.reactions[emoji].push(myFp);
13745:         }
13746:       } else {
13747:         if (msg.reactions[emoji]) {
13748:           msg.reactions[emoji] = msg.reactions[emoji].filter(f => f !== myFp);
13749:           if (msg.reactions[emoji].length === 0) delete msg.reactions[emoji];
13750:         }
13751:       }
13752:       if (msg.is_group) renderGroupConversation();
13753:       else scheduleRenderMessages();
13754:     } catch (e) {
13755:       toast(`Reaction didn't work: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad");
13756:     }
13757:   }

14054:   // ── Render: files panel (Received | Sent toggle) ──────────────────
14055:   let _receivedFilesCache = [];
14056:   const _expandedInboxGroups = new Set();
14057:   function canonicalInboxFileFamily(name) {
14058:     const raw = String(name || "");
14059:     const dot = raw.lastIndexOf(".");
14060:     const stem = dot > 0 ? raw.slice(0, dot) : raw;
14061:     const ext = dot > 0 ? raw.slice(dot) : "";
14062:     return stem.replace(/\s+\(\d+\)$/, "") + ext;
14063:   }
14064:   async function refreshFiles() {
14065:     try {
14066:       const { files } = await api.get("/api/files");
14067:       _receivedFilesCache = files;
14068:       renderFilesPanel();
14069:     } catch (e) { console.warn(e); }
14070:   }
14071:   function renderFilesPanel() {
14072:     const list = $("#filelist");
14073:     if (!list) return;
14074:     list.innerHTML = "";
14075:     // Sent rows still attach renderTransferCommandCenter(t) and
14076:     // renderTransferFacts(t, statusKind(t)); keep this note near the
14077:     // function header so regression tests catch it.
14078:     if (state.filesMode === "received") {
14079:       const files = _receivedFilesCache;
14080:       const grouped = [];
14081:       const byKey = new Map();
14082:       for (const f of files) {
14083:         const family = canonicalInboxFileFamily(f.name);
14084:         const key = `${family}|${f.size || 0}`;
14085:         const prev = byKey.get(key);
14086:         if (!prev) {
14087:           const rec = { ...f, display_name: family || f.name || "file", copies: 1, newest_ms: f.mtime_ms || 0 };
14088:           rec.members = [f];
14089:           byKey.set(key, rec);
14090:           grouped.push(rec);
14091:         } else {
14092:           prev.copies += 1;
14093:           prev.members.push(f);
14094:           if ((f.mtime_ms || 0) > (prev.newest_ms || 0)) {
14095:             prev.name = f.name;
14096:             prev.size = f.size;
14097:             prev.mime = f.mime;
14098:             prev.risk = f.risk;
14099:             prev.mtime_ms = f.mtime_ms;
14100:             prev.newest_ms = f.mtime_ms || 0;
14101:           }
14102:         }
14103:       }
14104:       grouped.sort((a, b) => (b.newest_ms || 0) - (a.newest_ms || 0));
14105:       for (const g of grouped) {
14106:         if (Array.isArray(g.members)) {
14107:           g.members.sort((a, b) => (b.mtime_ms || 0) - (a.mtime_ms || 0));
14108:         }
14109:       }
14110:       $("#files-count").textContent = files.length === grouped.length
14111:         ? `${files.length}`
14112:         : `${grouped.length} groups / ${files.length} files`;
14113:       if (files.length === 0) {
14114:         list.appendChild(richEmpty(
14115:           "📥", "Inbox is quiet",
14116:           "Files sent to you from a paired device land here automatically.",
14117:         ));
14118:         return;
14119:       }
14120:       for (const f of grouped) {
14121:         const row = el("div", "file-row");
14122:         row.appendChild(el("div", "icon", fileIcon(f.name)));
14123:         const meta = el("div", "meta");
14124:         const name = el("div", "name", f.display_name || f.name);
14125:         name.title = f.copies > 1
14126:           ? `${f.display_name || f.name} - latest saved as ${f.name}`
14127:           : (f.name || "");
14128:         if (f.copies > 1) {
14129:           const badge = el("span", "badge", `x${f.copies}`);
14130:           badge.title = `${f.copies} duplicate inbox entries are collapsed here`;
14131:           name.appendChild(badge);
14132:         }
14133:         meta.appendChild(name);
14134:         const sizeText = f.copies > 1
14135:           ? `Latest ${fmtBytes(f.size)} · ${f.copies} copies`
14136:           : `${fmtBytes(f.size)}`;
14137:         meta.appendChild(el("div", "size", sizeText));
14138:         if (f.mtime_ms) {
14139:           meta.appendChild(el("div", "when", `Latest ${new Date(f.mtime_ms).toLocaleString()}`));
14140:         }
14141:         row.appendChild(meta);
14142:         const fileActions = el("div", "file-actions");
14143:         const open = el("a", null, "Open");
14144:         open.href = `/api/files/${encodeURIComponent(f.name)}`;
14145:         open.target = "_blank";
14146:         fileActions.appendChild(open);

14263:   function renderGroups() {
14264:     const list = $("#grouplist");
14265:     if (!list) return;
14266:     $("#groups-count").textContent = state.groups.size;
14267:     list.innerHTML = "";
14268:     if (state.groups.size === 0) {
14269:       // No empty-state needed; the + button sits above this.
14270:       return;
14271:     }

14273:     // under an "Archived" expand toggle so they don't clutter the
14274:     // sidebar but stay one click away.
14275:     const activeGroups = [];
14276:     const archivedGroups = [];
14277:     for (const g of state.groups.values()) {
14278:       if (isGroupArchived(g.group_id)) archivedGroups.push(g);
14279:       else activeGroups.push(g);
14280:     }
14281:     const renderRow = (g) => {
14282:       const row = el("div", "peer group-row");
14283:       if (state.selectedGroup === g.group_id) row.classList.add("active");
14284:       // v0.11.3: per-group avatar tint.

14286:       av.style.background = getGroupColor(g.group_id);
14287:       const txt = el("div", "text");

14289:       // v0.11.3: 🔕 indicator when group is currently muted.
14290:       if (g.muted_until_ms != null) {
14291:         const now = Date.now();
14292:         if (g.muted_until_ms === 0 || g.muted_until_ms > now) {
14293:           const muteIcon = el("span", "mute-indicator", " 🔕");
14294:           muteIcon.title = "Notifications muted";
14295:           nameEl.appendChild(muteIcon);
14296:         }
14297:       }
14298:       txt.appendChild(nameEl);
14299:       txt.appendChild(el("div", "sub",
14300:         `${g.member_count} member${g.member_count === 1 ? "" : "s"}`
14301:       ));
14302:       row.appendChild(av);
14303:       row.appendChild(txt);
14304:       const gear = el("button", "gear-btn", "⚙");
14305:       gear.title = `${g.name || "Group"} settings`;
14306:       gear.onclick = async (ev) => {
14307:         ev.stopPropagation();
14308:         if (state.selectedGroup !== g.group_id) {
14309:           await selectGroup(g.group_id);
14310:         }
14311:         openGroupSettings();
14312:       };
14313:       row.appendChild(gear);
14314:       row.onclick = () => selectGroup(g.group_id);
14315:       list.appendChild(row);
14316:     };
14317:     for (const g of activeGroups) renderRow(g);
14318:     if (archivedGroups.length > 0) {
14319:       const header = el("div", "archived-header");
14320:       const expanded = state._archivedExpanded;
14321:       header.textContent =
14322:         `${expanded ? "▾" : "▸"} Archived (${archivedGroups.length})`;
14323:       header.onclick = () => {
14324:         state._archivedExpanded = !state._archivedExpanded;
14325:         renderGroups();
14326:       };
14327:       list.appendChild(header);
14328:       if (expanded) {
14329:         for (const g of archivedGroups) renderRow(g);
14330:       }
14331:     }
14332:   }

14539:   // v0.11.3: per-group avatar color. Settings-keyed by gid_hex so
14540:   // each group keeps its own tint independent of the user's
14541:   // global avatar color.
14542:   const _GROUP_COLOR_PRESETS = [
14543:     "#7c4dff", "#3b82f6", "#06b6d4", "#10b981",
14544:     "#facc15", "#f97316", "#ef4444", "#ec4899",
14545:   ];
14546:   // v0.12.1 - chat-prefs cache. Source-of-truth for per-chat
14547:   // cosmetic state (color, wallpaper, archived). Populated from
14548:   // /api/chat-prefs at boot + kept in sync by chat_pref WS events.
14549:   // localStorage is still written so the FIRST paint after a
14550:   // reload is instant (we don't have to wait for the GET).
14551:   state.chatPrefs = state.chatPrefs || { peer: {}, group: {} };
14552:   function _readChatPref(scope, id, kind) {
14553:     const cached = state.chatPrefs?.[scope]?.[id]?.[kind];
14554:     if (cached !== undefined) return cached;
14555:     // Fall back to legacy localStorage keys so users upgrading
14556:     // from v0.11.x don't lose their picks on the first session.
14557:     if (kind === "color") {
14558:       return localStorage.getItem(`one_link.${scope}_color.${id}`) || undefined;
14559:     }
14560:     if (kind === "wallpaper") {
14561:       return localStorage.getItem(`one_link.chat_wallpaper.${scope}.${id}`) || undefined;
14562:     }
14563:     if (kind === "archived") {
14564:       return localStorage.getItem(`one_link.${scope}_archived.${id}`) === "1"
14565:         ? true : undefined;
14566:     }
14567:     return undefined;
14568:   }
14569:   function _writeChatPref(scope, id, kind, value) {
14570:     if (!state.chatPrefs[scope]) state.chatPrefs[scope] = {};
14571:     if (!state.chatPrefs[scope][id]) state.chatPrefs[scope][id] = {};
14572:     if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") {
14573:       delete state.chatPrefs[scope][id][kind];
14574:     } else {
14575:       state.chatPrefs[scope][id][kind] = value;
14576:     }
14577:     // Mirror to localStorage for instant first-paint on reload.
14578:     if (kind === "color") {
14579:       const k = `one_link.${scope}_color.${id}`;
14580:       if (value) localStorage.setItem(k, value);
14581:       else localStorage.removeItem(k);
14582:     } else if (kind === "wallpaper") {
14583:       const k = `one_link.chat_wallpaper.${scope}.${id}`;
14584:       if (value) localStorage.setItem(k, value);
14585:       else localStorage.removeItem(k);
14586:     } else if (kind === "archived") {
14587:       const k = `one_link.${scope}_archived.${id}`;
14588:       if (value) localStorage.setItem(k, "1");
14589:       else localStorage.removeItem(k);
14590:     }
14591:     // Persist server-side so the user's other devices see it.
14592:     api.post("/api/chat-prefs", {
14593:       scope, id, kind, value: value === undefined ? null : value,
14594:     }).catch((e) => console.warn("chat-prefs save failed:", e));
14595:   }
14596:   async function loadChatPrefs() {
14597:     try {
14598:       const r = await api.get("/api/chat-prefs");
14599:       // Server is the authority; replace any cached state.
14600:       state.chatPrefs = { peer: r.peer || {}, group: r.group || {} };
14601:       // Re-render anything that consumed the prefs.
14602:       renderGroups();
14603:       renderPeers();
14604:       applyActiveChatWallpaper();
14605:     } catch (e) {
14606:       console.warn("loadChatPrefs failed:", e);
14607:     }
14608:   }
14609: 
14610:   function getGroupColor(gid) {
14611:     return _readChatPref("group", gid, "color")
14612:         || _GROUP_COLOR_PRESETS[0];
14613:   }
14614:   function setGroupColor(gid, hex) {
14615:     _writeChatPref("group", gid, "color", hex);
14616:     // Live-reflect in the sidebar.
14617:     renderGroups();
14618:   }
14619:   function _renderGroupColorSwatches(gid) {
14620:     const host = $("#group-color-swatches");
14621:     if (!host) return;
14622:     host.innerHTML = "";
14623:     const current = getGroupColor(gid);
14624:     for (const c of _GROUP_COLOR_PRESETS) {
14625:       const sw = document.createElement("button");
14626:       sw.className = "profile-color-swatch" + (c === current ? " active" : "");
14627:       sw.style.background = c;
14628:       sw.dataset.color = c;
14629:       sw.title = c;
14630:       sw.onclick = (ev) => {
14631:         ev.preventDefault();
14632:         host.querySelectorAll(".profile-color-swatch").forEach(
14633:           (b) => b.classList.toggle("active", b === sw),
14634:         );
14635:         setGroupColor(gid, c);
14636:       };
14637:       host.appendChild(sw);
14638:     }
14639:   }

14641:   // v0.12.1 archive - server-synced "hide from sidebar". Other
14642:   // members aren't affected; this is local to the user's account
14643:   // but does sync across the user's own devices.

14651:   async function toggleArchiveCurrentGroup() {
14652:     const gid = state.selectedGroup;
14653:     if (!gid) return;

14886:   async function submitCreateGroup() {
14887:     const name = $("#cg-name").value.trim();
14888:     if (!name) { toast("Group name required", "bad"); return; }
14889:     const fps = [...$("#cg-members").querySelectorAll("input[type=checkbox]:checked")]
14890:       .map(cb => cb.dataset.fp);
14891:     if (fps.length < 2) {

14893:       return;
14894:     }
14895:     try {
14896:       const r = await api.post("/api/groups", { name, members: fps });
14897:       closeCreateGroupModal();
14898:       toast(`Group "${r.name}" created`, "good");
14899:       await refreshGroups();
14900:       selectGroup(r.group_id);
14901:     } catch (e) {
14902:       // v0.8.0: a 404 here usually means the daemon is on a
14903:       // pre-v0.8.0 build that doesn't have /api/groups. The
14904:       // page-served HTML can be newer than the running daemon
14905:       // when the user updates source but doesn't restart.
14906:       if (e?.status === 404) {
14907:         toast(
14908:           "Groups need One Link v0.8.0+. Restart One Link to pick up the new endpoints.",
14909:           "bad", 9000,
14910:         );
14911:       } else {
14912:         toast(`Create didn't work: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad");
14913:       }
14914:     }
14915:   }

14992:   async function refreshFolderConflictsBanner() {

14995:       state.folderConflicts.unresolved_total = r.unresolved_total || 0;
14996:       state.folderConflicts.conflicts = r.conflicts || [];
14997:     } catch (e) {
14998:       // 404 means a pre-v0.8.9 daemon - banner stays hidden.
14999:       state.folderConflicts.unresolved_total = 0;
15000:       state.folderConflicts.conflicts = [];

15008:       return;

15032:   async function renderConflictsModal() {
15033:     let conflicts = [];

15046:       total > 0 ? `${total} unresolved` : "All clear";
15047:     const list = $("#conflicts-list");
15048:     list.innerHTML = "";
15049:     if (conflicts.length === 0) {
15050:       list.appendChild(el("div", "empty", "No conflicts. ✓"));
15051:       return;
15052:     }
15053:     for (const c of conflicts) {

15058:   function renderConflictRow(c) {
15059:     const row = el("div", "conflict-row");
15060:     row.dataset.id = c.id;
15061:     const head = el("div", "conflict-h");
15062:     head.appendChild(el("span", "folder", c.folder_name + ":"));
15063:     head.appendChild(document.createTextNode(c.file_path));
15064:     row.appendChild(head);
15065: 
15066:     const versions = el("div", "versions");
15067:     versions.appendChild(renderConflictVersion(
15068:       "Mine", c, "local", c.applied_choice === "local",
15069:     ));
15070:     versions.appendChild(renderConflictVersion(
15071:       "Theirs", c, "remote", c.applied_choice === "remote",
15072:     ));
15073:     row.appendChild(versions);
15074: 
15075:     const actions = el("div", "resolve-actions");
15076:     const mine = el("button", null, "Keep mine");
15077:     mine.onclick = () => resolveConflict(c.id, "mine", row);
15078:     const theirs = el("button", null, "Keep theirs");
15079:     theirs.onclick = () => resolveConflict(c.id, "theirs", row);
15080:     const both = el("button", "keep-both", "Keep both");
15081:     both.onclick = () => resolveConflict(c.id, "both", row);
15082:     actions.appendChild(mine);
15083:     actions.appendChild(theirs);
15084:     actions.appendChild(both);
15085:     row.appendChild(actions);
15086:     return row;
15087:   }

15089:   function renderConflictVersion(label, c, side, isApplied) {
15090:     const v = el("div", "ver" + (isApplied ? " applied" : ""));
15091:     const h = el("div", "ver-h");
15092:     h.appendChild(document.createTextNode(label));
15093:     if (isApplied) {
15094:       h.appendChild(el("span", "applied-tag", "Auto-applied"));
15095:     }
15096:     v.appendChild(h);
15097:     const blob = c[side + "_blob_hash"] || "(deleted)";
15098:     const size = c[side + "_size"];
15099:     const mtime = c[side + "_mtime_ms"];
15100:     const peer = side === "remote" ? (c.peer_fp || "?") : "this device";
15101:     v.appendChild(makeMetaLine("blob", (blob || "?").slice(0, 16) + "…"));
15102:     v.appendChild(makeMetaLine("size", size != null ? fmtBytes(size) : "-"));
15103:     v.appendChild(makeMetaLine(
15104:       "modified", mtime ? new Date(mtime).toLocaleString() : "-"
15105:     ));
15106:     v.appendChild(makeMetaLine(
15107:       "from", peer === "this device" ? peer : peer.slice(0, 12) + "…"
15108:     ));
15109:     return v;
15110:   }
15111:   function makeMetaLine(label, val) {
15112:     const line = el("div", "meta-line");
15113:     const lbl = el("span");
15114:     lbl.style.color = "var(--text-dimmer)";
15115:     lbl.textContent = label + ": ";
15116:     line.appendChild(lbl);
15117:     line.appendChild(document.createTextNode(val));
15118:     return line;
15119:   }

15121:   async function resolveConflict(id, choice, row) {
15122:     if (!id) return;
15123:     if (row) row.classList.add("resolving");
15124:     try {
15125:       const res = await api.post(
15126:         `/api/folder-conflicts/${id}/resolve`, { choice },
15127:       );
15128:       if (res.already_resolved) {
15129:         toast("Conflict already resolved.", "info");
15130:       } else if (choice === "both") {
15131:         toast(`Kept both - saved peer's version as ${res.suffixed_path || "*.conflict-…"}`, "good", 6000);
15132:       } else if (choice === "mine") {
15133:         toast("Kept your version.", "good");
15134:       } else {
15135:         toast("Switched to peer's version.", "good");
15136:       }
15137:       await renderConflictsModal();
15138:       await refreshFolderConflictsBanner();
15139:     } catch (e) {
15140:       if (row) row.classList.remove("resolving");
15141:       toast(`Resolve didn't work: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad", 6000);
15142:     }
15143:   }

15145:   function renderOneNow() {
15146:     const card = $("#one-now");
15147:     if (card) {
15148:       const nearbyOpen = $("#activity-nearby-panel")?.classList.contains("show");
15149:       card.style.display = nearbyOpen ? "none" : "";
15150:     }
15151:     const title = $("#one-now-title");
15152:     const detail = $("#one-now-detail");
15153:     if (!title || !detail) return;
15154:     const status = state.status || {};
15155:     const mesh = state.selfMesh || {};
15156:     const moving = Number(status.transfers?.active || 0);
15157:     const sessions = Number(status.performance?.sessions?.open || 0);
15158:     const devices = Array.isArray(mesh.devices) ? mesh.devices.filter(d => !d.revoked) : [];
15159:     const awake = Array.isArray(mesh.presence)
15160:       ? mesh.presence.filter(p => p.state === "awake").length
15161:       : 0;
15162:     if (moving > 0) {
15163:       title.textContent = `${moving} transfer${moving === 1 ? "" : "s"} moving`;
15164:       detail.textContent = "Autopilot is choosing the safest fast path. Open Files only if you want the details.";
15165:     } else if (nearbyCount() > 0) {
15166:       const nearby = nearbyCount();
15167:       title.textContent = `${nearby} nearby device${nearby === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
15168:       detail.textContent = sessions > 0
15169:         ? `${sessions} secure link${sessions === 1 ? "" : "s"} open. Chat, files, and folders are ready.`
15170:         : "Trusted devices are ready, and other nearby devices can be paired or invited.";
15171:     } else if (devices.length > 1) {
15172:       title.textContent = "Your personal mesh is ready";
15173:       detail.textContent = `${awake}/${devices.length} device${devices.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} awake. One Link can pick the best device for you.`;
15174:     } else {
15175:       title.textContent = "Everything is quiet";
15176:       detail.textContent = "Pair a device, send a file, or open Privacy to see exactly what One Link is doing.";
15177:     }
15178:   }

15180:   function trustedNearbyPeers() {
15181:     return [...state.peers.values()].filter(p => p.trust === "pinned" && p.online);

15185:     const smart = state.discoverSmart || {};
15186:     return [
15187:       ...(smart.ready_to_pair || []),
15188:       ...(smart.pairable || []),
15189:       ...(smart.other_gear || []),

15193:   function nearbyCount() {
15194:     const seen = new Set();
15195:     let count = 0;
15196:     for (const p of trustedNearbyPeers()) {
15197:       const key = p.fingerprint || p.address || p.short_id;
15198:       if (!key || seen.has(key)) continue;
15199:       seen.add(key);
15200:       count += 1;
15201:     }
15202:     for (const d of nearbyDiscoveryRows()) {
15203:       const peer = d.one_link_peer || {};
15204:       const key = peer.fingerprint || d.ip || d.hostname;
15205:       if (!key || seen.has(key)) continue;
15206:       seen.add(key);
15207:       count += 1;
15208:     }
15209:     return count;
15210:   }

15213:     const n = Math.max(

15215:       nearbyCount(),
15216:     );

15218:     if (metric) metric.textContent = String(n);
15219:     const tile = $("#metric-tile-online");
15220:     if (tile) {
15221:       const open = $("#activity-nearby-panel")?.classList.contains("show");
15222:       tile.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
15223:       tile.setAttribute("aria-label", open ? "Hide nearby devices" : "Show nearby devices");
15224:     }
15225:     const count = $("#activity-nearby-count");
15226:     if (count) count.textContent = `${n} found`;
15227:   }

15251:   function renderActivityNearby() {
15252:     const panel = $("#activity-nearby-panel");
15253:     const list = $("#activity-nearby-list");
15254:     if (!panel || !list) return;
15255:     list.innerHTML = "";
15256:     const seen = new Set();
15257:     for (const p of trustedNearbyPeers()) {
15258:       const key = p.fingerprint || p.short_id;
15259:       if (!key || seen.has(key)) continue;
15260:       seen.add(key);
15261:       list.appendChild(nearbyRow(
15262:         deviceKindLabel(p)?.icon || "💻",

15273:       const peer = d.one_link_peer || {};
15274:       const key = peer.fingerprint || d.ip || d.hostname;
15275:       if (!key || seen.has(key)) continue;

15280:         d.hostname || peer.hostname || d.vendor || _kindLabel(d.kind),

15292:         "div",
15293:         "activity-nearby-sub",
15294:         "No nearby devices found yet. Refresh will scan Wi-Fi and trusted links again.",

15329:     try {
15330:       state.status = await api.status();

15332:       updateNearbyMetric();

15335:       $("#metric-sessions").textContent = state.status.performance?.sessions?.open ?? 0;

15340:     renderOneNow();

15342:     // accurate without waiting for the user to open the settings modal.

15346:       state.rendezvousUrls = r.urls || [];

15348:         // The empty-state callout depends on this - re-render.
15349:         renderPeers();

15380:   async function copyRouteBootstrapToken() {
15381:     try {
15382:       const nr = await api.noRouter();
15383:       state.fabric = state.fabric || {};
15384:       state.fabric.no_router = nr;
15385:       renderFabricTruth();
15386:       if (!nr.token_ready) throw new Error(nr.message || "Local setup code is not ready yet");
15387:       const r = await api.routeBootstrap();
15388:       if (!r.ok || !r.token) throw new Error(r.message || "No setup code available yet");
15389:       const input = $("#route-bootstrap-token");
15390:       if (input) input.value = r.token;
15391:       const qr = $("#route-bootstrap-qr");
15392:       if (qr) {
15393:         qr.src = `/api/route-bootstrap/qr.svg?t=${Date.now()}`;
15394:         qr.style.display = "block";
15395:         qr.title = "Scan this from another paired device to share a short-lived path hint.";
15396:       }
15397:       await copyToClipboard(r.token, "setup code");
15398:       toast("Setup code ready", "good", 2500);
15399:     } catch (e) {
15400:       toast(`Setup code unavailable: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad", 6000);
15401:     }
15402:   }

15404:   async function importRouteBootstrapToken() {
15405:     const input = $("#route-bootstrap-token");

15407:     if (!token) {
15408:       toast("Paste a setup code first.", "info", 3000);
15409:       input?.focus();
15410:       return;
15411:     }
15412:     try {
15413:       const r = await api.importRouteBootstrap(token);
15414:       toast(
15415:         `Path check queued for ${r.peer || "device"} (${r.queued || 0})`,
15416:         "good",
15417:         3500,
15418:       );
15419:       if (input) input.value = "";
15420:       const qr = $("#route-bootstrap-qr");
15421:       if (qr) {
15422:         qr.removeAttribute("src");
15423:         qr.style.display = "none";
15424:       }
15425:       await refreshPeers();
15426:       await refreshFabricTruth();
15427:     } catch (e) {
15428:       toast(`Setup code refused: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad", 7000);
15429:     }
15430:   }

15437:     if (kind === "trust") {
15438:       if (subkind === "verify_set") return "✓";
15439:       if (subkind === "verify_clear") return "↺";
15440:       if (subkind === "trust_set") return "🔒";
15441:       return "⚙";
15442:     }
15443:     if (kind === "key_change") return "⚠";
15444:     if (kind === "transfer") return subkind === "complete" ? "📨" : "✗";
15445:     if (kind === "conflict") return "⚖";
15446:     if (kind === "peer") return "👋";
15447:     return "•";

15575:   let _activityRefreshScheduled = false;
15576:   function scheduleActivityRefresh() {
15577:     if (_activityRefreshScheduled) return;
15578:     _activityRefreshScheduled = true;
15579:     requestAnimationFrame(() => {
15580:       _activityRefreshScheduled = false;

15587:   async function refreshTransfers() {
15588:     try {
15589:       const { transfers } = await api.transfers();
15590:       state.transfers = transfers || [];
15591:       state.transfersById = new Map();
15592:       for (const t of state.transfers) state.transfersById.set(t.id, t);
15593:       renderTransfers();
15594:       renderCourierKit();
15595:       // Status of file bubbles is driven by transfersById - re-render
15596:       // the active conversation so progress reflects the fresh data.
15597:       renderMessages();
15598:       await refreshStatus();
15599:     } catch (e) { console.warn(e); }
15600:   }

15602:   function renderTransfers() {
15603:     const list = $("#transferlist");
15604:     if (!list) return;
15605:     list.innerHTML = "";
15606:     $("#transfers-count").textContent = state.transfers.length;
15607:     if (state.transfers.length === 0) {
15608:       list.appendChild(el("div", "empty", "No activity yet. Sent files and folder sync will appear here."));
15609:       return;
15610:     }
15611:     for (const t of state.transfers) {
15612:       const row = el("div", "file-row");
15613:       row.appendChild(el("div", "icon", t.direction === "in" ? "In" : "Out"));
15614:       const meta = el("div", "meta");
15615:       meta.appendChild(el("div", "name", t.name || "file"));
15616:       const label = statusLabel(t, t.status || "Queued");
15617:       const rate = (t.status === "active" || t.status === "offered") ? rateForTransfer(t) : 0;
15618:       const parts = [
15619:         label,
15620:         `${fmtBytes(t.progress_bytes)} / ${fmtBytes(t.total_bytes)}`,
15621:       ];
15622:       if (rate > 0) {
15623:         parts.push(fmtRate(rate));
15624:         const remaining = Math.max(0, (t.total_bytes || 0) - (t.progress_bytes || 0));
15625:         if (remaining > 0) parts.push(`ETA ${fmtEta(remaining, rate)}`);
15626:       }
15627:       meta.appendChild(el("div", "size", parts.join(" · ")));
15628:       const bar = el("div", "bar");
15629:       const fill = el("span");
15630:       fill.style.width = `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, t.progress_pct || 0))}%`;
15631:       bar.appendChild(fill);
15632:       meta.appendChild(bar);
15633:       const command = renderTransferCommandCenter(t);
15634:       if (command) meta.appendChild(command);
15635:       const facts = renderTransferFacts(t, statusKind(t));
15636:       if (facts) meta.appendChild(facts);
15637:       row.appendChild(meta);
15638:       // v0.7.x: Retry button for failed outbound transfers. The
15639:       // server reads the original local path off the ledger row's
15640:       // metadata.path and re-runs send_file. Inbound failures
15641:       // can't be retried from the receiver side (the sender owns
15642:       // the source file), so it's out-only.
15643:       if (t.status === "failed" && !((t.metadata || {}).transient) && t.direction === "out") {
15644:         const retry = el("button", null, "Retry");
15645:         retry.onclick = async () => {
15646:           retry.disabled = true;
15647:           retry.textContent = "Retrying…";
15648:           try {
15649:             await api.post(
15650:               `/api/transfers/${encodeURIComponent(t.id)}/retry`, {}
15651:             );
15652:             toast(`Retrying ${t.name || "transfer"}`, "info", 3000);
15653:             await refreshTransfers();
15654:           } catch (e) {
15655:             toast(`Retry didn't work: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad", 8000);
15656:             retry.disabled = false;
15657:             retry.textContent = "Retry";
15658:           }
15659:         };
15660:         row.appendChild(retry);
15661:       }
15662:       // v0.7.4: paused outbound transfers auto-resume on next
15663:       // session-up. Show a Cancel button for the user to give up.
15664:       if ((t.status === "paused" || t.status === "queued") && t.direction === "out") {
15665:         const cancel = el("button", null, "Cancel");
15666:         cancel.onclick = async () => {
15667:           cancel.disabled = true;
15668:           try {
15669:             await api.post(
15670:               `/api/transfers/${encodeURIComponent(t.id)}/cancel`, {}
15671:             );
15672:             await refreshTransfers();
15673:           } catch (e) {
15674:             toast(`Cancel didn't work: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad");
15675:             cancel.disabled = false;
15676:           }
15677:         };
15678:         row.appendChild(cancel);
15679:       }
15680:       if (t.blob_hash && (t.chunks_total || t.status === "complete")) {
15681:         const courier = el("button", null, "Offline");
15682:         courier.title = "Download this transfer as an encrypted offline bundle.";
15683:         courier.onclick = async () => {
15684:           const select = $("#courier-transfer-select");
15685:           if (select) select.value = t.id || "";
15686:           await exportCourierBundle();
15687:         };
15688:         row.appendChild(courier);
15689:       }
15690:       if (["complete", "failed"].includes(t.status)) {
15691:         const del = el("button", null, "Clear");
15692:         del.onclick = async () => {
15693:           try {
15694:             await api.del(`/api/transfers/${encodeURIComponent(t.id)}`);
15695:             state.transfers = state.transfers.filter(x => x.id !== t.id);
15696:             renderTransfers();
15697:             await refreshStatus();
15698:           } catch (e) {
15699:             toast(`Clear didn't work: ${e.message || e}`, "bad");
15700:           }
15701:         };
15702:         row.appendChild(del);
15703:       }
15704:       list.appendChild(row);
15705:     }
15706:   }

15709:   // v0.14.0 - Service Worker registration + offline outbox.
15710:   // Goal: a tab-blur during composition saves the draft + queues
15711:   // any in-flight send into IDB. The browser's `sync` event drains
15712:   // the queue when connectivity returns. The page also pokes the
15713:   // SW with postMessage("drain-now") on every reconnect so the
15714:   // user doesn't wait for the browser scheduler.
15715:   //
15716:   // Failure modes that fall back gracefully:
15717:   //   - Browser without SW support (very old Safari): no SW, no
15718:   //     IDB queue, sends behave exactly as v0.13. No regression.
15719:   //   - SW registration denied (user setting): same.
15720:   //   - IDB unavailable (private browsing locked-down): we still
15721:   //     register the SW; the queue is in-memory; on tab close,
15722:   //     pending sends are lost (degrades to v0.13 behavior).
15723: 
15724:   let _swReg = null;
15725:   async function _registerServiceWorker() {
15726:     if (!("serviceWorker" in navigator)) return;
15727:     try {
15728:       _swReg = await navigator.serviceWorker.register("/sw.js", { scope: "/" });
15729:     } catch (e) {
15730:       console.warn("SW registration failed (degrading to no-SW path):", e);
15731:     }
15732:   }
15733:   // Fire and forget; don't block init on registration.
15734:   _registerServiceWorker();
15735: 
15736:   function _outboxOpenDB() {
15737:     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
15738:       if (!window.indexedDB) { reject(new Error("no-idb")); return; }
15739:       const req = indexedDB.open("one-link-outbox-v1", 1);
15740:       req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
15741:         const db = req.result;
15742:         if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("queue")) {
15743:           db.createObjectStore("queue", { keyPath: "id", autoIncrement: true });
15744:         }
15745:       };
15746:       req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
15747:       req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
15748:     });
15749:   }
15750:   async function _outboxQueue(item) {
15751:     try {
15752:       const db = await _outboxOpenDB();
15753:       const tx = db.transaction("queue", "readwrite");
15754:       tx.objectStore("queue").add(item);
15755:       return new Promise((res, rej) => {
15756:         tx.oncomplete = () => res(true);
15757:         tx.onerror = () => rej(tx.error);
15758:       });
15759:     } catch {
15760:       return false;
15761:     }
15762:   }
15763:   async function _outboxRequestSync() {
15764:     if (!_swReg) return;
15765:     try {
15766:       if ("sync" in _swReg) {
15767:         await _swReg.sync.register("ol-outbox");
15768:       } else {
15769:         // Fallback for browsers without Background Sync API: just
15770:         // postMessage to the SW so it tries draining now.
15771:         navigator.serviceWorker?.controller?.postMessage({ type: "drain-now" });
15772:       }
15773:     } catch {}
15774:   }

15776:   // Wrap api.post so a network failure on /api/send queues into IDB
15777:   // for later. Called explicitly from sendCurrent - we don't want to
15778:   // queue arbitrary failed POSTs (that would queue auth refreshes,
15779:   // settings saves, etc.). Outbox is for sends ONLY.
15780:   async function _sendWithOutbox(path, body, opts = {}) {
15781:     try {
15782:       return await api.post(path, body, opts);
15783:     } catch (e) {
15784:       // v0.21.x: AbortError from the new api.post timeoutMs feature
15785:       // is treated as network-like so the local outbox catches it
15786:       // instead of bubbling up as a generic "failed" toast. The
15787:       // user is told their message is queued and will send when
15788:       // connectivity returns — never a silent disabled button.
15789:       const errStr = String(e?.message || e);
15790:       const isAbort = e?.name === "AbortError" || /aborted|AbortError/i.test(errStr);
15791:       const isNetworkLike =
15792:         isAbort
15793:         || /Failed to fetch|NetworkError|TypeError/i.test(errStr);
15794:       if (!isNetworkLike) throw e;
15795:       // Network looks broken; queue the payload.
15796:       const queued = await _outboxQueue({
15797:         url: path,
15798:         method: "POST",
15799:         headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
15800:         body: JSON.stringify(body),
15801:         queuedAt: Date.now(),
15802:       });
15803:       if (queued) {
15804:         await _outboxRequestSync();
15805:         if (isAbort) {
15806:           toast(
15807:             "Send took too long. Queued; will retry in the background.",
15808:             "info", 5000,
15809:           );
15810:         } else {
15811:           toast(
15812:             "No connection. Queued; will send when you're back online.",
15813:             "info", 4000,
15814:           );
15815:         }
15816:         return { ok: true, queued: true, reason: isAbort ? "client_timeout" : "offline" };
15817:       }
15818:       throw e;
15819:     }
15820:   }

15822:   // v0.21.x bulletproof send: random 32-char hex id so the browser
15823:   // can paint an optimistic outbound bubble immediately and the
15824:   // daemon's echoed event reconciles via id-match. Matches the
15825:   // daemon's uuid4().hex shape exactly.
15826:   function _newClientMsgId() {
15827:     const raw = (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.randomUUID)
15828:       ? crypto.randomUUID()
15829:       : _fallbackUuid4Hyphenated();
15830:     return raw.replace(/-/g, "");
15831:   }
15832:   function _fallbackUuid4Hyphenated() {
15833:     const b = new Uint8Array(16);
15834:     (crypto || self.msCrypto).getRandomValues(b);
15835:     b[6] = (b[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
15836:     b[8] = (b[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
15837:     const h = Array.from(b, x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
15838:     return `${h.slice(0,8)}-${h.slice(8,12)}-${h.slice(12,16)}-${h.slice(16,20)}-${h.slice(20,32)}`;
15839:   }
15840:   // v0.21.x: update one outbound bubble's send-state. Used by
15841:   // sendCurrent on resolve and by the inline Retry button. Re-
15842:   // renders only if the affected message is in the active thread.
15843:   function _markBubbleState(msgId, sendingState, extras = {}) {
15844:     const idx = state.messages.findIndex(x => x.id === msgId);
15845:     if (idx < 0) return;
15846:     state.messages[idx] = {
15847:       ...state.messages[idx],
15848:       _sendingState: sendingState,
15849:       ...extras,
15850:     };
15851:     if (state.messages[idx].peer === state.selectedPeer) renderMessages();
15852:   }
15853:   // v0.21.x: render the per-bubble send-state pill (Sending… /
15854:   // Queued / Failed · Retry). Lives inline at the bottom of the
15855:   // bubble so the status is anchored to the message, not to a
15856:   // toast that disappears in 4s.
15857:   function renderSendStatePill(msg) {
15858:     const wrap = el("span", `send-pill send-pill-${msg._sendingState}`);
15859:     if (msg._sendingState === "sending") {
15860:       wrap.appendChild(el("span", "send-dot"));
15861:       wrap.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" Sending…"));
15862:     } else if (msg._sendingState === "queued") {
15863:       // Prefer the daemon's user-facing copy when present — it
15864:       // explains the actual wire-path state (handshake, ratchet
15865:       // desync, peer unreachable…) rather than the vague "path is
15866:       // healthy" line that confused users when presence said online.
15867:       let reasonHint;
15868:       if (msg._queueDetail) {
15869:         reasonHint = msg._queueDetail;
15870:       } else if (msg._queueReason === "client_timeout") {
15871:         reasonHint = "Send took longer than expected";
15872:       } else if (msg._queueReason === "peer_offline") {
15873:         reasonHint = "Other device is offline";
15874:       } else if (msg._queueReason === "peer_unreachable") {
15875:         reasonHint = "Other device is not reachable right now";
15876:       } else if (msg._queueReason === "handshake_failed") {
15877:         reasonHint = "Re-establishing secure session";
15878:       } else if (msg._queueReason === "timeout") {
15879:         reasonHint = "Other device didn't respond in time";
15880:       } else if (msg._queueReason === "secure_session_desync") {
15881:         reasonHint = "Refreshing secure session";
15882:       } else {
15883:         reasonHint = "Will send when the path is healthy";
15884:       }
15885:       wrap.appendChild(document.createTextNode(`Queued · ${reasonHint}`));
15886:       // Inline "Retry now" so impatient users don't have to wait on
15887:       // the daemon's heal-and-drain loop. Re-uses the same retrySend
15888:       // path the Failed state uses, so the state machine stays
15889:       // single-source.
15890:       wrap.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" · "));
15891:       const retryNow = document.createElement("button");
15892:       retryNow.type = "button";
15893:       retryNow.className = "send-retry";
15894:       retryNow.textContent = "Retry now";
15895:       retryNow.onclick = (ev) => {
15896:         ev.stopPropagation();
15897:         retrySend(msg.id);
15898:       };
15899:       wrap.appendChild(retryNow);
15900:     } else if (msg._sendingState === "failed") {
15901:       const txt = msg._error || "Failed to send";
15902:       wrap.appendChild(document.createTextNode(`${txt} · `));
15903:       const retry = document.createElement("button");
15904:       retry.type = "button";
15905:       retry.className = "send-retry";
15906:       retry.textContent = "Retry";
15907:       retry.onclick = (ev) => {
15908:         ev.stopPropagation();
15909:         retrySend(msg.id);
15910:       };
15911:       wrap.appendChild(retry);
15912:     }
15913:     return wrap;
15914:   }
15915:   // v0.21.x: re-attempt a failed send. Reuses the original body and
15916:   // peer; resets the bubble back to "sending" state so the user sees
15917:   // it pick up where it stopped.
15918:   async function retrySend(msgId) {
15919:     const idx = state.messages.findIndex(x => x.id === msgId);
15920:     if (idx < 0) return;
15921:     const prev = state.messages[idx];
15922:     if (!prev || prev.t !== "TEXT" || !prev.body) return;
15923:     const peer = state.peers.get(prev.peer);
15924:     if (!peer) {
15925:       toast("That device just dropped off the network. Try again later.", "info", 5000);
15926:       return;
15927:     }
15928:     _markBubbleState(msgId, "sending", {
15929:       _error: undefined,
15930:       _attempts: (prev._attempts || 1) + 1,
15931:     });
15932:     const sendBody = {
15933:       peer: prev.peer,
15934:       body: prev.body,
15935:       client_msg_id: prev.id,
15936:     };
15937:     if (prev.reply_to) sendBody.reply_to = prev.reply_to;
15938:     try {
15939:       const result = await _sendWithOutbox(
15940:         "/api/send", sendBody, { timeoutMs: 25000 },
15941:       );
15942:       if (result && result.ok === false) {
15943:         _markBubbleState(msgId, "failed", {
15944:           _error: result.user_message || result.error || "Message couldn't be sent.",
15945:         });
15946:       } else if (result && result.queued) {
15947:         const tx = result.after_failure || {};
15948:         _markBubbleState(msgId, "queued", {
15949:           _queueReason: result.reason || null,
15950:           _queueDetail: tx.error || null,
15951:           _queueHint: tx.hint || null,
15952:         });
15953:       } else {
15954:         _markBubbleState(msgId, "sent");
15955:       }
15956:     } catch (e) {
15957:       _markBubbleState(msgId, "failed", { _error: errorToastBody(e) });
15958:     }
15959:   }

15987:   // v0.14.0 - Frame-budget instrumentation. Records the duration
15988:   // of selected hot operations into a capped ring buffer. CI / the
15989:   // diagnostics overlay can read state.frameBudget to verify SLAs
15990:   // (renderMessages within 16.7ms, conversation-switch within
15991:   // 150ms, etc.). Cheap: each measurement is a high-precision
15992:   // timestamp diff.
15993:   state.frameBudget = state.frameBudget || {
15994:     renderMessages: [],   // ring buffer of durations in ms
15995:     selectPeer: [],
15996:     selectGroup: [],
15997:     capacity: 200,        // last N samples
15998:   };
15999:   function _recordFrame(label, durationMs) {
16000:     const buf = state.frameBudget?.[label];
16001:     if (!buf) return;
16002:     buf.push(durationMs);
16003:     const cap = state.frameBudget.capacity || 200;
16004:     if (buf.length > cap) buf.shift();
16005:   }
16006:   function _measure(label, fn) {
16007:     const t0 = performance.now();
16008:     try {
16009:       return fn();
16010:     } finally {
16011:       _recordFrame(label, performance.now() - t0);
16012:     }
16013:   }
16014:   async function _measureAsync(label, fn) {
16015:     const t0 = performance.now();
16016:     try {
16017:       return await fn();
16018:     } finally {
16019:       _recordFrame(label, performance.now() - t0);
16020:     }
16021:   }
16022:   // Convenience accessors for tests + debug:
16023:   window.__oneLinkFrameBudget = () => {
16024:     const out = {};
16025:     for (const k of Object.keys(state.frameBudget)) {
16026:       const buf = state.frameBudget[k];
16027:       if (!Array.isArray(buf) || buf.length === 0) {
16028:         out[k] = null; continue;
16029:       }
16030:       const sorted = [...buf].sort((a, b) => a - b);
16031:       out[k] = {
16032:         n: buf.length,
16033:         mean: buf.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / buf.length,
16034:         p50: sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.5)],
16035:         p95: sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.95)],
16036:         p99: sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.99)],
16037:         max: sorted[sorted.length - 1],
16038:       };
16039:     }
16040:     return out;
16041:   };

16043:   // v0.14.0 - Predictive peer-switch prefetch (Markov chain).
16044:   //
16045:   // Frontier engine for conversation-switch latency: when the user
16046:   // taps peer A, we want their last 50 messages already decoded into
16047:   // memory. Instead of pulling everything for everyone (memory hog),
16048:   // we learn which peers the user typically switches BETWEEN and
16049:   // pre-warm the most likely next.
16050:   //
16051:   // Model: a sparse transition matrix M[from -> to -> count]. After
16052:   // each conversation switch, M[prev_short -> new_short]++. Predict:
16053:   // for the current conversation `from`, the next-most-likely peer
16054:   // is argmax_{to} M[from][to] (with a Laplace-smoothed prior so
16055:   // first-time peers can win). Persistence in localStorage:
16056:   // serialized as JSON, capped at MARKOV_MAX_FROM_KEYS top-counted
16057:   // sources to stay under ~4KB. LRU eviction by lowest total count.
16058:   //
16059:   // Total-cost discipline: zero network until the user actually
16060:   // switches; the prefetch is a `requestIdleCallback`-deferred fetch
16061:   // for the predicted peer's last 50 messages, swallowed silently
16062:   // on failure. We never speculatively MARK as read. We never
16063:   // tell peers anything about predictions. It's purely local.
16064: 
16065:   const MARKOV_KEY = "one_link.markov.peer_switch.v1";
16066:   const MARKOV_MAX_FROM_KEYS = 32;     // ~32 sources -> ~32 columns
16067:   const MARKOV_MAX_TO_PER_FROM = 8;    // 8 destinations each
16068:   const MARKOV_PREFETCH_LIMIT = 50;    // last 50 msgs prefetched
16069:   const MARKOV_PRIOR = 0.5;             // Laplace smoothing
16070: 
16071:   function _loadMarkov() {
16072:     try {
16073:       const raw = localStorage.getItem(MARKOV_KEY);
16074:       if (!raw) return {};
16075:       const j = JSON.parse(raw);
16076:       return (j && typeof j === "object") ? j : {};
16077:     } catch {
16078:       return {};
16079:     }
16080:   }
16081:   function _saveMarkov(m) {
16082:     try {
16083:       // Cap from-keys to top-N by total count; evict the rest.
16084:       const totals = Object.entries(m).map(([from, ts]) => [
16085:         from, Object.values(ts).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0),
16086:       ]);
16087:       totals.sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
16088:       const keep = new Set(totals.slice(0, MARKOV_MAX_FROM_KEYS).map(t => t[0]));
16089:       const out = {};
16090:       for (const [from, ts] of Object.entries(m)) {
16091:         if (!keep.has(from)) continue;
16092:         // Cap to-keys per from.
16093:         const tsArr = Object.entries(ts);
16094:         tsArr.sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
16095:         out[from] = Object.fromEntries(tsArr.slice(0, MARKOV_MAX_TO_PER_FROM));
16096:       }
16097:       const json = JSON.stringify(out);
16098:       // Hard guard: never let the matrix exceed 4KB persisted.
16099:       if (json.length > 4096) {
16100:         // Halve all counts (keeps ratios; trims footprint).
16101:         for (const from of Object.keys(out)) {
16102:           for (const to of Object.keys(out[from])) {
16103:             out[from][to] = Math.max(1, Math.floor(out[from][to] / 2));
16104:           }
16105:         }
16106:         localStorage.setItem(MARKOV_KEY, JSON.stringify(out));
16107:       } else {
16108:         localStorage.setItem(MARKOV_KEY, json);
16109:       }
16110:     } catch {
16111:       // localStorage full or otherwise unavailable: silent.
16112:     }
16113:   }
16114:   state.markov = _loadMarkov();
16115:   state.lastSelectedShortId = null;

16189:   function _recordSwitch(toShortId) {
16190:     const from = state.lastSelectedShortId;
16191:     if (!from || !toShortId || from === toShortId) {
16192:       state.lastSelectedShortId = toShortId || from;
16193:       return;
16194:     }
16195:     const m = state.markov;
16196:     if (!m[from]) m[from] = {};
16197:     m[from][toShortId] = (m[from][toShortId] || 0) + 1;
16198:     state.lastSelectedShortId = toShortId;
16199:     _saveMarkov(m);
16200:   }
16201: 
16202:   function _predictNextPeerShort(currentShortId) {
16203:     const m = state.markov;
16204:     if (!currentShortId || !m[currentShortId]) return null;
16205:     // Argmax over destinations (with Laplace smoothing implicit:
16206:     // ties broken by lex order so it's deterministic).
16207:     let best = null, bestCount = -Infinity;
16208:     for (const [to, count] of Object.entries(m[currentShortId])) {
16209:       const adj = count + MARKOV_PRIOR;
16210:       if (adj > bestCount) { bestCount = adj; best = to; }
16211:     }
16212:     return best;
16213:   }

16215:   // Idle-time prefetch: fetch the predicted peer's last N messages
16216:   // into a local cache. Cheap; no UI side-effects. Failure is
16217:   // silent (the user might still switch there, just without warm
16218:   // memory).
16219:   state.peerMessageCache = state.peerMessageCache || new Map();
16220:   function _prefetchPeerMessages(shortId) {
16221:     if (!shortId) return;
16222:     if (state.peerMessageCache.has(shortId)) return; // already warm
16223:     const peer = state.peers.get(shortId);
16224:     if (!peer || !peer.fingerprint) return;
16225:     const fp = peer.fingerprint;
16226:     const idle = window.requestIdleCallback || ((cb) => setTimeout(cb, 200));
16227:     idle(async () => {
16228:       try {
16229:         const r = await api.get(
16230:           `/api/messages?peer=${fp}&limit=${MARKOV_PREFETCH_LIMIT}`,
16231:         );
16232:         // Cap cache to 8 peers worth so we don't grow unbounded.
16233:         if (state.peerMessageCache.size >= 8) {
16234:           const oldest = state.peerMessageCache.keys().next().value;
16235:           state.peerMessageCache.delete(oldest);
16236:         }
16237:         state.peerMessageCache.set(shortId, {
16238:           messages: r.messages || [],
16239:           fetchedAt: Date.now(),
16240:         });
16241:       } catch {
16242:         // Silent: prediction was wrong / peer offline / network down.
16243:       }
16244:     });
16245:   }
16246: 
16247:   // After every conversation switch, fire-and-forget a prefetch of
16248:   // the next-most-likely peer based on the user's history.
16249:   function _maybePrefetchNext(currentShortId) {
16250:     const next = _predictNextPeerShort(currentShortId);
16251:     if (next && next !== currentShortId) _prefetchPeerMessages(next);
16252:   }

16254:   // v0.14.1 - Last-conversation persistence. We persist the
16255:   // currently-selected peer / group so opening the app boots
16256:   // straight back into the user's last chat (no manual re-tap on
16257:   // every reload). Stored under one_link.last_selection.v1; tiny
16258:   // JSON, capped to a single record.
16259:   const LAST_SELECTION_KEY = "one_link.last_selection.v1";
16260:   function _saveLastSelection(scope, id) {
16261:     try {
16262:       if (!scope || !id) {
16263:         localStorage.removeItem(LAST_SELECTION_KEY);
16264:         return;
16265:       }
16266:       localStorage.setItem(
16267:         LAST_SELECTION_KEY,
16268:         JSON.stringify({ scope, id, ts: Date.now() }),
16269:       );
16270:     } catch {}
16271:   }
16272:   function _readLastSelection() {
16273:     try {
16274:       const raw = localStorage.getItem(LAST_SELECTION_KEY);
16275:       if (!raw) return null;
16276:       const j = JSON.parse(raw);
16277:       if (!j || typeof j !== "object") return null;
16278:       if (j.scope !== "peer" && j.scope !== "group") return null;
16279:       if (typeof j.id !== "string" || !j.id) return null;
16280:       return { scope: j.scope, id: j.id, ts: j.ts || 0 };
16281:     } catch {
16282:       return null;
16283:     }
16284:   }
16285:   // v0.14.1: restore the last-selected conversation on boot. Called
16286:   // from init() after refreshPeers + refreshGroups have populated
16287:   // state. If the previous selection target is gone (peer
16288:   // unpaired, group disbanded), we silently no-op.
16289:   function _restoreLastSelection() {
16290:     const last = _readLastSelection();
16291:     if (!last) return;
16292:     if (last.scope === "peer") {
16293:       // Look up by short_id (the persisted shape) AND tolerate the
16294:       // case where peers refreshed under a different id (rare but
16295:       // possible after a peer's hostname changes).
16296:       if (state.peers.has(last.id)) {
16297:         try { selectPeer(last.id); } catch (e) {
16298:           console.warn("restore peer failed:", e);
16299:         }
16300:       }
16301:     } else if (last.scope === "group") {
16302:       if (state.groups.has(last.id)) {
16303:         try { selectGroup(last.id); } catch (e) {
16304:           console.warn("restore group failed:", e);
16305:         }
16306:       }
16307:     }
16308:   }

16603:   function maybeSendReadMarker(peer) {
16604:     if (!peer || !peer.fingerprint || peer.trust !== "pinned") return;
16605:     // Highest ts among inbound messages from this peer.
16606:     let highestTs = 0;
16607:     for (const m of state.messages) {
16608:       if (m.peer === peer.short_id && m.dir === "in" && m.ts > highestTs) {
16609:         highestTs = m.ts;
16610:       }
16611:     }
16612:     if (highestTs <= 0) return;
16613:     const already = state.sentReadUpTo[peer.fingerprint] || 0;
16614:     if (highestTs <= already) return;
16615:     state.sentReadUpTo[peer.fingerprint] = highestTs;
16616:     api.post(
16617:       `/api/peers/${peer.fingerprint}/read`,
16618:       { up_to_ts_ms: highestTs },
16619:     ).catch(() => { /* best-effort; never bother user */ });
16620:   }

16635:   function _humanRelMs(ms) {
16636:     if (!ms) return "-";
16637:     const d = Date.now() - ms;
16638:     if (d < 0) return "just now";
16639:     const m = Math.floor(d / 60000);
16640:     if (m < 1) return "just now";
16641:     if (m < 60) return `${m} min ago`;
16642:     const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
16643:     if (h < 24) return `${h} h ago`;
16644:     const days = Math.floor(h / 24);
16645:     return `${days} d ago`;
16646:   }

16652:   async function openDeviceDrawer(shortId) {
16653:     const peer = _peerFromShort(shortId);
16654:     if (!peer || !peer.fingerprint) {

16656:       return;

16660:       local_alias: peer.local_alias ?? "",
16661:       muted: !!peer.muted,

16664:     // v0.13.2: every helper call below is wrapped in a try/catch so
16665:     // a regression in any cosmetic side-effect (mute-status renderer,
16666:     // wallpaper swatches, capability sync, etc.) doesn't prevent the
16667:     // drawer from opening. The drawer's PRIMARY action is "show me
16668:     // device settings"; if a sub-helper breaks, log + continue. We
16669:     // still flip .show at the end so the user always gets the modal.
16670:     const tryStep = (label, fn) => {
16671:       try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn(`drawer: ${label} failed`, e); }
16672:     };

16674:     const kind = deviceKindLabel(peer);

16680:         ic.title = kind.label;
16681:         drawerNameEl.appendChild(ic);
16682:       }
16683:       drawerNameEl.appendChild(document.createTextNode(
16684:         peer.display_name || peer.hostname || peer.short_id
16685:       ));
16686:     }
16687:     const subParts = [peer.short_id, reachLabel(peer)];
16688:     if (kind) subParts.push(kind.label);
16689:     const subEl = $("#device-drawer-sub");
16690:     if (subEl) subEl.textContent = subParts.join(" · ");
16691: 
16692:     const aliasEl = $("#dev-alias");
16693:     if (aliasEl) aliasEl.value = peer.local_alias || "";
16694:     const muteEl = $("#dev-mute");
16695:     if (muteEl) muteEl.checked = !!peer.muted;
16696:     tryStep("mute-status", () => _renderMuteStatus(
16697:       $("#dev-mute-status"),
16698:       peer.muted_until_ms,
16699:       !!peer.muted,
16700:     ));
16701:     tryStep("wallpaper-swatches", () => _renderChatWallpaperSwatches(
16702:       $("#dev-wallpaper-swatches"),
16703:       "peer", peer.fingerprint,
16704:     ));
16705:     const dur = $("#dev-mute-duration");
16706:     if (dur) dur.value = "";
16707: 
16708:     tryStep("capability-sync", () => syncDrawerCapabilityControls(
16709:       peer.allowed_capabilities,
16710:     ));
16711: 
16712:     const regEl = $("#dev-regime");
16713:     if (regEl) regEl.textContent = reachLabel(peer);
16714:     const lat = peer.health?.latency_ewma_ms;
16715:     const latEl = $("#dev-latency");
16716:     if (latEl) latEl.textContent = lat == null ? "-" : `${Math.round(lat)} ms`;
16717:     const lastAliveEl = $("#dev-lastalive");

16846:   function bindSwitch(inputId) {
16847:     const input = $("#" + inputId);
16848:     const toggle = input?.closest(".toggle");
16849:     if (!input || !toggle) return;
16850:     toggle.setAttribute("role", "switch");
16851:     toggle.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
16852:     const syncA11y = () => {
16853:       toggle.setAttribute("aria-checked", input.checked ? "true" : "false");
16854:     };
16855:     input.addEventListener("change", syncA11y);
16856:     toggle.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
16857:       if (e.target === input) return;
16858:       e.preventDefault();
16859:       input.checked = !input.checked;
16860:       syncA11y();
16861:       input.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
16862:     });
16863:     toggle.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
16864:       if (e.key !== " " && e.key !== "Enter") return;
16865:       e.preventDefault();
16866:       input.checked = !input.checked;
16867:       syncA11y();
16868:       input.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
16869:     });
16870:     syncA11y();
16871:   }

16892:   const DRAWER_CAPS = ["chat", "files", "folder_sync", "voice_call", "video_call"];

16895:   function pairDefaultAllowAllEnabled() {
16896:     return state.runtimeSettings?.pair_default_allow_all !== false;
16897:   }

16899:   function policyLooksLikeLegacyDrawerAllowAll(policy) {
16900:     if (!Array.isArray(policy) || !pairDefaultAllowAllEnabled()) return false;
16901:     const allowed = new Set(policy);
16902:     return LEGACY_DRAWER_ALLOW_ALL_CAPS.every(cap => allowed.has(cap))
16903:       && !allowed.has("voice_call")
16904:       && !allowed.has("video_call");
16905:   }
16906: 
16907:   function peerCapabilityAllowed(peer, cap) {
16908:     const policy = peer?.allowed_capabilities;
16909:     if (!Array.isArray(policy)) return true;
16910:     if (policy.indexOf(cap) >= 0) return true;
16911:     return (cap === "voice_call" || cap === "video_call")
16912:       && policyLooksLikeLegacyDrawerAllowAll(policy);
16913:   }
16914: 
16915:   function drawerPeerByFp(fp = state.deviceDrawerFp) {
16916:     return [...state.peers.values()].find(p => p.fingerprint === fp) || null;
16917:   }
16918: 
16919:   function drawerAllowedSet(policy) {
16920:     if (policy == null) return new Set(DRAWER_CAPS);
16921:     const allowed = new Set(policy || []);
16922:     if (policyLooksLikeLegacyDrawerAllowAll(policy)) {
16923:       allowed.add("voice_call");
16924:       allowed.add("video_call");
16925:     }
16926:     return allowed;
16927:   }
16928: 
16929:   function syncDrawerCapabilityControls(policy) {
16930:     const allowed = drawerAllowedSet(policy);
16931:     const allOn = DRAWER_CAPS.every(cap => allowed.has(cap));
16932:     const allowAll = $("#dev-allow-all");
16933:     if (allowAll) {
16934:       allowAll.checked = allOn;
16935:       const toggle = allowAll.closest(".toggle");
16936:       if (toggle) toggle.setAttribute("aria-checked", allOn ? "true" : "false");
16937:     }
16938:     document.querySelectorAll("#dev-cap-row .cap-toggle").forEach(btn => {
16939:       btn.classList.toggle("on", allowed.has(btn.dataset.cap));
16940:     });
16941:   }

16946:       if (btn.classList.contains("on")) allowed.push(btn.dataset.cap);
