17036:   // v0.8.6: render the trust-history timeline inside the device
17037:   // drawer. Lazy-loaded on toggle so a quick drawer open doesn't
17038:   // hit the DB. The rendered list is keyed off ts_ms; severity
17039:   // drives the left-rail color (good/warn/bad/info).
17040:   async function loadDrawerTrustHistory() {
17041:     const fp = state.deviceDrawerFp;
17042:     if (!fp) return;
17043:     const tl = $("#dev-trust-timeline");
17044:     if (!tl) return;
17045:     tl.innerHTML = "";
17046:     tl.appendChild(el("div", "empty", "Loading…"));
17047:     let events = [];
17048:     try {
17049:       const res = await api.get(
17050:         `/api/peers/${fp}/trust-history?limit=200`
17051:       );
17052:       events = res.events || [];
17053:     } catch (e) {
17054:       tl.innerHTML = "";
17055:       tl.appendChild(el("div", "empty", `Couldn\'t load: ${e.message || e}`));
17056:       return;
17057:     }
17058:     // Drawer might have been closed while we waited on the network.
17059:     if (state.deviceDrawerFp !== fp) return;
17060:     tl.innerHTML = "";
17061:     if (events.length === 0) {
17062:       tl.appendChild(el("div", "empty", "No recorded trust events for this device."));
17063:       return;
17064:     }
17065:     for (const ev of events) {
17066:       const sev = ev.severity || "info";
17067:       const row = el("div", `tev sev-${sev}`);
17068:       row.appendChild(el("div", "tev-time", _humanRelMs(ev.ts_ms)));
17069:       const body = el("div", "tev-body");
17070:       body.appendChild(el("div", "tev-label", ev.label || ev.kind || "(unknown)"));
17071:       if (ev.detail) {
17072:         body.appendChild(el("div", "tev-detail", ev.detail));
17073:       }
17074:       const dateLine = el("div", "tev-detail",
17075:         new Date(ev.ts_ms).toLocaleString());
17076:       dateLine.style.fontSize = "10px";
17077:       dateLine.style.opacity = "0.7";
17078:       body.appendChild(dateLine);
17079:       row.appendChild(body);
17080:       tl.appendChild(row);
17081:     }
17082:   }

17491:   // ── v0.21.1 mobile-feel polish: gesture + viewport handlers ─────
17492:   //
17493:   // Three behaviours layer onto the existing CSS responsive shell:
17494:   //
17495:   //   1. Edge-swipe-right from the left edge opens the sidebar
17496:   //      drawer. Swipe-left while the drawer is open closes it.
17497:   //      Mimics iOS / Android system back gestures so the drawer
17498:   //      feels native, not "tap the tiny hamburger".
17499:   //
17500:   //   2. visualViewport tracking keeps `.app` height matched to
17501:   //      the visible-after-keyboard area. Without this, when the
17502:   //      soft keyboard slides up, our 100dvh-sized `.app` stays
17503:   //      tall and the composer ends up BEHIND the keyboard. Modern
17504:   //      browsers also honour viewport meta `interactive-widget=
17505:   //      resizes-content`, but the JS belt-and-suspenders catches
17506:   //      iOS Safari, which still hasn't fully implemented it as
17507:   //      of 2026-05.
17508:   //
17509:   //   3. Haptic feedback hook: tiny vibration on send + reaction
17510:   //      so the user knows the gesture took. Browser API is
17511:   //      navigator.vibrate; iOS Safari ignores it (no haptics on
17512:   //      web yet), but Android Chrome / Edge / Firefox all honour
17513:   //      a 10ms tick.
17514:   //
17515:   // The handlers all no-op on desktop form-factor so a hover-only
17516:   // accidental cursor drag doesn't fire phantom gestures.
17517:   (() => {
17518:     function _isPhone() {
17519:       return document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-form-factor") === "phone";
17520:     }
17521: 
17522:     // ---- Edge-swipe drawer gesture ----
17523:     // Touch starts on the left 24px of the screen → open drawer
17524:     // (or close if already open and swiping the other way).
17525:     let touchStartX = 0;
17526:     let touchStartY = 0;
17527:     let touchStartTime = 0;
17528:     let touchActive = false;
17529:     const EDGE_ZONE_PX = 24;
17530:     const MIN_SWIPE_PX = 60;
17531:     const MAX_VERTICAL_DRIFT_PX = 50;
17532:     const MAX_SWIPE_DURATION_MS = 500;
17533: 
17534:     function onTouchStart(ev) {
17535:       if (!_isPhone()) return;
17536:       // Don't compete with any open modal / backdrop.
17537:       if (document.querySelector(
17538:         ".modal-backdrop.show, .backdrop.show, .discover-overlay.show",
17539:       )) return;
17540:       const t = ev.touches[0];
17541:       const drawerOpen = document.querySelector(".app")?.classList.contains("mobile-side-open");
17542:       // To open: must start in the left edge zone.
17543:       // To close: drawer is open and finger started anywhere right of
17544:       // the drawer's right edge (~320px) - closes via swipe-left from
17545:       // the conversation area.
17546:       if (!drawerOpen && t.clientX > EDGE_ZONE_PX) return;
17547:       if (drawerOpen && t.clientX < 100) return;  // ignore drag from inside drawer
17548:       touchStartX = t.clientX;
17549:       touchStartY = t.clientY;
17550:       touchStartTime = Date.now();
17551:       touchActive = true;
17552:     }
17553:     function onTouchEnd(ev) {
17554:       if (!touchActive) return;
17555:       touchActive = false;
17556:       const t = ev.changedTouches[0];
17557:       const dx = t.clientX - touchStartX;
17558:       const dy = Math.abs(t.clientY - touchStartY);
17559:       const dt = Date.now() - touchStartTime;
17560:       if (dt > MAX_SWIPE_DURATION_MS) return;
17561:       if (dy > MAX_VERTICAL_DRIFT_PX) return;
17562:       const drawerOpen = document.querySelector(".app")?.classList.contains("mobile-side-open");
17563:       if (!drawerOpen && dx > MIN_SWIPE_PX) {
17564:         openMobileSidebar();
17565:         _haptic(8);
17566:       } else if (drawerOpen && dx < -MIN_SWIPE_PX) {
17567:         closeMobileSidebar();
17568:         _haptic(8);
17569:       }
17570:     }
17571:     document.addEventListener("touchstart", onTouchStart, { passive: true });
17572:     document.addEventListener("touchend", onTouchEnd, { passive: true });
17573: 
17574:     // ---- visualViewport keyboard-aware sizing ----
17575:     // When the soft keyboard slides up, visualViewport.height shrinks
17576:     // by the keyboard height. We mirror that into a CSS custom prop
17577:     // --ol-vh that the composer + chat list consume so the composer
17578:     // stays just above the keyboard instead of being hidden behind it.
17579:     const _vv = window.visualViewport;
17580:     function _syncViewportHeight() {
17581:       const h = (_vv && _vv.height) ? _vv.height : window.innerHeight;
17582:       document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--ol-vh", `${h}px`);
17583:     }
17584:     if (_vv) {
17585:       _vv.addEventListener("resize", _syncViewportHeight);
17586:       _vv.addEventListener("scroll", _syncViewportHeight);
17587:     }
17588:     window.addEventListener("orientationchange", _syncViewportHeight);
17589:     _syncViewportHeight();
17590: 
17591:     // ---- Haptic feedback hook ----
17592:     // Tiny tick on send / reaction. iOS Safari ignores (no Web Vibration
17593:     // API support); Android browsers honour. Wrap in try/catch because
17594:     // some browsers (Firefox in iframe) throw on .vibrate().
17595:     function _haptic(ms) {
17596:       try { navigator.vibrate && navigator.vibrate(ms); } catch {}
17597:     }
17598:     // Expose globally so existing send / reaction handlers can use it.
17599:     window._olHaptic = _haptic;
17600: 
17601:     // Wire haptic to message-send: when the send button is tapped, fire
17602:     // an 8ms tick before the network call. Coordinated through the
17603:     // existing send button click handler so we don't double-bind.
17604:     const sendBtn = document.querySelector("#btn-send");
17605:     if (sendBtn) {
17606:       sendBtn.addEventListener("click", () => _haptic(8), { passive: true });
17607:     }
17608:   })();

17610:   async function setCapability(cap, enabled, opts = {}) {
17611:     // v0.7.3: drawer can pass an explicit `fingerprint`; otherwise
17612:     // we fall back to the currently-selected peer (legacy callers).
17613:     let fp = opts.fingerprint || null;
17614:     let peer = null;
17615:     if (fp) {
17616:       peer = [...state.peers.values()].find(p => p.fingerprint === fp) || null;
17617:     } else {
17618:       peer = state.selectedPeer ? state.peers.get(state.selectedPeer) : null;
17619:       fp = peer?.fingerprint || null;
17620:     }
17621:     if (!fp) return;
17622:     const current = peer && peer.allowed_capabilities != null
17623:       ? new Set(peer.allowed_capabilities)
17624:       : new Set(["chat", "files", "folder_sync"]);
17625:     if (enabled) current.add(cap); else current.delete(cap);
17626:     try {
17627:       const res = await api.post(
17628:         `/api/peers/${fp}/capabilities`, { allowed: [...current] }
17629:       );
17630:       if (peer) peer.allowed_capabilities = res.allowed;
17631:       toast("Peer policy updated", "good");
17632:       return res;
17633:     } catch (e) {
17634:       toast(`Policy update failed: ${e.message || e}`, "bad");
17635:       throw e;
17636:     }
17637:   }

17645:   const WHATS_NEW_KEY = "one_link.last_seen_version";
17646:   const WHATS_NEW_HIGHLIGHTS = {
17647:     "0.21.0-alpha": {
17648:       headline: "v0.21 · the build that feels finished",
17649:       items: [
17650:         "Send button never silently hangs — every outbound message gets a status pill (Sending → Queued → Failed → Retry) and a 25s hard timeout that falls into the offline queue.",
17651:         "Click any photo to open a fullscreen lightbox. Arrow keys / swipe move between every photo in this conversation.",
17652:         "Long pasted messages collapse to a preview with a Show more toggle so the chat stays readable.",
17653:         "Calls now have audible ringback + ringtone, a permission preflight, and leave a missed-call entry with Call back if no one answers.",
17654:         "Voice messages: listen back before you send, play at 1.5x / 2x, with a waveform on every bubble.",
17655:         "Unread count surfaces in the tab title, OS dock badge, and per-peer sidebar.",
17656:         "Photos shipped with EXIF stripped by default. Edit before sending: crop, draw, blur a face.",
17657:       ],

17660:   function _maybeShowWhatsNew(currentVersion) {
17661:     if (!currentVersion) return;
17662:     let lastSeen = "";
17663:     try { lastSeen = localStorage.getItem(WHATS_NEW_KEY) || ""; } catch {}
17664:     if (lastSeen === currentVersion) return;
17665:     // First-launch ever path: the welcome wizard handles the user.
17666:     // Seed the key without showing the modal so the next version
17667:     // bump shows it correctly.
17668:     const onboardingDone = (() => {
17669:       try { return localStorage.getItem(ONBOARDING_STORAGE_KEY) === "1"; }
17670:       catch { return false; }
17671:     })();
17672:     if (!lastSeen && !onboardingDone) {
17673:       try { localStorage.setItem(WHATS_NEW_KEY, currentVersion); } catch {}
17674:       return;
17675:     }
17676:     const highlights = WHATS_NEW_HIGHLIGHTS[currentVersion]
17677:       || _autoGenericWhatsNew(currentVersion);
17678:     _showWhatsNewModal(highlights, currentVersion);
17679:   }
17680:   function _autoGenericWhatsNew(version) {
17681:     return {
17682:       headline: `Updated to v${version}`,
17683:       items: [
17684:         "Bug fixes and improvements across the chat surface.",
17685:         "See the project changelog for the full list of changes.",
17686:       ],
17687:     };
17688:   }
17689:   function _showWhatsNewModal(highlights, version) {
17690:     _ensureWhatsNewModal();
17691:     const modal = document.getElementById("whatsnew-modal");
17692:     modal.querySelector(".wnm-title").textContent = highlights.headline;
17693:     const list = modal.querySelector(".wnm-items");
17694:     list.innerHTML = "";
17695:     for (const it of highlights.items) {
17696:       const li = document.createElement("li");
17697:       li.textContent = it;
17698:       list.appendChild(li);
17699:     }
17700:     const dismiss = () => {
17701:       try { localStorage.setItem(WHATS_NEW_KEY, version); } catch {}
17702:       modal.classList.remove("show");
17703:       document.body.classList.remove("wnm-open");
17704:     };
17705:     modal.querySelector(".wnm-dismiss").onclick = dismiss;
17706:     modal.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
17707:       const t = ev.target;
17708:       if (t && t instanceof Element && t.hasAttribute("data-wnm-close")) dismiss();
17709:     }, { once: false });
17710:     document.addEventListener("keydown", (ev) => {
17711:       if (ev.key === "Escape" && modal.classList.contains("show")) dismiss();
17712:     }, { once: true });
17713:     modal.classList.add("show");
17714:     document.body.classList.add("wnm-open");
17715:   }
17716:   function _ensureWhatsNewModal() {
17717:     if (document.getElementById("whatsnew-modal")) return;
17718:     const m = document.createElement("div");
17719:     m.id = "whatsnew-modal";
17720:     m.className = "wnm-modal";
17721:     m.setAttribute("role", "dialog");
17722:     m.setAttribute("aria-modal", "true");
17723:     m.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "wnm-title-id");
17724:     m.innerHTML = `
17725:       <div class="wnm-backdrop" data-wnm-close></div>
17726:       <div class="wnm-pane">
17727:         <h2 class="wnm-title" id="wnm-title-id">What's new</h2>
17728:         <ul class="wnm-items"></ul>
17729:         <div class="wnm-actions">
17730:           <button type="button" class="wnm-dismiss">Start using it</button>
17731:         </div>
17732:       </div>
17733:     `;
17734:     document.body.appendChild(m);
17735:   }

17737:   function handleLocalVersionDrift(daemonVer, pageVer, reason) {
17738:     console.warn(
17739:       `One Link page/backend drift: page=${pageVer}, daemon=${daemonVer}, reason=${reason || "version"}`,
17740:     );
17741:     // Hand off to LiveRefresh: it schedules a soft reload as soon as
17742:     // the user is idle (no draft text, no open modal, no recent typing)
17743:     // so the UI quietly upgrades itself without disrupting work.
17744:     if (typeof LiveRefresh !== "undefined" && LiveRefresh.scheduleSoftReload) {
17745:       LiveRefresh.scheduleSoftReload(daemonVer, reason || "boot");
17746:     } else {
17747:       // Fallback: should never fire because LiveRefresh is defined
17748:       // earlier in this file. Keeps behavior safe if init order
17749:       // changes someday.
17750:       const key = `ol_local_version_drift:${daemonVer}:vs:${pageVer}`;
17751:       if (sessionStorage.getItem(key) === "1") return;
17752:       sessionStorage.setItem(key, "1");
17753:       toast("One Link refreshed itself in the background. If anything feels off, reopen it.", "info", 5000);
17754:     }
17755:   }

17960:   // Keep version metadata available for diagnostics without interrupting chat.
17961:   // Cross-version operation is handled by capability negotiation and per-send
17962:   // fallbacks; the user should only see an error if an action truly fails.
17963:   function recordPeerCompatibility() {
17964:     const myV = state.me?.app_version;
17965:     if (!myV) return;
17966:     const drifted = [];
17967:     for (const p of state.peers.values()) {
17968:       if (p.trust !== "pinned") continue;
17969:       const pv = p.app_version;
17970:       if (pv && pv !== myV) {
17971:         drifted.push(`${p.hostname || p.short_id}@${pv}`);
17972:       }
17973:     }
17974:     if (drifted.length) {
17975:       console.info(`One Link peer version drift observed: local=${myV}; peers=${drifted.join(", ")}`);
17976:     }
17977:   }

17986: 
17987:   // ── LiveRefresh: smart auto-reconnect + auto-update controller ────
17988:   //
17989:   // Goals (in priority order):
17990:   //   1. Just work. Recover automatically from network blips, daemon
17991:   //      restarts, laptop sleep/wake, tab dormancy, OS-level offline,
17992:   //      and version upgrades. The user should never have to hit
17993:   //      reload or restart One Link manually for a routine event.
17994:   //   2. Don't disrupt the user. Never auto-reload while the user has
17995:   //      draft text in a composer, is mid-pair, has a modal open, or
17996:   //      typed in the last few seconds. If they're busy, defer the
17997:   //      reload until they're idle - there is no hurry.
17998:   //   3. Stay silent when normal. A brief WS reconnect (< 4s) should
17999:   //      pass without surfacing anything. Only when reconnect drags
18000:   //      do we light up the existing offline banner with a calm
18001:   //      link-repair message - same channel users already know
18002:   //      from the OS-offline path, so it reads as familiar, not new.
18003:   //   4. Never reload-loop. We persist "already refreshed for version
18004:   //      X" in sessionStorage so a misbehaving daemon can't flap us
18005:   //      into a refresh cycle.
18006:   const LiveRefresh = (() => {
18007:     let reconnectAttempts = 0;
18008:     let reconnectTimer = null;
18009:     let bannerTimer = null;
18010:     let bannerShown = false;
18011:     let pendingReloadTimer = null;
18012:     let lastInputActivity = 0;
18013:     let lastConnectedAt = 0;
18014:     let wsHadOpen = false;
18015: 
18016:     // Track any keystroke / pointer activity so we can tell whether
18017:     // the user is currently driving the UI vs idle. Used to avoid
18018:     // mid-action reloads. Capture-phase so we see events regardless
18019:     // of which handler stops propagation.
18020:     document.addEventListener("input",   () => { lastInputActivity = Date.now(); }, true);
18021:     document.addEventListener("keydown", () => { lastInputActivity = Date.now(); }, true);
18022:     document.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => { lastInputActivity = Date.now(); }, true);
18023: 
18024:     function isUserBusy() {
18025:       // Composer has draft text → user is mid-message.
18026:       const inp = document.querySelector("#input");
18027:       if (inp && inp.value && inp.value.trim().length > 0) return true;
18028:       const gInp = document.querySelector("#group-input");
18029:       if (gInp && gInp.value && gInp.value.trim().length > 0) return true;
18030:       // Any modal / backdrop currently open → defer.
18031:       if (document.querySelector(".modal-backdrop.show, .backdrop.show")) return true;
18032:       if (document.querySelector(".pair-modal.show, .pair-backdrop.show")) return true;
18033:       // Recent activity → defer (5s grace).
18034:       if (Date.now() - lastInputActivity < 5000) return true;
18035:       // Tab not visible → safe-but-not-now: don't reload a hidden
18036:       // tab (next visible focus will re-check and reload then).
18037:       if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") return true;
18038:       return false;
18039:     }
18040: 
18041:     function backoffMs() {
18042:       // Exponential: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 30s cap. ±25% jitter so
18043:       // many tabs restoring after a daemon restart don't pile in
18044:       // lock-step.
18045:       const base = Math.min(30000, 1000 * Math.pow(2, reconnectAttempts));
18046:       const jitter = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5 * base;
18047:       return Math.floor(base + jitter);
18048:     }
18049: 
18050:     function showReconnectBanner() {
18051:       if (bannerShown) return;
18052:       bannerShown = true;
18053:       const b = document.querySelector("#offline-banner");
18054:       if (!b) return;
18055:       const txt = b.querySelector("span:not(.offline-dot)");
18056:       if (txt && b._savedText == null) {
18057:         b._savedText = txt.textContent;
18058:         // doctrine-ok: §3.2.a grandfathered legacy surface (ADR-PENDING-doctrine-sweep-v0.21); reconnect banner is on the v0.21 cleanup list. Replace with silent prewarm + capsule-mode fallback per LIVING_PRESENCE_ARCHITECTURE §3.
18059:         txt.textContent = "Restoring One Link…";
18060:       }
18061:       b.classList.add("show");
18062:     }
18063: 
18064:     function hideReconnectBanner() {
18065:       if (!bannerShown && navigator.onLine !== false) return;
18066:       bannerShown = false;
18067:       const b = document.querySelector("#offline-banner");
18068:       if (!b) return;
18069:       const txt = b.querySelector("span:not(.offline-dot)");
18070:       if (txt && b._savedText != null) {
18071:         txt.textContent = b._savedText;
18072:         b._savedText = null;
18073:       }
18074:       // Only fully clear if the OS reports online. If the OS still
18075:       // says offline, the offline handler's "You're offline" copy
18076:       // belongs there.
18077:       if (navigator.onLine !== false) {
18078:         b.classList.remove("show");
18079:       } else {
18080:         // Restore the OS-offline copy (saved above already).
18081:       }
18082:     }
18083: 
18084:     function onOpen() {
18085:       reconnectAttempts = 0;
18086:       lastConnectedAt = Date.now();
18087:       const wasReconnect = wsHadOpen;
18088:       wsHadOpen = true;
18089:       if (bannerTimer) { clearTimeout(bannerTimer); bannerTimer = null; }
18090:       hideReconnectBanner();
18091:       // After a reconnect (not the very first open), the daemon may
18092:       // have upgraded. Check now so any version drift triggers a
18093:       // soft reload instead of stale-page mystery errors.
18094:       if (wasReconnect) {
18095:         checkVersionDrift();
18096:         // Best-effort refresh of UI surfaces that may have missed
18097:         // events during the gap.
18098:         try { refreshPeers && refreshPeers(); } catch {}
18099:         try { refreshTransfers && refreshTransfers(); } catch {}
18100:         try { refreshStatus && refreshStatus(); } catch {}
18101:       }
18102:     }
18103: 
18104:     function onClose() {
18105:       if (!bannerTimer) {
18106:         // Don't flash the banner for sub-4s reconnects. Most daemon
18107:         // restarts during dev / upgrade complete inside this window.
18108:         bannerTimer = setTimeout(showReconnectBanner, 4000);
18109:       }
18110:       scheduleReconnect();
18111:     }
18112: 
18113:     function scheduleReconnect() {
18114:       if (reconnectTimer) return;
18115:       const delay = backoffMs();
18116:       reconnectAttempts++;
18117:       reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
18118:         reconnectTimer = null;
18119:         try { connectWS(); }
18120:         catch (e) {
18121:           // connectWS itself blew up (e.g. invalid host). Treat as
18122:           // a close; the next backoff slot will try again.
18123:           onClose();
18124:         }
18125:       }, delay);
18126:     }
18127: 
18128:     function forceReconnectNow() {
18129:       // Used by visibilitychange / network-restored. Cancel pending
18130:       // backoff, reset attempt counter, fire immediately.
18131:       if (reconnectTimer) { clearTimeout(reconnectTimer); reconnectTimer = null; }
18132:       reconnectAttempts = 0;
18133:       try { connectWS(); } catch { scheduleReconnect(); }
18134:     }
18135: 
18136:     async function checkVersionDrift() {
18137:       try {
18138:         const me = await api.get("/api/me");
18139:         const v = me && me.app_version;
18140:         const fp = me && me.source_fingerprint;
18141:         if (v && v !== PAGE_BUILT_FOR) {
18142:           scheduleSoftReload(v, "reconnect");
18143:           return;
18144:         }
18145:         if (
18146:           fp
18147:           && PAGE_SOURCE_FINGERPRINT !== "__ONE_LINK_SOURCE_FINGERPRINT__"
18148:           && fp !== PAGE_SOURCE_FINGERPRINT
18149:         ) {
18150:           scheduleSoftReload(`${v || PAGE_BUILT_FOR}:${fp}`, "source");
18151:         }
18152:       } catch {
18153:         // Ignore - we'll get another shot on the next reconnect.
18154:       }
18155:     }
18156: 
18157:     function scheduleSoftReload(targetVersion, reason) {
18158:       // Loop guard: never refresh twice for the same daemon version
18159:       // in one tab session.
18160:       const key = `ol_refreshed_for_version:${targetVersion}`;
18161:       if (sessionStorage.getItem(key) === "1") return;
18162:       if (pendingReloadTimer) return;
18163:       console.info(`LiveRefresh: daemon version drift (${PAGE_BUILT_FOR} → ${targetVersion}); reason=${reason}; scheduling soft reload when idle.`);
18164: 
18165:       let waitedMs = 0;
18166:       function attempt() {
18167:         pendingReloadTimer = null;
18168:         if (isUserBusy()) {
18169:           // Defer up to 5 minutes; after that, just reload - the
18170:           // user might have walked away leaving draft text behind,
18171:           // and a stale page is more dangerous than a lost draft.
18172:           if (waitedMs >= 5 * 60 * 1000) {
18173:             doReload();
18174:             return;
18175:           }
18176:           waitedMs += 10000;
18177:           pendingReloadTimer = setTimeout(attempt, 10000);
18178:           return;
18179:         }
18180:         doReload();
18181:       }
18182:       function doReload() {
18183:         sessionStorage.setItem(key, "1");
18184:         toast("Updating One Link…", "info", 2500);
18185:         // Give the toast ~1 frame to render before reload yanks the
18186:         // page out from under it. Use a short delay (not setImmediate)
18187:         // so the user actually sees the reassuring copy.
18188:         setTimeout(() => {
18189:           try { location.reload(); }
18190:           catch { location.href = location.href; }
18191:         }, 800);
18192:       }
18193:       // Initial 2s settle window so a noisy reconnect (multiple
18194:       // open/close handshakes during a daemon restart) doesn't
18195:       // race us to reload before the daemon stabilizes.
18196:       pendingReloadTimer = setTimeout(attempt, 2000);
18197:     }
18198: 
18199:     function attachWindowHandlers() {
18200:       // Tab returns to foreground → daemon may have restarted while
18201:       // we were dormant. Force a reconnect and re-check version.
18202:       document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
18203:         if (document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
18204:         if (!ws || ws.readyState >= 2 /* CLOSING|CLOSED */) {
18205:           forceReconnectNow();
18206:         } else if (ws.readyState === 1 /* OPEN */) {
18207:           // Long-dormant tab: WS might be a half-open zombie, and
18208:           // the daemon may have upgraded. Probe + check.
18209:           checkVersionDrift();
18210:         }
18211:       });
18212:       // OS reports network-up → reconnect immediately, don't wait
18213:       // for the backoff window.
18214:       window.addEventListener("online", () => {
18215:         forceReconnectNow();
18216:       });
18217:     }
18218: 
18219:     return {
18220:       onOpen, onClose,
18221:       forceReconnectNow,
18222:       scheduleSoftReload,
18223:       checkVersionDrift,
18224:       attachWindowHandlers,
18225:       isUserBusy,
18226:     };
18227:   })();
18228: 
18229:   // ── WebSocket live events ──────────────────────────────────────────
18230:   let ws = null;
18231:   function connectWS() {
18232:     try { if (ws) ws.close(); } catch {}
18233:     const proto = location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss:" : "ws:";
18234:     ws = new WebSocket(`${proto}//${location.host}/api/events`);
18235:     ws.onopen = LiveRefresh.onOpen;
18236:     ws.onmessage = (ev) => {
18237:       let m;
18238:       try { m = JSON.parse(ev.data); } catch { return; }

18709:   input.addEventListener("input", () => {
18710:     refreshSendEnabled();
18711:     saveActiveDraft();
18712:     input.style.height = "auto";
18713:     input.style.height = Math.min(160, input.scrollHeight) + "px";
18714:   });
18715:   input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
18716:     if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
18717:       e.preventDefault();
18718:       sendCurrent();
18719:     }
18720:   });
18721:   sendBtn.addEventListener("click", sendCurrent);
18722: 
18723:   // ── Staging tray (paste/drop/attach all stage instead of auto-send) ─
18724:   function readDataUrl(file) {
18725:     return new Promise((resolve) => {
18726:       if (!file.type?.startsWith("image/")) { resolve(null); return; }
18727:       const r = new FileReader();
18728:       r.onload = () => resolve(r.result);
18729:       r.onerror = () => resolve(null);
18730:       r.readAsDataURL(file);
18731:     });
18732:   }
18733:   async function stageFile(file) {
18734:     if (!file) return;
18735:     // v0.21.x: EXIF / metadata stripping for images. Camera photos
18736:     // carry GPS coords + camera model + timestamp by default; sending
18737:     // those reveals where and how a photo was taken. We re-encode
18738:     // through canvas (which discards all EXIF) UNLESS the user
18739:     // explicitly opted in to keep metadata via the per-tenant
18740:     // runtime setting. JPEG-quality 92 + size preserved at original
18741:     // pixel dims — only metadata changes.
18742:     const stripExif = state.runtimeSettings?.keep_image_metadata !== true;
18743:     let workingFile = file;
18744:     if (stripExif && _isImageFileForStrip(file)) {
18745:       try {
18746:         workingFile = await _stripImageMetadata(file);
18747:       } catch (e) {
18748:         // Best-effort: if re-encode fails (unsupported format, OOM),
18749:         // fall back to the original file rather than blocking the send.
18750:         console.warn("EXIF strip failed, sending original:", e);
18751:       }
18752:     }
18753:     const id = ++state.stagedSeq;
18754:     const dataUrl = await readDataUrl(workingFile);
18755:     state.staged.push({ id, file: workingFile, dataUrl });
18756:     renderStaging();
18757:     refreshSendEnabled();
18758:   }
18759:   function _isImageFileForStrip(file) {
18760:     const type = (file?.type || "").toLowerCase();
18761:     if (type === "image/jpeg" || type === "image/jpg" || type === "image/png" || type === "image/webp") return true;
18762:     // Some browsers leave file.type empty — sniff by extension.
18763:     const ext = (file?.name || "").split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() || "";
18764:     return ext === "jpg" || ext === "jpeg" || ext === "png" || ext === "webp";
18765:   }
18766:   async function _stripImageMetadata(file) {
18767:     const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
18768:     try {
18769:       const img = await new Promise((res, rej) => {
18770:         const i = new Image();
18771:         i.onload = () => res(i);
18772:         i.onerror = rej;
18773:         i.src = url;
18774:       });
18775:       const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
18776:       canvas.width = img.naturalWidth;
18777:       canvas.height = img.naturalHeight;
18778:       const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
18779:       ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
18780:       const outType = file.type === "image/png" ? "image/png" : "image/jpeg";
18781:       const quality = outType === "image/jpeg" ? 0.92 : undefined;
18782:       const blob = await new Promise((res) => canvas.toBlob(res, outType, quality));
18783:       if (!blob) return file;
18784:       return new File([blob], file.name, {
18785:         type: outType,
18786:         lastModified: file.lastModified,
18787:       });
18788:     } finally {
18789:       URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
18790:     }
18791:   }
18792:   function removeStaged(id) {
18793:     state.staged = state.staged.filter(s => s.id !== id);
18794:     renderStaging();
18795:     refreshSendEnabled();
18796:   }
18797:   function renderStaging() {
18798:     tray.innerHTML = "";
18799:     if (state.staged.length === 0) {
18800:       tray.classList.remove("show");
18801:       return;
18802:     }
18803:     tray.classList.add("show");
18804:     for (const s of state.staged) {
18805:       const chip = el("div", "chip");
18806:       const thumb = el("div", "thumb");
18807:       if (s.dataUrl) {
18808:         const img = document.createElement("img");
18809:         img.src = s.dataUrl;
18810:         thumb.appendChild(img);
18811:         // v0.21.x: edit affordance on image chips. Click thumb edge
18812:         // pencil OR double-click thumb itself opens the markup
18813:         // editor. Crop / pen / blur + undo + save replaces the
18814:         // staged file with the edited version.
18815:         if (_isImageFileForStrip(s.file)) {
18816:           const editBtn = document.createElement("button");
18817:           editBtn.type = "button";
18818:           editBtn.className = "chip-edit-btn";
18819:           editBtn.title = "Edit image (crop, draw, blur)";
18820:           editBtn.textContent = "✎";
18821:           editBtn.onclick = (ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); openImageEditor(s); };
18822:           thumb.appendChild(editBtn);
18823:           thumb.ondblclick = (ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); openImageEditor(s); };
18824:         }
18825:       } else {
18826:         thumb.textContent = fileIcon(s.file.name);
18827:       }
18828:       const meta = el("div", "meta");
18829:       // v0.21.x: inline-editable filename. Click → contenteditable
18830:       // → blur or Enter commits. Keeps "1779063202010_*.png"-style
18831:       // ugly names out of the receiver's chat history. Updates the
18832:       // File object on commit (browser File constructor preserves
18833:       // content + type; new instance gets the friendlier name).
18834:       const nameEl = el("div", "name editable", s.file.name);
18835:       nameEl.title = "Click to rename before sending";
18836:       nameEl.tabIndex = 0;
18837:       nameEl.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
18838:         ev.stopPropagation();
18839:         _beginRenameStaged(nameEl, s);
18840:       });
18841:       nameEl.addEventListener("keydown", (ev) => {
18842:         if (ev.key === "Enter" || ev.key === " ") {
18843:           ev.preventDefault();
18844:           _beginRenameStaged(nameEl, s);
18845:         }
18846:       });
18847:       meta.appendChild(nameEl);
18848:       meta.appendChild(el("div", "size", fmtBytes(s.file.size)));
18849:       const x = el("button", "x", "×");
18850:       x.title = "Remove";
18851:       x.onclick = () => removeStaged(s.id);
18852:       chip.appendChild(thumb);
18853:       chip.appendChild(meta);
18854:       chip.appendChild(x);
18855:       tray.appendChild(chip);
18856:     }
18857:   }
18858:   // v0.21.x: image markup editor for staged photos. Pen / blur /
18859:   // crop with undo. Output replaces the staged File so the receiver
18860:   // sees the edited version. Pure Canvas2D — no external deps.
18861:   //
18862:   // Op model: each user action pushes onto an `ops` stack. Render =
18863:   // baseImage → apply each op in order → render live stroke on top.
18864:   // Save flattens to a JPEG / PNG depending on source type.
18865:   const _editorState = {
18866:     chipId: null,
18867:     baseImage: null,
18868:     width: 0,
18869:     height: 0,
18870:     ops: [],
18871:     activeOp: null,
18872:     tool: "pen",
18873:     color: "#ff4d4d",
18874:     penSize: 4,
18875:     blurRadius: 14,
18876:     scale: 1,
18877:     pointer: null,
18878:   };
18879:   async function openImageEditor(staged) {
18880:     _ensureImageEditorModal();
18881:     const modal = document.getElementById("image-editor-modal");
18882:     const canvas = modal.querySelector(".iem-canvas");
18883:     const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
18884:     const stageUrl = URL.createObjectURL(staged.file);
18885:     const img = await new Promise((res, rej) => {
18886:       const i = new Image();
18887:       i.onload = () => res(i);
18888:       i.onerror = rej;
18889:       i.src = stageUrl;
18890:     });
18891:     _editorState.chipId = staged.id;
18892:     _editorState.baseImage = img;
18893:     _editorState.width = img.naturalWidth;
18894:     _editorState.height = img.naturalHeight;
18895:     _editorState.ops = [];
18896:     _editorState.activeOp = null;
18897:     _editorState.tool = "pen";
18898:     _editorState.color = "#ff4d4d";
18899:     _editorState.penSize = 4;
18900:     _editorState.blurRadius = 14;
18901:     _resizeEditorCanvas(canvas);
18902:     _redrawEditor();
18903:     URL.revokeObjectURL(stageUrl);
18904:     _attachEditorHandlers(canvas);
18905:     modal.classList.add("show");
18906:     document.body.classList.add("iem-open");
18907:   }
18908:   function _resizeEditorCanvas(canvas) {
18909:     const maxW = Math.min(window.innerWidth * 0.92, 1100);
18910:     const maxH = Math.min(window.innerHeight * 0.78, 720);
18911:     const aspect = _editorState.width / _editorState.height;
18912:     let w = _editorState.width;
18913:     let h = _editorState.height;
18914:     if (w > maxW) { w = maxW; h = w / aspect; }
18915:     if (h > maxH) { h = maxH; w = h * aspect; }
18916:     _editorState.scale = w / _editorState.width;
18917:     canvas.style.width = `${w}px`;
18918:     canvas.style.height = `${h}px`;
18919:     canvas.width = _editorState.width;
18920:     canvas.height = _editorState.height;
18921:   }
18922:   function _redrawEditor() {
18923:     const canvas = document.querySelector("#image-editor-modal .iem-canvas");
18924:     if (!canvas) return;
18925:     const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
18926:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
18927:     ctx.drawImage(_editorState.baseImage, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
18928:     for (const op of _editorState.ops) _applyOp(ctx, op, canvas);
18929:     if (_editorState.activeOp) _applyOp(ctx, _editorState.activeOp, canvas);
18930:     // Crop preview rectangle (active crop op is rendered as a marquee)
18931:     if (_editorState.tool === "crop" && _editorState.activeOp?.type === "crop-marquee") {
18932:       const r = _editorState.activeOp.rect;
18933:       ctx.save();
18934:       ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.9)";
18935:       ctx.lineWidth = 2 / _editorState.scale;
18936:       ctx.setLineDash([6 / _editorState.scale, 4 / _editorState.scale]);
18937:       ctx.strokeRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
18938:       ctx.restore();
18939:     }
18940:   }
18941:   function _applyOp(ctx, op, canvas) {
18942:     if (op.type === "pen") {
18943:       if (!op.points || op.points.length === 0) return;
18944:       ctx.save();
18945:       ctx.strokeStyle = op.color;
18946:       ctx.lineWidth = op.size;
18947:       ctx.lineCap = "round";
18948:       ctx.lineJoin = "round";
18949:       ctx.beginPath();
18950:       ctx.moveTo(op.points[0].x, op.points[0].y);
18951:       for (let i = 1; i < op.points.length; i++) {
18952:         ctx.lineTo(op.points[i].x, op.points[i].y);
18953:       }
18954:       ctx.stroke();
18955:       ctx.restore();
18956:     } else if (op.type === "blur") {
18957:       if (!op.points || op.points.length === 0) return;
18958:       // Draw a blurred copy of the canvas region into an off-screen
18959:       // canvas, then composite back through a path mask. Two passes
18960:       // keep the live preview cheap.
18961:       const off = document.createElement("canvas");
18962:       off.width = canvas.width;
18963:       off.height = canvas.height;
18964:       const octx = off.getContext("2d");
18965:       octx.filter = `blur(${op.radius}px)`;
18966:       octx.drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);
18967:       ctx.save();
18968:       ctx.beginPath();
18969:       for (const p of op.points) {
18970:         ctx.moveTo(p.x + op.radius * 1.6, p.y);
18971:         ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, op.radius * 1.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
18972:       }
18973:       ctx.clip();
18974:       ctx.drawImage(off, 0, 0);
18975:       ctx.restore();
18976:     } else if (op.type === "crop") {
18977:       // Crop is destructive — applied at apply-crop time, not in
18978:       // the live op stack. Handled by _applyCrop().
18979:     }
18980:   }
18981:   function _attachEditorHandlers(canvas) {
18982:     if (canvas._handlersAttached) return;
18983:     canvas._handlersAttached = true;
18984:     function ptFromEvent(ev) {
18985:       const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
18986:       const x = (ev.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width * canvas.width;
18987:       const y = (ev.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height * canvas.height;
18988:       return { x, y };
18989:     }
18990:     canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (ev) => {
18991:       canvas.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId);
18992:       const p = ptFromEvent(ev);
18993:       const t = _editorState.tool;
18994:       if (t === "pen") {
18995:         _editorState.activeOp = {
18996:           type: "pen",
18997:           color: _editorState.color,
18998:           size: _editorState.penSize / _editorState.scale,
18999:           points: [p],
19000:         };
19001:       } else if (t === "blur") {
19002:         _editorState.activeOp = {
19003:           type: "blur",
19004:           radius: _editorState.blurRadius / _editorState.scale,
19005:           points: [p],
19006:         };
19007:       } else if (t === "crop") {
19008:         _editorState.activeOp = {
19009:           type: "crop-marquee",
19010:           rect: { x: p.x, y: p.y, w: 0, h: 0 },
19011:           startX: p.x,
19012:           startY: p.y,
19013:         };
19014:       }
19015:       _redrawEditor();
19016:     });
19017:     canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (ev) => {
19018:       if (!_editorState.activeOp) return;
19019:       const p = ptFromEvent(ev);
19020:       const op = _editorState.activeOp;
19021:       if (op.type === "pen" || op.type === "blur") {
19022:         op.points.push(p);
19023:       } else if (op.type === "crop-marquee") {
19024:         op.rect.x = Math.min(op.startX, p.x);
19025:         op.rect.y = Math.min(op.startY, p.y);
19026:         op.rect.w = Math.abs(p.x - op.startX);
19027:         op.rect.h = Math.abs(p.y - op.startY);
19028:       }
19029:       _redrawEditor();
19030:     });
19031:     function endStroke() {
19032:       const op = _editorState.activeOp;
19033:       if (op) {
19034:         if (op.type === "pen" || op.type === "blur") {
19035:           _editorState.ops.push(op);
19036:         }
19037:         // crop-marquee stays as activeOp until user clicks Apply crop
19038:         if (op.type !== "crop-marquee") _editorState.activeOp = null;
19039:       }
19040:       _redrawEditor();
19041:       _refreshEditorToolbarState();
19042:     }
19043:     canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", endStroke);
19044:     canvas.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => {
19045:       // Don't end strokes when pointer briefly leaves; only on up.
19046:     });
19047:     canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", endStroke);
19048:   }
19049:   function _refreshEditorToolbarState() {
19050:     const modal = document.getElementById("image-editor-modal");
19051:     if (!modal) return;
19052:     const undoBtn = modal.querySelector(".iem-undo");
19053:     const applyCropBtn = modal.querySelector(".iem-apply-crop");
19054:     undoBtn.disabled = _editorState.ops.length === 0;
19055:     const hasCrop = _editorState.activeOp?.type === "crop-marquee"
19056:       && _editorState.activeOp.rect.w > 4
19057:       && _editorState.activeOp.rect.h > 4;
19058:     applyCropBtn.style.display = hasCrop ? "" : "none";
19059:   }
19060:   function _undoEditorOp() {
19061:     if (_editorState.ops.length === 0) return;
19062:     _editorState.ops.pop();
19063:     _redrawEditor();
19064:     _refreshEditorToolbarState();
19065:   }
19066:   function _applyCrop() {
19067:     const op = _editorState.activeOp;
19068:     if (op?.type !== "crop-marquee" || op.rect.w < 4 || op.rect.h < 4) return;
19069:     // Bake current state into a new baseImage at the crop rect.
19070:     const canvas = document.querySelector("#image-editor-modal .iem-canvas");
19071:     const off = document.createElement("canvas");
19072:     off.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(op.rect.w));
19073:     off.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(op.rect.h));
19074:     const octx = off.getContext("2d");
19075:     octx.drawImage(canvas, op.rect.x, op.rect.y, op.rect.w, op.rect.h,
19076:                    0, 0, off.width, off.height);
19077:     const dataUrl = off.toDataURL("image/png");
19078:     const img = new Image();
19079:     img.onload = () => {
19080:       _editorState.baseImage = img;
19081:       _editorState.width = img.naturalWidth;
19082:       _editorState.height = img.naturalHeight;
19083:       _editorState.ops = [];
19084:       _editorState.activeOp = null;
19085:       _resizeEditorCanvas(canvas);
19086:       _redrawEditor();
19087:       _refreshEditorToolbarState();
19088:     };
19089:     img.src = dataUrl;
19090:   }
19091:   function _saveEditor() {
19092:     const canvas = document.querySelector("#image-editor-modal .iem-canvas");
19093:     if (!canvas) return;
19094:     // Discard any active crop marquee before save.
19095:     if (_editorState.activeOp?.type === "crop-marquee") {
19096:       _editorState.activeOp = null;
19097:       _redrawEditor();
19098:     }
19099:     canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
19100:       if (!blob) return;
19101:       const staged = state.staged.find((s) => s.id === _editorState.chipId);
19102:       if (!staged) { _closeEditor(); return; }
19103:       const newName = staged.file.name.replace(/\.(png|jpe?g|webp)$/i, ".png")
19104:                       || `edited-${Date.now()}.png`;
19105:       try {
19106:         staged.file = new File([blob], newName, {
19107:           type: "image/png",
19108:           lastModified: Date.now(),
19109:         });
19110:       } catch {
19111:         staged.displayName = newName;
19112:       }
19113:       readDataUrl(staged.file).then((du) => {
19114:         staged.dataUrl = du;
19115:         renderStaging();
19116:       });
19117:       _closeEditor();
19118:       toast("Image updated. Click Send when ready.", "good", 3000);
19119:     }, "image/png");
19120:   }
19121:   function _closeEditor() {
19122:     const modal = document.getElementById("image-editor-modal");
19123:     if (modal) {
19124:       modal.classList.remove("show");
19125:       document.body.classList.remove("iem-open");
19126:     }
19127:     _editorState.baseImage = null;
19128:     _editorState.ops = [];
19129:     _editorState.activeOp = null;
19130:   }
19131:   function _ensureImageEditorModal() {
19132:     if (document.getElementById("image-editor-modal")) return;
19133:     const m = document.createElement("div");
19134:     m.id = "image-editor-modal";
19135:     m.className = "iem-modal";
19136:     m.setAttribute("role", "dialog");
19137:     m.setAttribute("aria-modal", "true");
19138:     m.setAttribute("aria-label", "Edit image");
19139:     m.innerHTML = `
19140:       <div class="iem-backdrop"></div>
19141:       <div class="iem-pane">
19142:         <div class="iem-toolbar">
19143:           <div class="iem-tools">
19144:             <button type="button" class="iem-tool" data-tool="pen" title="Draw">✏️ Pen</button>
19145:             <button type="button" class="iem-tool" data-tool="blur" title="Blur a region">⬜ Blur</button>
19146:             <button type="button" class="iem-tool" data-tool="crop" title="Crop">✂ Crop</button>
19147:           </div>
19148:           <div class="iem-color-row" data-color-row>
19149:             <button type="button" class="iem-color" data-color="#ff4d4d" style="background:#ff4d4d"></button>
19150:             <button type="button" class="iem-color" data-color="#ffd83b" style="background:#ffd83b"></button>
19151:             <button type="button" class="iem-color" data-color="#46d39a" style="background:#46d39a"></button>
19152:             <button type="button" class="iem-color" data-color="#5b9bff" style="background:#5b9bff"></button>
19153:             <button type="button" class="iem-color" data-color="#ffffff" style="background:#ffffff"></button>
19154:           </div>
19155:           <div class="iem-actions">
19156:             <button type="button" class="iem-undo" disabled>Undo</button>
19157:             <button type="button" class="iem-apply-crop" style="display:none">Apply crop</button>
19158:             <button type="button" class="iem-cancel">Cancel</button>
19159:             <button type="button" class="iem-save">Save</button>
19160:           </div>
19161:         </div>
19162:         <div class="iem-canvas-wrap">
19163:           <canvas class="iem-canvas"></canvas>
19164:         </div>
19165:       </div>
19166:     `;
19167:     document.body.appendChild(m);
19168:     // Wire toolbar handlers.
19169:     m.querySelectorAll(".iem-tool").forEach((btn) => {
19170:       btn.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
19171:         ev.stopPropagation();
19172:         const tool = btn.dataset.tool;
19173:         _editorState.tool = tool;
19174:         m.querySelectorAll(".iem-tool").forEach((x) =>
19175:           x.classList.toggle("active", x === btn));
19176:         const colorRow = m.querySelector("[data-color-row]");
19177:         if (colorRow) colorRow.style.display = tool === "pen" ? "" : "none";
19178:         // Cancel any in-flight crop marquee when switching tools.
19179:         if (tool !== "crop" && _editorState.activeOp?.type === "crop-marquee") {
19180:           _editorState.activeOp = null;
19181:           _redrawEditor();
19182:         }
19183:         _refreshEditorToolbarState();
19184:       });
19185:     });
19186:     m.querySelectorAll(".iem-color").forEach((btn) => {
19187:       btn.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
19188:         ev.stopPropagation();
19189:         _editorState.color = btn.dataset.color;
19190:         m.querySelectorAll(".iem-color").forEach((x) =>
19191:           x.classList.toggle("active", x === btn));
19192:       });
19193:     });
19194:     m.querySelector(".iem-undo").addEventListener("click", _undoEditorOp);
19195:     m.querySelector(".iem-apply-crop").addEventListener("click", _applyCrop);
19196:     m.querySelector(".iem-cancel").addEventListener("click", _closeEditor);
19197:     m.querySelector(".iem-save").addEventListener("click", _saveEditor);
19198:     // Default tool + color visual state.
19199:     m.querySelector(".iem-tool[data-tool='pen']").classList.add("active");
19200:     m.querySelector(".iem-color[data-color='#ff4d4d']").classList.add("active");
19201:     document.addEventListener("keydown", (ev) => {
19202:       if (!m.classList.contains("show")) return;
19203:       if (ev.key === "Escape") _closeEditor();
19204:       else if (ev.key === "z" && (ev.ctrlKey || ev.metaKey)) { ev.preventDefault(); _undoEditorOp(); }
19205:     });
19206:   }
19207: 
19208:   // v0.21.x: inline rename for staged files. Replaces the static
19209:   // filename label with a focused input; commits on blur/Enter,
19210:   // cancels on Escape. Sanitises to drop path-separator chars +
19211:   // disallow empty + cap at 255 chars.
19212:   function _beginRenameStaged(nameEl, s) {
19213:     const original = s.file.name;
19214:     const input = document.createElement("input");
19215:     input.type = "text";
19216:     input.className = "name-edit";
19217:     input.value = original;
19218:     input.maxLength = 255;
19219:     input.setAttribute("aria-label", "Rename staged file");
19220:     nameEl.replaceWith(input);
19221:     input.focus();
19222:     input.select();
19223:     const commit = () => {
19224:       const raw = input.value.trim();
19225:       const sanitised = raw.replace(/[\\\/]/g, "_").slice(0, 255);
19226:       const next = sanitised || original;
19227:       if (next !== original) {
19228:         try {
19229:           s.file = new File([s.file], next, {
19230:             type: s.file.type,
19231:             lastModified: s.file.lastModified,
19232:           });
19233:         } catch {
19234:           // Older browsers without File-renaming support: best-effort
19235:           // overlay name so the chip + send-time receiver still see
19236:           // the friendlier label.
19237:           s.displayName = next;
19238:         }
19239:       }
19240:       renderStaging();
19241:     };
19242:     input.addEventListener("blur", commit);
19243:     input.addEventListener("keydown", (ev) => {
19244:       if (ev.key === "Enter") { ev.preventDefault(); input.blur(); }
19245:       else if (ev.key === "Escape") { ev.preventDefault(); renderStaging(); }
19246:     });
19247:   }

19249:   // ── Multi-select + forward (v0.10.1) ──────────────────────────────
19250:   // Right-click any message → enters selection mode + selects it.
19251:   // Click any message in selection mode → toggle. Top action bar
19252:   // surfaces Forward / Copy / Pin / Delete / Cancel.
19253:   state.selecting = false;
19254:   state.selectedMessageIds = new Set();
19255: 
19256:   function enterSelection(seedMsgId) {
19257:     state.selecting = true;
19258:     state.selectedMessageIds = new Set();
19259:     if (seedMsgId) state.selectedMessageIds.add(seedMsgId);
19260:     document.querySelector("#messages")?.classList.add("selecting");
19261:     renderSelectionBar();
19262:     paintSelectionMarks();
19263:   }
19264:   function exitSelection() {
19265:     state.selecting = false;
19266:     state.selectedMessageIds.clear();
19267:     document.querySelector("#messages")?.classList.remove("selecting");
19268:     $("#select-bar").style.display = "none";
19269:     paintSelectionMarks();
19270:   }
19271:   function toggleMessageSelected(msgId) {
19272:     if (!state.selecting) return;
19273:     if (state.selectedMessageIds.has(msgId)) {
19274:       state.selectedMessageIds.delete(msgId);
19275:     } else {
19276:       state.selectedMessageIds.add(msgId);
19277:     }
19278:     if (state.selectedMessageIds.size === 0) {
19279:       exitSelection();
19280:       return;
19281:     }
19282:     renderSelectionBar();
19283:     paintSelectionMarks();
19284:   }
19285:   function paintSelectionMarks() {
19286:     document.querySelectorAll("#messages .msg").forEach((b) => {
19287:       const id = b.dataset.msgId;
19288:       b.classList.toggle("selected", !!id && state.selectedMessageIds.has(id));
19289:     });
19290:   }
19291:   function renderSelectionBar() {
19292:     const bar = $("#select-bar");
19293:     if (!bar) return;
19294:     const n = state.selectedMessageIds.size;
19295:     if (n === 0) {
19296:       bar.style.display = "none";
19297:       return;
19298:     }
19299:     bar.style.display = "flex";
19300:     $("#sb-count").textContent =
19301:       `${n} selected`;
19302:     // Disable Delete unless ALL selected are our own messages within
19303:     // the 5-min edit cooldown (mirrors per-bubble Delete eligibility).
19304:     const allOursAndRecent = _selectedMessages().every((m) => {
19305:       if (m.dir !== "out" || m.deleted) return false;
19306:       return Date.now() - (m.ts || 0) < 5 * 60 * 1000;
19307:     });
19308:     $("#sb-delete").disabled = !allOursAndRecent;
19309:     $("#sb-delete").style.opacity = allOursAndRecent ? "1" : ".4";
19310:   }
19311:   function _selectedMessages() {
19312:     // Resolves the set of msg_ids back to message records from
19313:     // state.messages OR state.groupMessages depending on context.
19314:     const all = state.selectedGroup
19315:       ? (state.groupMessages || [])
19316:       : (state.messages || []);
19317:     const ids = state.selectedMessageIds;
19318:     return all.filter((m) => ids.has(m.id));
19319:   }

19321:   function bindSelectionToBubble(b, msg) {
19322:     // Right-click enters selection mode + adds this msg.
19323:     b.addEventListener("contextmenu", (e) => {
19324:       e.preventDefault();
19325:       if (!state.selecting) {
19326:         enterSelection(msg.id);
19327:       } else {
19328:         toggleMessageSelected(msg.id);
19329:       }
19330:     });
19331:     // While selecting, plain click toggles.
19332:     b.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
19333:       if (!state.selecting) return;
19334:       // Don't intercept clicks on inline links inside the bubble.
19335:       if (e.target.tagName === "A") return;
19336:       e.stopPropagation();
19337:       toggleMessageSelected(msg.id);
19338:     });
19339:   }

19342:   async function selectionCopy() {
19343:     const lines = _selectedMessages()
19344:       .sort((a, b) => (a.ts || 0) - (b.ts || 0))
19345:       .map((m) => m.body || "");
19346:     const text = lines.join("\n");
19347:     try {
19348:       await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
19349:       toast(`Copied ${lines.length} message${lines.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`,
19350:             "good", 2000);
19351:     } catch (e) {
19352:       toast(`Copy didn't work: ${e.message || e}`, "bad");
19353:     }
19354:     exitSelection();
19355:   }
19356:   async function selectionDelete() {
19357:     const msgs = _selectedMessages();
19358:     if (msgs.length === 0) return;
19359:     if (!confirm(`Delete ${msgs.length} message${msgs.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}?\n\nThis tombstones them locally and (when reachable) on the recipient's device.`)) return;
19360:     let ok = 0, fail = 0;
19361:     for (const m of msgs) {
19362:       try {
19363:         await api.post(`/api/messages/${encodeURIComponent(m.id)}/delete`, {});
19364:         ok += 1;
19365:       } catch { fail += 1; }
19366:     }
19367:     toast(
19368:       fail === 0 ? `Deleted ${ok}.` : `Deleted ${ok}, ${fail} failed.`,
19369:       fail === 0 ? "good" : "warn",
19370:     );
19371:     exitSelection();
19372:     await loadHistory();
19373:   }
19374:   async function selectionPin() {
19375:     const msgs = _selectedMessages();
19376:     if (msgs.length === 0) return;
19377:     let ok = 0;
19378:     for (const m of msgs) {
19379:       try {
19380:         if (!isPinned(m)) {
19381:           togglePin(m);
19382:           ok += 1;
19383:         }
19384:       } catch {}
19385:     }
19386:     toast(`Pinned ${ok} message${ok === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`, "good", 2000);
19387:     exitSelection();
19388:   }

19391:   function openForwardPicker() {
19392:     const msgs = _selectedMessages();
19393:     if (msgs.length === 0) return;
19394:     $("#forward-summary").textContent =
19395:       `Choose where to send ${msgs.length} message${msgs.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`;
19396:     $("#forward-search").value = "";

19401:   function closeForwardPicker() {

19404:   function renderForwardTargets(filter) {
19405:     const list = $("#forward-list");
19406:     list.innerHTML = "";
19407:     const f = (filter || "").toLowerCase();
19408:     // Pinned peers first, then groups.
19409:     const peers = [...state.peers.values()]
19410:       .filter((p) => p.trust === "pinned")
19411:       .filter((p) => {
19412:         if (!f) return true;
19413:         const name = (p.display_name || p.hostname || p.short_id).toLowerCase();
19414:         return name.includes(f);
19415:       });
19416:     const groups = [...(state.groups?.values?.() || [])]
19417:       .filter((g) => !f || (g.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(f));
19418:     if (peers.length === 0 && groups.length === 0) {
19419:       list.appendChild(el("div", "empty", "Nothing matches. Try fewer words."));
19420:       return;
19421:     }
19422:     for (const p of peers) {
19423:       const row = el("div", "forward-row");
19424:       const init = (p.display_name || p.hostname || p.short_id || "?")[0];
19425:       row.appendChild(el("div", "fr-icon", init.toUpperCase()));
19426:       row.appendChild(el("div", "fr-name",
19427:         p.display_name || p.hostname || p.short_id));
19428:       row.appendChild(el("div", "fr-kind", "Device"));
19429:       row.onclick = () => forwardTo({ peer_short_id: p.short_id });
19430:       list.appendChild(row);
19431:     }
19432:     for (const g of groups) {
19433:       const row = el("div", "forward-row");
19434:       row.appendChild(el("div", "fr-icon", "👥"));
19435:       row.appendChild(el("div", "fr-name", g.name || "(unnamed group)"));
19436:       row.appendChild(el("div", "fr-kind", "Group"));
19437:       row.onclick = () => forwardTo({ group_id: g.group_id });
19438:       list.appendChild(row);
19439:     }
19440:   }
19441:   async function forwardTo(target) {
19442:     const msgs = _selectedMessages()
19443:       .sort((a, b) => (a.ts || 0) - (b.ts || 0));
19444:     if (msgs.length === 0) return;
19445:     closeForwardPicker();
19446:     const sending = toast(`Forwarding ${msgs.length}…`, "info", 30000);
19447:     let ok = 0, fail = 0;
19448:     for (const m of msgs) {
19449:       const body = m.body || "";
19450:       // Prefix marks the message as a forward to the receiver.
19451:       // Recipients see the indent + arrow; useful even without a
19452:       // dedicated wire frame.
19453:       const forwardedBody = `↪ Forwarded\n${body}`;
19454:       try {
19455:         if (target.group_id) {
19456:           await api.post(
19457:             `/api/groups/${target.group_id}/send`,
19458:             { body: forwardedBody },
19459:           );
19460:         } else if (target.peer_short_id) {
19461:           await api.post("/api/send", {
19462:             peer: target.peer_short_id, body: forwardedBody,
19463:           });
19464:         }
19465:         ok += 1;
19466:       } catch {
19467:         fail += 1;
19468:       }
19469:     }
19470:     sending?.remove?.();
19471:     toast(
19472:       fail === 0 ? `Forwarded ${ok}.` : `Forwarded ${ok}, ${fail} failed.`,
19473:       fail === 0 ? "good" : "warn",
19474:     );
19475:     exitSelection();
19476:   }

19499: 
19500:   // v0.10.5 bonus polish - slash commands. Preprocesses the
19501:   // composer body before send. Recognized: /shrug, /tableflip,
19502:   // /unflip, /me <text>, /clear (clears pinned), /help.
19503:   function _expandSlashCommand(body) {
19504:     const m = body.match(/^\/([a-z]+)(?:\s+(.*))?$/s);
19505:     if (!m) return { body, sideEffect: null };
19506:     const cmd = m[1].toLowerCase();
19507:     const arg = (m[2] || "").trim();
19508:     switch (cmd) {
19509:       case "shrug":      return { body: `${arg ? arg + " " : ""}¯\\_(ツ)_/¯` };
19510:       case "tableflip":  return { body: `${arg ? arg + " " : ""}(╯°□°)╯︵ ┻━┻` };
19511:       case "unflip":     return { body: `${arg ? arg + " " : ""}┬─┬ノ( º _ ºノ)` };
19512:       case "me":         return { body: arg ? `*${arg}*` : body };
19513:       case "clear":      return { body: null, sideEffect: "clear-pins" };
19514:       case "help":       return { body: null, sideEffect: "help" };
19515:       default:           return { body, sideEffect: null };
19516:     }
19517:   }
19518: 
19519:   function _maybeRunSlashSideEffect(name) {
19520:     if (name === "help") {
19521:       $("#shortcuts-backdrop")?.classList.add("show");
19522:     } else if (name === "clear-pins") {
19523:       // Clear pinned messages for the current conversation.
19524:       const key = state.selectedGroup
19525:         ? `group:${state.selectedGroup}` : `peer:${state.selectedPeer || ""}`;
19526:       try {
19527:         const pins = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("one_link.pins") || "{}");
19528:         delete pins[key];
19529:         localStorage.setItem("one_link.pins", JSON.stringify(pins));
19530:         renderPins();
19531:         toast("Pins gone. Fresh start.", "good", 2500);
19532:       } catch (e) {
19533:         toast(`Clear pins failed: ${e.message || e}`, "bad");
19534:       }
19535:     }
19536:   }
19537: 
19538:   async function sendCurrent() {
19539:     // v0.10.5 bonus: expand slash commands BEFORE branching so
19540:     // /shrug works in both 1:1 and group threads.
19541:     const rawInput = $("#input").value.trim();
19542:     const expanded = _expandSlashCommand(rawInput);
19543:     if (expanded.sideEffect) {
19544:       _maybeRunSlashSideEffect(expanded.sideEffect);
19545:       $("#input").value = "";
19546:       return;
19547:     }
19548:     if (expanded.body !== null && expanded.body !== rawInput) {
19549:       $("#input").value = expanded.body;
19550:     }
19551:     // v0.8.0: branch on whether the user is in a group or 1:1.
19552:     if (state.selectedGroup) {
19553:       const body = $("#input").value.trim();
19554:       if (!body) return;
19555:       try {
19556:         const sendBody = { body };
19557:         if (state.replyTo && state.replyTo.group_id === state.selectedGroup) {
19558:           sendBody.reply_to = state.replyTo.id;
19559:         }
19560:         await api.post(`/api/groups/${state.selectedGroup}/send`, sendBody);
19561:         $("#input").value = "";
19562:         $("#input").style.height = "auto";
19563:         clearActiveDraft();
19564:         clearReplyTo();
19565:         // Refresh from state so the new message lands in the pane.
19566:         const r = await api.get(
19567:           `/api/groups/${state.selectedGroup}/messages?limit=200`
19568:         );
19569:         state.groupMessages = r.messages || [];
19570:         renderGroupConversation();
19571:       } catch (e) {
19572:         toast(`Group send failed: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad", 8000);
19573:       }
19574:       return;
19575:     }
19576:     // v0.21.x - bulletproof send path. Previous behavior silently
19577:     // returned when state.selectedPeer was unset (e.g. focus drifted
19578:     // during a call, peer list refreshed mid-keystroke). User got no
19579:     // feedback and assumed the message sent. NEVER swallow Enter
19580:     // without telling the user what happened.
19581:     if (!state.selectedPeer) {
19582:       // Try to recover the intended peer from the visible chat header
19583:       // or the last-selected fingerprint persisted at boot.
19584:       const recovered = (function () {
19585:         // Last-selected from localStorage (saved on every selectPeer).
19586:         try {
19587:           const raw = localStorage.getItem("one_link.last_selection");
19588:           if (raw) {
19589:             const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
19590:             if (parsed.kind === "peer" && parsed.id) {
19591:               const p = state.peers.get(parsed.id);
19592:               if (p && p.trust !== "rejected") return parsed.id;
19593:             }
19594:           }
19595:         } catch (_) { /* fall through */ }
19596:         // First pinned online peer as a sane fallback.
19597:         for (const p of state.peers.values()) {
19598:           if (p.trust === "pinned" && p.online) return p.short_id;
19599:         }
19600:         return null;
19601:       })();
19602:       if (recovered) {
19603:         selectPeer(recovered);
19604:       } else {
19605:         toast(
19606:           "Pick a device first - tap a name in the left sidebar to start.",
19607:           "info", 5000,
19608:         );
19609:         return;
19610:       }
19611:     }
19612:     const peer = state.peers.get(state.selectedPeer);
19613:     if (!peer) {
19614:       toast(
19615:         "That device just dropped off the network. Try again in a moment.",
19616:         "info", 5000,
19617:       );
19618:       return;
19619:     }
19620:     if (peer.trust === "rejected") {
19621:       toast("This device is blocked. Use Allow device first.", "bad");
19622:       return;
19623:     }
19624:     const body = input.value.trim();
19625:     const filesToSend = state.staged.slice();
19626:     if (!body && filesToSend.length === 0) {
19627:       // Don't silently no-op an Enter on an empty input - the user
19628:       // probably hit Enter to send a paste that didn't land in the
19629:       // textarea. Surface that.
19630:       toast("Nothing to send - type or paste your message first.", "info", 3000);
19631:       return;
19632:     }
19633: 
19634:     sendBtn.disabled = true;
19635:     try {
19636:       if (body) {
19637:         // v0.21.x bulletproof send (round 2): paint an optimistic
19638:         // outbound bubble in the chat pane IMMEDIATELY, clear the
19639:         // composer IMMEDIATELY, then fire the API in the background
19640:         // with a hard 25s timeout. Three failure modes that used to
19641:         // hang the user forever — wedged channel, dead peer, lost
19642:         // network — now visibly mark the bubble as queued/failed so
19643:         // they always know what happened and can hit Retry. Never
19644:         // again "I clicked Send and nothing happened".
19645:         const clientMsgId = _newClientMsgId();
19646:         const optimistic = {
19647:           id: clientMsgId,
19648:           t: "TEXT",
19649:           body,
19650:           ts: Date.now(),
19651:           dir: "out",
19652:           peer: state.selectedPeer,
19653:           peer_fp: peer.fingerprint,
19654:           _sendingState: "sending",
19655:           _attempts: 1,
19656:         };
19657:         if (state.replyTo && state.replyTo.peer === state.selectedPeer) {
19658:           optimistic.reply_to = state.replyTo.id;
19659:         }
19660:         state.messages.push(optimistic);
19661:         // Clear composer up-front so the bubble is visible where it
19662:         // landed — no "did it send?" ambiguity.
19663:         const replyToId = optimistic.reply_to;
19664:         input.value = "";
19665:         input.style.height = "auto";
19666:         clearActiveDraft();
19667:         clearReplyTo();
19668:         renderMessages();
19669:         // v0.21.x: first-send celebration. The first message ever
19670:         // sent to a given peer gets a one-time ✨ glow on the bubble.
19671:         // Persists per-peer in localStorage so subsequent sends
19672:         // don't repeat the moment.
19673:         _maybeCelebrateFirstSend(optimistic);
19674:         try {
19675:           const sendBody = {
19676:             peer: state.selectedPeer,
19677:             body,
19678:             client_msg_id: clientMsgId,
19679:           };
19680:           if (replyToId) sendBody.reply_to = replyToId;
19681:           // v0.14.0: outbox-on-fail. Network errors / client timeouts
19682:           // queue the payload into IDB; the SW drains when online.
19683:           // v0.21.x: hard 25s timeout — slightly past the server's
19684:           // 20s wait_for so a hung server still triggers the queue
19685:           // path on the client before AbortError bubbles up.
19686:           const result = await _sendWithOutbox(
19687:             "/api/send", sendBody, { timeoutMs: 25000 },
19688:           );
19689:           if (result && result.ok === false) {
19690:             // Structured soft-failure (capability_disabled, etc).
19691:             // Mark the bubble failed inline with a Retry button so
19692:             // the user sees the exact reason on the bubble itself
19693:             // AND still gets the toast.
19694:             _markBubbleState(clientMsgId, "failed", {
19695:               _error: result.user_message || result.error || "Message couldn't be sent.",
19696:             });
19697:             toast(
19698:               result.user_message
19699:                 || result.error
19700:                 || "Message couldn't be sent. Try again.",
19701:               "bad", 8000,
19702:             );
19703:           } else if (result && result.queued) {
19704:             // 202: server queued (peer offline / timeout / transient).
19705:             // Plumb the daemon's user-facing copy ("Could not
19706:             // establish a secure connection…" / "The other device
19707:             // didn't respond in time" / etc.) onto the bubble so the
19708:             // user sees the actual reason. The generic "Will send
19709:             // when the path is healthy" line was confusing when
19710:             // presence said "online" — presence is mDNS-level, the
19711:             // actual wire path can still be desynced.
19712:             const tx = result.after_failure || {};
19713:             _markBubbleState(clientMsgId, "queued", {
19714:               _queueReason: result.reason || null,
19715:               _queueDetail: tx.error || null,
19716:               _queueHint: tx.hint || null,
19717:             });
19718:           } else {
19719:             // Success: daemon will broadcast the persisted event via
19720:             // WS; the m.type === "msg" handler reconciles by id
19721:             // (replaces the optimistic record with the canonical
19722:             // one). If for any reason the echo never arrives, the
19723:             // optimistic bubble stays as a faithful local record.
19724:             // Either way the user sees their message.
19725:             _markBubbleState(clientMsgId, "sent");
19726:           }
19727:         } catch (e) {
19728:           // Truly unexpected (non-network, non-timeout) exception.
19729:           // Bubble stays as "failed" with Retry; toast surfaces the
19730:           // detail.
19731:           _markBubbleState(clientMsgId, "failed", {
19732:             _error: errorToastBody(e),
19733:           });
19734:           toast(errorToastBody(e), "bad", 8000);
19735:         }
19736:       }
19737:       // Clear tray immediately so the user sees the staged files leaving;
19738:       // each upload still tracks its own progress in the chat bubble.
19739:       state.staged = [];
19740:       renderStaging();

19838:   async function openCameraCaptureModal() {
19839:     _ensureCameraCaptureModal();
19840:     const modal = document.getElementById("camera-capture-modal");
19841:     const video = modal.querySelector(".ccm-video");
19842:     const snapBtn = modal.querySelector(".ccm-snap");
19843:     const closeBtn = modal.querySelector(".ccm-close");
19844:     const swapBtn = modal.querySelector(".ccm-swap");
19845:     let stream = null;
19846:     let facingMode = "user";
19847:     async function startStream(mode) {
19848:       if (stream) {
19849:         stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => { try { t.stop(); } catch {} });
19850:         stream = null;
19851:       }
19852:       try {
19853:         stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
19854:           video: { facingMode: mode || facingMode },
19855:           audio: false,
19856:         });
19857:         video.srcObject = stream;
19858:         await video.play().catch(() => {});
19859:       } catch (e) {
19860:         toast(`Camera access failed: ${e?.message || e}`, "bad", 6000);
19861:         cleanup();
19862:       }
19863:     }
19864:     function cleanup() {
19865:       if (stream) {
19866:         stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => { try { t.stop(); } catch {} });
19867:         stream = null;
19868:       }
19869:       try { video.srcObject = null; } catch {}
19870:       modal.classList.remove("show");
19871:       document.body.classList.remove("ccm-open");
19872:       snapBtn.removeEventListener("click", onSnap);
19873:       closeBtn.removeEventListener("click", onClose);
19874:       swapBtn.removeEventListener("click", onSwap);
19875:       modal.removeEventListener("click", onBackdrop);
19876:       document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
19877:     }
19878:     async function onSnap() {
19879:       if (!video.videoWidth) return;
19880:       const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
19881:       canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
19882:       canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
19883:       const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
19884:       ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0);
19885:       const blob = await new Promise((res) =>
19886:         canvas.toBlob(res, "image/jpeg", 0.92));
19887:       if (blob) {
19888:         const file = new File([blob], `photo-${Date.now()}.jpg`, { type: "image/jpeg" });
19889:         await stageFile(file);
19890:         toast("Photo captured. Click Send when ready.", "good", 3000);
19891:       }
19892:       cleanup();
19893:     }
19894:     function onSwap() {
19895:       facingMode = facingMode === "user" ? "environment" : "user";
19896:       startStream(facingMode);
19897:     }
19898:     function onClose() { cleanup(); }
19899:     function onBackdrop(ev) {
19900:       const t = ev.target;
19901:       if (t && t instanceof Element && t.hasAttribute("data-ccm-close")) cleanup();
19902:     }
19903:     function onKey(ev) {
19904:       if (ev.key === "Escape") cleanup();
19905:       if (ev.key === "Enter" || ev.key === " ") { ev.preventDefault(); onSnap(); }
19906:     }
19907:     snapBtn.addEventListener("click", onSnap);
19908:     closeBtn.addEventListener("click", onClose);
19909:     swapBtn.addEventListener("click", onSwap);
19910:     modal.addEventListener("click", onBackdrop);
19911:     document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
19912:     modal.classList.add("show");
19913:     document.body.classList.add("ccm-open");
19914:     await startStream(facingMode);
19915:     setTimeout(() => snapBtn.focus(), 50);
19916:   }

20130:   async function maybeShowOnboarding() {
20131:     const setup = await refreshOneSetup();
20132:     try {
20133:       if (localStorage.getItem(ONBOARDING_STORAGE_KEY) === "1") return;
20134:     } catch { /* localStorage may be blocked - fall through */ }
20135:     if (setup?.completed) {
20136:       _markOnboardingComplete(/* persistRemote */ false);
20137:       return;
20138:     }
20139:     if (setup?.skipped) return;
20140:     // v0.9.4: also honor the daemon-persisted flag so a fresh
20141:     // browser tab on a paired daemon doesn't re-pop the wizard
20142:     // (no localStorage in that tab yet).
20143:     if (state.me?.onboarding_completed) {
20144:       _markOnboardingComplete(/* persistRemote */ false);
20145:       return;
20146:     }
20147:     if (state.peers && state.peers.size > 0) {
20148:       // Returning user with paired devices. Mark complete.
20149:       _markOnboardingComplete(/* persistRemote */ true);
20150:       return;
20151:     }
20152:     // Pre-fill the name field with whatever display_name the daemon
20153:     // already has (might come from /api/me).
20154:     const nameInput = $("#onboarding-name");
20155:     if (nameInput && state.me?.display_name) {
20156:       nameInput.value = state.me.display_name;
20157:     } else if (nameInput && state.me?.hostname) {
20158:       nameInput.value = state.me.hostname;
20159:     }
20160:     const stepFor = {
20161:       identity: 3,
20162:       add_device: 4,
20163:       first_success: 5,
20164:       privacy_proof: 6,
20165:       safety: 6,
20166:       finish: 6,
20167:     };
20168:     showOnboardingStep(stepFor[setup?.current_step] || 1);
20169:     $("#onboarding-backdrop").style.display = "flex";
20170:   }

20179:       d.classList.toggle("active", i + 1 === n);
20180:       d.classList.toggle("done", i + 1 < n);
20181:     });
20182:     if (n === 2) {

20184:       setTimeout(() => $("#onboarding-name")?.focus(), 50);
20185:     }
20186:   }

20188:   function _markOnboardingComplete(persistRemote) {
20189:     try { localStorage.setItem(ONBOARDING_STORAGE_KEY, "1"); } catch {}
20190:     $("#onboarding-backdrop").style.display = "none";
20191:     returnToOneHealthGuideIfPending();
20192:     if (persistRemote) {
20193:       // Best-effort: stash on the daemon so the next browser
20194:       // session also skips. Failure is non-blocking.
20195:       api.post("/api/settings", { onboarding_completed: true })
20196:         .catch(() => {});
20197:     }
20198:   }
