20207:   async function finishOnboarding() {
20208:     const nameInput = $("#onboarding-name");
20209:     const newName = (nameInput?.value || "").trim();
20210:     if (newName && newName !== state.me?.display_name) {
20211:       try {
20212:         await api.post("/api/settings", { display_name: newName });
20213:         state.me = { ...(state.me || {}), display_name: newName };
20214:         $("#me-host").textContent = newName;
20215:       } catch (e) {
20216:         toast(`Couldn't save name: ${e.message || e}`, "warn");
20217:         // Don't bail - let the user finish onboarding anyway.
20218:       }
20219:     }
20220:     try { await api.setupAction("complete"); } catch {}
20221:     _markOnboardingComplete(/* persistRemote */ true);
20222:   }

20241:   function renderOneSetupInviteCountdown() {
20242:     const hint = $("#one-setup-invite-hint");
20243:     const btn = $("#one-setup-add-device");
20244:     if (!_oneSetupInvite || !hint) return;
20245:     const expiresMs = Number(_oneSetupInvite.expires_ms || 0);
20246:     const remaining = Math.max(0, expiresMs - Date.now());
20247:     const qr = $("#one-setup-invite-qr");
20248:     const token = $("#one-setup-invite-token");
20249:     if (remaining <= 0) {
20250:       hint.textContent = "Invite expired. Create a fresh QR before adding another device.";
20251:       hint.classList.add("setup-expired");
20252:       if (btn) btn.textContent = "Refresh invite QR";
20253:       if (qr) qr.style.opacity = ".45";
20254:       if (token) token.classList.add("setup-expired");
20255:       clearInterval(_oneSetupInviteTimer);
20256:       _oneSetupInviteTimer = null;
20257:       return;
20258:     }
20259:     const minutes = Math.floor(remaining / 60000);
20260:     const seconds = Math.floor((remaining % 60000) / 1000);
20261:     hint.textContent =
20262:       `Scan this with the device you want to add. Expires in ${minutes}:${String(seconds).padStart(2, "0")}.`;
20263:     hint.classList.remove("setup-expired");
20264:     if (btn) btn.textContent = "Refresh invite QR";
20265:     if (qr) qr.style.opacity = "1";
20266:     if (token) token.classList.remove("setup-expired");
20267:   }

20272:         label: state.me?.display_name || state.me?.hostname || "Add device",
20273:       });

20293:       }, 1500);

20475:   // ── Command palette / global search (v0.9.3) ───────────────────────
20476:   // Ctrl+K (or Cmd+K) opens a modal with one input + result list.
20477:   // Searches messages, peers, groups, and inbox files via the
20478:   // /api/search endpoint. Arrow keys navigate; Enter activates;
20479:   // Esc closes.
20480:   state.paletteOpen = false;
20481:   state.paletteFocusIdx = 0;
20482:   state.paletteResults = [];      // flat list mirroring the rendered rows
20483:   state.paletteQuery = "";
20484:   let _paletteDebounce = null;
20485: 
20486:   function openPalette() {
20487:     if (state.paletteOpen) return;
20488:     state.paletteOpen = true;
20489:     $("#palette-backdrop").classList.add("show");
20490:     const input = $("#palette-input");
20491:     input.value = "";
20492:     state.paletteQuery = "";
20493:     state.paletteResults = [];
20494:     state.paletteFocusIdx = 0;
20495:     renderPaletteResults({ messages: [], peers: [], groups: [], files: [] });
20496:     setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 0);
20497:   }
20498:   function closePalette() {
20499:     state.paletteOpen = false;
20500:     $("#palette-backdrop").classList.remove("show");
20501:   }
20502: 
20503:   function paletteHighlight(text, query) {
20504:     // Simple case-insensitive highlight - wraps the matched span
20505:     // in <mark>. Falls back to plain text if no match.
20506:     const t = String(text || "");
20507:     if (!query) return document.createTextNode(t);
20508:     const idx = t.toLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLowerCase());
20509:     if (idx < 0) return document.createTextNode(t);
20510:     const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
20511:     if (idx > 0) frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(t.slice(0, idx)));
20512:     const m = document.createElement("mark");
20513:     m.textContent = t.slice(idx, idx + query.length);
20514:     frag.appendChild(m);
20515:     if (idx + query.length < t.length) {
20516:       frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(t.slice(idx + query.length)));
20517:     }
20518:     return frag;
20519:   }
20520: 
20521:   function renderPaletteResults(r) {
20522:     const host = $("#palette-results");
20523:     host.innerHTML = "";
20524:     state.paletteResults = [];
20525:     const q = state.paletteQuery;
20526:     const total = (r.messages?.length || 0) + (r.peers?.length || 0) +
20527:                   (r.groups?.length || 0) + (r.files?.length || 0);
20528:     if (q && total === 0) {
20529:       host.appendChild(el("div", "palette-empty", `Nothing matches "${q}". Spell it different?`));
20530:       return;
20531:     }
20532:     if (!q) {
20533:       host.appendChild(el("div", "palette-hint",
20534:         "Type to search across this device's messages, peers, groups, and received files."));
20535:       return;
20536:     }
20537: 
20538:     // Order: peers > groups > messages > files. Peers are most
20539:     // likely "I want to switch to that conversation"; messages are
20540:     // higher signal but visually noisier so come after the navigation
20541:     // candidates.
20542:     if (r.peers && r.peers.length > 0) {
20543:       host.appendChild(el("div", "palette-section-h", "Devices"));
20544:       for (const p of r.peers) {
20545:         const row = paletteRowPeer(p, q);
20546:         state.paletteResults.push({ row, action: () => paletteOpenPeer(p) });
20547:         host.appendChild(row);
20548:       }
20549:     }
20550:     if (r.groups && r.groups.length > 0) {
20551:       host.appendChild(el("div", "palette-section-h", "Groups"));
20552:       for (const g of r.groups) {
20553:         const row = paletteRowGroup(g, q);
20554:         state.paletteResults.push({ row, action: () => paletteOpenGroup(g) });
20555:         host.appendChild(row);
20556:       }
20557:     }
20558:     if (r.messages && r.messages.length > 0) {
20559:       host.appendChild(el("div", "palette-section-h", "Messages"));
20560:       for (const m of r.messages) {
20561:         const row = paletteRowMessage(m, q);
20562:         state.paletteResults.push({ row, action: () => paletteOpenMessage(m) });
20563:         host.appendChild(row);
20564:       }
20565:     }
20566:     if (r.files && r.files.length > 0) {
20567:       host.appendChild(el("div", "palette-section-h", "Files"));
20568:       for (const f of r.files) {
20569:         const row = paletteRowFile(f, q);
20570:         state.paletteResults.push({ row, action: () => paletteOpenFile(f) });
20571:         host.appendChild(row);
20572:       }
20573:     }
20574:     state.paletteFocusIdx = 0;
20575:     if (state.paletteResults[0]) {
20576:       state.paletteResults[0].row.classList.add("focused");
20577:     }
20578:   }
20579: 
20580:   function paletteRowPeer(p, q) {
20581:     const row = el("div", "palette-row");
20582:     row.appendChild(el("div", "pr-icon", "👤"));
20583:     const body = el("div", "pr-body");
20584:     const title = el("div", "pr-title");
20585:     title.appendChild(paletteHighlight(
20586:       p.display_name || p.hostname || p.short_id, q,
20587:     ));
20588:     if (p.is_verified) {
20589:       const v = el("span"); v.style.color = "var(--good)"; v.textContent = " ✓";
20590:       title.appendChild(v);
20591:     }
20592:     body.appendChild(title);
20593:     body.appendChild(el("div", "pr-sub",
20594:       `${p.trust} · ${p.short_id}`));
20595:     row.appendChild(body);
20596:     row.appendChild(el("span", "pr-kind", "PEER"));
20597:     row.onclick = () => paletteOpenPeer(p);
20598:     return row;
20599:   }
20600:   function paletteRowGroup(g, q) {
20601:     const row = el("div", "palette-row");
20602:     row.appendChild(el("div", "pr-icon", "👥"));
20603:     const body = el("div", "pr-body");
20604:     const title = el("div", "pr-title");
20605:     title.appendChild(paletteHighlight(g.name || "(unnamed)", q));
20606:     body.appendChild(title);
20607:     body.appendChild(el("div", "pr-sub", `Group · ${g.group_id.slice(0, 12)}…`));
20608:     row.appendChild(body);
20609:     row.appendChild(el("span", "pr-kind", "GROUP"));
20610:     row.onclick = () => paletteOpenGroup(g);
20611:     return row;
20612:   }
20613:   function paletteRowMessage(m, q) {
20614:     const row = el("div", "palette-row");
20615:     row.appendChild(el("div", "pr-icon", m.direction === "out" ? "↗" : "↘"));
20616:     const body = el("div", "pr-body");
20617:     const title = el("div", "pr-title");
20618:     title.appendChild(paletteHighlight(m.body || "(empty)", q));
20619:     body.appendChild(title);
20620:     const who = m.peer_display_name || m.peer_fp?.slice(0, 8) || "?";
20621:     const when = m.ts_ms ? new Date(m.ts_ms).toLocaleString() : "?";
20622:     body.appendChild(el("div", "pr-sub", `${who} · ${when}`));
20623:     row.appendChild(body);
20624:     row.appendChild(el("span", "pr-kind", "MSG"));
20625:     row.onclick = () => paletteOpenMessage(m);
20626:     return row;
20627:   }
20628:   function paletteRowFile(f, q) {
20629:     const row = el("div", "palette-row");
20630:     row.appendChild(el("div", "pr-icon", fileIcon(f.name)));
20631:     const body = el("div", "pr-body");
20632:     const title = el("div", "pr-title");
20633:     title.appendChild(paletteHighlight(f.name, q));
20634:     body.appendChild(title);
20635:     body.appendChild(el("div", "pr-sub",
20636:       `${fmtBytes(f.size)} · ${new Date(f.mtime_ms || 0).toLocaleString()}`));
20637:     row.appendChild(body);
20638:     row.appendChild(el("span", "pr-kind", "FILE"));
20639:     row.onclick = () => paletteOpenFile(f);
20640:     return row;
20641:   }

20643:   function paletteOpenPeer(p) {
20644:     closePalette();
20645:     if (!p.short_id) return;
20646:     selectPeer(p.short_id);
20647:   }
20648:   function paletteOpenGroup(g) {
20649:     closePalette();
20650:     if (g.group_id) selectGroup(g.group_id);
20651:   }
20652:   function paletteOpenMessage(m) {
20653:     closePalette();
20654:     // Switch to the conversation, then scroll to the message id.
20655:     if (m.room_id) {
20656:       // Group message - if we know which group.
20657:       // No direct ID mapping here; just open the conversation.
20658:     }
20659:     if (m.peer_fp) {
20660:       const peer = [...state.peers.values()]
20661:         .find(p => p.fingerprint === m.peer_fp);
20662:       if (peer) selectPeer(peer.short_id);
20663:     }
20664:     // Best-effort: scroll to the message after a tick (chat
20665:     // re-render runs on rAF).
20666:     setTimeout(() => {
20667:       const node = document.querySelector(`[data-msg-id="${m.id}"]`);
20668:       if (node) node.scrollIntoView({ block: "center", behavior: "smooth" });
20669:     }, 80);
20670:   }
20671:   function paletteOpenFile(f) {
20672:     closePalette();
20673:     // Open the file in a new tab - same as the per-bubble Open link.
20674:     window.open(`/api/files/${encodeURIComponent(f.name)}`, "_blank");
20675:   }
20676: 
20677:   function paletteFocus(delta) {
20678:     if (state.paletteResults.length === 0) return;
20679:     state.paletteResults[state.paletteFocusIdx]?.row.classList.remove("focused");
20680:     state.paletteFocusIdx =
20681:       (state.paletteFocusIdx + delta + state.paletteResults.length)
20682:         % state.paletteResults.length;
20683:     const r = state.paletteResults[state.paletteFocusIdx];
20684:     r?.row.classList.add("focused");
20685:     r?.row.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
20686:   }
20687:   function paletteActivateFocused() {
20688:     const r = state.paletteResults[state.paletteFocusIdx];
20689:     if (r) r.action();
20690:   }
20691: 
20692:   async function runPaletteSearch(q) {
20693:     state.paletteQuery = q;
20694:     if (!q) {
20695:       renderPaletteResults({ messages: [], peers: [], groups: [], files: [] });
20696:       return;
20697:     }
20698:     try {
20699:       const r = await api.get(`/api/palette?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&limit=10`);
20700:       // Drop the response if the user kept typing; only render the
20701:       // freshest query's results.
20702:       if (state.paletteQuery !== q) return;
20703:       renderPaletteResults(r);
20704:     } catch (e) {
20705:       const host = $("#palette-results");
20706:       host.innerHTML = "";
20707:       host.appendChild(el("div", "palette-empty",
20708:         `Search didn't work: ${e.message || e}`));
20709:     }
20710:   }
20711: 
20712:   // Wire keyboard.
20713:   document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
20714:     // Ctrl/Cmd + K opens the palette from anywhere.
20715:     // Legacy shortcut smoke shape: "k" || e.key === "K"
20716:     if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "k" && !e.shiftKey) {
20717:       // Don't fight the existing per-conversation Ctrl+K - only
20718:       // override when palette is closed AND the active element
20719:       // isn't the conversation search input.
20720:       if (document.activeElement?.id === "search-input") return;
20721:       e.preventDefault();
20722:       openPalette();
20723:       return;
20724:     }
20725:     if (!state.paletteOpen) return;
20726:     if (e.key === "Escape") {
20727:       e.preventDefault();
20728:       closePalette();
20729:     } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
20730:       e.preventDefault();
20731:       paletteFocus(+1);
20732:     } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
20733:       e.preventDefault();
20734:       paletteFocus(-1);
20735:     } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
20736:       e.preventDefault();
20737:       paletteActivateFocused();
20738:     }
20739:   });
20740: 
20741:   // Wire input.
20742:   $("#palette-input")?.addEventListener("input", (e) => {
20743:     const q = e.target.value;
20744:     if (_paletteDebounce !== null) clearTimeout(_paletteDebounce);
20745:     _paletteDebounce = setTimeout(() => runPaletteSearch(q.trim()), 120);
20746:   });
20747:   // Click outside the modal closes it.
20748:   $("#palette-backdrop")?.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
20749:     if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closePalette();
20750:   });

20752:   // ── Voice recording (v0.9.2) ───────────────────────────────────────
20753:   // Uses MediaRecorder (browser-native opus/webm) + reuses the
20754:   // existing /api/send-file pipeline. No new wire protocol - the
20755:   // peer just receives a regular file send; renderFileBubble
20756:   // recognizes audio extensions and renders a player inline.
20757:   state.voiceRec = null;        // MediaRecorder instance
20758:   state.voiceStream = null;     // active MediaStream (must be stopped)
20759:   state.voiceChunks = [];       // collected blob fragments
20760:   state.voiceStartedAt = 0;     // ms epoch
20761:   state.voiceTimerId = null;    // setInterval handle for the live timer
20762:   state.voiceCancelled = false; // sticky flag so onstop knows not to send
20763: 
20764:   // Pick the most-supported opus container. Prefer webm/opus (Chrome
20765:   // + Edge native), fall back to ogg/opus (Firefox), then plain
20766:   // webm/ogg without explicit opus codec spec (Safari ≥ 14.1
20767:   // exposes some MediaRecorder support but with audio/mp4).
20768:   function _pickVoiceMime() {
20769:     if (!("MediaRecorder" in window)) return null;
20770:     const candidates = [
20771:       "audio/webm;codecs=opus",
20772:       "audio/ogg;codecs=opus",
20773:       "audio/webm",
20774:       "audio/ogg",
20775:       "audio/mp4",
20776:       "",
20777:     ];
20778:     for (const m of candidates) {
20779:       try {
20780:         if (m === "" || MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(m)) return m;
20781:       } catch { /* keep iterating */ }
20782:     }
20783:     return null;
20784:   }
20785: 
20786:   function _voiceFilenameFor(mime) {
20787:     const ts = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-").slice(0, 19);
20788:     let ext = "webm";
20789:     if (/ogg/.test(mime)) ext = "ogg";
20790:     else if (/mp4/.test(mime)) ext = "m4a";
20791:     return `voice-${ts}.${ext}`;
20792:   }
20793: 
20794:   async function startVoiceRecording() {
20795:     if (state.voiceRec) return;
20796:     if (!state.selectedPeer) { toast("Pick a device first. Aim is required.", "info"); return; }
20797:     const peer = state.peers.get(state.selectedPeer);
20798:     if (peer?.trust === "rejected") {
20799:       toast("This device is blocked.", "bad");
20800:       return;
20801:     }
20802:     const mime = _pickVoiceMime();
20803:     if (mime === null) {
20804:       toast("This browser doesn't support voice recording.", "warn", 6000);
20805:       return;
20806:     }
20807:     let stream;
20808:     try {
20809:       stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
20810:     } catch (e) {
20811:       const why =
20812:         e?.name === "NotAllowedError" ? "Microphone permission denied." :
20813:         e?.name === "NotFoundError" ? "No microphone detected." :
20814:         `Mic access failed: ${e?.message || e}`;
20815:       toast(why, "bad", 6000);
20816:       return;
20817:     }
20818:     let rec;
20819:     try {
20820:       rec = mime ? new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType: mime })
20821:                  : new MediaRecorder(stream);
20822:     } catch (e) {
20823:       toast(`Recording failed to start: ${e?.message || e}`, "bad");
20824:       stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
20825:       return;
20826:     }
20827:     state.voiceStream = stream;
20828:     state.voiceRec = rec;
20829:     state.voiceChunks = [];
20830:     state.voiceStartedAt = Date.now();
20831:     state.voiceCancelled = false;
20832:     rec.ondataavailable = (ev) => {
20833:       if (ev.data && ev.data.size > 0) state.voiceChunks.push(ev.data);
20834:     };
20835:     rec.onstop = async () => {
20836:       // Stop the underlying mic stream regardless of cancel/send.
20837:       try { stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); } catch {}
20838:       stopVoiceTimer();
20839:       $("#voice-overlay").style.display = "none";
20840:       $("#btn-voice").classList.remove("recording");
20841:       $("#btn-voice").textContent = "🎤";
20842:       const wasCancelled = state.voiceCancelled;
20843:       const chunks = state.voiceChunks;
20844:       const recMime = rec.mimeType || mime || "audio/webm";
20845:       state.voiceRec = null;
20846:       state.voiceStream = null;
20847:       state.voiceChunks = [];
20848:       if (wasCancelled || chunks.length === 0) return;
20849:       const blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: recMime });
20850:       // Minimum threshold - anything under 200ms is almost
20851:       // certainly a misclick. Don't waste a peer-side bubble.
20852:       if (blob.size < 1024) {
20853:         toast("Voice clip was barely a syllable. Tossed.", "info");
20854:         return;
20855:       }
20856:       // v0.21.x: preview-before-send. Instead of immediately
20857:       // uploading, open a preview modal so the user can listen
20858:       // back, re-record, or cancel. Power users can disable this
20859:       // via state.runtimeSettings.voice_skip_preview.
20860:       const skipPreview = state.runtimeSettings?.voice_skip_preview === true;
20861:       if (skipPreview) {
20862:         await _sendVoiceBlob(blob, recMime);
20863:       } else {
20864:         openVoicePreviewModal(blob, recMime);
20865:       }
20866:     };
20867:     try {
20868:       rec.start();
20869:     } catch (e) {
20870:       toast(`Recording failed to start: ${e?.message || e}`, "bad");
20871:       stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
20872:       state.voiceRec = null;
20873:       state.voiceStream = null;
20874:       return;
20875:     }
20876:     $("#btn-voice").classList.add("recording");
20877:     $("#btn-voice").textContent = "⏹";
20878:     $("#voice-overlay").style.display = "flex";
20879:     $("#voice-timer").textContent = "0:00";
20880:     state.voiceTimerId = setInterval(updateVoiceTimer, 250);
20881:   }
20882: 
20883:   function stopVoiceRecording({ cancel = false } = {}) {
20884:     if (!state.voiceRec) return;
20885:     state.voiceCancelled = !!cancel;
20886:     try { state.voiceRec.stop(); } catch {}
20887:     // onstop handler does the rest.
20888:   }
20889: 
20890:   function stopVoiceTimer() {
20891:     if (state.voiceTimerId !== null) {
20892:       clearInterval(state.voiceTimerId);
20893:       state.voiceTimerId = null;
20894:     }
20895:   }
20896:   function updateVoiceTimer() {
20897:     if (!state.voiceStartedAt) return;
20898:     const sec = Math.floor((Date.now() - state.voiceStartedAt) / 1000);
20899:     const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
20900:     const s = sec - m * 60;
20901:     $("#voice-timer").textContent = `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, "0")}`;
20902:     // Hard cap at 5 minutes to protect the channel.
20903:     if (sec >= 300) {
20904:       stopVoiceRecording({ cancel: false });
20905:       toast("Voice clip capped at 5 minutes - sending now.", "info", 4000);
20906:     }
20907:   }

20909:   // v0.21.x: voice playback speed. Click cycles through 1x → 1.5x
20910:   // → 2x → 1x. Persisted in localStorage so the user's preferred
20911:   // speed sticks across audio bubbles. Browser natively supports
20912:   // arbitrary playbackRate values, including pitch preservation.
20913:   const VOICE_SPEEDS = [1.0, 1.5, 2.0];
20914:   const VOICE_SPEED_KEY = "one_link.voice_speed";
20915:   function _getVoiceSpeed() {
20916:     try {
20917:       const v = parseFloat(localStorage.getItem(VOICE_SPEED_KEY) || "1");
20918:       return VOICE_SPEEDS.includes(v) ? v : 1.0;
20919:     } catch { return 1.0; }
20920:   }
20921:   function _setVoiceSpeed(v) {
20922:     try { localStorage.setItem(VOICE_SPEED_KEY, String(v)); } catch {}
20923:   }
20924:   function _renderAudioSpeedButton(audio) {
20925:     const btn = document.createElement("button");
20926:     btn.type = "button";
20927:     btn.className = "audio-speed-btn";
20928:     btn.title = "Change playback speed";
20929:     const apply = (v) => {
20930:       try {
20931:         audio.playbackRate = v;
20932:         if ("preservesPitch" in audio) audio.preservesPitch = true;
20933:         else if ("mozPreservesPitch" in audio) audio.mozPreservesPitch = true;
20934:         else if ("webkitPreservesPitch" in audio) audio.webkitPreservesPitch = true;
20935:       } catch {}
20936:       btn.textContent = v === 1.0 ? "1x" : (v === 1.5 ? "1.5x" : "2x");
20937:       btn.dataset.speed = String(v);
20938:     };
20939:     apply(_getVoiceSpeed());
20940:     btn.onclick = (ev) => {
20941:       ev.stopPropagation();
20942:       const cur = parseFloat(btn.dataset.speed || "1");
20943:       const idx = VOICE_SPEEDS.indexOf(cur);
20944:       const next = VOICE_SPEEDS[(idx + 1) % VOICE_SPEEDS.length];
20945:       _setVoiceSpeed(next);
20946:       apply(next);
20947:     };
20948:     return btn;
20949:   }
20950:   // v0.21.x: waveform background for audio bubbles. Decodes the
20951:   // blob via Web Audio, samples peak amplitudes, draws bars. Cached
20952:   // per-blob-hash so re-renders are cheap. Drawn as a CSS background
20953:   // image on the audio-player wrap (the native controls remain
20954:   // interactive — the waveform sits behind them).
20955:   state.waveformCache = state.waveformCache || new Map();
20956:   async function _renderWaveformBg(audio, src, wrap, blobHash) {
20957:     if (!blobHash) return;
20958:     const cached = state.waveformCache.get(blobHash);
20959:     if (cached) { wrap.style.setProperty("--wf-bg", `url(${cached})`); wrap.classList.add("has-waveform"); return; }
20960:     try {
20961:       const resp = await fetch(src, { credentials: "same-origin" });
20962:       if (!resp.ok) return;
20963:       const buf = await resp.arrayBuffer();
20964:       const ACtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
20965:       if (!ACtx) return;
20966:       const ctx = new ACtx();
20967:       try {
20968:         const decoded = await ctx.decodeAudioData(buf.slice(0));
20969:         const dataUrl = _renderWaveformToDataUrl(decoded);
20970:         state.waveformCache.set(blobHash, dataUrl);
20971:         wrap.style.setProperty("--wf-bg", `url(${dataUrl})`);
20972:         wrap.classList.add("has-waveform");
20973:       } finally { try { ctx.close(); } catch {} }
20974:     } catch (_) { /* silent: waveform is purely cosmetic */ }
20975:   }
20976:   function _renderWaveformToDataUrl(audioBuffer) {
20977:     const W = 400, H = 48;
20978:     const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
20979:     canvas.width = W; canvas.height = H;
20980:     const cx = canvas.getContext("2d");
20981:     cx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
20982:     const data = audioBuffer.getChannelData(0);
20983:     const bars = 100;
20984:     const samplesPerBar = Math.max(1, Math.floor(data.length / bars));
20985:     const barW = W / bars;
20986:     cx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.42)";
20987:     for (let i = 0; i < bars; i++) {
20988:       let peak = 0;
20989:       for (let j = 0; j < samplesPerBar; j++) {
20990:         const v = Math.abs(data[i * samplesPerBar + j] || 0);
20991:         if (v > peak) peak = v;
20992:       }
20993:       const h = Math.max(2, peak * H * 0.9);
20994:       cx.fillRect(i * barW + 1, (H - h) / 2, barW - 2, h);
20995:     }
20996:     return canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
20997:   }

21001:   // or discard. The "do this every time" experience matches
21002:   // iMessage / WhatsApp behavior. Skip can be enabled per-user via

21081:   async function _sendVoiceBlob(blob, mime) {
21082:     const fname = _voiceFilenameFor(mime);
21083:     const file = new File([blob], fname, { type: mime });
21084:     const sending = toast(`Sending voice message…`, "info", 30000);
21085:     try {
21086:       await api.upload(state.selectedPeer, file);
21087:       sending?.remove();
21088:     } catch (e) {
21089:       sending?.remove();
21090:       toast(`Voice send failed: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad");
21091:     }
21092:   }

21094:   async function uploadFile(file) {
21095:     if (!state.selectedPeer) { toast("Pick a device first. Aim is required.", "info"); return; }
21096:     const peer = state.peers.get(state.selectedPeer);
21097:     if (peer?.trust === "rejected") {
21098:       toast("This device is blocked. Use Allow device first.", "bad");
21099:       return;
21100:     }
21101:     // v0.21.x: keep the File object so the sender's bubble can open
21102:     // the photo / file on click. The daemon stages then deletes the
21103:     // upload, so without this cache the outbound bubble would
21104:     // dead-end. Cached by name+size, so a same-name+size resend
21105:     // refreshes the entry.
21106:     rememberOutboundFile(file);
21107:     const sendingToast = toast(`Sending ${file.name}...`, "info", 30000);
21108:     try {
21109:       const result = await api.upload(state.selectedPeer, file);
21110:       sendingToast?.remove();
21111:       if (result?.queued || result?.paused) {
21112:         toast(`Waiting for device - ${file.name} will send automatically.`, "info", 5000);
21113:       }
21114:     } catch (e) {
21115:       sendingToast?.remove();
21116:       toast(`${file.name}: ${errorToastBody(e)}. One Link will keep anything already staged and retry when it can.`, "bad", 9000);
21117:     }
21118:   }

21120:   // Paste - stage instead of auto-send.
21121:   function handlePasteImage(e) {
21122:     if (!state.selectedPeer) return false;
21123:     const items = e.clipboardData?.items;
21124:     if (!items) return false;
21125:     let attached = false;
21126:     for (const item of items) {
21127:       if (item.kind !== "file") continue;
21128:       const file = item.getAsFile();
21129:       if (!file) continue;
21130:       const ext = (file.type || "image/png").split("/")[1] || "png";
21131:       const named = file.name && file.name.length > 0
21132:         ? file
21133:         : new File([file], `pasted-${Date.now()}.${ext}`, { type: file.type });
21134:       stageFile(named);
21135:       attached = true;
21136:     }
21137:     if (attached) {
21138:       e.preventDefault();
21139:       return true;
21140:     }
21141:     return false;
21142:   }
21143:   $("#input").addEventListener("paste", handlePasteImage);
21144:   // v0.12.3: typing indicator. Fires on every non-empty input
21145:   // event; daemon-side debounces to once per 2.5s/peer so a fast
21146:   // typer doesn't flood the wire. Privacy gate is enforced
21147:   // server-side too - we don't bother shipping the API call when
21148:   // the user has opted out, because we know we'll get
21149:   // skipped='privacy' back.
21150:   let _lastTypingFiredAt = 0;
21151:   $("#input").addEventListener("input", () => {
21152:     const text = $("#input").value || "";
21153:     if (!text.trim()) return;
21154:     if (state.runtimeSettings?.send_typing_indicators === false) return;
21155:     const now = Date.now();
21156:     // Client-side debounce mirrors the server-side 2.5s debounce
21157:     // so we don't even make the round trip while typing fast.
21158:     if (now - _lastTypingFiredAt < 2500) return;
21159:     _lastTypingFiredAt = now;
21160:     if (state.selectedPeer) {
21161:       const peer = state.peers.get(state.selectedPeer);
21162:       if (peer?.fingerprint && peer.trust === "pinned") {
21163:         api.post(`/api/peers/${peer.fingerprint}/typing`, {})
21164:           .catch(() => { /* best-effort */ });
21165:       }
21166:     }
21167:     // Group typing not implemented in this ship - would need a
21168:     // group_typing wire kind that fans out to all members.
21169:   });
21170:   document.addEventListener("paste", (e) => {
21171:     const t = e.target;
21172:     const isOurInput = t && t.id === "input";
21173:     const isAnyInput = t && (t.tagName === "INPUT" || t.tagName === "TEXTAREA");
21174:     if (isAnyInput && !isOurInput) return;
21175:     handlePasteImage(e);
21176:   });

21178:   // Drag-drop - stage instead of auto-send.

21182:       dragCounter++;

21190:   });
21191:   // Recursively walk a DirectoryEntry, returning {file, relPath}[].
21192:   // Browsers paginate readEntries() in batches of ~100, so we loop until
21193:   // empty. Path is included so we can show 'subdir/file.txt' in chips.
21194:   async function readAllEntries(reader) {
21195:     const out = [];
21196:     while (true) {
21197:       const batch = await new Promise((resolve, reject) =>
21198:         reader.readEntries(resolve, reject));
21199:       if (!batch.length) break;
21200:       out.push(...batch);
21201:     }
21202:     return out;
21203:   }
21204:   async function collectFromEntry(entry, prefix = "") {
21205:     const collected = [];
21206:     if (entry.isFile) {
21207:       const file = await new Promise((resolve, reject) =>
21208:         entry.file(resolve, reject));
21209:       collected.push({ file, relPath: prefix + file.name });
21210:     } else if (entry.isDirectory) {
21211:       const reader = entry.createReader();
21212:       const children = await readAllEntries(reader);
21213:       for (const child of children) {
21214:         const sub = await collectFromEntry(child, prefix + entry.name + "/");
21215:         collected.push(...sub);
21216:       }
21217:     }
21218:     return collected;
21219:   }
21220: 
21221:   document.addEventListener("drop", async (e) => {
21222:     e.preventDefault();
21223:     dragCounter = 0;
21224:     $("#drop-overlay").classList.remove("show");
21225:     if (!state.selectedPeer) { toast("Pick a device first. Aim is required.", "info"); return; }
21226:     const items = e.dataTransfer?.items;
21227:     let collected = [];
21228:     if (items && items.length && items[0].webkitGetAsEntry) {
21229:       // Use entries API to detect folders. This is what makes folder
21230:       // drops actually work.
21231:       const entries = [];
21232:       for (const item of items) {
21233:         const entry = item.webkitGetAsEntry?.();
21234:         if (entry) entries.push(entry);
21235:       }
21236:       try {
21237:         for (const entry of entries) {
21238:           const sub = await collectFromEntry(entry);
21239:           collected.push(...sub);
21240:         }
21241:       } catch (err) {
21242:         toast(`Folder read failed: ${err.message || err}`, "bad");
21243:       }
21244:     }
21245:     if (!collected.length) {
21246:       // Fallback: dataTransfer.files (works for plain file drops).
21247:       const files = Array.from(e.dataTransfer?.files || []);
21248:       collected = files.map(f => ({ file: f, relPath: f.name }));
21249:     }
21250:     if (collected.length === 0) return;
21251:     if (collected.length > 1) {
21252:       toast(`Staging ${collected.length} files`, "info", 2000);
21253:     }
21254:     for (const { file, relPath } of collected) {
21255:       // For nested files, attach the relative path to the staged name so
21256:       // the receiver can see where it came from. We can't preserve the
21257:       // tree on send (the wire protocol takes flat names), but the
21258:       // sender at least sees what they're sending.
21259:       const tagged = relPath !== file.name
21260:         ? new File([file], relPath.replace(/[\\\/]/g, "_"), { type: file.type })
21261:         : file;
21262:       await stageFile(tagged);
21263:     }
21264:   });

21302:   async function runSearch(q) {
21303:     if (!state.selectedPeer) {
21304:       searchBanner.style.display = "flex";
21305:       searchBannerText.textContent = "Select a peer to search their conversation.";
21306:       return;
21307:     }
21308:     try {
21309:       const peer = state.peers.get(state.selectedPeer);
21310:       const fp = peer?.fingerprint || state.selectedPeer;
21311:       const url = `/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&peer=${encodeURIComponent(fp)}&limit=200`;
21312:       const r = await api.get(url);
21313:       state.searchQuery = q;
21314:       state.searchResults = r.messages || [];
21315:       searchBanner.style.display = "flex";
21316:       searchBannerText.textContent = `${state.searchResults.length} result${state.searchResults.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} for "${q}"`;
21317:       renderMessages();
21318:     } catch (e) {
21319:       searchBannerText.textContent = `Search didn't work: ${e.message || e}`;
21320:       searchBanner.style.display = "flex";
21321:     }
21322:   }
21323: 
21324:   function finishSearch() {
21325:     state.searchQuery = "";
21326:     state.searchResults = null;
21327:     searchBanner.style.display = "none";
21328:     renderMessages();
21329:   }

21534:   // v0.21.x: build a redacted diagnostic snapshot. NEVER include
21535:   // peer fingerprints, display names, message bodies, file names,
21536:   // paths, addresses, or any other identifying info. Counts +
21537:   // shapes + recent error severities are enough for triage.
21538:   async function _buildDiagnosticReport() {
21539:     const report = {
21540:       generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
21541:       app_version: state.me?.app_version || PAGE_BUILT_FOR || "unknown",
21542:       page_version: PAGE_BUILT_FOR,
21543:       ua: {
21544:         platform: (navigator.userAgentData?.platform) || navigator.platform || "unknown",
21545:         mobile: navigator.userAgentData?.mobile === true,
21546:         language: navigator.language || "",
21547:         cores: navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 0,
21548:       },
21549:       window: {
21550:         innerWidth: window.innerWidth,
21551:         innerHeight: window.innerHeight,
21552:         devicePixelRatio: window.devicePixelRatio || 1,
21553:       },
21554:       peers: {
21555:         count: state.peers.size,
21556:         online: [...state.peers.values()].filter((p) => p.online).length,
21557:         pinned: [...state.peers.values()].filter((p) => p.trust === "pinned").length,
21558:         rejected: [...state.peers.values()].filter((p) => p.trust === "rejected").length,
21559:         // Coarse version distribution; specific versions only, no FPs.
21560:         versions: (() => {
21561:           const v = {};
21562:           for (const p of state.peers.values()) {
21563:             const k = p.app_version || "unknown";
21564:             v[k] = (v[k] || 0) + 1;
21565:           }
21566:           return v;
21567:         })(),
21568:       },
21569:       groups: { count: state.groups?.size || 0 },
21570:       messages_in_memory: state.messages.length,
21571:       transfers: { active: state.transfers?.length || 0 },
21572:       unread_total: state.totalUnread || 0,
21573:       debug_errors_recent: (state.debugEntries || [])
21574:         .filter((e) => e.severity === "error")
21575:         .slice(0, 50)
21576:         .map((e) => ({
21577:           severity: e.severity,
21578:           // Strip user-supplied bodies if they leaked in. The first
21579:           // 200 chars of the structured message is enough for triage.
21580:           message: String(e.message || "").slice(0, 200),
21581:           ts: e.ts || e.timestamp || "",
21582:         })),
21583:       runtime_settings: (() => {
21584:         const r = state.runtimeSettings || {};
21585:         // Whitelist only known knob names; drop any user-supplied
21586:         // strings (e.g. download_folder paths) that could identify.
21587:         const allow = [
21588:           "display_read_receipts", "send_read_receipts",
21589:           "send_typing_indicators", "notification_sound",
21590:           "show_message_preview", "keep_image_metadata",
21591:           "voice_skip_preview", "dnd_enabled",
21592:         ];
21593:         const out = {};
21594:         for (const k of allow) if (k in r) out[k] = r[k];
21595:         return out;
21596:       })(),
21597:       status_summary: state.status ? {
21598:         transfers_active: state.status.transfers?.active || 0,
21599:         sessions_open: state.status.performance?.sessions?.open || 0,
21600:         cdc_cache_bytes: state.status.performance?.cdc_cache?.bytes || 0,
21601:         schema_version: state.status.schema_version || null,
21602:         protocol_version: state.status.protocol_version || null,
21603:       } : null,
21604:     };
21605:     return report;
21606:   }
21607:   function _diagnosticReportToText(report) {
21608:     return JSON.stringify(report, null, 2);
21609:   }
21610:   $("#settings-export-diagnostics")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
21611:     const report = await _buildDiagnosticReport();
21612:     const text = _diagnosticReportToText(report);
21613:     const blob = new Blob([text], { type: "application/json" });
21614:     const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
21615:     const a = document.createElement("a");
21616:     a.href = url;
21617:     a.download = `one-link-diagnostics-${new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-").slice(0, 19)}.json`;
21618:     document.body.appendChild(a);
21619:     a.click();
21620:     document.body.removeChild(a);
21621:     URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
21622:     toast("Diagnostic report downloaded. Nothing identifying inside.", "good", 4500);
21623:   });
21624:   $("#settings-copy-diagnostics")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
21625:     const report = await _buildDiagnosticReport();
21626:     const text = _diagnosticReportToText(report);
21627:     try {
21628:       await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
21629:       toast("Diagnostic report copied to clipboard.", "good", 4000);
21630:     } catch {
21631:       toast("Couldn't copy — clipboard access denied.", "bad", 4500);

21660:   // v0.15.0 - PWA install prompt handler. Browsers (Chrome, Edge,
21661:   // Samsung Internet, Brave) fire `beforeinstallprompt` once
21662:   // installability criteria are met (manifest valid + SW registered
21663:   // + served over HTTPS or localhost). We capture the event, prevent
21664:   // the browser's own banner, and show our own button in About.
21665:   // On click, we call .prompt() on the deferred event so the user
21666:   // gets the OS-native install dialog. Firefox + iOS Safari don't
21667:   // fire this event; on those platforms users follow the OS
21668:   // add-to-home-screen path instead.
21669:   state.installPromptEvent = null;
21670:   function _showInstallAffordance() {
21671:     const row = document.querySelector("#install-pwa-row");
21672:     const help = document.querySelector("#install-pwa-help");
21673:     if (row) row.style.display = "";
21674:     if (help) help.style.display = "";
21675:   }
21676:   function _hideInstallAffordance() {
21677:     const row = document.querySelector("#install-pwa-row");
21678:     const help = document.querySelector("#install-pwa-help");
21679:     if (row) row.style.display = "none";
21680:     if (help) help.style.display = "none";
21681:   }
21682:   window.addEventListener("beforeinstallprompt", (e) => {
21683:     // Stop the browser's own banner so we control when + where the
21684:     // prompt appears (in our About pane, not as a top-of-page bar
21685:     // that competes with the chat surface).
21686:     e.preventDefault();
21687:     state.installPromptEvent = e;
21688:     _showInstallAffordance();
21689:   });
21690:   window.addEventListener("appinstalled", () => {
21691:     state.installPromptEvent = null;
21692:     _hideInstallAffordance();
21693:     toast("One Link installed. Open it from your home screen any time.", "good", 5000);
21694:   });
21695:   document.querySelector("#btn-install-pwa")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
21696:     const ev = state.installPromptEvent;
21697:     if (!ev) {
21698:       toast("Install isn't available in this browser. Try Chrome or Edge, or use your browser's 'Add to home screen' option.", "info", 6000);
21699:       return;
21700:     }
21701:     try {
21702:       ev.prompt();
21703:       const choice = await ev.userChoice;
21704:       // Either way, the deferred prompt is single-use; clear it.
21705:       state.installPromptEvent = null;
21706:       if (choice && choice.outcome === "accepted") {
21707:         // appinstalled will fire and hide the affordance. No-op here.
21708:       } else {
21709:         // User dismissed; keep the affordance hidden until a future
21710:         // beforeinstallprompt fires (browser may re-fire after a
21711:         // few page loads).
21712:         _hideInstallAffordance();
21713:       }
21714:     } catch (err) {
21715:       toast(`Install prompt failed: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`, "bad");
21716:     }
21717:   });
21718: 
21719:   // Detect "already running as installed PWA" - Chrome sets the
21720:   // display-mode media query to "standalone" inside the installed
21721:   // shell. Suppress the install affordance so the user isn't told
21722:   // to "install" the thing they're already inside.
21723:   if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(display-mode: standalone)").matches) {
21724:     _hideInstallAffordance();
21725:   }

21727:   // v0.14.8 - Phone diagnostics escape hatch. The Advanced settings
21728:   // pane carries the desktop-only "Open diagnostics" button + the
21729:   // page-wide Ctrl+Shift+D shortcut. Phones have neither (no
21730:   // keyboard, Advanced pane is hidden). Long-pressing the version
21731:   // string in About is the in-app fallback so a phone user can
21732:   // still reach diagnostics if a maintainer asks "open the debug
21733:   // overlay and tell me what you see." 800ms threshold matches
21734:   // platform conventions.
21735:   (function _wirePhoneDiagnosticsLongPress() {
21736:     const target = $("#settings-about-version");
21737:     if (!target) return;
21738:     let timer = null;
21739:     const start = (e) => {
21740:       // Skip non-phone form-factors - desktop has Ctrl+Shift+D and
21741:       // the Advanced pane button. Avoid surprising desktop users
21742:       // who linger on the version string.
21743:       const ff = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-form-factor");
21744:       if (ff !== "phone") return;
21745:       timer = setTimeout(() => {
21746:         timer = null;
21747:         $("#settings-backdrop")?.classList.remove("show");
21748:         openDebugOverlay();
21749:       }, 800);
21750:     };
21751:     const cancel = () => { if (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); timer = null; } };
21752:     target.addEventListener("touchstart", start, { passive: true });
21753:     target.addEventListener("touchend", cancel);
21754:     target.addEventListener("touchmove", cancel);
21755:     target.addEventListener("touchcancel", cancel);
21756:     // Mouse fallback so a tablet on a hybrid form-factor still works.
21757:     target.addEventListener("mousedown", start);
21758:     target.addEventListener("mouseup", cancel);
21759:     target.addEventListener("mouseleave", cancel);
21760:   })();

21766:   async function refreshDebugLog() {
21767:     try {
21768:       const sevSel = $("#debug-severity");
21769:       const sev = sevSel ? sevSel.value : "";
21770:       // Plain string concat (not template literal) so the markup
21771:       // smoke test's URL extractor doesn't capture `${qs}` as a
21772:       // path segment.
21773:       const qs = sev ? "?severity=" + encodeURIComponent(sev) : "";
21774:       const r = await api.get("/api/debug/log" + qs);
21775:       state.debugEntries = r.entries || [];
21776:       // Track highest id we've seen so live WS updates can prepend
21777:       // only the new ones without re-fetching.
21778:       for (const e of state.debugEntries) {
21779:         if (e.id > state.debugLastId) state.debugLastId = e.id;
21780:       }
21781:       renderDebugLog();
21782:       $("#debug-error-count").textContent = state.debugEntries
21783:         .filter(e => e.severity === "error").length;
21784:     } catch (e) {
21785:       console.warn("debug log fetch failed", e);
21786:     }
21787:   }

22040:   function _formatSas(s) {
22041:     s = (s || "").toString().padStart(6, "0");
22042:     return s.slice(0, 3) + " " + s.slice(3);
22043:   }
22044: 
22045:   // v0.7.9 multi-modal SAS verification helpers.
22046:   //
22047:   // The 6-digit SAS we present today (`043 192`) is hard to compare
22048:   // by phone call ("did you say one or seven?"), and 6 digits look a
22049:   // lot like every other 6 digits. v0.7.9 surfaces two derived
22050:   // representations alongside the canonical digits so the user can
22051:   // pick whichever modality fits the situation:
22052:   //
22053:   //   • Audio readback - SpeechSynthesis reads "zero four three,
22054:   //     one nine two" aloud so the OTHER end can echo it back.
22055:   //   • Visual SAS art - a deterministic 6-cell grid of distinct
22056:   //     emoji + colors derived from the SAS. Faster to compare
22057:   //     visually than reading 6 digits twice (similar in spirit to
22058:   //     SSH host-key randomart, Threema's emoji codes).
22059:   //
22060:   // Both are pure functions of the SAS digits - no extra wire data
22061:   // needed. Either side can render them locally.
22062: 
22063:   // 24 distinct, easy-to-distinguish emoji. Avoid skin-tone
22064:   // variants and culturally-loaded symbols. Each maps to a digit
22065:   // pair so a 6-digit SAS yields 6 cells (one per digit, with the
22066:   // symbol selected from `digit*2` mod table.length plus an offset
22067:   // derived from neighbours so two equal digits produce different
22068:   // cells).
22069:   const SAS_ART_EMOJI = [
22070:     "🐶","🐱","🦊","🐼","🐯","🐸",
22071:     "🦋","🌸","🌳","🌈","🌊","🌙",
22072:     "🍎","🍊","🍋","🍇","🍒","🥑",
22073:     "🚀","🛸","⚓","🎵","🔔","⚡",
22074:   ];
22075:   const SAS_ART_BG = [
22076:     "#5b3aa8","#3a6fa8","#3aa87f","#a87f3a","#a83a5b","#5ba83a",
22077:     "#6a3aa8","#3a4aa8","#3aa897","#a8a23a","#a83a8b","#3aa83a",
22078:   ];
22079: 
22080:   function sasArtCells(sas) {
22081:     const s = String(sas || "").padStart(6, "0").slice(0, 6);
22082:     const cells = [];
22083:     for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
22084:       const d = parseInt(s[i], 10) || 0;
22085:       // Mix neighboring digits so two adjacent identical digits
22086:       // don't produce identical cells.
22087:       const left = parseInt(s[(i + 5) % 6], 10) || 0;
22088:       const right = parseInt(s[(i + 1) % 6], 10) || 0;
22089:       const emojiIdx = (d * 7 + left * 3 + i * 11) % SAS_ART_EMOJI.length;
22090:       const bgIdx = (d * 5 + right * 3 + i * 13) % SAS_ART_BG.length;
22091:       cells.push({
22092:         emoji: SAS_ART_EMOJI[emojiIdx],
22093:         bg: SAS_ART_BG[bgIdx],
22094:         digit: s[i],
22095:       });
22096:     }
22097:     return cells;
22098:   }
22099: 
22100:   function renderSasArt(host, sas) {
22101:     if (!host) return;
22102:     host.innerHTML = "";
22103:     if (!sas) {
22104:       host.classList.add("empty");
22105:       return;
22106:     }
22107:     host.classList.remove("empty");
22108:     for (const c of sasArtCells(sas)) {
22109:       const cell = el("div", "cell", c.emoji);
22110:       cell.style.backgroundColor = c.bg;
22111:       cell.title = `digit ${c.digit}`;
22112:       host.appendChild(cell);
22113:     }
22114:   }
22115: 
22116:   function speakSas(sas) {
22117:     if (!("speechSynthesis" in window)) {
22118:       toast("This browser doesn't support speech.", "warn");
22119:       return;
22120:     }
22121:     const s = String(sas || "").padStart(6, "0").slice(0, 6);
22122:     if (!s || s === "000000") {
22123:       toast("Pair code isn't ready yet.", "info");
22124:       return;
22125:     }
22126:     // Cancel any in-flight readback so rapid clicks don't queue.
22127:     window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
22128:     // Spell digit-by-digit with a pause every 3 digits - matches
22129:     // the "043 192" formatting and makes phone-call confirmation
22130:     // bulletproof.
22131:     const words = ["zero","one","two","three","four","five","six","seven","eight","nine"];
22132:     const spoken = s.split("").map((d, i) => {
22133:       const word = words[parseInt(d, 10)] || d;
22134:       return i === 3 ? `, ${word}` : word;
22135:     }).join(" ");
22136:     const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(spoken);
22137:     u.rate = 0.85;
22138:     u.pitch = 1.0;
22139:     window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
22140:   }
22141: 
22142:   // v0.14.7 - phone pair flow: SAS-art primary + shorter button
22143:   // copy. Reading 6 digits twice on a phone screen is fiddly; the
22144:   // 6-cell visual grid is faster to glance-compare. Buttons get a
22145:   // direct "Match" / "Don't match" framing matching what the user
22146:   // is actually being asked.
22147:   function _applyPhonePairFlow() {
22148:     if (document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-form-factor") !== "phone") return;
22149:     const art = document.querySelector("#pair-sas-art");
22150:     if (art) art.style.display = "grid";
22151:     const toggle = document.querySelector("#pair-sas-art-toggle");
22152:     if (toggle) toggle.classList.add("on");
22153:     const m = document.querySelector("#pair-match");
22154:     if (m) m.textContent = "Match";
22155:     const x = document.querySelector("#pair-mismatch");
22156:     if (x) x.textContent = "Don't match";
22157:   }

22159:   async function openPairModal(peer) {
22160:     state.pairing = { peerFp: peer.fingerprint, sas: null, weConfirmed: false };
22161:     pairTitle.textContent = "Pair this device";
22162:     pairExplain.textContent = "Compare the code below with the same code shown on the other device. They must be identical.";
22163:     pairAvatar.textContent = initials(peer.hostname || peer.short_id);
22164:     pairName.textContent = peer.hostname || "(unknown)";
22165:     pairSub.textContent = peer.short_id;
22166:     pairSasEl.textContent = "…";
22167:     renderSasArt($("#pair-sas-art"), null);
22168:     showPairStage("compare");  // v0.8.7
22169:     _applyPhonePairFlow();
22170:     pairBackdrop.classList.add("show");
22171:     // UX audit P0-4: 60s watchdog. If the other device doesn't
22172:     // respond, surface a clear "didn't confirm yet" message
22173:     // instead of hanging silently forever.
22174:     _startPairWatchdog(peer.fingerprint);
22175:     try {
22176:       const res = await api.post(`/api/peers/${peer.fingerprint}/pair`, {});
22177:       state.pairing.sas = res.sas;
22178:       pairSasEl.textContent = _formatSas(res.sas);
22179:       // v0.7.9: SAS art is rendered up-front but kept hidden until
22180:       // the user toggles it. Pre-rendering avoids a flash on toggle.
22181:       renderSasArt($("#pair-sas-art"), res.sas);
22182:     } catch (e) {
22183:       pairSasEl.textContent = "";
22184:       _clearPairWatchdog();
22185:       toast(`Couldn't start pairing. ${e.message || e}`, "bad");
22186:     }
22187:   }
22188: 
22189:   // UX audit P0-4 helper. Watches the pair flow for inactivity.
22190:   // After 60s with the modal still open and pairing not complete,
22191:   // surface a visible "didn't respond" message. closePairModal()
22192:   // also clears this so a successful pair doesn't trigger it.
22193:   let _pairWatchdogTimer = null;
22194:   function _startPairWatchdog(peerFp) {
22195:     _clearPairWatchdog();
22196:     _pairWatchdogTimer = setTimeout(() => {
22197:       if (!state.pairing || state.pairing.peerFp !== peerFp) return;
22198:       if (!pairBackdrop.classList.contains("show")) return;
22199:       pairExplain.textContent = (
22200:         "The other device hasn't confirmed yet. Open One Link on "
22201:         + "that device and look for a matching code, or close this "
22202:         + "and try again."
22203:       );
22204:       try { toast("The other device hasn't responded. You can wait or close and try again.", "warn", 6000); }
22205:       catch (_) {}
22206:     }, 60_000);
22207:   }
22208:   function _clearPairWatchdog() {
22209:     if (_pairWatchdogTimer) {
22210:       clearTimeout(_pairWatchdogTimer);
22211:       _pairWatchdogTimer = null;
22212:     }
22213:   }

22364:   // v0.21.x: search-as-you-type across all settings panes. Empty
22365:   // query restores the full nav + all rows. Non-empty hides any
22366:   // settings-row whose text doesn't include the query (case-fold),
22367:   // hides any pane that has zero matching rows, and hides nav
22368:   // buttons for hidden panes. If the active pane becomes hidden,
22369:   // jump to the first pane that still has matches.
22370:   const _settingsSearchInput = $("#settings-search");
22371:   function _applySettingsSearch(q) {
22372:     const needle = (q || "").trim().toLowerCase();
22373:     const navButtons = document.querySelectorAll(".settings-nav-item");
22374:     const panes = document.querySelectorAll(".settings-pane[data-settings-pane]");
22375:     if (needle === "") {
22376:       // Reset: every row visible, every nav button visible.
22377:       navButtons.forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("nav-hidden"));
22378:       panes.forEach((p) => {
22379:         p.classList.remove("pane-empty");
22380:         p.querySelectorAll(".settings-row, .settings-help, .settings-section-h, .settings-row-block, .profile-avatar-row")
22381:           .forEach((el) => el.classList.remove("row-hidden"));
22382:       });
22383:       _settingsEmptyState(false);
22384:       return;
22385:     }
22386:     const visiblePanes = new Set();
22387:     panes.forEach((pane) => {
22388:       let visibleInPane = 0;
22389:       // Treat each child element as a row group; if its text matches,
22390:       // keep it. Two passes — first include matching elements + their
22391:       // immediate label cluster, then hide the rest.
22392:       const groups = pane.querySelectorAll(":scope > *");
22393:       groups.forEach((group) => {
22394:         const text = (group.textContent || "").toLowerCase();
22395:         if (text.includes(needle)) {
22396:           group.classList.remove("row-hidden");
22397:           visibleInPane++;
22398:         } else {
22399:           group.classList.add("row-hidden");
22400:         }
22401:       });
22402:       // Pane title (h3) almost always matches the pane name; keep it
22403:       // visible when any descendant matched so users don't lose context.
22404:       const h3 = pane.querySelector(":scope > h3");
22405:       if (h3 && visibleInPane > 0) h3.classList.remove("row-hidden");
22406:       if (visibleInPane > 0) {
22407:         pane.classList.remove("pane-empty");
22408:         visiblePanes.add(pane.dataset.settingsPane);
22409:       } else {
22410:         pane.classList.add("pane-empty");
22411:       }
22412:     });
22413:     navButtons.forEach((btn) => {
22414:       const k = btn.dataset.settingsPane;
22415:       // Also keep the nav button visible if the pane name itself
22416:       // matches the query, even when no row inside matched.
22417:       const labelMatches = (btn.textContent || "").toLowerCase().includes(needle);
22418:       if (visiblePanes.has(k) || labelMatches) btn.classList.remove("nav-hidden");
22419:       else btn.classList.add("nav-hidden");
22420:     });
22421:     // If the current active pane is now empty, switch to the first pane
22422:     // that has matches.
22423:     const activePane = document.querySelector(".settings-pane.active");
22424:     if (activePane && activePane.classList.contains("pane-empty")) {
22425:       const firstVisible = [...navButtons].find((b) => !b.classList.contains("nav-hidden"));
22426:       if (firstVisible) switchSettingsPane(firstVisible.dataset.settingsPane);
22427:     }
22428:     _settingsEmptyState(visiblePanes.size === 0);
22429:   }
22430:   function _settingsEmptyState(show) {
22431:     const host = document.querySelector(".settings-pane-host");
22432:     if (!host) return;
22433:     let banner = host.querySelector(".settings-search-empty");
22434:     if (show) {
22435:       if (!banner) {
22436:         banner = document.createElement("div");
22437:         banner.className = "settings-search-empty";
22438:         banner.textContent = "Nothing matches that. Try fewer words.";
22439:         host.appendChild(banner);
22440:       }
22441:       banner.style.display = "";
22442:     } else if (banner) {
22443:       banner.style.display = "none";
22444:     }
22445:   }
22446:   if (_settingsSearchInput) {
22447:     _settingsSearchInput.addEventListener("input", (ev) => {
22448:       _applySettingsSearch(ev.target.value);
22449:     });
22450:     _settingsSearchInput.addEventListener("keydown", (ev) => {
22451:       if (ev.key === "Escape") {
22452:         ev.target.value = "";
22453:         _applySettingsSearch("");
22454:       }
22455:     });
22456:     // Reset search whenever the settings modal opens fresh.
22457:     const settingsBackdrop = document.getElementById("settings-backdrop");
22458:     if (settingsBackdrop) {
22459:       const obs = new MutationObserver(() => {
22460:         if (settingsBackdrop.classList.contains("show")) {
22461:           // Don't clear text; let users return to their query. Just
22462:           // re-apply so newly-rendered content (e.g. lazy-loaded
22463:           // storage pane) honors the current filter.
22464:           _applySettingsSearch(_settingsSearchInput.value);
22465:         }
22466:       });
22467:       obs.observe(settingsBackdrop, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"] });
22468:     }
22469:   }

22471:   // v0.11.6 - fetch + render the per-chat storage breakdown.
22472:   async function refreshStorageUsage() {
22473:     const totalsHost = $("#storage-totals");
22474:     const tableHost = $("#storage-table");
22475:     if (!totalsHost || !tableHost) return;
22476:     totalsHost.innerHTML = `<span class="settings-help">Loading…</span>`;
22477:     let r;
22478:     try {
22479:       r = await api.get("/api/storage/usage");
22480:     } catch (e) {
22481:       totalsHost.innerHTML = `<span class="settings-help">Failed to load: ${errorToastBody(e)}</span>`;
22482:       tableHost.innerHTML = "";
22483:       return;
22484:     }
22485:     const totals = r.totals || {};
22486:     totalsHost.innerHTML = "";
22487:     const stat = (n, lbl) => {
22488:       const wrap = el("div", "stat");
22489:       wrap.appendChild(el("div", "stat-num", n));
22490:       wrap.appendChild(el("div", "stat-lbl", lbl));
22491:       return wrap;
22492:     };
22493:     totalsHost.appendChild(stat(String(totals.chat_count || 0), "chats"));
22494:     totalsHost.appendChild(stat(String(totals.msg_count || 0), "messages"));
22495:     totalsHost.appendChild(stat(fmtBytes(totals.file_bytes || 0), "files"));
22496: 
22497:     tableHost.innerHTML = "";
22498:     const peers = r.peers || [];
22499:     const groups = r.groups || [];
22500:     if (peers.length === 0 && groups.length === 0) {
22501:       tableHost.innerHTML = `<p class="settings-help">No conversations yet.</p>`;
22502:       return;
22503:     }
22504:     const renderRow = (kind, name, msgs, bytes, clearFn) => {
22505:       const row = el("div", `storage-row scope-${kind}`);
22506:       row.appendChild(el("div", "name", name));
22507:       const num = el("div", "stat-num", String(msgs));
22508:       num.appendChild(el("span", "stat-lbl-inline", " msgs"));
22509:       row.appendChild(num);
22510:       const sz = el("div", "stat-num", bytes != null ? fmtBytes(bytes) : "-");
22511:       row.appendChild(sz);
22512:       const btn = el("button", "btn-ghost", "Clear");
22513:       btn.onclick = clearFn;
22514:       row.appendChild(btn);
22515:       tableHost.appendChild(row);
22516:     };
22517:     for (const p of peers) {
22518:       renderRow("peer", p.display_name || p.fingerprint.slice(0, 8),
22519:         p.msg_count, p.file_bytes,
22520:         async () => {
22521:           if (!confirm(
22522:             `Clear local chat history with "${p.display_name}"?\n\n` +
22523:             "Only YOUR copy is deleted."
22524:           )) return;
22525:           try {
22526:             await api.del(`/api/peers/${p.fingerprint}/history`);
22527:             toast("Cleared", "good");
22528:             refreshStorageUsage();
22529:           } catch (e) {
22530:             toast(`Clear didn't work: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad");
22531:           }
22532:         });
22533:     }
22534:     for (const g of groups) {
22535:       renderRow("group", g.name, g.msg_count, null,
22536:         async () => {
22537:           if (!confirm(
22538:             `Clear local chat history for group "${g.name}"?\n\n` +
22539:             "Only YOUR copy is deleted; other members are unaffected."
22540:           )) return;
22541:           try {
22542:             await api.del(`/api/groups/${g.group_id}/history`);
22543:             toast("Cleared", "good");
22544:             refreshStorageUsage();
22545:           } catch (e) {
22546:             toast(`Clear didn't work: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad");
22547:           }
22548:         });
22549:     }
22550:   }

22552:   async function clearTraceScope(scope, label) {
22553:     if (!confirm(
22554:       `Clear ${label} from One Link?\n\n` +
22555:       "This removes local app records only. It will not delete files or folders from your computer."
22556:     )) return;
22557:     try {
22558:       const traceEndpoints = {
22559:         chat: "/api/traces/chat",
22560:         files: "/api/traces/files",
22561:         folders: "/api/traces/folders",
22562:         activity: "/api/traces/activity",
22563:       };
22564:       const endpoint = traceEndpoints[scope];
22565:       if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`unknown trace scope: ${scope}`);
22566:       await api.del(endpoint);
22567:       toast(`${label} cleared`, "good");
22568:       if (scope === "chat") {
22569:         state.messages = [];
22570:         state.groupMessages = [];
22571:         await loadHistory();
22572:       }
22573:       if (scope === "files") {
22574:         state.transfers = [];
22575:         state.transfersById = new Map();
22576:         await refreshFiles();
22577:         await refreshTransfers();
22578:       }
22579:       if (scope === "folders") {
22580:         await refreshFolders();
22581:       }
22582:       if (scope === "activity") {
22583:         state.activityEvents = [];
22584:         await refreshActivityFeed();
22585:         await refreshTransfers();
22586:       }
22587:       refreshStorageUsage();
22588:     } catch (e) {
22589:       toast(`Clear didn't work: ${errorToastBody(e)}`, "bad", 8000);
22590:     }
22591:   }

22628:   // v0.11.1 Profile helpers - avatar preview + bio counter + color

22630:   function _initialsFor(name) {
22631:     if (!name) return "?";

22633:     if (parts.length === 0) return "?";
22634:     if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
22635:     return (parts[0][0] + parts[parts.length - 1][0]).toUpperCase();
22636:   }

22687:   // v0.11.2 mute-status text. Renders into a target node:
22688:   //   "Muted forever"     when muted_until_ms === 0
22689:   //   "Muted until …"     when muted_until_ms > now
22690:   //   "" (cleared)        when not muted
22691:   // Falls back to the legacy boolean if muted_until_ms is null but
22692:   // legacyMuted is true (v0.7.3-era state).
22693:   function _renderMuteStatus(target, mutedUntilMs, legacyMuted) {
22694:     if (!target) return;
22695:     const now = Date.now();
22696:     if (mutedUntilMs == null) {
22697:       target.textContent = legacyMuted ? "Muted (legacy toggle)." : "";
22698:       return;
22699:     }
22700:     if (mutedUntilMs === 0) {
22701:       target.textContent = "Muted until you unmute.";
22702:       return;
22703:     }
22704:     if (mutedUntilMs <= now) {
22705:       target.textContent = "Mute expired.";
22706:       return;
22707:     }
22708:     const d = new Date(mutedUntilMs);
22709:     target.textContent = `Muted until ${d.toLocaleString()}`;
22710:   }

22712:   // v0.11.1 - render blocked devices in Privacy pane. Uses the
22713:   // existing /api/peers endpoint with ?include=rejected so we don't
22714:   // need a new backend route.
22715:   async function refreshBlockedDevicesList() {
22716:     const host = $("#blocked-devices-list");
22717:     if (!host) return;
22718:     let rejected = [];
22719:     try {
22720:       const r = await api.get("/api/peers?include=rejected");
22721:       const all = r.peers || [];
22722:       rejected = all.filter((p) => p.trust === "rejected");
22723:     } catch (e) {
22724:       console.warn("refreshBlockedDevicesList:", e);
22725:     }
22726:     host.innerHTML = "";
22727:     if (rejected.length === 0) {
22728:       const empty = el("p", "settings-help blocked-empty",
22729:         "No blocked devices.");
22730:       host.appendChild(empty);
22731:       return;
22732:     }

23257:     const newSorted = newUrls.slice().sort();

23259:       oldUrls.some((u, i) => u !== newSorted[i]);

23269:           "good",

23274:       }

23353:   function isTypingTarget(t) {
23354:     if (!t) return false;
23355:     if (t.isContentEditable) return true;
23356:     const tag = t.tagName;
23357:     return tag === "INPUT" || tag === "TEXTAREA" || tag === "SELECT";
23358:   }
23359:   function anyModalOpen() {

23361:   }
23362:   function closeAnyModal() {
23363:     document.querySelectorAll(".modal-backdrop.show, .discover-overlay.show")
23364:       .forEach(b => b.classList.remove("show"));
23365:     if (state.discoverOpen) state.discoverOpen = false;

23367:   document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
23368:     // Esc - universal close (search input, modals)
23369:     if (e.key === "Escape") {
23370:       if (searchWrap.classList.contains("open")) {
23371:         searchInput.value = ""; finishSearch();
23372:         searchWrap.classList.remove("open");
23373:         return;
23374:       }
23375:       if (anyModalOpen()) {
23376:         closeAnyModal();
23377:         return;
23378:       }
23379:     }
23380:     // Bypass keyboard shortcuts while typing, except for the special
23381:     // Ctrl-combos that users expect to work everywhere.
23382:     const typing = isTypingTarget(e.target);
23383:     const ctrl = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey;
23384:     // v0.9.3: Ctrl+K is now the GLOBAL command palette (handled in
23385:     // its own listener earlier in the file). Ctrl+F replaces it as
23386:     // the per-conversation search trigger - matches Slack / VS Code
23387:     // / Notion conventions. Without this remap the two handlers
23388:     // would race + the palette would steal focus mid-search.
23389:     if (ctrl && (e.key === "f" || e.key === "F") && !e.shiftKey) {
23390:       // Skip if browser-native find is desirable (no conversation
23391:       // open).
23392:       if (!state.selectedPeer && !state.selectedGroup) return;
23393:       e.preventDefault();
23394:       searchWrap.classList.add("open");
23395:       searchInput.focus();
23396:       return;
23397:     }
23398:     if (ctrl && e.key === "/") {
23399:       e.preventDefault();
23400:       input.focus();
23401:       return;
23402:     }
23403:     // v0.8.1.1: hidden diagnostics - Ctrl+Shift+D.
23404:     if (ctrl && e.shiftKey && (e.key === "d" || e.key === "D")) {
23405:       e.preventDefault();
23406:       openDebugOverlay();
23407:       return;
23408:     }
23409:     if (ctrl && e.key === ",") {
23410:       e.preventDefault();
23411:       $("#btn-settings").click();
23412:       return;
23413:     }
23414:     if (ctrl && (e.key === "n" || e.key === "N")) {
23415:       e.preventDefault();
23416:       $("#open-discover-modal").click();
23417:       return;
23418:     }
23419:     if (ctrl && /^[1-9]$/.test(e.key)) {
23420:       e.preventDefault();
23421:       const peers = [...state.peers.values()];
23422:       const idx = parseInt(e.key, 10) - 1;
23423:       if (peers[idx]) selectPeer(peers[idx].short_id);
23424:       return;
23425:     }
23426:     if (!typing && e.key === "?") {
23427:       e.preventDefault();
23428:       $("#shortcuts-backdrop").classList.add("show");
23429:       return;
23430:     }
23431:   });

23568: // Living Presence Tier α-pre - call UI driver.
23569: // All call actions go through POST /api/v1/calls; state updates
23570: // arrive over the WebSocket as "call_event" tail events.
23571: (function () {
23572:   if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
23573:   const $$ = (sel) => document.querySelector(sel);
23574: 
23575:   // Local state - tracks the currently-shown call surface.
23576:   const callUI = {
23577:     activeCallId: null,
23578:     activeCallPeer: null,
23579:     activeCallPeerFp: null,
23580:     inboundCallId: null,
23581:     inboundCallPeer: null,
23582:     inboundCallPeerFp: null,
23583:     pendingIceCandidates: [],
23584:     appliedIceKeys: new Set(),
23585:     appliedRemoteOfferKeys: new Set(),
23586:     appliedRemoteAnswerKeys: new Set(),
23587:     metricsTimer: null,
23588:     mediaWatchdogTimer: null,
23589:     oneEvents: [],
23590:     localMediaReady: false,
23591:     sdpOfferInFlight: false,
23592:     sdpAnswerInFlight: false,
23593:     lastLocalOfferSdp: "",
23594:     lastLocalAnswerSdp: "",
23595:     lastOfferSendMs: 0,
23596:     lastAnswerSendMs: 0,
23597:     acceptedCallIds: new Set(),
23598:     lastAcceptRetryMs: {},

23605:   async function callApiPost(body) {
23606:     try {
23607:       const r = await fetch("/api/v1/calls", {
23608:         method: "POST",
23609:         headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
23610:         body: JSON.stringify(body),
23611:         credentials: "same-origin",
23612:       });
23613:       return await r.json();
23614:     } catch (_) {
23615:       return { ok: false, user_message: "Couldn't reach the daemon." };
23616:     }
23617:   }
23618: 
23619:   async function callApiList() {
23620:     try {
23621:       const r = await fetch("/api/v1/calls", {
23622:         method: "GET",
23623:         credentials: "same-origin",
23624:         cache: "no-store",
23625:       });
23626:       return await r.json();
23627:     } catch (_) {
23628:       return { calls: [] };
23629:     }
23630:   }
23631: 
23632:   // ── Tier α media - getUserMedia + RTCPeerConnection bring-up.
23633:   // The browser handles audio/video tracks directly via WebRTC SRTP;
23634:   // the daemon brokers SDP exchange. Local media stays on this device
23635:   // until the call ends - the daemon never sees the raw audio/video.
23636:   const media = {
23637:     localStream: null,        // MediaStream from getUserMedia
23638:     remoteStream: null,        // assembled from ontrack events
23639:     pc: null,                  // RTCPeerConnection (when wired)
23640:     iceConfigReady: null,      // Promise that resolves after STUN config is applied
23641:     muted: false,
23642:     cameraOff: false,
23643:   };
23644: 
23645:   async function startLocalMedia(constraints) {
23646:     // Doctrine §3.3.c: permissions are asked at install or first
23647:     // call, never mid-call. If the user denied, fall through to
23648:     // audio-only or text. Never throw.
23649:     if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
23650:       return null;
23651:     }
23652:     try {
23653:       const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(
23654:         constraints || { audio: true, video: true },
23655:       );
23656:       media.localStream = stream;
23657:       attachLocalPreview(stream);
23658:       return stream;
23659:     } catch (_) {
23660:       // Permissions denied / no devices. Try audio-only fallback.
23661:       if (constraints && constraints.video) {
23662:         try {
23663:           const audioOnly = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(
23664:             { audio: true },
23665:           );
23666:           media.localStream = audioOnly;
23667:           // No video preview to show - but the call can still
23668:           // proceed with voice.
23669:           return audioOnly;
23670:         } catch (_) { /* fall through to silent */ }
23671:       }
23672:       return null;
23673:     }
23674:   }
23675: 
23676:   function attachLocalPreview(stream) {
23677:     const v = $$("#call-local-video");
23678:     if (!v) return;
23679:     v.srcObject = stream;
23680:     // Only show the preview pip if we actually have video.
23681:     const hasVideo = stream.getVideoTracks().length > 0;
23682:     v.classList.toggle("show", hasVideo);
23683:     try { v.play(); } catch (_) {}
23684:   }
23685: 
23686:   function attachRemoteStream(stream) {
23687:     media.remoteStream = stream;
23688:     const v = $$("#call-remote-video");
23689:     const a = $$("#call-remote-audio");
23690:     if (v) v.srcObject = stream;
23691:     if (a) a.srcObject = stream;
23692:     const hasVideo = stream.getVideoTracks().length > 0;
23693:     if (v) {
23694:       v.classList.toggle("show", hasVideo);
23695:       try { v.play(); } catch (_) {}
23696:     }
23697:     if (a) {
23698:       try { a.play(); } catch (_) {}
23699:     }
23700:     const surface = $$("#call-active-surface");
23701:     if (surface) surface.classList.toggle("has-remote-video", hasVideo);
23702:   }
