23749:   // Tier β - Reality Engine browser bridge.
23750:   //
23751:   // Every ATTEST_WINDOW_MS (default 1000) the browser hashes the
23752:   // captured audio since the last attestation and POSTs the SHA-256
23753:   // to the daemon as ``action: attest_frame``. The daemon signs the
23754:   // hash with the device's Ed25519 identity key and ships a
23755:   // CALL_FRAME_ATTEST to the peer. The peer's UI sees a fresh
23756:   // Reality dot state every second.
23757:   const ATTEST_WINDOW_MS = 1000;
23758:   const attest = {
23759:     recorder: null,         // MediaRecorder for outbound audio
23760:     pendingChunks: [],      // accumulated Blob chunks for current window
23761:     windowStartMs: 0,
23762:     timer: null,
23763:   };
23764: 
23765:   async function sha256HexFromBlobs(blobs) {
23766:     // Concatenate the array of Blobs into one ArrayBuffer and SHA-256 it.
23767:     const merged = new Blob(blobs);
23768:     const buf = await merged.arrayBuffer();
23769:     const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buf);
23770:     const bytes = new Uint8Array(digest);
23771:     let hex = "";
23772:     for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
23773:       hex += bytes[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
23774:     }
23775:     return hex;
23776:   }
23777: 
23778:   async function closeAttestWindow() {
23779:     if (!callUI.activeCallId) return;
23780:     if (!attest.pendingChunks.length) return;
23781:     const chunks = attest.pendingChunks;
23782:     attest.pendingChunks = [];
23783:     try {
23784:       const hex = await sha256HexFromBlobs(chunks);
23785:       const tsUs = Date.now() * 1000;
23786:       await callApiPost({
23787:         action: "attest_frame",
23788:         call_id: callUI.activeCallId,
23789:         segment_hash_hex: hex,
23790:         timestamp_us: tsUs,
23791:         path_class: "lan",
23792:         recording_state: "none",
23793:       });
23794:     } catch (_) {
23795:       // Failure is non-fatal - the call continues, dot just stays grey.
23796:     }
23797:   }
23798: 
23799:   function startAttestStream(stream) {
23800:     // MediaRecorder is the most browser-friendly way to get a stream
23801:     // of opaque opus chunks we can hash. It uses ondataavailable
23802:     // to emit Blobs at the timeslice cadence we pass.
23803:     if (!window.MediaRecorder || !stream) return;
23804:     try {
23805:       attest.recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, {
23806:         mimeType: "audio/webm; codecs=opus",
23807:       });
23808:     } catch (_) {
23809:       // Browser doesn't support that mimeType - fall back to defaults.
23810:       try { attest.recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream); }
23811:       catch (_) { return; }
23812:     }
23813:     attest.recorder.ondataavailable = (ev) => {
23814:       if (ev.data && ev.data.size > 0) attest.pendingChunks.push(ev.data);
23815:     };
23816:     attest.recorder.start(200);  // emit a chunk every 200ms
23817:     attest.windowStartMs = Date.now();
23818:     attest.timer = setInterval(closeAttestWindow, ATTEST_WINDOW_MS);
23819:   }
23820: 
23821:   function stopAttestStream() {
23822:     if (attest.recorder) {
23823:       try { attest.recorder.stop(); } catch (_) {}
23824:       attest.recorder = null;
23825:     }
23826:     if (attest.timer) {
23827:       clearInterval(attest.timer);
23828:       attest.timer = null;
23829:     }
23830:     attest.pendingChunks = [];
23831:   }
23832: 
23833:   function setupRtcPeerConnection() {
23834:     // Build the RTCPeerConnection + wire signaling transport.
23835:     //
23836:     // SDP + ICE exchange flows through the daemon's /api/v1/calls
23837:     // surface (action: send_sdp_offer / send_sdp_answer /
23838:     // send_ice_candidate). Inbound SDP / ICE arrives as
23839:     // ``call_event`` tail messages over the existing WebSocket.
23840:     if (!window.RTCPeerConnection) return null;
23841:     if (media.pc && media.pc.signalingState !== "closed") return media.pc;
23842:     // May 15 2026 - sovereignty default: NO third-party STUN
23843:     // servers. Same-LAN pairing works without them (host
23844:     // candidates suffice). Cross-NAT pairing requires the user to
23845:     // opt in via Settings → stun_servers, or the operator to set
23846:     // ONE_LINK_STUN_SERVERS on the daemon side. The daemon's
23847:     // ``/api/peer-rtc/ice-config`` endpoint returns whatever the
23848:     // user has configured; we fetch it asynchronously and wire it
23849:     // in. Empty list = host-only ICE = LAN-only fallback.
23850:     const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers: [] });
23851:     // Best-effort fetch of user-configured STUN. Silent on failure
23852:     // - we'd rather degrade to LAN-only than reach a third party.
23853:     media.iceConfigReady = (async () => {
23854:       try {
23855:         const r = await fetch("/api/peer-rtc/ice-config", {
23856:           credentials: "include", cache: "no-store",
23857:         });
23858:         if (!r.ok) return;
23859:         const cfg = await r.json();
23860:         if (Array.isArray(cfg.iceServers) && cfg.iceServers.length > 0) {
23861:           pc.setConfiguration({ iceServers: cfg.iceServers });
23862:         }
23863:       } catch (_) { /* LAN-only fallback is fine */ }
23864:     })();
23865:     pc.ontrack = (ev) => {
23866:       let stream = media.remoteStream;
23867:       if (!stream || (ev.streams && ev.streams[0] && stream !== ev.streams[0])) {
23868:         stream = (ev.streams && ev.streams[0]) || new MediaStream();
23869:       }
23870:       try { stream.addTrack(ev.track); } catch (_) {}
23871:       attachRemoteStream(stream);
23872:       addOneCallEvent(`Remote ${ev.track.kind} connected.`);
23873:       reportCallEvent("remote_track_connected", { media_kind: ev.track.kind });
23874:     };
23875:     pc.onicecandidate = (ev) => {
23876:       // Trickle each candidate to the daemon as it's gathered.
23877:       // ev.candidate === null signals end-of-gathering.
23878:       if (!callUI.activeCallId) return;
23879:       if (ev.candidate === null) {
23880:         callApiPost({
23881:           action: "send_ice_candidate",
23882:           call_id: callUI.activeCallId,
23883:           candidate: "",
23884:           sdp_mid: null,
23885:           sdp_m_line_index: null,
23886:           end_of_candidates: true,
23887:         });
23888:         return;
23889:       }
23890:       callApiPost({
23891:         action: "send_ice_candidate",
23892:         call_id: callUI.activeCallId,
23893:         candidate: ev.candidate.candidate,
23894:         sdp_mid: ev.candidate.sdpMid,
23895:         sdp_m_line_index: ev.candidate.sdpMLineIndex,
23896:         end_of_candidates: false,
23897:       });
23898:     };
23899:     pc.oniceconnectionstatechange = () => {
23900:       // The Immune System reads connection state via vitals; emitted
23901:       // as a metrics ping on the events WebSocket.
23902:       reportCallMetricsOnce();
23903:       addOneCallEvent(`Media route ${pc.iceConnectionState}.`);
23904:       reportCallEvent("ice_state_changed", { state: pc.iceConnectionState });
23905:     };
23906:     pc.onconnectionstatechange = () => {
23907:       reportCallMetricsOnce();
23908:     };
23909:     media.pc = pc;
23910:     return pc;
23911:   }
23912: 
23913:   async function sendLocalSdpOffer() {
23914:     if (!media.pc || !callUI.activeCallId) return;
23915:     if (callUI.sdpOfferInFlight) return;
23916:     try {
23917:       callUI.sdpOfferInFlight = true;
23918:       addOneCallEvent("Preparing media offer...");
23919:       reportCallEvent("offer_preparing");
23920:       if (media.iceConfigReady) await media.iceConfigReady;
23921:       const offer = await media.pc.createOffer();
23922:       await media.pc.setLocalDescription(offer);
23923:       callUI.lastLocalOfferSdp = offer.sdp || "";
23924:       callUI.lastOfferSendMs = Date.now();
23925:       const result = await callApiPost({
23926:         action: "send_sdp_offer",
23927:         call_id: callUI.activeCallId,
23928:         sdp: offer.sdp,
23929:       });
23930:       addOneCallEvent(result && result.ok
23931:         ? "Media offer sent."
23932:         : "Media offer could not reach the other device.");
23933:       reportCallEvent(result && result.ok ? "offer_sent" : "offer_send_failed", {
23934:         ok: !!(result && result.ok),
23935:       });
23936:     } catch (e) {
23937:       addOneCallEvent(`Media offer failed: ${e && e.name ? e.name : "error"}.`);
23938:       reportCallEvent("offer_send_failed", { ok: false });
23939:     } finally {
23940:       callUI.sdpOfferInFlight = false;
23941:     }
23942:   }
23943: 
23944:   async function resendLocalSdpOffer(reason) {
23945:     if (!media.pc || !callUI.activeCallId || callUI.sdpOfferInFlight) return;
23946:     const sdp = (
23947:       callUI.lastLocalOfferSdp
23948:       || (media.pc.localDescription && media.pc.localDescription.type === "offer"
23949:         ? media.pc.localDescription.sdp
23950:         : "")
23951:     );
23952:     if (!sdp) return;
23953:     const now = Date.now();
23954:     if (now - callUI.lastOfferSendMs < 3000) return;
23955:     try {
23956:       callUI.sdpOfferInFlight = true;
23957:       callUI.lastOfferSendMs = now;
23958:       addOneCallEvent("Resending media offer...");
23959:       reportCallEvent("offer_resend", { reason: reason || "watchdog" });
23960:       const result = await callApiPost({
23961:         action: "send_sdp_offer",
23962:         call_id: callUI.activeCallId,
23963:         sdp,
23964:       });
23965:       reportCallEvent(result && result.ok ? "offer_resent" : "offer_resend_failed", {
23966:         ok: !!(result && result.ok),
23967:         reason: reason || "watchdog",
23968:       });
23969:     } catch (_) {
23970:       reportCallEvent("offer_resend_failed", { ok: false, reason: reason || "watchdog" });
23971:     } finally {
23972:       callUI.sdpOfferInFlight = false;
23973:     }
23974:   }
23975: 
23976:   function ensureLocalTracksOnPeerConnection() {
23977:     if (!media.pc || !media.localStream) return false;
23978:     const liveTracks = media.localStream.getTracks()
23979:       .filter((t) => t.readyState === "live");
23980:     if (!liveTracks.length) return false;
23981:     const alreadyAttached = new Set(
23982:       (media.pc.getSenders ? media.pc.getSenders() : [])
23983:         .map((s) => s && s.track)
23984:         .filter(Boolean),
23985:     );
23986:     liveTracks.forEach((track) => {
23987:       if (alreadyAttached.has(track)) return;
23988:       try { media.pc.addTrack(track, media.localStream); } catch (_) {}
23989:     });
23990:     return true;
23991:   }
23992: 
23993:   function sdpKey(sdp) {
23994:     const text = String(sdp || "");
23995:     if (!text) return "";
23996:     return `${text.length}:${text.slice(0, 96)}:${text.slice(-96)}`;
23997:   }

24021:       });
24022:     } catch (e) {

24031:     if (!media.pc || !callUI.activeCallId || callUI.sdpAnswerInFlight) return;
24032:     const sdp = (
24033:       callUI.lastLocalAnswerSdp
24034:       || (media.pc.localDescription && media.pc.localDescription.type === "answer"
24035:         ? media.pc.localDescription.sdp
24036:         : "")

24040:     if (now - callUI.lastAnswerSendMs < 3000) return;
24041:     try {

24044:       addOneCallEvent("Resending media answer...");
24045:       reportCallEvent("answer_resend", { reason: reason || "duplicate_offer" });
24046:       const result = await callApiPost({

24049:         sdp,
24050:       });
24051:       reportCallEvent(result && result.ok ? "answer_resent" : "answer_resend_failed", {
24052:         ok: !!(result && result.ok),
24053:         reason: reason || "duplicate_offer",
24054:       });
24055:     } catch (_) {
24056:       reportCallEvent("answer_resend_failed", { ok: false, reason: reason || "duplicate_offer" });
24057:     } finally {
24058:       callUI.sdpAnswerInFlight = false;

24060:   }

24062:   async function ensureMediaNegotiation(reason) {
24063:     if (!callUI.activeCallId || !media.pc || !media.localStream) return;
24064:     const hasLiveLocal = ensureLocalTracksOnPeerConnection();
24065:     if (!hasLiveLocal) return;
24066:     if (!callUI.localMediaReady) {
24067:       callUI.localMediaReady = true;
24068:       reportCallEvent("local_media_ready", { reason: reason || "watchdog" });
24069:     }
24070:     if (
24071:       media.pc.signalingState === "have-local-offer"
24072:       && media.pc.localDescription
24073:       && media.pc.localDescription.type === "offer"
24074:       && !media.pc.remoteDescription
24075:     ) {
24076:       await resendLocalSdpOffer(reason || "watchdog");
24077:       return;
24078:     }
24079:     if (media.pc.localDescription) return;
24080:     if (media.pc.signalingState && media.pc.signalingState !== "stable") return;
24081:     addOneCallEvent(`Media negotiation starting${reason ? ` (${reason})` : ""}.`);
24082:     reportCallEvent("negotiation_starting", { reason });
24083:     await sendLocalSdpOffer();
24084:   }

24086:   async function applyRemoteSdpOffer(sdp) {
24087:     if (!sdp) return;
24088:     if (!media.pc) setupRtcPeerConnection();
24089:     const key = sdpKey(sdp);
24090:     if (
24091:       key
24092:       && media.pc.localDescription
24093:       && media.pc.localDescription.type === "offer"
24094:       && sdpKey(media.pc.localDescription.sdp) === key
24095:     ) {
24096:       reportCallEvent("remote_offer_echo_ignored");
24097:       await resendLocalSdpOffer("offer_echo");
24098:       return;
24099:     }
24100:     if (key && callUI.appliedRemoteOfferKeys.has(key)) {
24101:       await resendLocalSdpAnswer("duplicate_offer");
24102:       return;
24103:     }
24104:     if (
24105:       media.pc.remoteDescription
24106:       && media.pc.remoteDescription.type === "offer"
24107:       && sdpKey(media.pc.remoteDescription.sdp) === key
24108:     ) {
24109:       if (key) callUI.appliedRemoteOfferKeys.add(key);
24110:       await resendLocalSdpAnswer("duplicate_offer");
24111:       return;
24112:     }
24113:     if (media.pc.signalingState && media.pc.signalingState !== "stable") {
24114:       if (
24115:         media.pc.signalingState === "have-local-offer"
24116:         && media.pc.localDescription
24117:         && media.pc.localDescription.type === "offer"
24118:       ) {
24119:         await resendLocalSdpOffer("offer_collision");
24120:       }
24121:       return;
24122:     }
24123:     try {
24124:       if (key) callUI.appliedRemoteOfferKeys.add(key);
24125:       await media.pc.setRemoteDescription({ type: "offer", sdp });
24126:       await flushPendingIceCandidates();
24127:       await sendLocalSdpAnswer();
24128:     } catch (_) { /* fall through */ }
24129:   }
24130: 
24131:   async function applyRemoteSdpAnswer(sdp) {
24132:     if (!sdp || !media.pc) return;
24133:     const key = sdpKey(sdp);
24134:     if (key && callUI.appliedRemoteAnswerKeys.has(key)) return;
24135:     if (
24136:       media.pc.remoteDescription
24137:       && media.pc.remoteDescription.type === "answer"
24138:       && sdpKey(media.pc.remoteDescription.sdp) === key
24139:     ) {
24140:       if (key) callUI.appliedRemoteAnswerKeys.add(key);
24141:       return;
24142:     }
24143:     if (media.pc.signalingState !== "have-local-offer") return;
24144:     try {
24145:       if (key) callUI.appliedRemoteAnswerKeys.add(key);
24146:       await media.pc.setRemoteDescription({ type: "answer", sdp });
24147:       await flushPendingIceCandidates();
24148:     } catch (_) { /* fall through */ }
24149:   }
24150: 
24151:   async function applyRemoteIceCandidate(data) {
24152:     const iceKey = data && `${data.call_id || callUI.activeCallId || ""}|${data.sdp_mid || ""}|${data.sdp_m_line_index ?? ""}|${data.candidate || ""}|${data.end_of_candidates ? "end" : ""}`;
24153:     if (!media.pc || !media.pc.remoteDescription) {
24154:       if (!iceKey || !callUI.pendingIceCandidates.some((item) => (
24155:         `${item.call_id || callUI.activeCallId || ""}|${item.sdp_mid || ""}|${item.sdp_m_line_index ?? ""}|${item.candidate || ""}|${item.end_of_candidates ? "end" : ""}`
24156:       ) === iceKey)) {
24157:         callUI.pendingIceCandidates.push(data);
24158:       }
24159:       return;
24160:     }
24161:     if (iceKey && callUI.appliedIceKeys.has(iceKey)) return;
24162:     if (iceKey) callUI.appliedIceKeys.add(iceKey);
24163:     // end_of_candidates → addIceCandidate(null) signals completion.
24164:     if (data && data.end_of_candidates) {
24165:       try { await media.pc.addIceCandidate(null); } catch (_) {}
24166:       return;
24167:     }
24168:     try {
24169:       await media.pc.addIceCandidate({
24170:         candidate: data.candidate,
24171:         sdpMid: data.sdp_mid,
24172:         sdpMLineIndex: data.sdp_m_line_index,
24173:       });
24174:     } catch (_) { /* candidate may arrive before remote description */ }
24175:   }
24176: 
24177:   async function flushPendingIceCandidates() {
24178:     if (!media.pc || !media.pc.remoteDescription) return;
24179:     const queued = callUI.pendingIceCandidates.splice(0);
24180:     for (const item of queued) {
24181:       await applyRemoteIceCandidate(item);
24182:     }
24183:   }

24188:       muteBtn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(media.muted));
24189:       muteBtn.textContent = media.muted ? "Unmute" : "Mute";
24190:     }
24191:     const camBtn = $$("#btn-call-camera");
24192:     if (camBtn) {
24193:       camBtn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(media.cameraOff));
24194:       camBtn.textContent = media.cameraOff ? "Camera on" : "Camera";
24195:     }
24196:   }

24218:   async function refreshPrivacyPanel() {
24219:     const body = document.getElementById("privacy-panel-body");

24390:   function _fmtRelTime(ts_ms) {
24391:     if (!ts_ms) return "-";
24392:     const dt = Date.now() - ts_ms;
24393:     if (dt < 60_000) return `${Math.round(dt / 1000)}s ago`;
24394:     if (dt < 3600_000) return `${Math.round(dt / 60_000)}m ago`;
24395:     if (dt < 86_400_000) return `${Math.round(dt / 3600_000)}h ago`;
24396:     return `${Math.round(dt / 86_400_000)}d ago`;
24397:   }

24399:   function escapeText(s) {
24400:     if (s == null) return "";
24401:     const div = document.createElement("div");
24402:     div.textContent = String(s);
24403:     return div.innerHTML;
24404:   }
24405:   function escapeAttr(s) {
24406:     return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/"/g, "&quot;");

24409:   // May 16 2026 - UNIVERSAL MODAL CLOSE LAYER (UX audit P0-1, P0-2,
24410:   // P1-9). Replaces 18+ ad-hoc bindings with one document-level
24411:   // pair of handlers that close ANY visible modal via:
24412:   //   - click on the backdrop element itself (not its children)
24413:   //   - Escape key (closes the topmost visible modal)
24414:   //
24415:   // Recognized overlay shapes:
24416:   //   .modal-backdrop.show          (most modals)
24417:   //   .modal-backdrop[style*=flex]  (onboarding uses inline style)
24418:   //   .discover-overlay.show
24419:   //   .privacy-panel-overlay.show
24420:   //   .call-overlay.show            (call ringing / active)
24421:   //   .voice-overlay[style*=flex]   (voice recording)
24422:   //
24423:   // _closeOverlay(el) does the right thing for each shape +
24424:   // emits a synthetic event so any per-modal cleanup (e.g.
24425:   // stopping a recording, releasing a camera) can listen.
24426:   function _isOverlayVisible(el) {
24427:     if (!el) return false;
24428:     if (el.classList.contains("show")) return true;
24429:     // Onboarding + voice overlay use inline style.display.
24430:     const cs = el.style && el.style.display;
24431:     if (cs && cs !== "none" && cs !== "") return true;
24432:     // Fall back to computed style for anything else.
24433:     try {
24434:       return getComputedStyle(el).display !== "none";
24435:     } catch (_) { return false; }
24436:   }
24437:   function _closeOverlay(el) {
24438:     if (!el) return;
24439:     // Special closers - let the existing code path run if it
24440:     // exposes a documented close function. This preserves
24441:     // side-effects (stop recording, release camera, restore focus
24442:     // to the trigger, etc.).
24443:     if (el.id === "privacy-panel-overlay"
24444:         && typeof _hidePrivacyPanel === "function") {
24445:       _hidePrivacyPanel();
24446:       return;
24447:     }
24448:     if (el.id === "voice-overlay"
24449:         && typeof window.cancelVoiceRecord === "function") {
24450:       window.cancelVoiceRecord();
24451:       return;
24452:     }
24453:     if (el.id === "onboarding-backdrop") {
24454:       el.style.display = "none";
24455:       returnToOneHealthGuideIfPending();
24456:       return;
24457:     }
24458:     // Default: strip the .show class. Works for every other modal.
24459:     el.classList.remove("show");
24460:     // Dispatch a synthetic close event so per-modal cleanup that
24461:     // wants to listen (e.g., stopping a media-gallery slideshow)
24462:     // can do so without rewriting its close button handler.
24463:     try { el.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("ol-modal-closed", { bubbles: true })); }
24464:     catch (_) {}
24465:   }
24466:   // Backdrop-click delegation - close when the user clicks the
24467:   // dark area outside the inner panel.
24468:   document.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
24469:     const t = ev.target;
24470:     if (!t || !(t instanceof Element)) return;
24471:     // Close-X delegation: any element with id ending in "-close"
24472:     // (settings-cancel, device-cancel, conflicts-close, shortcuts-
24473:     // close, debug-close, rdz-help-close, palette-close, privacy-
24474:     // panel-close, etc.) should close its containing overlay. The
24475:     // existing per-button handlers already do this; this is a
24476:     // safety net so a forgotten binding doesn't trap the user.
24477:     const closeBtn = t.closest("[data-modal-close], #privacy-panel-close, "
24478:       + "#palette-close, #shortcuts-close, #rdz-help-close, #debug-close, "
24479:       + "#conflicts-close");
24480:     if (closeBtn) {
24481:       const overlay = closeBtn.closest(
24482:         ".modal-backdrop, .privacy-panel-overlay, .discover-overlay, "
24483:         + ".onboarding-backdrop, .voice-overlay, .call-overlay"
24484:       );
24485:       if (overlay) {
24486:         _closeOverlay(overlay);
24487:         return;
24488:       }
24489:     }
24490:     // Backdrop click: target IS the backdrop element itself.
24491:     if (
24492:       t.classList.contains("modal-backdrop")
24493:       || t.classList.contains("privacy-panel-overlay")
24494:       || t.classList.contains("discover-overlay")
24495:       || t.classList.contains("onboarding-backdrop")
24496:     ) {
24497:       if (_isOverlayVisible(t)) {
24498:         _closeOverlay(t);
24499:         return;
24500:       }
24501:     }
24502:   });

24504:   // Single Esc handler closes the TOPMOST visible overlay.
24505:   // "Topmost" = last visible one in DOM order (highest z-index
24506:   // stacking-context for our use; we always append overlays at
24507:   // body level). This makes Esc work everywhere - pair modal,
24508:   // settings, device drawer, call overlays, every menu -
24509:   // without each modal needing its own listener. Doctrine of
24510:   // invisibility honored: the keyboard-shortcuts modal at
24511:   // L5961 explicitly promises "Esc - close current modal";
24512:   // before this commit that promise was a lie.
24513:   function _topmostVisibleOverlay() {
24514:     const candidates = document.querySelectorAll(
24515:       ".modal-backdrop, .privacy-panel-overlay, .discover-overlay, "
24516:       + ".onboarding-backdrop, .voice-overlay, .call-overlay"
24517:     );
24518:     let last = null;
24519:     for (const el of candidates) {
24520:       if (_isOverlayVisible(el)) last = el;
24521:     }
24522:     return last;
24523:   }
24524:   document.addEventListener("keydown", (ev) => {
24525:     if (ev.key !== "Escape") return;
24526:     const top = _topmostVisibleOverlay();
24527:     if (top) {
24528:       ev.preventDefault();
24529:       _closeOverlay(top);
24530:     }
24531:   });

24533:   document.addEventListener("keydown", (ev) => {

24536:     if (ev.key === "Escape" && isOpen) {
24537:       _hidePrivacyPanel();
24538:       return;

24542:       ev.preventDefault();

24544:         window.openPrivacyPanel();

24549:   // ── Public entry: a contact "Call" button calls this. ──
24550:   window.startLivingPresenceCall = async function (
24551:     peerMasterVkHex, peerLabel, opts,
24552:   ) {
24553:     // May 15 2026 - `opts` is an optional `{ video: boolean }`.
24554:     //   { video: true }  → voice + video call (camera on)
24555:     //   { video: false } → voice-only call (camera off)
24556:     // Default (no opts) preserves the legacy video-on behaviour so
24557:     // older callers don't break.
24558:     const wantVideo = !opts || opts.video !== false;
24559:     const label = peerLabel || peerMasterVkHex.slice(0, 8);
24560:     // v0.21.x: permission preflight. Before triggering the cold
24561:     // browser getUserMedia prompt, run a one-time explainer modal
24562:     // so the user knows WHY the browser is about to ask for mic /
24563:     // camera. Skip when permissions are already granted (returning
24564:     // user) OR when the user has acked the preflight before. On
24565:     // Cancel: abort silently without firing the call_invite.
24566:     const preflight = (
24567:       typeof window._callPermissionPreflight === "function"
24568:         ? window._callPermissionPreflight
24569:         : async () => true
24570:     );
24571:     const proceed = await preflight({ video: wantVideo, peerLabel: label });
24572:     if (!proceed) return;
24573:     callUI.activeCallId = null;
24574:     callUI.activeCallPeer = label;
24575:     callUI.activeCallPeerFp = peerMasterVkHex;
24576:     callUI.activeCallKind = wantVideo ? "video" : "voice";
24577:     showOutgoingOverlay(label, {
24578:       kind: wantVideo ? "video" : "voice",
24579:     });
24580:     addOneCallEvent("Starting secure call path...");
24581:     setupRtcPeerConnection();
24582:     callUI.localMediaReady = false;
24583:     const mediaPromise = startLocalMedia({ audio: true, video: wantVideo });
24584:     const result = await callApiPost({
24585:       action: "initiate",
24586:       peer_master_vk_hex: peerMasterVkHex,
24587:       peer_label: label,
24588:       kind: wantVideo ? "video" : "voice",
24589:     });
24590:     if (!result.ok) {
24591:       if (typeof toast === "function") toast(result.user_message, "warn");
24592:       hideOutgoingOverlay();
24593:       stopAllMedia();
24594:       callUI.activeCallId = null;
24595:       callUI.activeCallPeer = null;
24596:       callUI.activeCallPeerFp = null;
24597:       return;
24598:     }
24599:     callUI.activeCallId = result.call_id;
24600:     // v0.21.x: track this outgoing call so we get a missed-call /
24601:     // ended-call bubble in chat when the daemon's phase_changed
24602:     // event fires for ended/async_capture.
24603:     _trackCallStart(result.call_id, {
24604:       peerLabel: label,
24605:       peerFp: peerMasterVkHex,
24606:       direction: "out",
24607:       kind: wantVideo ? "video" : "voice",
24608:     });
24609:     // Tier α: pre-warm local media so the mic (and optionally the
24610:     // camera) are ready by the time the peer accepts. If
24611:     // permissions are denied, the call still proceeds (text/voice-
24612:     // note fallback). For a voice-only call we skip camera capture
24613:     // entirely so the indicator light doesn't come on.
24614:     const stream = await mediaPromise;
24615:     if (stream && media.pc) {
24616:       stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => {
24617:         try { media.pc.addTrack(t, stream); } catch (_) {}
24618:       });
24619:       // Tier β - start per-window frame attestation (video only;
24620:       // voice-only calls have no video frames to attest).
24621:       if (wantVideo) startAttestStream(stream);
24622:       // Wire the self-preview tile (video only). Lets the caller
24623:       // see exactly what the peer will see when they pick up -
24624:       // catches "wrong camera selected" / "lens cover on" before
24625:       // they answer.
24626:       if (wantVideo) {
24627:         const selfPrev = $$("#call-outgoing-selfpreview");
24628:         if (selfPrev) {
24629:           try { selfPrev.srcObject = stream; } catch (_) {}
24630:         }
24631:       }
24632:       // Apply any pre-call mute / pre-call camera-off the user
24633:       // already chose on the overlay (handlers above only flip
24634:       // the flag; the stream may not have existed yet).
24635:       if (_outgoingState.preMuted) {
24636:         stream.getAudioTracks().forEach((t) => { t.enabled = false; });
24637:       }
24638:       if (_outgoingState.preCamOff) {
24639:         stream.getVideoTracks().forEach((t) => { t.enabled = false; });
24640:       }
24641:     }
24642:     callUI.localMediaReady = true;
24643:     reportCallEvent("local_media_ready", { reason: "start" });
24644:     // Originator creates the SDP offer + sends it now. The peer
24645:     // will respond with an SDP answer once they accept.
24646:     await sendLocalSdpOffer();
24647:   };

24649:   /**
24650:    * Compute peer initials for the avatar circle.
24651:    * "Computer 2" -> "C2"; "Alice" -> "A"; "fc9f0a5f" -> "fc"
24652:    */
24653:   function _peerInitials(label) {
24654:     if (!label) return "?";
24655:     const parts = String(label).trim().split(/\s+/);
24656:     if (parts.length >= 2) {
24657:       return (parts[0][0] + parts[parts.length - 1][0]).toUpperCase();
24658:     }
24659:     return label.length >= 2
24660:       ? (label[0] + label[1]).toUpperCase()
24661:       : label[0].toUpperCase();
24662:   }

24723:     if (kindIcon) kindIcon.textContent = isVideo ? "📹" : "📞";
24724:     if (kindText) kindText.textContent = isVideo ? "Video call" : "Voice call";
24725:     // Hide the pre-camera toggle for voice-only calls.
24726:     if (preCamBtn) preCamBtn.style.display = isVideo ? "" : "none";
24727: 
24728:     _resetOutgoingState();
24729:     if (overlay) {
24730:       overlay.classList.add("show");
24731:       overlay.classList.toggle("has-video", isVideo);
24732:     }
24733:     // v0.21.x: audible ringback while waiting for peer to pick up.
24734:     // Honors quiet hours, peer mute, and notification-sound toggle.
24735:     if (typeof window.startCallRingback === "function") {
24736:       window.startCallRingback({ peer_fp: callUI.activeCallPeerFp });
24737:     }
24738: 
24739:     // Kick off the elapsed-seconds counter (ticks every 1s).
24740:     _outgoingState.startedMs = Date.now();
24741:     const tick = () => {
24742:       const secs = Math.floor((Date.now() - _outgoingState.startedMs) / 1000);
24743:       const elapsed = $$("#call-outgoing-elapsed");
24744:       if (elapsed) elapsed.textContent = _fmtElapsed(secs);

24750:     // instead" fallback so the user can downgrade gracefully.
24751:     _outgoingState.fallbackTimerId = setTimeout(() => {
24752:       const fallback = $$("#call-outgoing-fallback");
24753:       if (fallback) fallback.classList.add("show");
24754:     }, 8000);

24756:     // Probe the daemon's connection-status endpoint to label the
24757:     // route. Refresh every 2.5s while the overlay is up - the
24758:     // detected regime may sharpen as the dial progresses.
24759:     _refreshOutgoingRoute().catch(() => { /* non-fatal */ });
24760:     _outgoingState.routeTimerId = setInterval(() => {
24761:       _refreshOutgoingRoute().catch(() => {});
24762:     }, 2500);
24763:   }
24764: 
24765:   /**
24766:    * Best-effort: pull per-peer regime + latency from /api/peers
24767:    * (the same data the sidebar surfaces) and write a one-liner
24768:    * route label under the status. Silent on failure - the call
24769:    * surface must never block on a network probe.
24770:    */
24771:   async function _refreshOutgoingRoute() {
24772:     try {
24773:       const peerFp = callUI.activeCallPeerFp;
24774:       if (!peerFp) return;
24775:       const r = await fetch("/api/peers", {
24776:         headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
24777:         credentials: "same-origin",
24778:       });
24779:       if (!r.ok) return;
24780:       const body = await r.json();
24781:       const peer = (body.peers || []).find(
24782:         (p) => p.fingerprint === peerFp || p.short_id === peerFp,
24783:       );
24784:       const route = $$("#call-outgoing-route");
24785:       if (!route) return;
24786:       if (!peer) {
24787:         route.textContent = "no route";
24788:         return;
24789:       }
24790:       // Translate the regime code into something a normal user
24791:       // can read at a glance.
24792:       const regimeLabel = (() => {
24793:         const r = peer.regime;
24794:         if (!r) return peer.online ? "connecting…" : "offline";
24795:         if (r === "lan-fast") return "Wi-Fi (LAN)";
24796:         if (r === "lan-medium") return "Wi-Fi";
24797:         if (r === "wan-fast") return "Internet (fast)";
24798:         if (r === "wan-slow") return "Internet (slow)";
24799:         if (r === "relay") return "via relay";
24800:         return r;
24801:       })();
24802:       const latency = peer.latency_ms != null
24803:         ? ` · ${Math.round(peer.latency_ms)} ms`
24804:         : "";
24805:       route.textContent = `${regimeLabel}${latency}`;
24806:     } catch (_) { /* silent - never block the call surface */ }
24807:   }

24814:     if (typeof window.stopCallRing === "function") window.stopCallRing();

25010:   async function reportCallMetricsOnce() {
25011:     if (!callUI.activeCallId || !media.pc) return;
25012:     try {
25013:       const stats = await media.pc.getStats();
25014:       let rttMs = null;
25015:       let jitterMs = null;
25016:       let loss = null;
25017:       let kbps = null;
25018:       stats.forEach((s) => {
25019:         if (s.type === "candidate-pair" && (s.selected || s.nominated)) {
25020:           if (typeof s.currentRoundTripTime === "number") {
25021:             rttMs = Math.round(s.currentRoundTripTime * 1000);
25022:           }
25023:           const bytes = Number(s.availableOutgoingBitrate || 0);
25024:           if (bytes > 0) kbps = Math.round(bytes / 1000);
25025:         }
25026:         if (s.type === "inbound-rtp" && !s.isRemote) {
25027:           if (typeof s.jitter === "number") jitterMs = Math.round(s.jitter * 1000);
25028:           const lost = Number(s.packetsLost || 0);
25029:           const received = Number(s.packetsReceived || 0);
25030:           if (lost + received > 0) loss = lost / (lost + received);
25031:         }
25032:       });
25033:       if (rttMs !== null) updateOneChip("#call-one-rtt", `${rttMs} ms`);
25034:       if (loss !== null) updateOneChip("#call-one-loss", `${Math.round(loss * 100)}%`);
25035:       if (kbps !== null) updateOneChip("#call-one-route", kbps > 5000 ? "Fast local" : "Local");
25036:       const selected = {
25037:         ice_connection_state: media.pc.iceConnectionState || null,
25038:         connection_state: media.pc.connectionState || null,
25039:         ice_gathering_state: media.pc.iceGatheringState || null,
25040:         signaling_state: media.pc.signalingState || null,
25041:         has_local_description: !!media.pc.localDescription,
25042:         has_remote_description: !!media.pc.remoteDescription,
25043:         local_audio_tracks: media.localStream ? media.localStream.getAudioTracks().length : 0,
25044:         local_video_tracks: media.localStream ? media.localStream.getVideoTracks().length : 0,
25045:         local_live_audio_tracks: media.localStream ? media.localStream.getAudioTracks().filter((t) => t.readyState === "live").length : 0,
25046:         local_live_video_tracks: media.localStream ? media.localStream.getVideoTracks().filter((t) => t.readyState === "live").length : 0,
25047:         remote_audio_tracks: media.remoteStream ? media.remoteStream.getAudioTracks().length : 0,
25048:         remote_video_tracks: media.remoteStream ? media.remoteStream.getVideoTracks().length : 0,
25049:         remote_live_audio_tracks: media.remoteStream ? media.remoteStream.getAudioTracks().filter((t) => t.readyState === "live").length : 0,
25050:         remote_live_video_tracks: media.remoteStream ? media.remoteStream.getVideoTracks().filter((t) => t.readyState === "live").length : 0,
25051:       };
25052:       ensureMediaNegotiation("metrics").catch(() => {});
25053:       await callApiPost({
25054:         action: "report_metrics",
25055:         call_id: callUI.activeCallId,
25056:         rtt_ms: rttMs,
25057:         jitter_ms: jitterMs,
25058:         loss_rate: loss,
25059:         bandwidth_estimate_kbps: kbps,
25060:         ...selected,
25061:       });
25062:     } catch (_) {}
25063:   }

25094:   async function acceptInboundCall() {
25095:     if (!callUI.inboundCallId) return;
25096:     const inboundCallId = callUI.inboundCallId;
25097:     const inboundPeer = callUI.inboundCallPeer;
25098:     const inboundPeerFp = callUI.inboundCallPeerFp;
25099:     callUI.acceptedCallIds.add(inboundCallId);
25100:     hideIncomingRing();
25101:     callUI.activeCallId = inboundCallId;
25102:     callUI.activeCallPeer = inboundPeer;
25103:     callUI.activeCallPeerFp = inboundPeerFp;
25104:     showActiveSurface(inboundPeer, "");
25105:     setupRtcPeerConnection();
25106:     callUI.localMediaReady = false;
25107:     const mediaPromise = startLocalMedia({ audio: true, video: true });
25108:     const result = await callApiPost({
25109:       action: "accept", call_id: inboundCallId,
25110:     });
25111:     reportCallEvent(result && result.ok ? "accept_sent" : "accept_failed", {
25112:       ok: !!(result && result.ok),
25113:     });
25114:     if (result.ok) {
25115:       const stream = await mediaPromise;
25116:       if (stream && media.pc) {
25117:         stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => {
25118:           try { media.pc.addTrack(t, stream); } catch (_) {}
25119:         });
25120:         startAttestStream(stream);
25121:       }
25122:       callUI.localMediaReady = true;
25123:       reportCallEvent("local_media_ready", { reason: "accept" });
25124:       if (callUI.pendingRemoteOffer) {
25125:         const offerSdp = callUI.pendingRemoteOffer;
25126:         callUI.pendingRemoteOffer = null;
25127:         await applyRemoteSdpOffer(offerSdp);
25128:       } else {
25129:         await ensureMediaNegotiation("accept");
25130:       }
25131:     } else {
25132:       callUI.acceptedCallIds.delete(inboundCallId);
25133:       callUI.localMediaReady = false;
25134:       hideActiveSurface();
25135:       stopAllMedia();
25136:       callUI.activeCallId = null;
25137:       callUI.activeCallPeer = null;
25138:       callUI.activeCallPeerFp = null;
25139:       if (typeof toast === "function") toast(result.user_message, "warn");
25140:     }
25141:     callUI.inboundCallId = null;
25142:     callUI.inboundCallPeerFp = null;
25143:   }
25144: 
25145:   async function resolveSimultaneousCallIfNeeded(inboundCallId, inboundPeerFp) {
25146:     if (!inboundCallId || !inboundPeerFp) return false;
25147:     if (!callUI.activeCallId || !callUI.activeCallPeerFp) return false;
25148:     if (callUI.activeCallPeerFp !== inboundPeerFp) return false;
25149:     if (callUI.activeCallId === inboundCallId) return false;
25150:     const keepInbound = String(inboundCallId) < String(callUI.activeCallId);
25151:     if (keepInbound) {
25152:       const oldCallId = callUI.activeCallId;
25153:       await callApiPost({ action: "hangup", call_id: oldCallId });
25154:       hideOutgoingOverlay();
25155:       hideActiveSurface();
25156:       stopAllMedia();
25157:       callUI.activeCallId = null;
25158:       await acceptInboundCall();
25159:       return true;
25160:     }
25161:     await callApiPost({ action: "decline", call_id: inboundCallId });
25162:     if (callUI.inboundCallId === inboundCallId) {
25163:       callUI.inboundCallId = null;
25164:       callUI.inboundCallPeer = null;
25165:       callUI.inboundCallPeerFp = null;
25166:     }
25167:     return true;
25168:   }
25169: 
25170:   async function backfillLivingPresenceCalls() {
25171:     const payload = await callApiList();
25172:     const calls = Array.isArray(payload && payload.calls) ? payload.calls : [];
25173:     const visibleCallIds = new Set(calls.map((c) => c && c.call_id).filter(Boolean));
25174:     let inboundStillRinging = false;
25175:     for (const call of calls) {
25176:       if (!call || !call.call_id) continue;
25177:       const phase = String(call.phase || "").toLowerCase();
25178:       const incoming = !!call.is_incoming || call.local_role === "recipient";
25179:       if (incoming && call.pending_sdp_offer && !callUI.pendingRemoteOffer) {
25180:         callUI.pendingRemoteOffer = call.pending_sdp_offer;
25181:       }
25182:       if (!incoming && call.pending_sdp_answer && media.pc) {
25183:         applyRemoteSdpAnswer(call.pending_sdp_answer);
25184:       }
25185:       const pendingIce = Array.isArray(call.pending_ice_candidates)
25186:         ? call.pending_ice_candidates
25187:         : [];
25188:       for (const candidate of pendingIce) {
25189:         await applyRemoteIceCandidate({
25190:           call_id: call.call_id,
25191:           peer_master_vk_hex: call.peer_master_vk_hex,
25192:           ...candidate,
25193:         });
25194:       }
25195:       if (incoming && phase === "ringing") {
25196:         if (
25197:           callUI.acceptedCallIds.has(call.call_id)
25198:           || callUI.activeCallId === call.call_id
25199:         ) {
25200:           inboundStillRinging = callUI.inboundCallId === call.call_id;
25201:           const now = Date.now();
25202:           const last = Number(callUI.lastAcceptRetryMs[call.call_id] || 0);
25203:           if (now - last > 3000) {
25204:             callUI.lastAcceptRetryMs[call.call_id] = now;
25205:             callApiPost({ action: "accept", call_id: call.call_id }).catch(() => {});
25206:             reportCallEvent("accept_resend", { reason: "ringing_backfill" });
25207:           }
25208:           continue;
25209:         }
25210:         inboundStillRinging = true;
25211:         if (callUI.inboundCallId !== call.call_id) {
25212:           callUI.inboundCallId = call.call_id;
25213:           callUI.inboundCallPeer = peerLabelFromCall(call);
25214:           callUI.inboundCallPeerFp = call.peer_master_vk_hex || null;
25215:         }
25216:         if (await resolveSimultaneousCallIfNeeded(
25217:           callUI.inboundCallId,
25218:           callUI.inboundCallPeerFp,
25219:         )) {
25220:           continue;
25221:         }
25222:         showIncomingRing(callUI.inboundCallPeer || peerLabelFromCall(call));
25223:         continue;
25224:       }
25225:       if (phase === "active") {
25226:         callUI.acceptedCallIds.add(call.call_id);
25227:         if (!callUI.activeCallId || callUI.activeCallId === call.call_id) {
25228:           callUI.activeCallId = call.call_id;
25229:           callUI.activeCallPeer = peerLabelFromCall(call);
25230:           callUI.activeCallPeerFp = call.peer_master_vk_hex || callUI.activeCallPeerFp;
25231:           hideOutgoingOverlay();
25232:           hideIncomingRing();
25233:           showActiveSurface(callUI.activeCallPeer, "");
25234:         }
25235:         if (incoming && call.pending_sdp_offer && media.pc) {
25236:           applyRemoteSdpOffer(call.pending_sdp_offer);
25237:         }
25238:         continue;
25239:       }
25240:       if (
25241:         call.call_id === callUI.inboundCallId &&
25242:         (phase === "ended" || phase === "async_capture" || phase === "resumable")
25243:       ) {
25244:         hideIncomingRing();
25245:         callUI.inboundCallId = null;
25246:         callUI.inboundCallPeer = null;
25247:         callUI.inboundCallPeerFp = null;
25248:       }
25249:       if (
25250:         call.call_id === callUI.activeCallId &&
25251:         (phase === "ended" || phase === "async_capture" || phase === "resumable")
25252:       ) {
25253:         hideOutgoingOverlay();
25254:         hideActiveSurface();
25255:         stopAllMedia();
25256:         stopCallTelemetry();
25257:         callUI.activeCallId = null;
25258:         callUI.activeCallPeer = null;
25259:         callUI.activeCallPeerFp = null;
25260:       }
25261:     }
25262:     if (callUI.activeCallId && !visibleCallIds.has(callUI.activeCallId)) {
25263:       hideOutgoingOverlay();
25264:       hideIncomingRing();
25265:       hideActiveSurface();
25266:       stopAllMedia();
25267:       stopCallTelemetry();
25268:       callUI.activeCallId = null;
25269:       callUI.activeCallPeer = null;
25270:       callUI.activeCallPeerFp = null;
25271:       callUI.inboundCallId = null;
25272:       callUI.inboundCallPeer = null;
25273:       callUI.inboundCallPeerFp = null;
25274:     }
25275:     if (callUI.inboundCallId && !inboundStillRinging) {
25276:       const matching = calls.find((c) => c && c.call_id === callUI.inboundCallId);
25277:       if (!matching) {
25278:         hideIncomingRing();
25279:         callUI.inboundCallId = null;
25280:         callUI.inboundCallPeer = null;
25281:         callUI.inboundCallPeerFp = null;
25282:       }
25283:     }
25284:   }

25451:   // v0.21.x: per-call lifecycle tracking so we can synthesize a
25452:   // "missed call" bubble for calls that ended without reaching
25453:   // active phase (peer_declined, invite_timeout, originator
25454:   // cancelled). In-memory; the daemon-side persistence ship will
25455:   // replace this with durable history.
25456:   if (!callUI._callTracking) callUI._callTracking = {};
25457:   function _trackCallStart(callId, info) {
25458:     if (!callId) return;
25459:     callUI._callTracking[callId] = {
25460:       peerLabel: info.peerLabel || "",
25461:       peerFp: info.peerFp || null,
25462:       direction: info.direction || "out",
25463:       kind: info.kind || "voice",
25464:       startedMs: Date.now(),
25465:       reachedActive: false,
25466:       endedAt: null,
25467:     };
25468:   }
25469:   function _markCallActive(callId) {
25470:     const t = callUI._callTracking[callId];
25471:     if (t) t.reachedActive = true;
25472:   }
25473:   function _resolveCallEnded(callId, endCause) {
25474:     const t = callUI._callTracking[callId];
25475:     if (!t || t.endedAt) return;
25476:     t.endedAt = Date.now();
25477:     if (!t.reachedActive) {
25478:       _renderMissedCallBubble(callId, t, endCause);
25479:     } else {
25480:       _renderEndedCallBubble(callId, t, endCause);
25481:     }
25482:     delete callUI._callTracking[callId];
25483:   }
25484:   function _peerShortIdForFp(fp) {
25485:     if (!fp) return null;
25486:     for (const p of state.peers.values()) {
25487:       if (p.fingerprint === fp) return p.short_id;
25488:     }
25489:     return null;
25490:   }
25491:   function _renderMissedCallBubble(callId, t, endCause) {
25492:     const peerShortId = _peerShortIdForFp(t.peerFp) || t.peerFp || "";
25493:     if (!peerShortId) return;
25494:     const labelByCause = {
25495:       peer_declined: "Declined",
25496:       invite_timeout: "No answer",
25497:       user_hangup_local: "Cancelled",
25498:       network_async_conversion: "Could not connect",
25499:     };
25500:     const msg = {
25501:       id: `missed-${callId}`,
25502:       t: "CALL_LOG",
25503:       ts: t.startedMs,
25504:       dir: t.direction === "out" ? "out" : "in",
25505:       peer: peerShortId,
25506:       peer_fp: t.peerFp,
25507:       call_kind: t.kind || "voice",
25508:       call_outcome: "missed",
25509:       call_end_cause: endCause || "",
25510:       call_end_label: labelByCause[endCause] || "No answer",
25511:       call_duration_s: 0,
25512:     };
25513:     state.messages.push(msg);
25514:     if (state.messages.length > 1000) state.messages = state.messages.slice(-800);
25515:     if (msg.peer === state.selectedPeer) renderMessages();
25516:   }
25517:   function _renderEndedCallBubble(callId, t, endCause) {
25518:     const peerShortId = _peerShortIdForFp(t.peerFp) || t.peerFp || "";
25519:     if (!peerShortId) return;
25520:     const durSec = Math.max(0, Math.round((t.endedAt - t.startedMs) / 1000));
25521:     const durLabel = durSec >= 60
25522:       ? `${Math.floor(durSec / 60)}m ${durSec % 60}s`
25523:       : `${durSec}s`;
25524:     const msg = {
25525:       id: `ended-${callId}`,
25526:       t: "CALL_LOG",
25527:       ts: t.startedMs,
25528:       dir: t.direction === "out" ? "out" : "in",
25529:       peer: peerShortId,
25530:       peer_fp: t.peerFp,
25531:       call_kind: t.kind || "voice",
25532:       call_outcome: "ended",
25533:       call_end_cause: endCause || "",
25534:       call_end_label: durLabel,
25535:       call_duration_s: durSec,
25536:     };
25537:     state.messages.push(msg);
25538:     if (state.messages.length > 1000) state.messages = state.messages.slice(-800);
25539:     if (msg.peer === state.selectedPeer) renderMessages();
25540:   }

25542:   window.handleLivingPresenceCallEvent = function (m) {
25543:     if (!m || m.type !== "call_event") return false;
25544:     const tail = m.tail_kind;
25545:     const callId = m.call_id;
25546:     if (tail === "show_ring") {
25547:       if (callUI.acceptedCallIds.has(callId) || callUI.activeCallId === callId) {
25548:         const now = Date.now();
25549:         const last = Number(callUI.lastAcceptRetryMs[callId] || 0);
25550:         if (now - last > 3000) {
25551:           callUI.lastAcceptRetryMs[callId] = now;
25552:           callApiPost({ action: "accept", call_id: callId }).catch(() => {});
25553:           reportCallEvent("accept_resend", { reason: "duplicate_ring" });
25554:         }
25555:         return true;
25556:       }
25557:       callUI.inboundCallId = callId;
25558:       callUI.inboundCallPeer = (m.peer_label || callId.slice(0, 8));
25559:       callUI.inboundCallPeerFp = m.peer_master_vk_hex || null;
25560:       resolveSimultaneousCallIfNeeded(callId, callUI.inboundCallPeerFp);
25561:       _trackCallStart(callId, {
25562:         peerLabel: callUI.inboundCallPeer,
25563:         peerFp: callUI.inboundCallPeerFp,
25564:         direction: "in",
25565:         kind: m.kind || "voice",
25566:       });
25567:       showIncomingRing(callUI.inboundCallPeer);
25568:       return true;
25569:     }
25570:     if (tail === "phase_changed") {
25571:       const phase = m.new_phase;
25572:       if (phase === "active") {
25573:         _markCallActive(callId);
25574:         hideOutgoingOverlay();
25575:         hideIncomingRing();
25576:         if (!callUI.activeCallId) {
25577:           callUI.activeCallId = callId;
25578:           callUI.activeCallPeer = callId.slice(0, 8);
25579:         }
25580:         if (m.peer_master_vk_hex) callUI.activeCallPeerFp = m.peer_master_vk_hex;
25581:         showActiveSurface(callUI.activeCallPeer, "");
25582:         ensureMediaNegotiation("active");
25583:       } else if (phase === "ended" || phase === "async_capture") {
25584:         _resolveCallEnded(callId, m.end_cause || "");
25585:         hideOutgoingOverlay();
25586:         hideIncomingRing();
25587:         hideActiveSurface();
25588:         stopAllMedia();
25589:         if (callUI.activeCallId === callId) callUI.activeCallId = null;
25590:         if (callUI.activeCallId === null) callUI.activeCallPeerFp = null;
25591:       }
25592:       return true;
25593:     }
25594:     if (tail === "recording_state_changed") {
25595:       // recording_state: int (matches RecordingState enum).
25596:       // 3 = RECORDING_MUTUAL. Any other = NOT_RECORDING-ish.
25597:       if (m.recording_state === 3) showRecordingBadge();
25598:       else hideRecordingBadge();
25599:       return true;
25600:     }
25601:     if (tail === "resume_offer_available") {
25602:       // The chat surface will render a resume affordance - no
25603:       // overlay needed here (the call is no longer live).
25604:       if (typeof toast === "function") {
25605:         toast("Voice note saved. You can pick up where you left off.", "info", 4000);
25606:       }
25607:       return true;
25608:     }
25609:     if (tail === "sdp_offer") {
25610:       // Recipient side: peer's SDP offer arrived. Track it so we
25611:       // setRemoteDescription + createAnswer once we accept.
25612:       callUI.pendingRemoteOffer = m.sdp || "";
25613:       addOneCallEvent("Media offer received.");
25614:       reportCallEvent("remote_offer_received");
25615:       if (callUI.activeCallId === callId && media.pc && callUI.localMediaReady) {
25616:         callUI.pendingRemoteOffer = null;
25617:         applyRemoteSdpOffer(m.sdp);
25618:       }
25619:       return true;
25620:     }
25621:     if (tail === "sdp_answer") {
25622:       addOneCallEvent("Media answer received.");
25623:       reportCallEvent("remote_answer_received");
25624:       applyRemoteSdpAnswer(m.sdp);
25625:       return true;
25626:     }
25627:     if (tail === "ice_candidate") {
25628:       applyRemoteIceCandidate(m);
25629:       return true;
25630:     }
25631:     if (tail === "call_refused") {
25632:       hideIncomingRing();
25633:       hideOutgoingOverlay();
25634:       hideActiveSurface();
25635:       stopAllMedia();
25636:       if (callUI.activeCallId === callId) callUI.activeCallId = null;
25637:       if (callUI.inboundCallId === callId) callUI.inboundCallId = null;
25638:       if (typeof toast === "function") {
25639:         toast(m.user_message || "Call refused.", "warn", 6000);
25640:       }
25641:       return true;
25642:     }
25643:     if (tail === "sas_verification_required") {
25644:       const pane = $$("#call-sas-pane");
25645:       const words = $$("#call-sas-words");
25646:       if (words && typeof m.sas_words === "string") {
25647:         words.textContent = m.sas_words;
25648:       }
25649:       if (pane) pane.style.display = "block";
25650:       return true;
25651:     }
25652:     if (tail === "frame_attestation") {
25653:       // Tier β - Reality dot live update.
25654:       // m.verified: bool. m.kind: "Real" | "Repaired" | etc. (UI words).
25655:       if (typeof window.updateRealityDot === "function") {
25656:         window.updateRealityDot({
25657:           callId,
25658:           verified: m.verified,
25659:           kind: m.kind,
25660:           path: m.path,
25661:           recording: m.recording,
25662:         });
25663:       }
25664:       updateOneChip("#call-one-reality", m.verified ? "Real" : "Checked");
25665:       addOneCallEvent(m.verified ? "Reality proof confirmed this media window." : "Reality proof is checking this media.");
25666:       return true;
25667:     }
25668:     // ── Tier δ - Immune System actions ───────────────────────────
25669:     if (tail === "immune_lower_fidelity") {
25670:       // Drop the outbound video bitrate. RTCRtpSender.setParameters
25671:       // takes a few hundred ms to negotiate, but the codec ramp is
25672:       // smooth - no visible glitch.
25673:       const targetKbps = m.target_video_bitrate_kbps || 200;
25674:       updateOneChip("#call-one-engine", "Adaptive");
25675:       addOneCallEvent("One Link lowered video bitrate to keep the call smooth.");
25676:       if (media.pc) {
25677:         media.pc.getSenders().forEach((sender) => {
25678:           if (!sender.track || sender.track.kind !== "video") return;
25679:           try {
25680:             const params = sender.getParameters();
25681:             if (!params.encodings) params.encodings = [{}];
25682:             params.encodings[0].maxBitrate = targetKbps * 1000;
25683:             sender.setParameters(params);
25684:           } catch (_) { /* older browser */ }
25685:         });
25686:       }
25687:       return true;
25688:     }
25689:     if (tail === "immune_voice_only") {
25690:       // Disable the video track entirely. Track stays connected
25691:       // (DTLS-SRTP doesn't churn) but emits black frames.
25692:       if (media.localStream) {
25693:         media.localStream.getVideoTracks().forEach((t) => {
25694:           t.enabled = false;
25695:         });
25696:       }
25697:       updateOneChip("#call-one-engine", "Voice first");
25698:       addOneCallEvent("Camera paused automatically so the conversation stays clear.");
25699:       if (typeof toast === "function" && m.user_message) {
25700:         toast(m.user_message, "info", 5000);
25701:       }
25702:       return true;
25703:     }
25704:     if (tail === "immune_convert_to_async") {
25705:       // The call is converting to a voice-note. Browser stops sending
25706:       // RTC packets + starts capsule MediaRecorder; daemon's lifecycle
25707:       // has already advanced to ASYNC_CAPTURE.
25708:       if (typeof toast === "function" && m.user_message) {
25709:         toast(m.user_message, "info", 8000);
25710:       }
25711:       updateOneChip("#call-one-engine", "Capsule");
25712:       addOneCallEvent("One Link is preserving the conversation as a resumable voice capsule.");
25713:       // Stop ICE / RTC sends - voice-note ride only happens via
25714:       // the daemon's CALL_CAPSULE_CHUNK / capsule_transport path,
25715:       // which the attest stream Blobs already feed.
25716:       // We keep the MediaRecorder running so capsule_transport
25717:       // can pick up the chunks.
25718:       return true;
25719:     }
25720:     if (tail === "immune_prewarm_route") {
25721:       updateOneChip("#call-one-route", "Preparing");
25722:       addOneCallEvent("One Link is warming a stronger path in the background.");
25723:       // Tier ε - no UI yet; the Route Brain owns this. The hook is
25724:       // here so the next tier doesn't need an additional dispatch.
25725:       return true;
25726:     }
25727:     if (tail === "immune_suggest_handoff") {
25728:       updateOneChip("#call-one-engine", "Handoff");
25729:       addOneCallEvent(m.user_message || "One Link found a better device for this call.");
25730:       if (typeof toast === "function" && m.user_message) {
25731:         toast(m.user_message, "info", 8000);
25732:       }
25733:       return true;
25734:     }
25735:     if (tail === "immune_switch_route" || tail === "immune_rekey") {
25736:       updateOneChip("#call-one-route", tail === "immune_rekey" ? "Refreshed" : "Switched");
25737:       addOneCallEvent(tail === "immune_rekey"
25738:         ? "Secure connection refreshed."
25739:         : "One Link moved the call to a better route.");
25740:       // Quiet acks - the underlying switch happens daemon-side.
25741:       return true;
25742:     }
25743:     return false;
25744:   };
25745:   setTimeout(backfillLivingPresenceCalls, 250);
25746:   setInterval(backfillLivingPresenceCalls, 1500);
25747:   document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
25748:     if (!document.hidden) backfillLivingPresenceCalls();
25749:   });
25750: })();
25751: </script>
25752: 
25753: </body>
25754: </html>
<<<CONTENT_END>>>

 540: 
 541: <script>
 542: (() => {
 543:   "use strict";
 544: 
 545:   // ── tiny DOM helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
 546:   const $ = (sel) => document.querySelector(sel);
 547:   const text = (el, s) => { if (el) el.textContent = s; };
 548:   const show = (el) => { if (el) el.hidden = false; };
 549:   const hide = (el) => { if (el) el.hidden = true; };
 550:   const cls = (el, name, on) => { if (el) el.classList.toggle(name, !!on); };
 551: 
 552:   function setPill(state, label) {
 553:     const p = $("#ident-state");
 554:     if (!p) return;
 555:     p.classList.remove("good", "warn", "bad", "dim");
 556:     p.classList.add(state);
 557:     p.textContent = label;
 558:   }
 559: 
 560:   function setDiag(line) {
 561:     const d = $("#diag");
 562:     if (d) d.textContent = line;
 563:   }
 564: 
 565:   // ── encoding helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
 566:   const HEX = "0123456789abcdef";
 567:   function bytesToHex(buf) {
 568:     const u8 = buf instanceof Uint8Array ? buf : new Uint8Array(buf);
 569:     let out = "";
 570:     for (let i = 0; i < u8.length; i++) {
 571:       const b = u8[i];
 572:       out += HEX[b >> 4] + HEX[b & 0xf];
 573:     }
 574:     return out;
 575:   }
 576:   function bytesToB64Url(buf) {
 577:     const u8 = buf instanceof Uint8Array ? buf : new Uint8Array(buf);
 578:     let bin = "";
 579:     for (let i = 0; i < u8.length; i++) bin += String.fromCharCode(u8[i]);
 580:     return btoa(bin)
 581:       .replace(/\+/g, "-")
 582:       .replace(/\//g, "_")
 583:       .replace(/=+$/, "");
 584:   }
 585:   function b64UrlToBytes(s) {
 586:     const b64 = s.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
 587:     const pad = b64.length % 4 ? "=".repeat(4 - (b64.length % 4)) : "";
 588:     const bin = atob(b64 + pad);
 589:     const u8 = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
 590:     for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) u8[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
 591:     return u8;
 592:   }
 593: 
 594:   // ── fingerprint ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 595:   // BLAKE3 isn't in browsers natively. The desktop daemon uses BLAKE3
 596:   // for fingerprints; for browser-peer we tag the hash algorithm so a
 597:   // future ship can vendor a BLAKE3-WASM and produce daemon-compatible
 598:   // fingerprints. v0.16.0: SHA-256, prefixed `sha256:`.
 599:   async function fingerprintOf(pubBytes) {
 600:     const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", pubBytes);
 601:     return "sha256:" + bytesToHex(digest);
 602:   }
 603: 
 604:   // ── OPFS persistence ────────────────────────────────────────────────
 605:   // Identity layout (v0.16.0):
 606:   //   /identity/v1/keypair.json
 607:   //     {
 608:   //       "v": 1,
 609:   //       "alg": "Ed25519",
 610:   //       "created_ms": <int>,
 611:   //       "private_key_jwk": { ... },
 612:   //       "public_key_b64u": "<43 chars base64url>",
 613:   //       "fingerprint": "sha256:<hex>"
 614:   //     }
 615:   // Wrap-key encryption arrives in v0.16.1 (storage layer ship).
 616:   // For now the JWK is plain — same threat model as a desktop
 617:   // identity.key file in `~/.local/share/...`. OPFS is per-origin
 618:   // per-profile, not exfiltratable by a same-machine attacker
 619:   // without code execution as the same user.
 620:   const ID_DIR_NAME = "identity";
 621:   const ID_VERSION_DIR = "v1";
 622:   const ID_FILE = "keypair.json";
 623: 
 624:   async function _opfsRoot() {
 625:     if (!navigator.storage || !navigator.storage.getDirectory) {
 626:       throw new Error("OPFS unavailable in this browser");
 627:     }
 628:     return navigator.storage.getDirectory();
 629:   }
 630: 
 631:   async function _identityDir(create = false) {
 632:     const root = await _opfsRoot();
 633:     const id = await root.getDirectoryHandle(ID_DIR_NAME, { create });
 634:     return id.getDirectoryHandle(ID_VERSION_DIR, { create });
 635:   }
 636: 
 637:   async function readIdentity() {
 638:     let dir;
 639:     try {
 640:       dir = await _identityDir(false);
 641:     } catch (e) {
 642:       return null;
 643:     }
 644:     let fileHandle;
 645:     try {
 646:       fileHandle = await dir.getFileHandle(ID_FILE, { create: false });
 647:     } catch (e) {
 648:       return null;
 649:     }
 650:     const file = await fileHandle.getFile();
 651:     const text = await file.text();
 652:     try {
 653:       return JSON.parse(text);
 654:     } catch (e) {
 655:       return null;
 656:     }
 657:   }
 658: 
 659:   async function writeIdentity(rec) {
 660:     const dir = await _identityDir(true);
 661:     const fileHandle = await dir.getFileHandle(ID_FILE, { create: true });
 662:     const writable = await fileHandle.createWritable();
 663:     await writable.write(JSON.stringify(rec));
 664:     await writable.close();
 665:   }
 666: 
 667:   // v0.16.1 — encryption-at-rest. Opt-in. The on-disk record is
 668:   // either:
 669:   //
 670:   // 1. UNWRAPPED — the same shape readIdentity returns today, with
 671:   //    private_key_jwk in plaintext. Used when the user hasn't
 672:   //    set a passphrase. Same security floor as a plaintext
 673:   //    identity.key on a desktop daemon.
 674:   //
 675:   // 2. WRAPPED — a thin envelope:
 676:   //      {
 677:   //        "v":              1,
 678:   //        "wrapped":        true,
 679:   //        "kdf":            "pbkdf2-sha256",
 680:   //        "kdf_iterations": 600000,
 681:   //        "kdf_salt_b64u":  "<16 bytes salt>",
 682:   //        "iv_b64u":        "<12 bytes AES-GCM IV>",
 683:   //        "ct_b64u":        "<unwrapped record encrypted>",
 684:   //        "fingerprint":    "sha256:<hex>",      // public, OK to leak
 685:   //        "public_key_b64u":"<32 bytes>",        // public, OK to leak
 686:   //        "created_ms":     <int>,
 687:   //        "wrapped_ms":     <int>
 688:   //      }
 689:   //
 690:   // Public material (fingerprint + public key) is left outside the
 691:   // wrap so we can show the device's own identity to the user
 692:   // without unlocking — useful for diagnostics + the unlock UI.
 693:   // The PRIVATE key + the JWK go inside the AES-GCM ciphertext.
 694:   //
 695:   // KDF: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 600,000 iterations (OWASP 2023
 696:   // floor). Native Web Crypto. Argon2id is the eventual upgrade
 697:   // (queued for v0.18.x with proper WASM vendoring); upgrading
 698:   // is mechanical because the envelope carries `kdf` + `kdf_*`
 699:   // params explicitly.
 700:   const KDF_ITERATIONS_DEFAULT = 600000;
 701:   const SALT_BYTES = 16;
 702:   const IV_BYTES = 12; // AES-GCM standard
 703: 
 704:   function _randomBytes(n) {
 705:     const u8 = new Uint8Array(n);
 706:     crypto.getRandomValues(u8);
 707:     return u8;
 708:   }
 709: 
 710:   async function _deriveAesKey(passphrase, salt, iterations) {
 711:     const enc = new TextEncoder();
 712:     const baseKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
 713:       "raw",
 714:       enc.encode(passphrase),
 715:       { name: "PBKDF2" },
 716:       /*extractable=*/false,
 717:       ["deriveKey"],
 718:     );
 719:     return crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
 720:       {
 721:         name: "PBKDF2",
 722:         hash: "SHA-256",
 723:         salt,
 724:         iterations,
 725:       },
 726:       baseKey,
 727:       { name: "AES-GCM", length: 256 },
 728:       /*extractable=*/false,
 729:       ["encrypt", "decrypt"],
 730:     );
 731:   }
 732: 
 733:   async function wrapIdentity(rec, passphrase) {
 734:     if (!passphrase || passphrase.length < 6) {
 735:       throw new Error("passphrase must be at least 6 characters");
 736:     }
 737:     const salt = _randomBytes(SALT_BYTES);
 738:     const iv = _randomBytes(IV_BYTES);
 739:     const iterations = KDF_ITERATIONS_DEFAULT;
 740:     const key = await _deriveAesKey(passphrase, salt, iterations);
 741:     const enc = new TextEncoder();
 742:     const ct = await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
 743:       { name: "AES-GCM", iv },
 744:       key,
 745:       enc.encode(JSON.stringify(rec)),
 746:     );
 747:     return {
 748:       v: 1,
 749:       wrapped: true,
 750:       kdf: "pbkdf2-sha256",
 751:       kdf_iterations: iterations,
 752:       kdf_salt_b64u: bytesToB64Url(salt),
 753:       iv_b64u: bytesToB64Url(iv),
 754:       ct_b64u: bytesToB64Url(new Uint8Array(ct)),
 755:       fingerprint: rec.fingerprint,
 756:       public_key_b64u: rec.public_key_b64u,
 757:       created_ms: rec.created_ms,
 758:       wrapped_ms: Date.now(),
 759:     };
 760:   }
 761: 
 762:   async function unwrapIdentity(envelope, passphrase) {
 763:     if (!envelope || !envelope.wrapped) {
 764:       throw new Error("not a wrapped envelope");
 765:     }
 766:     if (envelope.kdf !== "pbkdf2-sha256") {
 767:       throw new Error(`unsupported kdf: ${envelope.kdf}`);
 768:     }
 769:     const salt = b64UrlToBytes(envelope.kdf_salt_b64u);
 770:     const iv = b64UrlToBytes(envelope.iv_b64u);
 771:     const ct = b64UrlToBytes(envelope.ct_b64u);
 772:     const iterations = envelope.kdf_iterations || KDF_ITERATIONS_DEFAULT;
 773:     const key = await _deriveAesKey(passphrase, salt, iterations);
 774:     let pt;
 775:     try {
 776:       pt = await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
 777:         { name: "AES-GCM", iv },
 778:         key,
 779:         ct,
 780:       );
 781:     } catch (e) {
 782:       // AES-GCM tag-mismatch on bad passphrase — surface as a
 783:       // semantic error, not the raw "bad decrypt" exception.
 784:       throw new Error("wrong passphrase");
 785:     }
 786:     const dec = new TextDecoder();
 787:     const json = dec.decode(pt);
 788:     return JSON.parse(json);
 789:   }
 790: 
 791:   function isWrappedEnvelope(rec) {
 792:     return !!(rec && rec.wrapped === true && rec.ct_b64u);
 793:   }
 794: 
 795:   async function deleteIdentity() {
 796:     const root = await _opfsRoot();
 797:     let dir;
 798:     try {
 799:       dir = await root.getDirectoryHandle(ID_DIR_NAME, { create: false });
 800:     } catch (e) {
 801:       return; // already gone
 802:     }
 803:     // Recursively remove the whole identity tree.
 804:     await root.removeEntry(ID_DIR_NAME, { recursive: true });
 805:   }
 806: 
 807:   // ── identity generation ─────────────────────────────────────────────
 808:   async function generateIdentity() {
 809:     // Web Crypto Ed25519 has been baseline in Chrome 113+/Safari 17+/
 810:     // Firefox 130+. Production deployment targets must match.
 811:     const kp = await crypto.subtle.generateKey(
 812:       { name: "Ed25519" },
 813:       /*extractable=*/true,
 814:       ["sign", "verify"],
 815:     );
 816:     const publicSpki = await crypto.subtle.exportKey("raw", kp.publicKey).catch(() => null)
 817:       || await crypto.subtle.exportKey("spki", kp.publicKey);
 818:     // Ed25519 public is 32 bytes raw; SPKI wraps it in ASN.1. Try
 819:     // raw first (newer browsers); fall back to extracting the
 820:     // 32-byte tail from the 44-byte SPKI prefix.
 821:     const pubBytes = (publicSpki.byteLength === 32)
 822:       ? new Uint8Array(publicSpki)
 823:       : new Uint8Array(publicSpki).slice(-32);
 824:     const privateJwk = await crypto.subtle.exportKey("jwk", kp.privateKey);
 825:     const fp = await fingerprintOf(pubBytes);
 826:     const rec = {
 827:       v: 1,
 828:       alg: "Ed25519",
 829:       created_ms: Date.now(),
 830:       private_key_jwk: privateJwk,
 831:       public_key_b64u: bytesToB64Url(pubBytes),
 832:       fingerprint: fp,
 833:     };
 834:     return rec;
 835:   }
 836: 
 837:   // ── session state ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
 838:   // The unwrapped identity record lives only in memory after unlock.
 839:   // We intentionally don't keep the passphrase in memory — it's
 840:   // discarded after deriving the AES key. To re-encrypt with a new
 841:   // passphrase we need the user to re-enter the old one (proves
 842:   // possession), or to re-wrap from the in-memory `state.rec`.
 843:   const state = {
 844:     rec: null,         // unwrapped identity record (null = locked)
 845:     envelope: null,    // wrapped envelope from disk (null = unwrapped)
 846:   };
 847: 
 848:   function _renderIdentityCard(rec) {
 849:     setPill("good", "ready");
 850:     text($("#ident-status"), "Identity loaded.");
 851:     text($("#ident-fp"), rec.fingerprint);
 852:     text($("#ident-pub"), rec.public_key_b64u);
 853:     show($("#ident-fp-wrap"));
 854:     show($("#ident-pub-wrap"));
 855:     show($("#actions-card"));
 856:     // If we boot from a wrapped envelope, swap the passphrase
 857:     // button labels so the user can REMOVE the passphrase. Setting
 858:     // a new passphrase on already-wrapped is "rotate."
 859:     if (state.envelope) {
 860:       const setBtn = $("#btn-set-passphrase");
 861:       if (setBtn) setBtn.textContent = "Change passphrase";
 862:       show($("#btn-remove-passphrase"));
 863:       text($("#passphrase-help"),
 864:         "Identity is encrypted on disk. Change the passphrase to rotate the wrap " +
 865:         "key, or remove it to switch back to plaintext storage.");
 866:     } else {
 867:       const setBtn = $("#btn-set-passphrase");
 868:       if (setBtn) setBtn.textContent = "Set passphrase";
 869:       hide($("#btn-remove-passphrase"));
 870:     }
 871:   }
 872: 
 873:   async function _showUnlockGate(envelope) {
 874:     // Hide the actions card while locked — user can't export or
 875:     // reset until unlocked. Reset is reachable via the unlock-failure
 876:     // path (via prompt), which we'll route below.
 877:     hide($("#actions-card"));
 878:     show($("#unlock-card"));
 879:     text($("#ident-status"),
 880:       "Identity exists on disk but is encrypted. Enter your passphrase to unlock.");
 881:     setPill("warn", "locked");
 882:     text($("#ident-fp"), envelope.fingerprint);
 883:     text($("#ident-pub"), envelope.public_key_b64u);
 884:     show($("#ident-fp-wrap"));
 885:     show($("#ident-pub-wrap"));
 886:     setDiag(
 887:       `opfs:identity/v1/keypair.json · wrapped ` +
 888:       `${envelope.wrapped_ms ? new Date(envelope.wrapped_ms).toLocaleString() : ""}`
 889:     );
 890:     // Auto-focus the passphrase input on phones too — the
 891:     // virtual keyboard pops if focus + click; otherwise focus
 892:     // alone is enough on desktop.
 893:     const input = $("#unlock-passphrase");
 894:     if (input) {
 895:       try { input.focus(); } catch {}
 896:     }
 897:   }
 898: 
 899:   async function _unlockWith(passphrase) {
 900:     if (!state.envelope) return;
 901:     let rec;
 902:     try {
 903:       rec = await unwrapIdentity(state.envelope, passphrase);
 904:     } catch (e) {
 905:       throw e;
 906:     }
 907:     state.rec = rec;
 908:     hide($("#unlock-card"));
 909:     _renderIdentityCard(rec);
 910:   }
 911: 
 912:   // ── boot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 913:   async function boot() {
 914:     // Quick-fail UX: detect missing platform features early so the
 915:     // user gets a clear message instead of a JS console error.
 916:     // v0.20.4 — also surface insecure-context as the FIRST check;
 917:     // many phones land here with crypto.subtle present but
 918:     // restricted, and "no web crypto" is misleading in that case.
 919:     if (!window.isSecureContext) {
 920:       state.boot_error_msg = "page loaded over plain HTTP; Web Crypto needs HTTPS";
 921:       setPill("bad", "insecure context");
 922:       text($("#ident-status"),
 923:         "Browsers block Web Crypto on plain HTTP to a LAN address. " +
 924:         "Reopen the QR on your laptop to get an https:// link.");
 925:       return;
 926:     }
 927:     if (!window.crypto || !crypto.subtle) {
 928:       state.boot_error_msg = "Web Crypto not exposed";
 929:       setPill("bad", "no web crypto");
 930:       text($("#ident-status"), "This browser doesn't expose Web Crypto. Try Chrome, Edge, Safari 17+, or Firefox 130+.");
 931:       return;
 932:     }
 933:     if (!navigator.storage || !navigator.storage.getDirectory) {
 934:       state.boot_error_msg = "OPFS not exposed";
 935:       setPill("bad", "no opfs");
 936:       text($("#ident-status"),
 937:         "This browser doesn't expose OPFS. Identity needs persistent storage. Try Chrome 86+, Edge 86+, Safari 15.2+, or Firefox 111+.");
 938:       return;
 939:     }
 940: 
 941:     setDiag("checking opfs identity…");
 942:     let onDisk = null;
 943:     try {
 944:       onDisk = await readIdentity();
 945:     } catch (e) {
 946:       setDiag(`opfs read failed: ${e && e.message ? e.message : e}`);
 947:     }
 948: 
 949:     // Wrapped envelope on disk → show unlock gate. Boot stops here
 950:     // until the user enters the passphrase.
 951:     if (isWrappedEnvelope(onDisk)) {
 952:       state.envelope = onDisk;
 953:       await _showUnlockGate(onDisk);
 954:       return;
 955:     }
 956: 
 957:     // Unwrapped record on disk (legacy or never-wrapped) → use it.
 958:     if (onDisk && onDisk.fingerprint && onDisk.public_key_b64u && onDisk.private_key_jwk) {
 959:       state.rec = onDisk;
 960:       _renderIdentityCard(onDisk);
 961:       setDiag(`opfs:identity/v1/keypair.json · created ${new Date(onDisk.created_ms).toLocaleString()}`);
 962:       return;
 963:     }
 964: 
 965:     setPill("warn", "generating");
 966:     text($("#ident-status"), "Generating a fresh keypair…");
 967:     setDiag("calling crypto.subtle.generateKey…");
 968:     let rec;
 969:     try {
 970:       rec = await generateIdentity();
 971:     } catch (e) {
 972:       // v0.20.4 — stash the actual error so the autopair flow can
 973:       // surface it instead of the generic "no identity in 12s"
 974:       // mystery. Common culprits: Safari < 17 (no Ed25519 support),
 975:       // Firefox < 130 (Ed25519 still behind a flag).
 976:       const msg = e && e.message ? e.message : String(e);
 977:       state.boot_error_msg = `keygen failed: ${msg}`;
 978:       setPill("bad", "keygen failed");
 979:       text($("#ident-status"),
 980:         `Couldn't generate a keypair: ${msg}. ` +
 981:         "Ed25519 needs Chrome 113+/Safari 17+/Firefox 130+.");
 982:       return;
 983:     }
 984:     setDiag("writing identity to OPFS…");
 985:     try {
 986:       await writeIdentity(rec);
 987:     } catch (e) {
 988:       setPill("bad", "opfs write failed");
 989:       text($("#ident-status"),
 990:         `Generated keypair but couldn't persist: ${e && e.message ? e.message : e}. ` +
 991:         "Identity won't survive a refresh.");
 992:     }
 993:     state.rec = rec;
 994:     _renderIdentityCard(rec);
 995:     setDiag(`opfs:identity/v1/keypair.json · just created`);
 996:   }
